english: The POC is still awaiting a tentative list of athletes who will compete in men’s 3×3 and 5×5 basketball, weight lifting, and jiu jitsu.

text: Ginalantaw nga pagabug-usan sang 874 ang delegation sang Pilipinas sa diin 177 diri ang team officials (coaches, team managers ukon NSA representatives), kag 20 ang myembro sang medical team (doctors, nurses kag masseurs/therapists) kag administrative staff.
english: The Philippine delegation is expected to consist of 874 of which 177 are team officials (coaches, team managers or NSA representatives), and 20 are members of the medical team (doctors, nurses and masseurs/therapists) and administrative staff.

text: Ginadumilian sang Procurement Service – Department of Budget and Management (PS-DBM) ang siyam ka kumpanya nga may koneksyon kay Pacifico kag Sarah Discaya matapos kanselahon ang ila Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System (PhilGEPS) membership bangud sang pagkabawi sang ila lisensya halin sa Philippine Contractors Accreditation Board (PCAB).
english: The Procurement Service – Department of Budget and Management (PS-DBM) is banning nine companies connected to Pacifico and Sarah Discaya after they canceled their Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System (PhilGEPS) membership due to the revocation of their license from the Philippine Contractors Board (APCAB).

text:
Lakip sa mga kumpanya nga ginadumilian amo ang:

Suno sa New Government Procurement Act (NGPA), ang PCAB license isa ka importante nga rekisito para sa PhilGEPS membership.
english:
Among the firms banned are:

According to the New Government Procurement Act (NGPA), PCAB license is an essential requirement for PhilGEPS membership.

text: Kun indi mapadayon ang lisensya, ang isa ka kumpanya ginadiskwalipikar sa pagpasakop sa bidding para sa mga kontrata sang gobyerno.
english: If the license is not maintained, a company is disqualified from bidding for government contracts.

text: Ginpahayag ni PS-DBM Executive Director Gemaries Caong nga ang PhilGEPS platinum membership amo ang nagapanguna nga rekisito para sa mga proyekto nga nagaagi sa competitive bidding, samtang ang PCAB license kinahanglanon para sa iban nga procurement mode pareho sang small value projects kag emergency cases.
english: PS-DBM Executive Director Gemaries Caong said PhilGEPS platinum membership is the primary requirement for projects that go through competitive bidding, while PCAB license is required for other procurement modes such as small value projects and emergency cases.

text: Gindugang pa ni Caong nga ang mga nasambit nga kumpanya indi na makaintra sa civil works projects kun ang procurement mode nagakinahanglan sang PhilGEPS platinum ukon PCAB license.
english: Caong added that these companies will no longer be able to participate in civil works projects if the procurement mode requires a PhilGEPS platinum or PCAB license.

text: Ang pamilya Discaya isa sa mga ginapangusisa subong, nga kaangtanan sa ginadudahan nga maanomalya nga mga flood-control projects sang gobyerno.
english: The Discaya family is one of those currently under investigation, in connection with suspected anomalous government flood-control projects.

text: ISA ka “surprise announcement” ang ginpahayag ni DILG Sec.
english: A “surprise announcement” was made by DILG Sec.

text: Benjamin  Abalos Jr.
english: Benjamin Abalos Jr.

text: sa isa ka presscon sadtong Enero 4.
english: at a presscon on January 4.

text: Nanawagan siya diri sa mga matag-as nga mga opisyales (halin koronel tubtub heneral) sang PNP agud mag-sumiter sang ila courtesy resignation.
english: He called on senior officials (from colonel to general) of the PNP to submit their courtesy resignation.

text: Mga 1,000 ini sila tanan, sunu sa isa ka balita.
english: There are about 1,000 of them in all, according to one news report.

text: Sugot sini si PNP Chief General Rodolfo Azurin Jr, kag wala nagpaulihi ini sa pag-sumiter sang iya courtesy resignation sadtong Enero 5.
english: PNP Chief General Rodolfo Azurin Jr. agreed, and he did not hesitate to submit his courtesy resignation on January 5.

text: Upod diri ni Azurin sanday Deputy Chief for Administration, Lt.
english: Azurin was accompanied by Deputy Chief for Administration, Lt.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Rhodel Sermonia, Deputy Chief for Operations, Lt.
english: Rhodel Sermonia, Deputy Chief for Operations, Lt.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Benjamin Santos Jr., si Chief of Directorial Maj.
english: Benjamin Santos Jr., Chief of Directorial Maj.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Michael John Dubria, kag si PNP Internal Affairs Service Director Alfegar Triambulo.
english: Michael John Dubria, and PNP Internal Affairs Service Director Alfegar Triambulo.

text: Tungod sa sining courtesy resignation ni Azurin, ginalauman nga tanan sini sa ila magatuman sa sining panawagan ni Abalos.
english: Given Azurin's courtesy resignation, it is expected that all of them will comply with Abalos' call.

text: In fact, una gid nag-sumiter sang ila courtesy resignation ang 2 ka heneral kag 28 ka mga koronel sang PRO-7 (Central Visayas) sadtong Enero 6.
english: In fact, 2 generals and 28 colonels of PRO-7 (Central Visayas) first submitted their courtesy resignation on January 6.

text: Ginapangunahan ini ni PRO-7 chief Brigadier General Jerry Bearis.
english: It is led by PRO-7 chief Brigadier General Jerry Bearis.

text: Sunu kay Bearis, lakip diri ang Deputy Regional Director for Administration, Deputy Regional Director for Operation, kag ang Deputy Regional Chief and Directorial Staff.
english: According to Bearis, this includes the Deputy Regional Director for Administration, Deputy Regional Director for Operation, and the Deputy Regional Chief and Directorial Staff.

text: Diri sa PRO-6 (Western Visayas), may mga 29 ka mga heneral kag koronel nga gina-expect man nga mag-sumiter sang ila mga courtesy resignation.
english: Here in PRO-6 (Western Visayas), there are about 29 generals and colonels who are also expected to submit their courtesy resignations.

text:
***

Ngaa sila gid nga tanan ang kinahanglan mag-sumiter sang ila courtesy resignation?
english:
***

Why do they really all have to submit their courtesy resignation?

text: Sunu kay Abalos, ina tungod nabutang gid ang kredibilidad sang bug-os nga PNP sa paglamita sini sa ila sa droga.
english: According to Abalos, this is because the credibility of the entire PNP has been put in place in its involvement in drugs.

text: Labi na gid kay ang na-involver amo ang mga matag-as nga mga opisyales sang pamunuan sang PNP.
english: Especially since those involved are senior officials of the PNP leadership.

text: Sa matandaan pa, sa isa ka regular nga buy-bust operation sa Tondo, Manila, gintudlo gid sang suspect si Police Master Sergeant Rodolfo Mayo Jr.
english: In a regular buy-bust operation in Tondo, Manila, the suspect pointed out Police Master Sergeant Rodolfo Mayo Jr.

text: sang PDEA bilang isa sa mga mayor-mayor sa pagpalapta sang droga sa pungsod.
english: of the PDEA as one of the major drug traffickers in the country.

text: Gintultol siya kag nakita gid sa isa ka storage area upod ang 990 kilos sang shabu.
english: He was tracked down and found in a storage area with 990 kilos of shabu.

text: Nagwa man sa imbestigasyon ang rebelasyon nga may pila gid kay mga heneral kag koronel ang naangot gali sa illegal drug trade.
english: The investigation also revealed that some of the generals and colonels were involved in the illegal drug trade.

text: Daw indi pa magpati si Abalos, apang ang iya kabalaka nagtulod gid sa iya agud mag–apelar sa ining matag-as nga mga opisyal sang PNP nga mag-sumiter sang ila courtesy resignation.
english: Abalos did not seem to believe it, but his concern prompted him to appeal to these senior PNP officials to submit their courtesy resignation.

text: May bendisyon ini ni Presidente BBM.
english: It has the blessing of President BBM.

text: Pila pa man lang ang na-suspetsuhan sa ila, sunu kay Abalos, apang dalhon na gid lang ang iban tungod ang problema sang kredibilidad sang PNP nasandig gid sa pagpamuno sang mga heneral kag koronel.
english: Only a few of them are suspected, Abalos said, but the rest will be brought because the problem of the credibility of the PNP depends on the leadership of generals and colonels.

text: Imagine, siling niya, kon sin-o pa gali ang dapat mag-protejer sa mga pumuluyo batok sa droga, sila pa gali ang promotor.
english: Imagine, he said, who else should protect the people against drugs, they are the promoters.

text: In fact, nagapati siya nga ang courtesy resignation gid lang ang pinakamadasig nga paagi agud masabat ang problema sang PNP sa droga sa pungsod.
english: In fact, he believes that courtesy resignation is the fastest way to solve the PNP's drug problem in the country.

text: Gani kinahanglan na gid ang “thorough cleansing” sang PNP, pamat-ud pa niya.
english: Therefore, the PNP needs a thorough cleansing, he said.

text:
***

Kumporme kita sa ginapangayo ni Abalos nga mag-sumiter sing courtesy resignation ang ining mga matag-as nga mga opisyal sang PNP, basta matuman lang ang kasuguan.
english:
***

We agree with Abalos' request that these senior PNP officials submit courtesy resignations, as long as the law is complied with.

text: Kag mapatuman lang ang “due process” kag wala sang paglabag sa Civil Sevice Law, among others.
english: And just implement the “due process” and no violation of the Civil Service Law, among others.

text: Sa Idalom sang aton Bill of Rights, ginapaseguro diri ang “due process of law”, partikular ang kinamatarong sang akusado sa “presumption” nga inosente siya tubtub mapamatud-an gid nga “guilty”, kon guilty gid man, siya sang competent court.
english: Under our Bill of Rights, it ensures due process of law, particularly the right of the accused to the presumption of innocence until proven guilty, if guilty, by the competent court.

text: Ang Civil Service Law naman nagasiling nga ang tanan nga empleyado sa gobyerno may kinamatarong sa security of Tenure.
english: The Civil Service Law on the other hand states that all government employees are entitled to security of Tenure.

text: In other words, indi sila mapahalin (dismissed) sa serbisyo except for “just or authorized cause, kag “only after due process”.
english: In other words, they cannot be dismissed from service except for “just or authorized cause, and “only after due process”.

text:
***

Natuman bala ini nga mga requisitos sang layi sa  panawagan ni Abalos agud mag-sumiter sang courtesy resignation ining mga high ranking PNP officials?
english:
***

Did Abalos' call for these high ranking PNP officials to submit courtesy resignation meet the requirements of the law?

text: Sa aton ordinaryo nga paghangop, hue!
english: In our ordinary understanding, hue!

text: Sunu kay Abalos ang courtesy resignation nila wala man nagakahulugan nga na-dismiss na sila.
english: Abalos said their courtesy resignation does not mean that they have been dismissed.

text: Pa-imbestigahan pa sila kon ano gid ang ila involvement sa illegal drug trade kag kon ano gid kadalom sang ila involvement tubtub mahusgaran sila  kag kon ano ang bagay nga pamatbat sa ila.
english: They will be investigated as to their involvement in the illegal drug trade and the depth of their involvement until they are tried and what is the appropriate explanation for them.

text: Meantime, makapabilin pa anay sila sa serbisyo.
english: Meantime, they can stay in service.

text: May natukod na nga Committee of 5 agud maghimo sini nga imbestigasyon sa sining mga matag-as nga opisyales sang PNP.
english: A Committee of 5 has been formed to conduct this investigation into these senior PNP officials.

text: Isa dira si Baguio City mayor Benjamin Magalong, nga retired na bilang Director sang Criminal Investigation Detection Group./PN
english: One of them is Baguio City Mayor Benjamin Magalong, who has retired as Director of the Criminal Investigation Detection Group./PN

english: 53 in the latest Women's Tennis Association rankings this Monday.

text: Oct.

text: Antes sini, naglab-ot si Eala sa quarterfinals sang Suzhou WTA 125.
english: Before that, Eala reached the quarterfinals of Suzhou WTA 125.

text: Nag-intra man siya sa uhan Open qualifiers kag opening round sang Kinoshita Group Japan Open.
english: He also participated in the uhan Open qualifiers and opening round of the Kinoshita Group Japan Open.

text: Nagpasaka sang formal complaint ang P-pop girl group nga BINI sa wala pa ginhingadlan nga indibidwal.
english: P-pop girl group BINI filed a formal complaint against the unnamed individual.

text: Base ini sa screenshot nga gin-share sa social media sang ila legal counsel nga Atty. Joji Alonso, Agusto 14, kun sa diin makit-an ang kabahin sang legal document nga may pangalan sang mga myembro sang BINI sa isa ka unspecified case.
english: This is based on a screenshot shared on social media by their legal counsel Atty. Joji Alonso, August 14, where part of the legal document with the names of BINI members in an unspecified case was found.

text: Ang ginlista nga pangalan sang complainants amo sanday Gwenth Apulli, Mariah Queen Arceta, Sheena Mae Catacutan, Mikhaela Janna Lim, Mary Loi Yves Ricalde, Jhoanna Christine Robles, Stacey Aubrey Sevilleja kag Ma.
english: The named complainants are Gwenth Apulli, Mariah Queen Arceta, Sheena Mae Catacutan, Mikhaela Janna Lim, Mary Loi Yves Ricalde, Jhoanna Christine Robles, Stacey Aubrey Sevilleja and Ma.

text: Nicolette Vergara.
english: Nicolette Vergara.

text: Apisar wala ginpakita sa picture ang pangalan sang respondent, madasig ang espekulasyon sang netizens nga posible nga ang internet personality nga si Christian “Xian” Gaza ang ginreklamo.
english: Although the name of the respondent was not shown in the picture, netizens were quick to speculate that it was possible that internet personality Christian “Xian” Gaza was complained about.

text: Sang nagligad nga adlaw, may gin-post ang self-proclaimed “Pambansang Marites na Lalaki” nga naga-target sa isa ka myembro sang BINI.
english: The other day, the self-proclaimed “Pambansang Marites na Lalaki” posted something targeting a BINI member.

text: “Mga Gen Z, okay lang makipag-kanttan as long as gumagamit kayo palagi ng condom upang hindi makabuo.
english: “Gen Z, it's okay to have sex as long as you always use a condom so you don't get pregnant.

text: Lalong-lalo na doon sa isang member ng BINI na sobrang palaiyt,” post sini sa social media.
english: Lalong-lalo na doon sa isang member ng BINI na sobrang palaiyt,” post sini sa social media.

text: Kilala si Gaza nga self-confessed investment scammer.
english: Gaza is known as a self-confessed investment scammer.

text: Sang 2018, na-convict siya sa 11 counts sang paglapas sa Bouncing Check Law nga naangot sa ₱2.6 million investment scheme.
english: In 2018, he was convicted of 11 counts of violation of the Bouncing Check Law linked to a ₱2.6 million investment scheme.

text: Bantog naman ang P-pop girl group sa mga hits nga “Pantropiko,” “Karera,” “Lagi,” “Huwag Muna Tayong Umuwi,” “Cherry on Top” and “Blink Twice,” kag iban pa.#
english: The P-pop girl group is famous for its hits “Pantropiko,” “Karera,” “Lagi,” “Huwag Muna Tayong Umuwi,” “Cherry on Top” and “Blink Twice,” among others.

text: Nalipay si former President Rodrigo Duterte sang nahibaluan sini nga nagdaog siya sa iya pagpadalagan bilang alkalde sa Davao City.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte was happy to learn that he won his race for mayor of Davao City.

text: Suno ini sa iya utod nga si Bong Duterte nga nagbisita sa anay punong ehekutibo sa detention facility sa The Hague, Netherlands.
english: This was according to his brother Bong Duterte who visited the former chief executive at the detention facility in The Hague, Netherlands.

text: “He’s very happy when I told him we got an overwhelming vote as mayor.
english: “He’s very happy when I told him we got an overwhelming vote as mayor.

text: He smiled,” suno kay Bong sa Facebook live video ni former Presidential spokesman Harry Roque.
english: He smiled,” Bong said in a Facebook live video of former Presidential spokesman Harry Roque.

text: Pahayag pa sang manghod sini, maayo ang kondisyon sang former president, kag nagapasalamat ini sa iya nga supporters lakip na ang mga yara sa The Hague nga nagatipon para sa iya.
english: His younger brother said the former president is in good condition and is grateful to his supporters including those in The Hague who are gathering for him.

text: “He would like to thank all those who supported him… I told him merong mga tao sa park,” suno kay Bong.
english: “He would like to thank all those who supported him… I told him there are people in the park,” Bong said.

text:
“From the bottom of his heart talagang nagpapasalamat siya sa mga sumuporta sa kanya not only sa park, world wide.”

Matandaan nga opisyal na nga ginproklamar sang Davao election board nga nagdaog si Duterte sa mayoral race nga nakakuha sang masobra 660,000 ka mga boto sa iya hometown.
english:
“From the bottom of his heart he is really grateful to those who supported him not only in the park, world wide.”

It can be recalled that the Davao election board officially proclaimed that Duterte won the mayoral race with more than 660,000 votes in his hometown.

text: Bangud didto siya naka-detain sa Netherlands, ginalauman nga ang iya bata nga si incumbent Sebastian “Baste” Duterte amo man gihapon ang magapungko nga mayor bangud siya ang na-eleher nga bise-alcalde.
english: Since he is detained in the Netherlands, it is expected that his son, incumbent Sebastian “Baste” Duterte, will still be the mayor because he was elected vice-mayor.

text: Marso 11 sang gindakop si Duterte sa gahum sang arrest warrant sang International Criminal Court (ICC) bangud sa ginaalegar nga crimes against humanity.
english: Duterte was arrested on March 11 under an arrest warrant issued by the International Criminal Court (ICC) for alleged crimes against humanity.

text: Sa Septyembre 23 naka-schedule ang confirmation of charges.#
english: Confirmation of charges is scheduled for September 23.

text: Ang pagpalangga sang isa ka iloy amo ang isa ka sahi sang pagpalangga nga indi gid naton pag-ibaylo sa iban.
english: A mother’s love is the one kind of love we would never trade for anyone else.

text: Amo ina ang kinaandan para sa aton nga mga tawo, apang may isa ka istorya sa Turkey nga nagapamatuod nga amo man ina nga klase sang pagpalangga ang sarang mahatag sang sapat.
english: That’s the norm for us humans, but there’s a story in Turkey that proves the same kind of affection the animal can give.

text: Sa isa ka veterinary clinic, nakuhaan gid sang CCTV camera ang isa ka heartwarming story sang isa ka layaw nga ido.
english: At a veterinary clinic, a CCTV camera captured a heartwarming story of a stray dog.

text: Natabo ini sa Adnan Kahveci neighborhood sang Beylikduzu sa probinsya sang Istanbul.
english: It happened in the Adnan Kahveci neighborhood of Beylikduzu in Istanbul province.

text: Suno sa clinic, sang nagligad lamang nga adlaw, may yara sang animal lover nga nagdangop sa ila agud dal-on ang isa ka tutoy nga nakit-an sini sa dalan.
english: According to the clinic, just the other day, an animal lover approached them to bring a puppy he found on the street.

text: Suno sa nagdala, amo lang ini isa ang buhi pa kag gusto niya nga mabuligan ini sang veterinarian.
english: According to the carrier, it is the only one still alive and he wants a veterinarian to help it.

text: Amo na lang ang kakibot sang mga tawo didto bangud dugay-dugay, ara na ang iloy sang tutoy, kag wala ini naga-isahanon.
english: The people there were surprised because after a while, the mother of the puppy was there, and she was not alone.

text: Dala sini paagi sa iya baba ang isa ka tutoy nga halos wala na nagahulag.
english: It carries in its mouth a puppy that is barely moving.

text: Suno sa technician, na-notice nila kun daw ano ka desperada ang ido nga madala ang iya bata sa clinic.
english: According to the technician, they noticed how desperate the dog was to get her child to the clinic.

text: Natukiban sang vet nga naga-suprer na gali ang puppy sang hypothermia kag tuman na gid ka nubo ang heart rate.
english: The vet discovered that the puppy was suffering from hypothermia and had a very low heart rate.

text: Base pa sa surveillance footage, makit-an gid kun ano ka worried ang iloy nga ido bangud naga-sunod-sunod ini sa staff sa clinic kag ginalantaw gid sila samtang ginatatap nila ang tutoy.
english: Based on the surveillance footage, you can see how worried the mother dog is because she follows the staff at the clinic and watches them while they take care of the puppy.

text: Sa maayo nga palad, naluwas sang team ang little puppy kag ang bilog nga pamilya sang ido ang naga-recover na subong sa amo nga clinic.
english: Fortunately, the team was able to save the little puppy and the entire dog family is now recovering at the clinic.

text: Indi bastante ang gatas sang iloy para sa iya mga tutoy gani nga naggamit ang clinic sang formula para nga maluwas ang iya duha ka babies.
english: The mother did not have enough milk for her babies so the clinic used formula to save her two babies.

text: Nagdesisyon man ang clinic nga indi anay sila magbaton sang bisita para nga makapahuway sang maayo ang mother dog kag iya kabataan.
english: The clinic also decided not to accept visitors for the time being so that the mother dog and her children can rest well.

text: Ginpahayag sang doctor nga madamo gid ang na-intriga sa istorya sang ido kag nakita gid nila kun ano ini kaalam kag caring nga klase sang sapat.
english: The doctor said that many people were intrigued by the story of the dog and they saw how intelligent and caring it is.

text: Ginlutos ni Filipino boxer Vincent Astrolabio nga tumandok sang General Santos City ang two-time Olympic Gold medalist nga si Guillermo Rigondeaux sa sambuwa nga ginpatigayon sa Dubai Marina sa Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
english: Filipino boxer Vincent Astrolabio, a native of General Santos City, defeated two-time Olympic Gold medalist Guillermo Rigondeaux in a fight held at the Dubai Marina in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

text: Nakuha ni Astrolabio ang WBC International Bantamweight belt via unanimous decision.
english: Astrolabio won the WBC International Bantamweight belt via unanimous decision.

text: 95-94 ang final score nga ginhatag sang tatlo ka judges, nga nagapabor kay Astrolabio sa eighth round knockdown.
english: 95-94 was the final score given by the three judges, favoring Astrolabio with an eighth round knockdown.

text: Bitbit sang 24-anyos nga Gen-San boxer ang 16-3 nga win-loss nga may 12 knockouts samtang (20-3, 13 KOs) naman ang rekord ni Rigondeaux.
english: The 24-year-old Gen-San boxer carries a 16-3 win-loss record with 12 knockouts while Rigondeaux has a 20-3, 13 KOs record.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginlutos man ni Filipino World Boxing Organization world bantam king John Riel Casimero si Rigondeaux sa sambuwa sang nagligad nga Agosto 2021.
english: It is known that Filipino World Boxing Organization world bantam king John Riel Casimero also defeated Rigondeaux in a fight last August 2021.

text: MANILA– Ginpanginwala sang Filipino-British Actress  nga si Kelly Day ang isyu nga nagbalikanay sila sang anay kahagugma nga si Inigo Pascual.
english: MANILA – Filipino-British actress Kelly Day has denied the issue that she is back with her ex-boyfriend Inigo Pascual.

text: Suno kay Kelly, madamo ang nagbash sa iyabangud sa nasambit nga isyu, apamng wala ini sang kamatuoran.
english: According to Kelly, many people have bashed her over the issue, but it is not true.

text: Pahayag  pa ni Kelley, may rason kun ngaa nagbulagay sila kag nangin mag ex, kag tubton subong, nagapabilin sa gihapon ang nasambit nga rason.
english: Kelley said there was a reason why they broke up and became exes, and until now, the reason remains.

text: Ginklaro man sang natungdan nga mag-abyan lang sila ni Inigo, kag wala ini sang malisya.
english: He also clarified that he and Inigo are just friends, and he has no malice.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang mga litrato sang duha nga naglapta sa social media ang nagikan sa blessing sang balay ni Inigo, sa diin personal nga gin-imbitar sang Iloy sang aktor si Kelley.
english: It is known that the photos of the two that circulated on social media came from the blessing of Inigo's house, where the actor's mother personally invited Kelley.

text: Binigyan ng House committee on appropriations ng pitong araw ang bagong kalihim ng Department of Public Works and Highways na si Vince Dizon upang repasuhin at muling isumite ang P881.3-bilyong budget proposal ng ahensya para sa 2026, kung saan halos isang-katlo ay nakalaan sa flood control projects.
english: The House committee on appropriations gave new Department of Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon seven days to review and resubmit the agency's P881.3-billion budget proposal for 2026, of which nearly one-third is allocated to flood control projects.

text: Sa mosyon ni Rep.
english: In the motion of Rep.

text: Leila de Lima, itinakda ng komite ang deadline sa Setyembre 16 para sa pagsusumite ng lahat ng errata, amendments, at bagong probisyon bago ipagpatuloy ang deliberasyon.
english: Leila de Lima, the committee set a deadline of September 16 for the submission of all errata, amendments, and new provisions before continuing the deliberation.

text: Inamin ni Dizon na halos hindi niya maunawaan ang kasalukuyang panukalang budget dahil umano sa “state of disarray.” Kanyang idiniin na bukas siya sa pagbawas ng alokasyon lalo na sa flood control na umabot sa P268 bilyon, dahil matagal nang inuugnay sa korapsyon.
english: Dizon admitted that he can hardly understand the current budget proposal because of the state of disarray. He stressed that he is open to reducing the allocation especially for flood control which reached P268 billion, because it has long been linked to corruption.

text: Ipinunto rin ni Rep.
english: He also pointed out that Rep.

text: Marcelino Libanan na maraming flood control projects ang inilaan sa mga lugar na hindi naman binabaha, samantalang ang mga bagyuhin namang komunidad ay kulang sa sea walls.
english: Marcelino Libanan said many flood control projects have been allocated to areas that are not flooded, while the typhoon-prone communities lack sea walls.

text: Ayon kay Dizon, kailangang bawasan ang pondo para sa mga hindi prayoridad na lugar at ituon sa mga aktuwal na nangangailangan.
english: According to Dizon, funds should be reduced for non-priority areas and focused on those who are actually in need.

text: Bukod sa flood control, binanggit din ni Dizon na rerepasuhin ang mga “coded” contracts, rock-netting projects, redundant asphalt overlays, at solar rock studs na matagal nang itinuturing na pinagkukunan ng kickbacks.
english: Aside from flood control, Dizon also mentioned that coded contracts, rock-netting projects, redundant asphalt overlays, and solar rock studs that have long been considered sources of kickbacks will be reviewed.

text: Samantala, iminungkahi ni Rep.
english: Meanwhile, Rep.

text: Chel Diokno ang paggamit ng bank secrecy waivers at cyber warrants upang matunton ang posibleng katiwalian at makapreserba ng ebidensya laban sa mga tiwaling opisyal.
english: Chel Diokno the use of bank secrecy waivers and cyber warrants to track down possible corruption and preserve evidence against corrupt officials.

text: Sinabi ni Dizon na bukas siya sa koordinasyon kasama ang Philippine National Police-Cybercrime Division para dito.
english: Dizon said he is open to coordination with the Philippine National Police-Cybercrime Division for this.

text: Nananatiling suspendido ang deliberasyon sa budget ng DPWH hanggang maipasa ang binagong panukala.
english: The deliberation on the DPWH budget remains suspended until the amended proposal is passed.

text: Nag-protesta ang Vietnam batok sa China matapos ginaalegar ginkastigo kag ginkawatan sang mga Chinese ang 10 ka mga manugpangisda nga Vietnamese tatlo ka adlaw na ang nagligad samtang sila ang nagapangisda sa Hoang Sa ukon Paracel Islands.
english: Vietnam has protested against China after the Chinese allegedly beat and robbed 10 Vietnamese fishermen three days ago while they were fishing in the Hoang Sa or Paracel Islands.

text: Suno sa Vietnamese foreign ministry, ang Chinese law enforcers mismo ang involved sa amo nga insidente batok sa Vietnamese fishermen kag ginpangkuha pa ang ila nga fishing equipment.
english: According to the Vietnamese foreign ministry, Chinese law enforcers themselves were involved in the incident against the Vietnamese fishermen and confiscated their fishing equipment.

text: Ang Paracel Islands ang ginakontrol sang China kag gina-claim man sang Vietnam.
english: The Paracel Islands are controlled by China and also claimed by Vietnam.

text: Gintawag sang Vietnamese ministry nga brutal nga sahi sang treatment ang ginhimo sang Chinese law enforcement forces, kag dapat nga respetuhon man nila ang soberanya sang Vietnam.
english: The Vietnamese ministry called the Chinese law enforcement forces a brutal treatment, and that they should also respect Vietnam's sovereignty.

text: “Vietnam is extremely concerned, indignant and resolutely protests the brutal treatment by Chinese law enforcement forces of Vietnamese fishermen and fishing boats operating in the Hoang Sa archipelago of Vietnam,” pahayag ni foreign ministry spokesperson Pham Thu Hang.
english: “Vietnam is extremely concerned, indignant and resolutely protests the brutal treatment by Chinese law enforcement forces of Vietnamese fishermen and fishing boats operating in the Hoang Sa archipelago of Vietnam,” foreign ministry spokesperson Pham Thu Hang said in a statement.

text: Sabat naman sang Chinese foreign ministry, iligal ang pagpangisda sang mga Vietnamese sa Paracel Islands, wala sang pahanugot halin sa gobyerno sang Beijing, gani naghulag ang Chinese authorities agud punggan sila.
english: The Chinese foreign ministry said the Vietnamese were illegally fishing in the Paracel Islands without permission from the Beijing government, so the Chinese authorities moved to stop them.

text: “The on-site operations were professional and restrained, and no injuries were found,” suno sa China.
english: “The on-site operations were professional and restrained, and no injuries were found,” according to China.

text: Base sa report sang kapital sang Vietnamese vessel, ginbakol sang salsalon ang mga manugpangisda.
english: According to the Vietnamese vessel's capital report, the fishermen were beaten with iron bars.

text: Ginaalegar nga yara sa 40 ka mga tawo ang nag-atake sa ila kag naglawig sang tatlo ka oras ang insidente.
english: It is alleged that around 40 people attacked them and the incident lasted for three hours.

text: Gindugang sini nga halos isa ka oras matapos ang natabo, nagkalalipong sila bangud sa sakit nga nabatyagan.
english: He added that almost an hour after the incident, they became dizzy due to the pain they felt.

text: Apat sa Vietnamese crew ang gindala sa ospital sang nakaabot na sa Quang Ngai port.
english: Four of the Vietnamese crew were taken to hospital upon arrival at Quang Ngai port.

text: Isa ang nabalian sang tiil kag duha naman ang nabalian sang kamot.
english: One broke his leg and two broke their hands.

text: Nagtrending ang pinasahi nga paagi sang Hollywood singer nga si Katy Perry sa pag-anunsyo sang iya pregnancy sa subang niya nga bata sa iya fiancee kag aktor nga si Orlando Bloom.
english: Hollywood singer Katy Perry announced her pregnancy with her fiancee and actor Orlando Bloom in a special way.

text: Paagi sa iya pinakabag-o nga music video, ginpakita ni Katy ang iya baby bump sa katapusan nga parte sang video.
english: With her latest music video, Katy showed off her baby bump in the last part of the video.

text: May mga eksena man sa music video sa diin nakasuksok sang puti nga dress ang singer.
english: There are also scenes in the music video where the singer is wearing a white dress.

text: Sa video naman nga gin-upload ni Katy sa iya nga social media account, ginpahayag sang singer nga madamo pa sang good news nga dapat bantayan ang iya mga fans subong nga tuig magluwas sa iya pregnancy news.
english: In a video uploaded by Katy on her social media account, the singer said that there are many good news that her fans should watch out for this year besides her pregnancy news.

text: Nahimo na nga tropical depression ang isa ka low pressure area nga nasiplatan sa nakatundan sang Northern Luzon.
english: A low pressure area spotted west of Northern Luzon has become a tropical depression.

text:
Suno sa weather bureau, ginakilala ini subong sa local name nga ‘Lannie.’

Base sa 5:00 bulletin sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), ulihi nakit-an ang bagyo sa kalayuon nga 315 km nakatundan sang Sinait, Ilocos Sur.
english:
According to the weather bureau, it is now known by the local name 'Lannie.'

Based on the 5:00 bulletin of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), the typhoon was last spotted at a distance of 315 km west of Sinait, Ilocos Sur.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 45 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga 55 km/h.

Wala pa sang ginpaguwa nga wind signal subong sa bisan diin nga parte sang Pilipinas.
english:
It brought winds of 45 km/h near the center and gusts of 55 km/h.

No wind signal has been issued in any part of the Philippines.

text: Base sa track and intensity forecast, magahulag si Lannie pa-naaminhan nakatundan tubtub sa Lunes antes ini magliso pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan sa bilog nga forecast period.
english: Based on the track and intensity forecast, Lannie will move northwest until Monday before turning west northwest throughout the forecast period.

text: Posible ini magguwa sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) subong nga aga ukon karon sa hapon.
english: It is likely to exit the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) this morning or this afternoon.

text: Mahimo man suno sa bureau nga magbaskog ini bilang tropical storm karon sa gab-i ukon buwas sa kaagahon.#
english: The bureau said it could also strengthen as a tropical storm tonight or tomorrow morning.

text: Ginapanglantaw sang isa ka veteran boxing analyst nga si Atty. Ed Tolentino ang systematic breakdown ni reigning IBF world super flyweight champion Jerwin Ancajas nga depensahan ang iya titulo batok kay Fernando Daniel Martinez sa away subong nga adlaw sa Cosmopolitan, Las Vegas, USA.
english: Veteran boxing analyst Atty. Ed Tolentino's systematic breakdown of reigning IBF world super flyweight champion Jerwin Ancajas to defend his title against Fernando Daniel Martinez in today's fight at Cosmopolitan, Las Vegas, USA.

text: Si Ancajas ang may yara sang (33-1-2, 22KOs), kag madugay nga na nauyatan ang amu nga titulo sang napyerdi sini si McJoe Arroyo via unanimous decision sang 2016.
english: Ancajas is 33-1-2, 22KOs, and held the title for a long time when he defeated McJoe Arroyo via unanimous decision in 2016.

text: Sa liwat sini nga pagadepensahan sa ika siyam ka tion ang iya titulo batok sa unbeaten opponent kag former Olympian nga si Martinez.
english: He will once again defend his title for the ninth time against unbeaten opponent and former Olympian Martinez.

text: Apang, nagasalig si Tolentino nga makuha sang Pinoy boxer ang kadalag-an.
english: However, Tolentino is confident that the Filipino boxer will win.

text: Nagdangat sa 196,000 ka mga miyembro sang Social Security System (SSS) ang nakabaton sang kabug-usan nga P2.62 billion nga unemployment benefits.
english: A total of 196,000 members of the Social Security System (SSS) received a total of P2.62 billion in unemployment benefits.

text: Suno sa Department of Finance (DOF), kalabanan sa sini nga unemployment benefits ang gin-release sa tunga sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: According to the Department of Finance (DOF), most of these unemployment benefits were released amid the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Halin sang Marso 2020 tubtob sang Hunyo 2021, ninety percent ukon P2.35 billion nga cash grant ang ginpagwa sa idalom sang SSS Unemployment Insurance Benefit (UIB).
english: From March 2020 to June 2021, ninety percent or P2.35 billion cash grant was released under the SSS Unemployment Insurance Benefit (UIB).

text: Ini ang kasunod sang mga hitabo kun sa diin madamo nga mga empleyado ang temporaryo ukon permanente nga nadulaan sang trabaho kadungan sang pagpatuman sang istrikto nga quarantine measures.
english: This follows incidents where many employees temporarily or permanently lost their jobs during the implementation of strict quarantine measures.

text: Tiniyak ni Department of Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon na ang mga flood control projects na isasama at paglalaan ng pondo sa 2026 national budget ay talagang nasa flood prone areas.
english: Department of Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon assured that the flood control projects that will be included and allocated funds in the 2026 national budget are indeed in flood prone areas.

text: Sinabi ni Dizon bahagi ito ng pagbabago sa gagawin nila sa kanilang budget.
english: Dizon said this is part of a change in their budget.

text: Gagamiting basehan sa pagtukoy sa mga lugar na bibigyan ng budget para sa flood control projects ay ang mga nasa red zone na tinukoy ng project NOAH.
english: The basis for identifying the areas to be allocated budget for flood control projects are those in the red zone identified by project NOAH.

text: Nabatid nasa P268.3 billion ang pondo ng DPWH para sa flood control projects para sa fiscal year 2026.
english: The DPWH has allocated P268.3 billion for flood control projects for fiscal year 2026.

text: Subalit dahil nakitaan ito ng mga anomalya, pabor si Dizon na tapyasan ito at ilaan talaga duon sa mga lugar na binabaha.
english: However, since it was found to be anomalous, Dizon is in favor of cutting it down and really putting it in the flooded areas.

text: Sa budget briefing ng DPWH pabor si Dizon na i-realign ang pondo sa flood control kapag napatunayang hindi na ito kailangan, ang pondo ay mapupunta sa maintenance ng mga major roads and bridges.
english: In the budget briefing of the DPWH, Dizon was in favor of realigning the funds for flood control when it is proven that it is no longer needed, the funds will go to the maintenance of major roads and bridges.

text: Suportado naman ni Dizon ang mungkahi ni Appropriations panel Chair Rep.
english: Dizon supported the proposal of Appropriations panel Chair Rep.

text: Mikaela Suansing na gawing basehan ang siyensa para sa pagtukoy sa mga lugar na paglalaanan ng flood control projects.
english: Mikaela Suansing to use science as a basis for identifying areas for flood control projects.

text: Samantala, ibinunyag ni Secretary Dizon sa house panel na walang sistema at walang malinaw na plano ang ahensiya kung saan ilalagay ang mga flood control projects.
english: Meanwhile, Secretary Dizon revealed to the house panel that the agency has no system and no clear plan where to place the flood control projects.

text: Dahil dito sinabi ni Dizon isa ito sa kaniyang tututukan at bahagi sa mga ipatutupad na reporma sa ahensiya.
english: Because of this, Dizon said this is one of his focuses and part of the reforms to be implemented in the agency.

text: Sa budget briefing tinalakay ang isyu sa pagkakaroon ng master plan sa flood control project.
english: The budget briefing discussed the issue of having a master plan for the flood control project.

text: Ayon kay Dizon para sa Metro Manila mayruon ng binubuong master plan at posible matapos ito sa susunod na taon.
english: According to Dizon for Metro Manila there is a master plan being developed and it is likely to be completed next year.

text: Sinabi ng kalihim na malaking bagay ang master plan para sa pagtatayo ng mga flood control projects ng sa gayon maiwasan na magkakaroon ng mga ghost projects.
english: The secretary said that the master plan for the establishment of flood control projects is a great thing to avoid ghost projects.

text: Upang matugunan ang mga pagbaha sa Metro Manila, inihayag ng Kalihim na makikipag ugnayan ang DPWH sa Metro Manila Development Authority (MMDA) para sa gagawing dredging o paglilinis sa lahat ng mga water ways sa kalakhang Maynila.
english: To address the floods in Metro Manila, the Secretary said the DPWH will liaise with the Metro Manila Development Authority (MMDA) for dredging or cleaning of all waterways in the Manila area.

text: Siniguro naman ni Dizon na mananagot ang mga District Engineers kapag may natuklasang ghost projects sa kanilang mga lugar.
english: Dizon assured that the District Engineers will be held accountable when ghost projects are discovered in their areas.

text: Giit ng Kalihi na hindi siya mag-aatubuling tanggalin ang mga ito sa pwesto.
english: Kalihi insisted that he would not hesitate to remove these from office.

text:
Ginklaro sang Philippine Embassy sa Tel Aviv nga wala sang Pilipino nga nasamaran sang natabo ang terror attack sa Israel kag nagpaulan pa ang Iran sang missiles sa amo man nga Jewish state sang nagligad nga Myerkules sang gab-i.

Suno sa embahada, hilway sa katalagman ang tanan nga mag Pinoy kag gilayon nga nagpanago sa bomb shelters sang may ginpaguwa na nga advisory ang otoridad.
english:
The Philippine Embassy in Tel Aviv clarified that no Filipinos were injured in the terror attack on Israel and that Iran fired missiles at the same Jewish state last Wednesday night.

According to the embassy, ​​all Filipinos are safe and immediately took refuge in bomb shelters when the authorities issued an advisory.

text: “Most Filipinos were already sheltering in place or already inside safe rooms when the shooting took place and shortly before the missile attack at about 7:30 p.m.,” pahayag sini.
english: “Most Filipinos were already sheltering in place or already inside safe rooms when the shooting took place and shortly before the missile attack at about 7:30 p.m.,” it said.

text: Nagpasalamat man ang gobyerno sang Pilipinas sa Filipino community sa amo nga pungsod bangud sa ila kooperasyon, amo man sa Israeli Defense Forces (IDF) Homefront Command sa ila madasig nga pag-alerto sa mga tawo.
english: The Philippine government also thanked the Filipino community in the country for their cooperation, as well as the Israeli Defense Forces (IDF) Homefront Command for their prompt alert to the people.

text: Balik na sa kinaandan nga trabaho ang mga Pilipino suno sa embahada apang nagapabilin nga alerto pananglitan may mga emerhensya.
english: Filipinos are back to normal work, the embassy said, but remain alert in case of emergencies.

text: Myerkules sang kaagahon (Manila time) sang nag-isyu ang Philippine embassy sang advisory agud nga hingyuon sa mga Pinoy nga magpabilin lang sa protected areas kasunod sang paglunsar sang Iran sang ginabanta 200 missiles kasunod man sang pagpang-atake nga ginhimo sang Lebanon.
english: On Wednesday morning (Manila time), the Philippine embassy issued an advisory urging Filipinos to stay in protected areas following Iran's launch of about 200 missiles following the attack by Lebanon.

text: Una na nga nagpaathag ang Iran Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps nga ang ila missile attack ang kasunod sang kamatayon sang Gazans amo man sang mga lider sang Hezbollah kag Hamas.
english: Earlier, the Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps explained that its missile attack followed the deaths of Gazans as well as Hezbollah and Hamas leaders.

text: Nagpaandam man ini nga pasagunsunan pa ang atake pananglitan magbalos man ang Israel.
english: He also warned that the attack would be intensified if Israel retaliated.

text: Nagsaka na sa 43 ang na-rekord sang Department of Health (DOH) nga firecracker-related injuries sa Pilipinas samtang mas nagahilapit ang selebrasyon sang Bag-ong Tuig.
english: The Department of Health (DOH) has recorded 43 firecracker-related injuries in the Philippines as the New Year celebration approaches.

text: Suno sa ahensya, 18 ang mga bag-o nga kaso nga nagdugang sa Christmas Day, Disyembre 25.
english: According to the agency, 18 new cases were added on Christmas Day, December 25.

text: Mas manubo na ini nga tally ipaanggid sa 28 cases nga na-rekord sa amo man nga adlaw sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: This is a lower tally compared to the 28 cases recorded on the same day last year.

text: Ini nga firecracker-related injuries ang gina-monitor subong sa 62 sentinel hospitals sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: These firecracker-related injuries are currently being monitored at 62 sentinel hospitals nationwide.

text: Sa 43 nga mga pasyente, 34 ang naga-edad 19-anyos panubo kag anum naman ang 20-anyos pasaka.
english: Of the 43 patients, 34 were under the age of 19 and six were over the age of 20.

text: Kun gender naman ang pagahambalan, 39 sa mga biktima ang mga lalaki samtang apat naman ang mga babaye.
english: In terms of gender, 39 of the victims were male while four were female.

text: Gin-report man sang DOH nga 86% sa sini nga mga kaso ang resulta sang paggamit sang iligal nga palupok.
english: The DOH also reported that 86% of these cases were the result of the use of illegal fireworks.

text: Matandaan nga una na nagpahanumdom ang Philippine National Police nga indi dapat magsindi sang firecrackers sa residential areas kun naga-welcome sa 2025.
english: It can be recalled that the Philippine National Police earlier reminded that firecrackers should not be lit in residential areas when welcoming 2025.

text: Gina-abisuhan man ang publiko nga indi na maggamit sang prohibited firecrackers kaangay sang watusi, piccolo, kag masobra 20 ka iban pa.
english: The public is also advised not to use prohibited firecrackers such as watusi, piccolo, and more than 20 others.

text: Sa bahin sang DOH, gina-abiso sa publiko nga maglikaw sa paggamit sang fireworks kun magselebrar sini nga holidays.
english: On the part of the DOH, the public is advised to refrain from using fireworks when celebrating these holidays.

text: Sa baylo, gina-engganyo ang paggamit sang drums, busina, kag iban pa nga alternatibo nga bagay nga mahimo makatuga sang gahod.
english: Instead, the use of drums, horns, and other alternative objects that can create noise is encouraged.

text: Dako ang posibilidad nga magdangat sa P11 trillion ang kapyerdehan sang sektor sang edukasyon sa sulod sang 40 ka-tuig bangud sa long-term impact sang COVID-19 pandemic sa face-to-face classes, pagsirado sang mga buluthuan kag pagkadula sang trabaho sang mga manunudlo.
english: The education sector is likely to lose P11 trillion over the next 40 years due to the long-term impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on face-to-face classes, school closures and teacher job losses.

text: Santo sa data sang National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA), ang losses para sa school year 2020 to 2021 ang ginabanta yara sa P230 billion kag posible nga magasaka pa ini sa P10.8 trillion sa masunod nga 10 tubtob 40 ka-tuig.
english: According to data from the National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA), the losses for the school year 2020 to 2021 are estimated at P230 billion and are likely to rise to P10.8 trillion in the next 10 to 40 years.

text: Suno sa ahensya, ang computation ang ginbase sa isa ka-tuig nga pagsirado sang mga buluthuan, module-based learning kag ang impact sini sa masunod nga 40 ka-tuig sa average working life sang isa ka indibidwal.
english: According to the agency, the computation is based on the one-year closure of schools, module-based learning and its impact over the next 40 years on the average working life of an individual.

text: Gin-athag man sang NEDA nga humalin sang nag-umpisa ang pandemya partikular sang Marso 2020, kapin 865 ka pribado nga mga eskwelahan ang nagsirado kasunod sang mga ginpatuman nga total lockdowns.
english: NEDA also explained that since the beginning of the pandemic particularly in March 2020, more than 865 private schools have closed following the implementation of total lockdowns.

text: Ini ang wala lang nag-apekto sa sektor sang edukasyon kundi mangin sa bug-os nga ekonomiya sang pungsod.
english: This has not only affected the education sector but also the entire economy of the country.

text: Ginaduso sang Philippine National Police (PNP) sa pagpanguna ni PNP Chief PGen.
english: The Philippine National Police (PNP) led by PNP Chief PGen.

text: Nicolas Torre III ang paggamit sang mas madamo nga body-worn cameras, drones, mga mobile closed-circuit television (CCTVs) agud nga mas mapadasig ang response time sang mga pulis sa mga emergencies sang publiko.
english: Nicolas Torre III the use of more body-worn cameras, drones, mobile closed-circuit televisions (CCTVs) to speed up the response time of the police in public emergencies.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirmar ni Police Regional Office III Director kag PNP Spokesperson PBGen.
english: This was confirmed by Police Regional Office III Director and PNP Spokesperson PBGen.

text: Jean Fajardo nga ang PNP ang may yara na karon sang indi magnubo sa 2,700 nga mga body-worn cameras kun sa diin 648 halin diri ang may ikasarang nga maka-live broadcast samtang ang nabilin ang ginagamit para maka-record.
english: Jean Fajardo said the PNP now has at least 2,700 body-worn cameras of which 648 are capable of live broadcasting while the rest are used for recording.

text: Suno kay Fajardo, kon maka-fully operational na ang 911 , luyag mismo sang hepe nga tanan nga mga nagapatrolya nga mga pulis ang may suksok nga BWC.
english: According to Fajardo, when 911 is fully operational, the chief himself wants all patrolling policemen to wear BWCs.

text: Ini matapos nga ginmando ni Torre sa ila pinakauna nga Command Conference nga dapat himuon nga mas moderno ang pagresponde sang mga pulis sa kinahanglanon sang mga Pilipino ilabi na kun para ini sa pagpabilin sang ikaayo kag katawhayan sa mga komunidad.
english: This comes after Torre ordered at their first Command Conference that the police should be more modern in responding to the needs of Filipinos especially when it comes to maintaining peace and order in the communities.

text: Samtang, kasunod sini ginaplano man sang PNP nga maggamit sang mga drones ilabi na kun may mga dalagko nga pagtililipon kun sa diin may yara na sila sang 965 nga mga drones nga ginpreparar sang organisasyon.
english: Meanwhile, the PNP is also planning to use drones especially when there are large gatherings where they already have 965 drones prepared by the organization.

text: Kabahin man sang bag-o nga modernized approach sang PNP ang paggamit sang mga CCTV cameras para sa 360° nga pagsubaybay sa mga lugar nga ginakadtuan sang kadam-an.
english: Also part of the new modernized approach of the PNP is the use of CCTV cameras for 360° monitoring of public places.

text: Lantawon sang Iloilo City Government kun ano ang nangin lapses sa tagdumalahan sa Balay Dalayunan sa Bo.
english: The Iloilo City Government will look into the lapses in the management of the Balay Dalayunan in Bo.

text: Obrero, Lapuz, Iloilo City matapos nga may nakapalagyo na naman nga mga menor de edad.
english: Obrero, Lapuz, Iloilo City after another minor escaped.

text: Apat ka Children in Conflict with the Law (CICL) ang na-report nga naka-eskapo sang Byernes sang kaagahon, apang duha pa lang ang natigayon nga nabalik sa pasilidad.
english: Four Children in Conflict with the Law (CICL) were reported to have escaped on Friday morning, but only two have been returned to the facility.

text: Sa sini nga latest nga hitabo, ang naka-guwa sa pasilidad amo ang isa ka 15-anyos, duha ka 16-anyos, kag isa ka 17-anyos.
english: In this latest incident, those who were able to leave the facility were a 15-year-old, two 16-year-olds, and a 17-year-old.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Teresa Gelogo, head sang City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO), iya ginpahayag nga abilidaran gid ang mga bata nga nakaguwa gihapon bisan pa nga may jail personnel na kag may worker pa halin mismo sa syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Teresa Gelogo, head of the City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO), said the children are still able to get out despite the presence of jail personnel and workers from the city itself.

text: Padayon naman ang kooperasyon sang ginikananan sang CICL agud nga mabalik ang ila mga bata sa nasambit nga youth home.
english: The parents of CICL continue to cooperate to return their children to the youth home.

text: Ginapahayag nga duha pa lang sa apat ang nakabalik sa facility.
english: Only two of the four have reportedly returned to the facility.

text: Kun matandaan, sang Pebrero, may nakapalagyo man nga kabataan sa Balay Dalayunan matapos ginguba ang window grills sa second floor kag gingamit naman ang ila mga habol agud makapanaog.
english: In February, children also escaped from the Balay Dalayunan after breaking the window grills on the second floor and using their blankets to get down.

text: Sang amo nga tion, na-involve pa ang amo nga mga kabataan sa holdup incident sa Quirino Bridge sa Barangay President Roxas, City Proper.#
english: At that time, the children were involved in the holdup incident at the Quirino Bridge in Barangay President Roxas, City Proper.

text: Handa nga magpresentar sang counter evidence ang defense team ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa tion nga mag-atubang ang anay Presidente sa International Criminal Court (ICC) sa Setyembre 23.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte's defense team is ready to present counter evidence when the former President appears before the International Criminal Court (ICC) on September 23.

text: Sa isa ka redacted document nga napetsahan Setyembre 2, ginpahibalo sang lead defense lawyer ni anay President Duterte nga si Nicholas Kaufman ang Pre-Trial Chamber 1 sang mga ebidensya nga iya isumiter para sa confirmation of charges hearings nga magasuporta sa mga argumento batok sa mga dokumento nga nagaunod sang mga kaso batok sa anay presidente.
english: In a redacted document dated September 2, former President Duterte’s lead defense lawyer Nicholas Kaufman informed Pre-Trial Chamber 1 of the evidence he will submit for confirmation of charges hearings that will support arguments against the documents containing charges against the former president.

text: Ang abiso sang defense team ang nagasanto sa Rules of Procedures and Evidence sang ICC, nga nagakinahanglan sa depensa nga maghatag sang listahan sang ebidensya sa korte indi maglapaw sa 15 ka adlaw antes ang natalana nga hearing.
english: The defense team’s notification was in line with the ICC’s Rules of Procedures and Evidence, which require the defense to provide a list of evidence to the court no later than 15 days before the scheduled hearing.

text: Natalana nga magasugod sa Setyembre 23 ang apat ka adlaw nga confirmation of charges hearing sa ginaalegar crimes against humanity batok sa anay Presidente sang Pilipinas.
english: The four-day confirmation of charges hearing on alleged crimes against humanity against the former Philippine President is scheduled to begin on September 23.

text: Nagpaulan ang Iran sang ballistic missiles sa Israel bilang balos sa kampanya sini batok sa Hezbollah sa Lebanon.
english: Iran has rained ballistic missiles on Israel in retaliation for its campaign against Hezbollah in Lebanon.

text: Ginabanta nga 200 ka missiles ang ginlunsar sang Iran.
english: Iran launched an estimated 200 missiles.

text: Antes sini, nag-anunsyo na nga daan ang militar sang Israel sa posible ballistic missile strike halin sa Iran kag ginpaandaman ang publiko nga magpanago sa hilway nga lugar sa tion sang pagpang-atake.
english: Earlier, the Israeli military had announced in advance a possible ballistic missile strike from Iran and warned the public to hide in safe places during the attack.

text: Una na nagpromisa ang Iran nga magabalos sila kasunod sang atake sang Israel nga nagpatay sa top leader sang Hezbollah.
english: Iran had earlier vowed to retaliate following the Israeli attack that killed Hezbollah's top leader.

text: Ang kampanya sang Israel sa Lebanon ang ginakabig pinakadako nga escalation sang regional warfare humalin sang naglupok ang inaway sa Gaza sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Israel's campaign in Lebanon is seen as the biggest escalation of regional warfare since the Gaza war broke out last year.

text: Ginsiling naman sang Israel nga wala sang seryoso nga casualties ang na-report.
english: Israel said no serious casualties were reported.

text: Gilayon naman nga nag-isyu ang Philippine Embassy sa Israel sang advisory sa local Filipino community nga magsulod sa protected space kasunod sang pagpaulan sang missiles sang Iranian government.
english: The Philippine Embassy in Israel immediately issued an advisory to the local Filipino community to enter the protected space following the Iranian government's missile rain.

text: Ginpanugyan man sang Embassy sa mga Pinoy nga magsunod sa mga mando sang Home Front Command.
english: The Embassy also advised Filipinos to follow the orders of the Home Front Command.

text: Ginaduso sa gobyerno nga palip-uton lang ang quarantine period para sa mga fully vaccinated nga byahero halin sa iban nga pungsod partikular na sa North America.
english: The government is being proposed to shorten the quarantine period for fully vaccinated travelers from other countries particularly North America.

text: Ini ang panugyan ni Presidential Adviser for Entrepreneurship Joey Concepcion samtang nagahilapit na ang Christmas season.
english: This is the advice of Presidential Adviser for Entrepreneurship Joey Concepcion as the Christmas season approaches.

text: Ginsuportahan sang nasambit nga palace adviser ang hingyo sang isa ka airline company nga ang pasahero sang international flights ang mapaidalom sa testing 72 hours antes ang departure, i-quarantine sa ila arrival, kag magpaidalom sa confirmatory test sa ikatatlo nga adlaw.
english: The palace adviser supported the request of an airline company that passengers of international flights be tested 72 hours before departure, quarantined upon arrival, and undergo a confirmatory test on the third day.

text: Kun negative ang resulta, pwede na nga padayunon ang quarantine sa balay.
english: If the result is negative, the quarantine at home can be continued.

text: Suno kay Concepcion, dapat nga alalayan subong ang airline companies agud nga indi magcollapse kag indi mangin mabudlay ang pagbyahe sa masunod nga mga tuig.
english: According to Concepcion, the airline companies should be supported now so that they will not collapse and travel will not be difficult in the coming years.

text: Ang mas manubo nga quarantine period para sa fully vaccinated travelers halin sa iban nga pungsod ang makabulig agud nga maka-save sang P25,000 ang byahero kag mangin mas maayo pa ang quarantine sa balay.
english: The shorter quarantine period for fully vaccinated travelers from other countries will help the traveler save P25,000 and improve home quarantine.

text: Masako na ang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) Region 6 sa preparasyon para sa 2025 Baranggay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE) sa Disyembre apisar pa sang mga huring-huring nga indi ini madayon.
english: The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) Region 6 is busy preparing for the 2025 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE) in December despite rumors that it will not take place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Dennis Ausan, regional director sang Comelec Western Visayas, iya ginpahayag nga santo ang ila preparasyon sa kun ano ang nakabutang sa layi nga hiwaton ang eleksyon sa December 1, 2025.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Dennis Ausan, regional director of the Comelec Western Visayas, said they are preparing in accordance with the law to hold the election on December 1, 2025.

text: Magalain lamang ini kun may bag-o nga layi nga ipasar sa Kongreso nga magapaiway sang piniliay.
english: This will only get worse if a new law is passed in Congress that will postpone the election.

text: Ang House Bill No.
english: House Bill No.

text: 10344 nga amo ang nagaduso nga i-reset ang 2025 BSKE sa katapusan nga Lunes sang October 2026 ang pending pa gihapon sa Committee on Suffrage and Electoral Reforms halin sang May 8, 2024.
english: 10344 which proposes to reset the 2025 BSKE to the last Monday of October 2026 is still pending in the Committee on Suffrage and Electoral Reforms since May 8, 2024.

text: Suno kay Ausan, lakip sa ila ginahimo amo ang imbentaryo sang available nga registration forms, pagpasiguro nga wala sang deperensya sa mga makina kag iban pa nga paraphernalia, kag paghanda man sang gamiton nga ballot boxes.
english: According to Ausan, among the activities they are doing are inventorying the available registration forms, ensuring that there are no defects in the machines and other paraphernalia, and also preparing the ballot boxes to be used.

text: Una na nga gin-release sang poll body ang calendar of activities para sa nasambit nga eleksyon.
english: The poll body has already released the calendar of activities for the said election.

text: Lakip sa balantayan nga mga petsa amo ang Hulyo 1 tubtub 11, 2025 nga amo ang voter registration kag applications for membership sa Katipunan ng Kabataan (KK).
english: Among the expected dates are July 1 to 11, 2025 for voter registration and applications for membership in the Katipunan ng Kabataan (KK).

text: October 1 to October 7 ang filing sang certificates of candidacy; October 27 to December 31 ang election period; November 20 to November 29 ang campaign period; samtang sa Disyembre 1 naman ang election day.
english: October 1 to October 7 is the filing of certificates of candidacy; October 27 to December 31 is the election period; November 20 to November 29 is the campaign period; while December 1 is the election day.

text: Sa bilog nga election period, ipatuman sang poll body ang key provisions sang Batas Pambansa Blg.
english: Throughout the election period, the poll body will implement the key provisions of Batas Pambansa Blg.

text: 881 (Omnibus Election Code) lakip na ang pagdumili sa mga armas luthang.
english: 881 (Omnibus Election Code) including the ban on firearms.

text: Nakapauli na sa Poland ang Filipino alpine skier nga si Asa Miller matapos ang closing ceremony sang 2022 Winter Olympics sang Pebrero 20.
english: Filipino alpine skier Asa Miller is back in Poland after the closing ceremony of the 2022 Winter Olympics on February 20.

text: Nahibalu-an nga si Asa Miller ang isahanon nga nagtiglawas sang Pilipinas sa Olimpiada nga nag-compete sa Men’s giant slalom kag Men’s slalom event sa Beijing, China.
english: Asa Miller is the only Philippine representative in the Olympics who competed in the Men's giant slalom and Men's slalom events in Beijing, China.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Jim Apelar, presidente sang Philippine Ski and Snowboard Federation, iya ginpahayag nga wala pa nakadesisyon si Miller kun magapasakop ini sa 2026 winter olympics sa Italy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Jim Apelar, president of the Philippine Ski and Snowboard Federation, said Miller has not yet decided whether to compete in the 2026 winter olympics in Italy.

text: Suno kay Apelar, nagpahayag si Miller nga plano sini nga nga tutuokan ang iya pagskwela nga subong sophomore sa isa ka unibersidad sa Utah, USA.
english: According to Apelar, Miller said he plans to focus on his sophomore studies at a university in Utah, USA.

text: Nagtanyag si Cebu 5th District Representative Duke Frasco sang tunga sa milyon ka pesos nga padya sa sin-o man nga makahatag sang credible information kaangot sa mga anomaliya ukon iregularidad sa flood control projects sa iya nga distrito.
english: Cebu 5th District Representative Duke Frasco offered a half a million pesos reward to anyone who can provide credible information regarding anomalies or irregularities in flood control projects in his district.

text: Pahayag sini, ginhingyo na niya sa DPWH Regional Office nga magpatigayon sang full review sa tanan nga mga proyekto sa iya nasakpan nga district.
english: He said he has already asked the DPWH Regional Office to conduct a full review of all projects in his district.

text:
Yari ang iya statement:

“I am offering a personal reward of ₱500,000 for any credible information that may lead to the finding of any anomalies or irregularities in DPWH FLOOD CONTROL projects within the 5th District of Cebu.
english:
Here is his statement:

“I am offering a personal reward of ₱500,000 for any credible information that may lead to the finding of any anomalies or irregularities in DPWH FLOOD CONTROL projects within the 5th District of Cebu.

text: Please report directly to this hotline 0956 279 4183 and the Citizens’ Complaint Hotline 8888.
english: Please report directly to this hotline 0956 279 4183 and the Citizens’ Complaint Hotline 8888.

text: Following the President’s call for a nationwide investigation on flood control projects, I immediately asked the DPWH Regional Office to conduct a full review of all projects in the 5th District of Cebu.
english: Following the President’s call for a nationwide investigation on flood control projects, I immediately asked the DPWH Regional Office to conduct a full review of all projects in the 5th District of Cebu.

text: I will never tolerate any irregularities or substandard work, and I fully support efforts to uphold transparency and accountability in all government-funded projects.
english: I will never tolerate any irregularities or substandard work, and I fully support efforts to uphold transparency and accountability in all government-funded projects.

text: Thank you for your attention to this matter!”
english: Thank you for your attention to this matter!”

text: Patay ang 25 ka mga indibidwal matapos nga nasunog ang isa ka school bus sa Thailand nga may sakay nga 44 ka kabataan kag mga manunudlo.
english: At least 25 people have been killed after a school bus carrying 44 children and teachers caught fire in Thailand.

text: Lakip sa sakay sang bus ang naga-edad halin kindergarten tubtob sa 13 ukon 14-anyos nga mga estudyante.
english: Among the bus passengers were students ranging in age from kindergarten to 13 or 14-years-old.

text: Suno kay Transport Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit, indi pa maathag ang numero sang mga napatay apang 25 ka tawo ang unaccounted matapos ang sunog.
english: According to Transport Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit, the number of deaths is not yet clear but 25 people are unaccounted for after the fire.

text: Sa inisyal nga report, may 44 ka sakay, 38 ka estudyante kag anum ka manunudlo, samtang tatlo ka mga manunudlo kag 16 ka mga estudyante ang nakaguwa kag nakaluwas.
english: According to initial reports, there were 44 people on board, 38 students and six teachers, while three teachers and 16 students were able to escape.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagsugod ang sunog matapos nga ang isa ka goma sang bus ang naglupok sa highway sa Bangkok mga alas 12:30 sang hapon (0530 GMT), rason nga ang bus nakabunggo sa isa ka barrier kag nagkalayo.
english: The fire is understood to have started after a tire of the bus burst on the highway in Bangkok at around 12:30 pm (0530 GMT), causing the bus to hit a barrier and burst into flames.

text: Ang mga rescue workers ang nagbutang sang mga screen agud amligan ang mga bombero kag mga imbestigador samtang nagakuha sang mga bangkay gikan sa nasunog nga bus.
english: Rescue workers set up screens to protect firefighters and investigators while removing bodies from the burning bus.

text: Nagpalab-ot naman sang simpatiya si Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra sa pamilya sang mga biktima sa makahalanusbo nga trahedya.
english: Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra expressed his condolences to the families of the victims of the tragic tragedy.

text: Nagsaka ang utilization rate sang government agencies’ budgets ukon ang pondo sang pila ka ahensya sang gobyerno sa una nga walo ka bulan sang 2021.
english: The utilization rate of government agencies’ budgets or the funding of some government agencies increased in the first eight months of 2021.

text: Suno sa Department of Budget and Management (DBM), halin sang Enero tubtob Agusto, kapin P1.64 trillion ang nabuhin sa P1.85 trillion nga Notice of Cash Allocation (NCA).
english: According to the Department of Budget and Management (DBM), from January to August, more than P1.64 trillion was deducted from the P1.85 trillion Notice of Cash Allocation (NCA).

text: Bangud sini, nagsaka sa 89-percent ang utilization rate sang pondo, mas mataas ipaanggid sa 80 percent nga rate sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: As a result, the utilization rate of the fund rose to 89-percent, higher compared to the 80 percent rate last year.

text: Nahibaluan nga agud ma-cover ang cash requirements sang mga programa, operasyon, kag proyekto nga ginapatigayon sang mga ahensya sang gobyerno, naga-isyu ang DBM sang NCAs sa government-servicing institutions.
english: It is known that to cover the cash requirements of programs, operations, and projects carried out by government agencies, the DBM issues NCAs to government-servicing institutions.

text: Sa una nga walo ka bulan sang 2021, ang Civil Service Commission kag ang Commission on Human Rights ang nakarekord sang pinakataas nga utilization rate sang pondo.
english: In the first eight months of 2021, the Civil Service Commission and the Commission on Human Rights recorded the highest utilization rate of funds.

text: Nagpanglakaak sa masobra 200 ang napatay sa Nepal bangud sa pagbaha kag sa pagkatiphag sang duta dala sang mabaskog nga pag-ulan.
english: More than 200 people have been killed in Nepal by floods and landslides caused by heavy rains.

text: Suno pa sa home ministry, magluwas sa 209 nga kumpirmado nga patay, may 29 pa nga missing.
english: According to the home ministry, besides the 209 confirmed dead, there are 29 missing.

text: Sa masobra 4,200 nga na-rescue sang otoridad, kalabanan ang nakaangkon sang samad kag subong ginabulong sang response teams.
english: Of the more than 4,200 people rescued by the authorities, most sustained injuries and are being treated by response teams.

text: “We intensified aerial rescue for people who are sick or still need to be brought to safety,” suno kay home ministry spokesman Rishi Ram Tiwari.
english: “We have intensified aerial rescue for people who are sick or still need to be brought to safety,” said home ministry spokesman Rishi Ram Tiwari.

text: Kadam-an sa napatay ang halin sa syudad sang Kathmandu nga nalapawan sang tubig-baha.
english: Most of the dead were from the flood-hit city of Kathmandu.

text: May landslide pa nga natabo sa highway 16 kilometres halin sa amo nga city.
english: There was also a landslide on the highway 16 kilometers from the city.

text: Ini nga pag-inulan ang ginalaragway nga pinakamalala sa sulod sang pila ka dekada nga naeksperyensyahan sa eastern kag central regions sang pungsod.
english: This rainfall is described as the worst in decades experienced in the eastern and central regions of the country.

text: Suno sa Nepal police, posible nga maglawig pa sang pila ka adlaw ang rescue operations.
english: According to Nepal police, the rescue operations are likely to take several days.

text: Sa nagligad nga 24 ka oras, lakip sa na-retrieve amo ang 100 ka mga bangkay nga nalubong sa debris lakip na ang halin sa nagkalalubong nga mga pampasahero nga salakyan.
english: In the past 24 hours, among those retrieved were 100 bodies buried in debris including those from buried passenger vehicles.

text: Nagbalik naman ang domestic flights apang may pila pa ka lugar nga mabudlay agyan bangud sa landslides.
english: Domestic flights have resumed but there are still some areas that are difficult to access due to landslides.

text: Nag-untat na subong ang pag-ulan sa Nepal kag ginalauman nga mgaayo na ang kondisyon sang tiyempo sa masunod nga inadlaw.
english: The rains have now stopped in Nepal and the weather conditions are expected to improve in the coming days.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – May nagkalain-lain nga mga pamaagi sa pagsaulog sang Christmas ang preso sa lloilo City District Jail Male Dormitory sa Barangay Ungka, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – There are different ways to celebrate Christmas for the inmates in the lloilo City District Jail Male Dormitory in Barangay Ungka, Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jail Superintendent Richard Servano, District Jail Warden sang Iloilo City District Jail Male Dormitory, iya ginpahayag nga indi malikawan nga magbatyag sang kasubo ang mga preso ilabi na nga malayo ang mga ini sa ila pamilya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jail Superintendent Richard Servano, District Jail Warden of the Iloilo City District Jail Male Dormitory, said it is inevitable that the inmates will feel sad especially since they are far from their families.

text: Apang suno kay Servano, may mga nagkalain-lain sila nga programa nga ginpreparar para sa mga preso kaangay sang singing contest kag dance competition.
english: However, according to Servano, they have various programs prepared for the inmates such as singing contest and dance competition.

text: Ginpasalamatan man sini ang mga regalo nga ginhatag sang religious organization ukon religious group para sa mga preso.
english: He also thanked the gifts given by the religious organization or religious group for the inmates.

text: Sa pihak sini, gin-athag ni Servano nga hugot sa gihapon ang ila ginapatuman nga seguridad sa mga bisita nga magasulod sa presuhan.
english: Meanwhile, Servano explained that they are still tight security for visitors entering the jail.

text: Kinahanglan sang Pilipinas ang P1.1 trillion nga investments agud nga maka-develop sang mas epektibo nga water supply kag sanitation system sa 2030.
english: The Philippines needs P1.1 trillion in investments to develop a more efficient water supply and sanitation system by 2030.

text: Ginlunsyar sang National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) ang “Philippine Water Supply and Sanitation Master Plan” nga may katuyuan nga malab-ot ang universal access sa safe, sufficient, affordable kag sustainable water supply kag sanitization sa 2030.
english: The National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) launched the “Philippine Water Supply and Sanitation Master Plan” with the goal of achieving universal access to safe, sufficient, affordable and sustainable water supply and sanitation by 2030.

text: Suno kay Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Chua, 44 percent lang sa mga households ang may yara sang maayo nga koneksyon sa waterworks systems samtang ang nabilin nga 56 percent ukon 57 million nga mga Filipinos ang nagakuha pa sang tubig halin sa communal pipes ukon sa bubon nga 250 meters ang kalayuon gikan sa ila mga balay.
english: According to Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Chua, only 44 percent of households have good connections to waterworks systems while the remaining 56 percent or 57 million Filipinos still get water from communal pipes or wells 250 meters away from their homes.

text: Suportado man sang NEDA ang paghimo sang Department of Water Resources agud tingbon na lang ang water sector kag mapamunuan ang implementasyon sang master plan sang pungsod.
english: NEDA also supports the creation of the Department of Water Resources to unite the water sector and lead the implementation of the country's master plan.

text: Posible nga dagdagan sang kaso kag penalidad sang gobyerno sang Taiwan ang isa sa ila Olympic flagbearers bangud sa pagsuksok sini sang uniporme sang China.
english: The Taiwanese government is likely to increase charges and penalties against one of its Olympic flagbearers for wearing a Chinese uniform.

text: Ginapahayag nga ginkaakig sang mga opisyal sang Taiwan ang online post ni Olympian Huang Yu-ting.
english: Taiwanese officials reportedly took offense to Olympian Huang Yu-ting’s online post.

text: Gilayon naman nga ginpanas sang babaye nga atleta ang iya social media post matapos makabaton sang mga pagpakamalaot.
english: The female athlete immediately deleted her social media post after receiving criticism.

text: Naghampang ang 33-anyos nga si Huang sa 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics duha ka semana na ang nagligad.
english: The 33-year-old Huang played in the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics two weeks ago.

text: Depensa naman sini sa mga nagapadako sang isyu, dapat nga mangin sports na lang ang mga tawo kag dapat nga untatan na ang paghaboy sang pagpakamalaot.
english: He defended those who are exaggerating the issue, saying that people should be sports and stop throwing insults.

text: Suno naman sa mga opisyal sang Taiwan, nagapatigayon na sila sang imbestigasyon may kaangtanan sa insidente.
english: Taiwanese officials said they were conducting an investigation into the incident.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginapanindugan sang China nga sakop sa gihapon sang ila nga pungsod ang Taiwan.
english: China insists that Taiwan is still part of its country.

text: Ginsita sang mga mamalidha ang P1 billion nga pondo sa proposed budget sang Department of Health para sa 2026.
english: Lawmakers cited the P1 billion fund in the Department of Health's proposed budget for 2026.

text: Suno kay House Deputy Speaker Janette Garin, sa baylo nga ipain kuntani ang amo ka dako nga pondo para sa mga pampubliko nga ospital kag rural health units (RHUS), nagpain pa ang DOH sang amo ka dako nga budget para gastuhon sa pagpanami sang mga opisina sang ahensya.
english: According to House Deputy Speaker Janette Garin, instead of allocating such a large fund for public hospitals and rural health units (RHUS), the DOH allocated such a large budget to be spent on improving the agency's offices.

text: Ginkwestyon sang kongresista kun paano ini nakalusot sa Department of Budget and Management (DBM).
english: The congressman questioned how it escaped the Department of Budget and Management (DBM).

text: Suno kay Garin nga tiglikom na sadto sang DOH, ang amo nga alokasyon nga nasiplatan sa hearing sang House committee on appropriations, wala nagasanto sa prayoridad ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr., nga nagaduso sang “zero balance billing” sa mga ospital para sa mga pigado nga pasyente.
english: According to Garin, who is now secretary of the DOH, the allocation, which was seen in the hearing of the House committee on appropriations, is not in line with the priority of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., who proposes “zero balance billing” in hospitals for poor patients.

text: Bangud sini, ginpahayag ni Garin nga kinahanglan nga mas mangin mapisan ang mga mamalidha nga busision ang proposed budget para makakas ang mga indi man kinahanglan nga alokasyon.
english: Because of this, Garin said that lawmakers need to be more diligent in voting on the proposed budget to remove unnecessary allocations.

text: Nagsaka na sa 116 ang napatay sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika kasunod sang paglaslas ni Hurricane Helene.
english: The death toll from Hurricane Helene has risen to 116 in the United States.
