text: Ini nga death toll ang na-rekord sa anum ka states partikular sa Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee kag Alabama matapos nga nag-landfall si Helene sa Florida bilang Category 4 hurricane.
english: This death toll was recorded in six states particularly Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee and Alabama after Helene made landfall in Florida as a Category 4 hurricane.

text: Suno sa White House, masobra pa sa 600 ang missing ukon “unaccounted for” bilang resulta sang malain nga tiyempo.
english: According to the White House, more than 600 are still missing or “unaccounted for” as a result of the bad weather.

text: Sa subong, masobra duha ka milyon ka mga residente ang wala gihapon sang suplay sang kuryente, kag madamo pa ang wala sang ideya kun nakaluwas ang ila mga himata bangud wala pa nabalik ang estable nga communication services.
english: Currently, more than two million residents are still without electricity supply, and many more have no idea if their relatives survived because stable communication services have not been restored.

text: Kinahanglan pa nga i-airlift sang officials ang pila ka emergency supplies lakip ang pagkaon kag tubig sa pila ka areas nga may road closures sa gihapon.
english: Officials still need to airlift some emergency supplies including food and water to some areas that still have road closures.

text: Ginkumpirma naman sang White House nga bisitahon ni US President Joe Biden ang North Carolina sa Myerkules agud ma-check ang sitwasyon sang mga residente.
english: The White House confirmed that US President Joe Biden will visit North Carolina on Wednesday to check on the situation of the residents.

text: Magatakop na subong nga adlaw ang 2022 Winter Olympics.
english: The 2022 Winter Olympics will come to an end today.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagsugud sang Pebrero 4 ang Winter Olympics sa Beijing, China.
english: The Winter Olympics began on February 4 in Beijing, China.

text: Naga-isahanon naman ang ginpadala nga atleta sang Pilipinas nga amu ang Filipino Alpine skier nga si Asa Miller.
english: The Philippine athlete, Filipino Alpine skier Asa Miller, was sent alone.

text: Si Miller ang naghampang sa men’s giant slalom event sang Pebrero 13 apang gin-register nga DNF ukon “Did not Finish”.
english: Miller played in the men’s giant slalom event on February 13 but was registered as DNF or “Did not Finish”.

text: Nagpasakop man ini sa men’s slalom event sang Pebrero 16 kag liwat gin-register bilang DNF.
english: He also competed in the men’s slalom event on February 16 and was again registered as a DNF.

text: Gin-ako naman ni Miller nga nadula sini ang iya kumpyansa sa kaugalingon sang napyerde ini sa duha ka kompetisyon.
english: Miller admitted that he lost his confidence when he lost two competitions.

text: Apang, nagpasalig si Miller nga magabawi ini sa 2026 winter Olympics nga patigayunon sa Italya.
english: However, Miller assured that it will bounce back by the 2026 winter Olympics to be held in Italy.

text: Proud naman ang mga Pinoy sa nagaisahanon nga tiglawas sang Pilipinas sa 2022 Winter Olympics.
english: Filipinos are proud of the Philippines' only representative in the 2022 Winter Olympics.

text: Suno kay Miller, nangin memorable kag masadya ang iya pagrepresentar sang Pilipinas subong nga tuig apisar nga napaslawan ini ng makakuha sang medalya.
english: According to Miller, it was memorable and fun for him to represent the Philippines this year despite failing to win a medal.

text: Patigayunon naman ang closing ceremony sang 2022 Winter Olympics las 8 subong nga gab-i.
english: The closing ceremony of the 2022 Winter Olympics will be held at 8 pm tonight.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – Ginapatihan nga may hangover pa ang lalaki nga driver sang SUV nga nakabunggo sa poste sa atubang sang Plaza Libertad sa JM Basa Street, Iloilo City Proper.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – The male driver of an SUV that hit a pole in front of Plaza Libertad in JM Basa Street, Iloilo City Proper is believed to have a hangover.

text: Ang biktima nga ginpahinago lang ang pangalan ang naga-edad sang 27 anyos kag residente sang Negros Occidental.
english: The victim, whose name was withheld, is 27 years old and a resident of Negros Occidental.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Chief Master Sergeant Edward Larrida, imbestigador sa Traffic Enforcement Unit sang Iloilo City Police Office, iya ginpahayag nga nagapanimaho pa sang ilimnon ang biktima sang gin-rescue.
english: Police Chief Master Sergeant Edward Larrida, investigator of the Traffic Enforcement Unit of the Iloilo City Police Office, said the victim was still smelling of alcohol when he was rescued.

text: Apang suno kay Larrida, ang Land Transportation Office (LTO) lang ang may yara sang alcohol breath analyzer nga amo kuntani ang makatumod kung ang isa ka indibidwal ang hubog ukon naka-inom sang makahulobog nga ilimnon.
english: However, according to Larrida, only the Land Transportation Office (LTO) has an alcohol breath analyzer that should have determined whether an individual was drunk or had consumed alcoholic beverages.

text: Suno kay Larrida, santo sa ila imbestigasyon madasig ang pagmaneho sang biktima samtang nagapadulong sa General Hughes, Iloilo City Proper.
english: According to Larrida, based on their investigation, the victim was driving fast while heading to General Hughes, Iloilo City Proper.

text: Apang sang yara na ini sa JM Basa Street, ginpahayag sang biktima nga may nag-overtake sa iya nga motorsiklo rason nga naaksidente ini.
english: However, when he was on JM Basa Street, the victim said that someone overtook his motorcycle causing him to have an accident.

text: Gilayon naman ini nga gindala sa ospital matapos nag-angkon sang pilas sa kamot kag ulo
english: He was rushed to the hospital after sustaining injuries to his hand and head

text: Nagsabat ang militante nga grupo nga Hezbollah nga handa sila pananglitan dayunon sang Israel ang ground offensive ukon ground assault sa Lebanon.
english: The militant group Hezbollah responded that it is ready if Israel continues a ground offensive or ground assault in Lebanon.

text: Suno pa sa deputy leader nga si Naim Qassem, posible pa nga maglawig ang ila away.
english: Deputy leader Naim Qassem said the fight could continue.

text: “We will face any scenario and we are ready if Israel decides to enter by land, the resistance forces are ready for any ground confrontation,” pahayag sini sa Al-Manar television channel sang grupo.
english: “We will face any scenario and we are ready if Israel decides to enter by land, the resistance forces are ready for any ground confrontation,” he told the group’s Al-Manar television channel.

text:
“We know the battle may be long.”

Ginsiling man sini nga magapili sila sang bag-o nga lider kasunod sang pagpatay sang Israel kay Hassan Nasrallah nga isa sa founding members sang Hezbollah nga nagpamuno sa amo nga grupo sa Middle East sa masobra tatlo ka dekada.
english:
“We know the battle may be long.”

He also said they would elect a new leader following Israel's killing of Hassan Nasrallah, one of the founding members of Hezbollah who led the group in the Middle East for more than three decades.

text: Pahayag ini Qassem, padayon sila nga magaaway batok sa Israel bilang kabahin sang ila nga suporta sa Gaza kag sa Palestine kag bilang kabahin sang proteksyon sa mga taga-Lebanon.
english: Qassem said they will continue to fight against Israel as part of their support for Gaza and Palestine and as part of the protection of the Lebanese people.

text: Baliskad ini sa panindugan sang Israel Defense Forces nga ang Hezbollah amo ang nagabutang sa mga Lebanese sa risgo kag amo ang nagapamatay sa mga inosente nga sibilyan.
english: This is contrary to the position of the Israel Defense Forces that Hezbollah is putting the Lebanese at risk and is killing innocent civilians.

text: Sa nagligad nga 24 ka oras, nahibaluan nga may 136 ka panibag-o nga napatay sa Lebanon bangud sa airstrikes sang Israel.
english: In the past 24 hours, there have been 136 new deaths in Lebanon due to Israeli airstrikes.

text: Ginpasirado naman sang Israel pati ang tatlo ka border towns — gintawag ini nga closed military zones — kag ginalantaw nga signos nga mas malapit na ang ila himuon nga ground assault agud mapapas ang Hezbollah.
english: Israel has also closed three border towns — called closed military zones — and is seen as a sign that it is closer to launching a ground assault to destroy Hezbollah.

text: Ginapaabot na ni Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Secretary Christina Roque nga madamo pa gid nga opisyal sang ila attached agency nga Philippine Contractors Accreditation Board (PCAB) ang magapanaog sa ila pwesto sa palaabuton nga mga adlaw.
english: Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Secretary Christina Roque expects more officials of her attached agency, the Philippine Contractors Accreditation Board (PCAB), to step down in the coming days.

text: Ini pagkatapos nga nag-resign ang executive director sang board nga si Herbert Matienzo kag duha pa ka iban nga miyembro.
english: This is after the board’s executive director Herbert Matienzo and two other members resigned.

text: “We’re still expecting more resignations in the next few days, effective immediately also,” pahayag sang tiglikom sa atubang sang reporters.
english: “We’re still expecting more resignations in the next few days, effective immediately as well,” the secretary told reporters.

text: Ini ang sa tunga man sang kontrobersiya kaangot sa ginaalegar nga anomaliya sa flood control projects sang gobyerno.
english: This is also amid controversy over alleged anomalies in government flood control projects.

text:
Sa hearing sang House Infrastructure Committee sang Martes, matandaan nga nagpanawagan si House Deputy Speaker Jefferson Khonghun nga ipa-lifestyle check si Matienzo bangud sang alegasyon nga “registration for sale.”

Isa ang PCAB sa implementing boards sang Construction Industry Authority of the Philippines nga sa idalom sang pagdumala sang DTI.
english:
During the hearing of the House Infrastructure Committee on Tuesday, it can be recalled that House Deputy Speaker Jefferson Khonghun called for Matienzo to undergo a lifestyle check over the alleged “registration for sale.”

The PCAB is one of the implementing boards of the Construction Industry Authority of the Philippines under the supervision of the DTI.

text: Nagpasalig naman ang ahensya nga ipaguwa nila ang kabug-usan nga listahan sang mga kumpaniya nga mawad-an sang lisensya kadungan sang ginapatigayon nga kumprehensibo nga imbestigasyon sa mga ginaalegar nga anomaliya nga may kaangtanan sa accreditation sang mga kontraktor.
english: The agency promised to release the full list of companies that will lose their licenses while conducting a comprehensive investigation into alleged anomalies related to the accreditation of contractors.

text: Sa subong, gin-revoke na sang board ang lisensya sang siyam ka construction firms nga ginapanag-iyahan ni Sarah Discaya.#
english: The board has now revoked the licenses of nine construction firms owned by Sarah Discaya.

text: SOUTH KOREA – Nagpalab-ot sang bulig pinansyal ang mga kilala nga personalidad sa South Korea bangud sa padayon nga pagsaka sang kaso sang Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID)-19 sa Daegu City kag iban pa nga bahin sang nasambit nga pungsod.
english: SOUTH KOREA – Prominent personalities in South Korea have donated financial assistance due to the continuous increase in cases of Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID)-19 in Daegu City and other parts of the country.

text: Lakip sa mga personalidad nga nagpalab-ot sang bulig amo ang mga celebrities nga sanday Hyun bin, Son Ye Jin, Park Seo Jun, award winning director nga si Bang Joon ho, Song Kang Ho, miyembro sang idol group nga BTS nga si Suga kag madamo pa.
english: Among the personalities who extended help were celebrities Hyun bin, Son Ye Jin, Park Seo Jun, award winning director Bang Joon ho, Song Kang Ho, idol group BTS member Suga and many more.

text: Suno sa Korea Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, may yara na sang 2,337 nga positibo nga kaso sang COVID-19 sa South Korea sa diin 13 na ang napatay.
english: According to the Korea Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, there are 2,337 positive cases of COVID-19 in South Korea with 13 deaths.

text: Naggradwar nga pareho nga Magna Cum Laude ang identical triplets sa Zamboanga Sibugay.
english: Both identical triplets graduated Magna Cum Laude in Zamboanga Sibugay.

text: Ini amo sanday Eva May, Lorie May kag Xennia May.
english: They are Eva May, Lorie May and Xennia May.

text: Ang tatlo ang magkaupod nga nagdako kag dungan man nga nag-eskwela sa kolehiyo sa Jose Rizal Memorial State University – Tampilisan Campus.
english: The three grew up together and also attended college at the same time at Jose Rizal Memorial State University – Tampilisan Campus.

text: Pareho man nga Bachelor of Science in Business Administration major in Financial Management ang ila nga kurso.
english: Both are Bachelor of Science in Business Administration major in Financial Management.

text: USA- Ginkansela sang banda nga Green Day ang ila labing una nga concert sa pungsod Pilipinas, bangud sa coronavirus disease 2019.
english: USA- The band Green Day has canceled their first concert in the Philippines, due to the coronavirus disease 2019.

text: Sa Social media post sang nasambit nga banda, nabudlayan sila magdesisyon sa kanselasyon sang ila concert.
english: In a social media post by the band, they said they had a hard time deciding on the cancellation of their concert.

text: Nagpanawagan naman ang grupo nga hulaton nalang ang ila liwat nga pagpagwa sang pahayag, kun san-o  naman ini hiwatun.
english: The group called for the public to wait for their next statement, when it will be held.

text: Nahibaluan nga, patigayunon kuntani sa Marso 14 sa Mall of Asia Arena ang concert sang nasambit nga band.
english: The band's concert was scheduled to be held on March 14 at the Mall of Asia Arena.

text: Nagapati ang pamunuan sang Employers Confederation of the Philippines (ECOP) nga epektibo ang nangin tikang sang National Government nga pahalugan ang quarantine restrictions pinaagi sa pagpaidalom sa granular lockdown sa pila ka mga lugar nga may clustering of cases ukon may pagtimbuok sang COVID-19 sa National Capital Region (NCR).
english: The leadership of the Employers Confederation of the Philippines (ECOP) believes that the National Government's move to ease quarantine restrictions by imposing a granular lockdown in some areas with clustering of cases or outbreaks of COVID-19 in the National Capital Region (NCR) has been effective.

text: Nahibaluan nga gin-anunsyo sang Malacañang sang Lunes, Septyembre 6, nga panubuan sa general community quarantine (GCQ) ang classification sa Manila, umpisa, Septyembre 8 tubtob 30.
english: It is known that Malacañang announced on Monday, September 6, that the classification in Manila will be lowered to general community quarantine (GCQ), starting, September 8 to 30.

text: Ipatuman man ang ”localized lockdown scheme”, kun sa diin i-lockdown lang ang mga bahin sang lugar ukon barangay nga may mataas nga numero sang COVID-19.
english: The localized lockdown scheme will also be implemented, where only parts of the area or barangay with high numbers of COVID-19 will be locked down.

text: Suno kay ECOP President Sergio Ortiz Luis Jr., dako kag maayo ini nga tikang sang gobyerno agud mabalanse ang ikaayong-lawas sang mga tawo kag ang ekonomiya sangpungsod.
english: According to ECOP President Sergio Ortiz Luis Jr., this is a big and good step by the government to balance the health of the people and the economy of the country.

text: Bentaha man ini suno sa natungdan agud indi maapektuhan ang trabaho sang mga mamumugon sa iban nga lugar nga manubo ang kaso sang COVID-19.
english: He said this is also an advantage so that the work of workers in other areas with low cases of COVID-19 will not be affected.

text: Handa na para sa 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics giant slalom competition ang Filipino alpine skier nga si Asa Miller.
english: Filipino alpine skier Asa Miller is ready for the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics giant slalom competition.

text: Ini nga competition ang patigayunon subong nga adlaw sa National Alpine Skiing Centre sa Yanqing, China.
english: This competition will be held today at the National Alpine Skiing Center in Yanqing, China.

text: Suno kay Miller, ipagwa sini ang iya nga “best” kag magapabilin nga relaxed agud nga malumpawasan ang challenging slopes sang Xiaohaituo Mountain.
english: Miller said he will give his best and remain relaxed to overcome the challenging slopes of Xiaohaituo Mountain.

text: Nagpalab-ot naman sang suporta kay Miller ang mga nauna na nga Pinoy Olympian nga nag-compete sa Winter Olympics nga si Ben Nanasca kag Juan Cipriano.
english: Miller was also supported by former Filipino Olympians who competed in the Winter Olympics, Ben Nanasca and Juan Cipriano.

text: Si Nanasca ang nagpartisipar man sa men’s giant slalom sang ini ang nag-compete sang 1972.
english: Nanasca also participated in the men’s giant slalom when it competed in 1972.

text: Isa pa ka Filipino Olympian nga si Michael Teruel ang nagpalab-ut man sang iya nga suporta.
english: Another Filipino Olympian, Michael Teruel, also expressed his support.

text: Si Teruel ang nakakuha sang place nga ika-71st sa giant slalom kag 49th sa slalom sa Albertville 1992 Winter Olympics.
english: Teruel placed 71st in the giant slalom and 49th in the slalom at the Albertville 1992 Winter Olympics.

text: Nagapati ang mga nauna nga Olympians nga mangin manami ang performance si Miller.
english: Previous Olympians believe Miller will perform well.

text: Nahibaluan nga maga-compete si Miller sa men’s giant slalom umpisa las 10:00 subong nga aga, Pebrero 13, kag magabalik pagkatapos sang tatlo ka adlaw ukon sa Pebrero 16, para sa men’s slalom event nga maga-umpisa man takna las 10:00 sa aga.
english: Miller will compete in the men's giant slalom starting at 10:00 this morning, February 13, and will return after three days or on February 16, for the men's slalom event which will also start at 10:00 am.

text: Siya ang naga-isahanon nga atleta nga ginpadala sang pungsod para sa 2022 Winter Olympics.
english: He was the only athlete the country sent for the 2022 Winter Olympics.

text: Naghilibion ang isa ka Ilongga Overseas Filipino Worker sa Lebanon samtang ginalaragway ang sitwasyon sa amo nga pungsod bangud sa padayon nga pag-atake sang Israel agud i-target ang grupo nga Hezbollah.
english: An Ilongga Overseas Filipino Worker in Lebanon cried while describing the situation in the country due to Israel's continuous attacks to target the group Hezbollah.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Neena Camince Trabasas, Bombo International Correspondent sa Lebanon kag 25 ka tuig na nga OFW, iya ginpahayag nga apisar nabalaka sila sa ila seguridad nga mga Pinoy, mas nagapangibabaw ang ila kaluoy sa mga inosente nga kabataan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Neena Camince Trabasas, Bombo International Correspondent in Lebanon and 25-year-old OFW, said that although they are concerned about their security as Filipinos, their compassion for the innocent children prevails.

text: Suno kay Trabasas, indi takos kag wala nagakaangay para sa kabataan nga masaksihan ang kinagamo.
english: According to Trabasas, it is not appropriate and inappropriate for children to witness the violence.

text: Nagalaum naman ini nga magtahaw na ang sitwasyon kag wala na sang maumid nga mga sibilyan.
english: He hopes that the situation will improve and no more civilians will be injured.

text: Sa pihak sang nagakatabo, wala sang plano si Trabasas nga magpauli sa Pilipinas.
english: Despite what is happening, Trabasas has no plans to return to the Philippines.

text: Suno sa iya, dako ini nga risgo para sa ila apang desidido ini nga magpabilin sa Lebanon.
english: He said it was a big risk for them but he was determined to stay in Lebanon.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginaengganyo sang gobyerno sang Pilipinas ang mga OFWs sa Lebanon nga mag-avail sang repatriation.
english: The Philippine government is encouraging OFWs in Lebanon to avail of repatriation.

text: Ginaduso sa Kamara nga buhinan ang value-added tax (VAT) halin sa 12% pakadto sa 10% agud mabuligan nga magnubo ang inflation ukon pagsaka sang presyo sang mga produkto.
english: The House is proposing to reduce the value-added tax (VAT) from 12% to 10% to help reduce inflation.

text: Si Batangas First District Representative Leandro Leviste ang nag-file sang House Bill 4302 ukon VAT Reduction Act of 2025.
english: Batangas First District Representative Leandro Leviste filed House Bill 4302 or VAT Reduction Act of 2025.

text: Suno sa iya, nagdako na gid ang nakuha sang gobyerno sa VAT halin P156.67 bilyon sang 2005 tubtob P1.20 trilyon sa 2024, gani masarangan pa gihapon nga ibanan sa 10% bisan pa madula ang P200 bilyon nga kita.
english: He said the government's VAT revenue has increased from P156.67 billion in 2005 to P1.20 trillion in 2024, so it can still be reduced to 10% even if the P200 billion in revenue is lost.

text: Ginsiling ni Leviste nga mabug-at ang VAT labi na sa mga pigado kag middle class, gani makabulig gid kun ibanan ukon buhinan ini para mangin patas ang sistema sang buwis kag malikawan ang mataas nga inflation.
english: Leviste said that VAT is heavy especially on the poor and middle class, so it would help if it was reduced to make the tax system fair and avoid high inflation.

text: Ginsiling man niya nga ang 12% VAT sa Pilipinas ang pinakamataas sa Southeast Asia ipaanggid sa iban nga pungsod pareho sang Vietnam, Cambodia, Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Laos, kag Myanmar.
english: He also said that the 12% VAT in the Philippines is the highest in Southeast Asia compared to other countries such as Vietnam, Cambodia, Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Laos, and Myanmar.

text: Ang ini nga ginaduso nga hagna nagatugot man nga temporaryo nga ibalik sa 12% ang VAT kon sobra sa target ang budget deficit sang gobyerno.
english: The proposed bill also allows the VAT to be temporarily restored to 12% if the government's budget deficit exceeds the target.

text: Ginsiling naman ni Finance Undersecretary Karlo Adriano nga pagatun-an nila ang proposal.
english: Finance Undersecretary Karlo Adriano said they will study the proposal.

text: Iginiit ni Senate Minority Leader Vicente “Tito” Sotto III na wala dapat ikabahala ang mga opisyal at mambabatas na nadadawit sa isyu ng flood control projects kung wala silang ginawang mali.
english: Senate Minority Leader Vicente “Tito” Sotto III stressed that the officials and lawmakers involved in the issue of flood control projects should not be worried if they have done nothing wrong.

text: Sa isang panayam, sinabi ni Sotto na kung walang katiwalian sa pagkakasama ng ilang proyekto sa budget, wala rin umanong dahilan para matakot.
english: In a statement, Sotto said that if there is no corruption in the inclusion of some projects in the budget, there is no reason to be afraid.

text: Binigyang-diin niya na dapat managot ang sinumang responsable, kabilang ang mga contractor, opisyal ng Department of Public Works and Highways, at mga politiko na posibleng nagpasok ng kuwestyunableng proyekto sa pondo.
english: He stressed that anyone responsible should be held accountable, including contractors, officials of the Department of Public Works and Highways, and politicians who may have included questionable projects in the fund.

text: Suportado rin ni Sotto ang kautusan ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Sotto also supported President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s decree.

text: sa DPWH at Department of Budget and Management na muling busisiin ang buong pondo ng DPWH para sa 2026 sa ilalim ng National Expenditure Program.
english: to the DPWH and Department of Budget and Management to review the entire DPWH fund for 2026 under the National Expenditure Program.

text: Ayon sa kanya, hindi raw makakatarungan na dumiretso sa 2026 budget kung hindi pa natutukoy ang mga iregularidad sa 2025.
english: According to him, it is not fair to go straight to the 2026 budget if the irregularities in 2025 have not been identified.

text: Binanggit niya ang ulat na may mga proyektong tinukoy nang ‘completed’ sa 2025 ngunit muling lumitaw sa 2026 budget.
english: He mentioned the report that some projects were specified as 'completed' in 2025 but will reappear in the 2026 budget.

text: Para sa kanya, ito ay dapat tanggalin at tukuyin kung sino ang nagpasok nito.
english: For him, it should be removed and it should be determined who inserted it.

text: Ipinunto rin ni Sotto ang kahalagahan ng Senate Bill 1215, na kanyang inihain, na naglalayong lumikha ng isang Independent People’s Commission upang magsagawa ng patas na imbestigasyon sa mga kaso ng maling paggamit ng pondo.
english: Sotto also pointed out the importance of Senate Bill 1215, which he introduced, which seeks to create an Independent People's Commission to conduct fair investigations into cases of misuse of funds.

text: Aniya, makatutulong ito upang tiyaking may proteksyon ang taumbayan laban sa pang-aabuso sa kapangyarihan.
english: He said this will help ensure that the people are protected against abuse of power.

text: Dagdag pa niya, pera ng taong-bayan ang pinag-uusapan, hindi ng gobyerno, kaya nakapanghihinayang ang umano’y katiwaliang kaakibat ng mga ‘ghost projects.’
english: He added that the people's money is being discussed, not the government's, so the alleged corruption involved in ghost projects is disappointing.

text: Game nga ginsabat sang aktor nga si Arjo Atayde kun si Maine Mendoza na bala ang iya future wife.
english: Game that actor Arjo Atayde answered if Maine Mendoza is his future wife.

text: “Ofcourse” Ini ang nangin sabat sang 29 anyos nga aktor sa nasambit nga pamangkot.
english: “Ofcourse” This was the 29-year-old actor's answer to the question.

text: Gin-ako man ni Arjo nga na istoryahan na nila ni Maine ang natuhoy sa isyu sang pagpakasal.
english: Arjo also admitted that he and Maine have already discussed the issue of marriage.

text: Samtang sa pamangkot naman kun san-o ini, mas piliun ni Arjo nga himuon ini nga pribado para sa iya pamilya kag sa ila duha ni Maine.
english: Meanwhile, when asked when it will be, Arjo prefers to make it private for his family and both Maine.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagselebrar sang ila first anniversary sang damlag lang ang couple.
english: The couple celebrated their first anniversary recently.

text: Nagtambong pa liwat sa training session ang 15-anyos nga Russian figure skating sensation nga si Kamila Valieva apisar nga ini ang sentro sang latest drug testing scandal sa Winter Olympics sa Beijing, China.
english: 15-year-old Russian figure skating sensation Kamila Valieva attended another training session despite being at the center of the latest drug testing scandal at the Winter Olympics in Beijing, China.

text: Antes ang paglupok sang kontrobersiya, si Valieva ang nakahimo na sang maragtas bilang first female skater nga naka-land sa quadruple jump sa Olympics.
english: Before the eruption of controversy, Valieva had already made history as the first female skater to land a quadruple jump at the Olympics.

text: Siya man ang heavy favorite nga makadaog sang gold medal sa women’s individual event sa masunod nga semana.
english: She is also the heavy favorite to win the gold medal in the women’s individual event next week.

text: Matandaan nga ang team nanday Valieva ang nagdaog sang gold medal sa isa ka team event subong nga semana apang gin-delay ang awarding ceremony bangud ginpahayag nga nagpositibo ang amo nga skater sa drugs nga ginadumilian sa Olympics.
english: Valieva's team won a gold medal in a team event this week but the awarding ceremony was delayed because the skater reportedly tested positive for drugs banned at the Olympics.

text: Ang amo nga positive test ang posible mangin rason nga bawion sa Russia ang gold nga nadag-an kag threat man sa partisipasyon ni Valieva sa individual event sa masunod nga semana.
english: Such a positive test could be the reason for Russia to withdraw the gold won and also a threat to Valieva's participation in the individual event next week.

text: Ginpahayag nga sang Disyembre pa gin-take ang drug test apang subong lang nga semana naguwa ang report.
english: The drug test was reportedly taken in December but the report came out this week.

text: Sandig pa sa report, ang na-trace nga drug amo ang trimetazidine, isa ka metabolic agent nga ginagamit para sa treatment sang angina kag vertigo nga gina-ban sang World Anti-Doping Agency bangud makapadasig ini sa blood flow efficiency kag makabulig man sa endurance sang tawo.
english: According to the report, the traced drug is trimetazidine, a metabolic agent used for the treatment of angina and vertigo that is banned by the World Anti-Doping Agency because it can increase blood flow efficiency and help human endurance.

text: Si Valieva kag ang iya nga teammates ang wala naga-compete para sa Russia kundi sa idalom sang Russian Olympic Committee.
english: Valieva and her teammates are not competing for Russia but under the Russian Olympic Committee.

text: Ini bangud pormal nga gin-ban sang 2019 WADA ang Russia nga mag-compete sa major sporting events sa nadiskubrehan nga lapnagon kag state-sponsored nga doping ukon paggamit sang sang ginadumilian nga substances para sa hinampang.
english: This is because in 2019 WADA formally banned Russia from competing in major sporting events for the discovery of widespread and state-sponsored doping or the use of banned substances for the game.

text: Isa na naman ka high-ranking official sang Hezbollah ang ginpatay sang Israel pagkatapos nga ginkumpirma nga napatay man ang ila long-time leader nga si Hassan Nasrallah.
english: Israel has killed another high-ranking Hezbollah official after confirming that its long-time leader Hassan Nasrallah was also killed.

text: Suno sa Israel Defense Forces (IDF), ang latest nga napatay sa airstrike amo si Nabil Kaouk nga deputy head sang Central County sang Hezbollah.
english: According to the Israel Defense Forces (IDF), the latest killed in the airstrike was Nabil Kaouk who was deputy head of Central County of Hezbollah.

text: Si Kaouk ang isa ka beterano nga miyembro sang militant group halin pa sang 1980s kag naka-serbe pa anay bilang military commander sang amo nga grupo sa southern Lebanon sang nag-gyera sila kag ang Israel sang 2006.
english: Kaouk is a veteran member of the militant group since the 1980s and served as the group's military commander in southern Lebanon during the 2006 war with Israel.

text: Ikapito na siya nga Hezbollah leader nga napatay sa atake sang Israel sa sulod lamang sang halos isa ka semana.
english: He is the seventh Hezbollah leader killed in an Israeli attack in just over a week.

text: Ang ila kamatayon ilabi na ang kay Nasrallah nga dominant political figure sa Middle East ang ginalantaw nga magapasangkad pa sang away sa rehiyon.
english: Their deaths, especially those of Nasrallah, the dominant political figure in the Middle East, are expected to escalate the conflict in the region.

text: Kaangot diri, apat man ang patay kag 45 ang nasamaran sang ginpang-igu man sang Israel ang power station sa Hodeidah, Yemen.
english: Meanwhile, four people were killed and 45 wounded when Israel also hit a power station in Hodeidah, Yemen.

text: Gina-claim sang Israel nga ini nga power plant kag ang seaport sa Ras Issa ang ginagamit sang Houthis.
english: Israel claims that this power plant and the seaport in Ras Issa are used by the Houthis.

text: Ang Houthi rebel group kaangay man sa Hezbollah kag Hamas nga mga proxy groups sang Iran kag palareho nga mga kaaway sang Israel.#
english: The Houthi rebel group is similar to Hezbollah and Hamas, which are Iranian proxy groups and equal enemies of Israel.

text: Nagsaka sa P337 billion as of July 2021 ang utang sang national government.
english: The national government's debt rose to P337 billion as of July 2021.

text: Bangud sini, naglab-ot sa P2.27 trillion ang year-to-year date tally.
english: As a result, the year-to-year date tally reached P2.27 trillion.

text: Santo sa data sang Bureau of Treasury, 50 percent gid ang ginsaka sang actual gross financing ipaanggid sa P134.55 billion sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: According to Bureau of Treasury data, actual gross financing increased by 50 percent compared to P134.55 billion last year.

text: Nagsaka naman sa 169 percent ukon P180.36 billion ang domestic borrowings halin sa P66.83 billion sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Domestic borrowings rose by 169 percent or P180.36 billion from P66.83 billion last year.

text: Sa una nga pito ka bulan sang 2021, P1.93 trillion na ang kabug-usan nga pondo nga ginhulam sang gobyerno.
english: In the first seven months of 2021, the total funds borrowed by the government were P1.93 trillion.

text: SI RUSSIAN President Vladimir Putin nagpahayag sa Forbes Business News sadtong Pebrero 16, 2022 nga luyag ini makig-negosasyon sa kay US President Joe Biden angot sa seguridad sang ila mga pungsod.
english: RUSSIAN President Vladimir Putin told Forbes Business News on February 16, 2022 that he wants to negotiate with US President Joe Biden on the security of their countries.

text: Luyag sini punggan ni Biden ang pag-deploy sang medium-range missiles sang US sa mga pungsod sang North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) sa Uropa, kag pamalabagan man ang pagsulod sang Ukraine sa NATO.
english: Biden wants to stop the US deployment of medium-range missiles to North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) countries in Europe, and also block Ukraine's accession to NATO.

text: Sadtong Disyembre 25, 10 ka bulan pagkatapos nga ginsalakay na sang Russia ang Ukraine sadtong Pebrero 20,  liwat nagpahayag si Putin sang iya intensyon nga makig-negosasyon.
english: On December 25, 10 months after Russia had already invaded Ukraine on February 20,  Putin again expressed his intention to negotiate.

text: Indi na ugaling kay Biden lang kundi sa “everyone involved” para sa “acceptable solutions” sa padayon na nga away sang Russia kag Ukraine.
english: However, it is not just for Biden but for “everyone involved” for “acceptable solutions” to the ongoing conflict between Russia and Ukraine.

text: Wala diri ni Putin ginpahayag kon ano gid ang iya luyag, ukon ang pwede niya mapasugtan.
english: Putin has not here revealed what he really wants, or what he might agree to.

text: Ano ayhan ini?
english: What could it be?

text: Mahibal-an ta pa ina seguro kon matabo gid man ining negosasyon.
english: We'll probably find out if this negotiation actually happens.

text:
***

Nakita seguro ni Putin ang dugang nga “security threat” sa iya pungsod sa liwat nga paghugpong sang 30 ka myembro sang NATO sa pagbulos ni US President Joe Biden  kay Donald Trump.
english:
***

Putin probably sees an additional “security threat” to his country in the reunification of 30 NATO members with the replacement of US President Joe Biden by Donald Trump.

text: Dugang pa diri ang pagpa-itin-itin sang kasilingan sini nga Ukraine sang luyag sini sa pagsulod sa military alliance sang NATO.
english: In addition, its neighbor Ukraine is threatening its desire to join the NATO military alliance.

text: Sa pag-dissolve sang Union of Soviet Socialist Republics USSR) sadtong 1991, lubos na nakigbugras ang Ukraine sa ano man nga relasyon sa Russia kag nangin myembro na sang United Nations.
english: With the dissolution of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (USSR) in 1991, Ukraine broke with Russia and became a member of the United Nations.

text: Ginkaakig gid ini sang Russia, labi na gid sa pagpungko na sa poder ni Putin.
english: Russia was very angry about this, especially since Putin came to power.

text: Ginbuligan pa gani sini ang mga rebelde sa ila kawsa batok sa Ukraine tubtub maagaw ang Crimea kag gingamhan na ini ni Putin sugod sadtong 2014.
english: It even helped the rebels in their cause against Ukraine until Crimea was seized and Putin has ruled it since 2014.

text:
***

Sa negosasyon nga ginpaabot ni Putin kay Biden, luyag sini, sa nasiling ta na, nga indi mag-pahamtang ang US sang medium-range missiles sa mga pungsod sang NATO sa Uropa, nga malapit sini nga mga kasilingan.
english:
***

In the negotiations that Putin expected from Biden, he wanted, as we have already said, to prevent the US from deploying medium-range missiles in NATO countries in Europe, which are its close neighbors.

text: Ugaling kay sige man taya sang Russia sang iya mga missiles sa mga pungsod sang NATO sa Uropa, luas pa sa “nuclear threat” sini  sa United States sa North America.
english: However, Russia continues to launch missiles at NATO countries in Europe, in addition to its nuclear threat to the United States in North America.

text: Unfair!
english: Unfair!

text: Luyag man ni Putin kumbinsihon ni Biden ang Ukraine nga indi magsulod sa NATO.
english: Putin also wants Biden to convince Ukraine not to join NATO.

text: Indi ugaling ini mahimo sang US tungod sa “open policy” sang NATO.
english: However, the US cannot do this because of NATO's open policy.

text: Dapat nga ang Ukraine gid ang magtanyag sang iya luyag sa pagsulod sa NATO.
english: It should be Ukraine itself that offers what it wants to join NATO.

text: Segurado naton ugaling nga indi mamati si Ukraine President Zelensky sa katulad nga suhestyon halin sa Russia.
english: We are sure, however, that Ukrainian President Zelensky will not listen to a similar suggestion from Russia.

text: Akig gid ini sa pag-okupar sang Russia sang Crimea, nga luyag bawion ini bisan sa paagi lang sa United Nations sa bulig sang NATO.
english: It is furious about Russia’s occupation of Crimea, wanting to reclaim it even if only through the United Nations with the help of NATO.

text: Mabudlay man ugaling nga makasulod sa NATO ang Ukraine, kay kinahanglan sini ang pagpasugot gid sang tanan nga mga myembro.
english: However, it is also difficult for Ukraine to join NATO, as it requires the consent of all members.

text: Isa sa sini nga indi magpasugot ang Turkey.
english: One of these is that Turkey will not agree.

text: Nakapahayag na gani ini nga “neutral” ini sa away sang Ukraine kag Russia.
english: It has even declared itself “neutral” on the Ukraine-Russia conflict.

text: Daw wala na aputan ugaling ining panugyan ni Putin nga negosasyon sadtong Pebrero 16.
english: However, Putin's proposal for negotiations on February 16 seems to have failed.

text: Gani ginpa-atake na ni Putin ang Ukraine sadtong Pebrero 20 kay kuno “clear and imminent security threat” na ini sa Russia.
english: So Putin attacked Ukraine on February 20 because it was a “clear and imminent security threat” to Russia.

text: Ginpamahog man sini ang iya nuclear power sa kon sin-o man ang may gana nga atakehon ang Russia.
english: It also threatened its nuclear power against anyone who had the appetite to attack Russia.

text: No problem.
english: No problem.

text: Wala man sing luyag atakehon ang Russia tungod gani isa ini ka nuclear power.
english: Nor does Russia want to attack anyone because it is therefore a nuclear power.

text: Luas lang kon ini ang manguna!
english: Unless it takes the lead!

text: Ang Russia pa gani ang may gana mang-gyera, nga ginhimo gid sini batok sa Ukraine sadtong Pebrero 20.
english: Even Russia is willing to go to war, which it did against Ukraine on February 20th.

text: Pwede ugaling ang magbulig sa both sides, tutal ang gyera yara man lang sa Ukraine.
english: However, both sides can help, since the war is still in Ukraine.

text:
***

Nagsala si Putin nga madale lutoson ang Ukraine.
english:
***

Putin was wrong that Ukraine was easy to defeat.

text: Tubtub karon, sa pagligad na sang mga 10 ka bulan, pila lang ka lugar ang naagaw sini.
english: So far, after about 10 months, it has captured only a few places.

text: In fact, nabawi na sang Ukraine ang mga 54% sang naagaw sang Russia nga mga 15% nga teritoryo sang Ukraine.
english: In fact, Ukraine has already recaptured about 54% of what Russia seized which is about 15% of Ukrainian territory.

text: Nag-abanse gid sing maayo ang Ukraine sa pag-abot sang taglamig (winter) sugod sadtong Disyembre sang sini nga tuig.
english: Ukraine has made significant progress with the arrival of winter since December of this year.

text: Ini ayhan ang kabangdanan kon ngaa  makig-negosasyon na si Putin sa “everyone involved”?
english: Is this why Putin is negotiating with “everyone involved”?

text: Kay pwede malutos na sing lubos ini?
english: Because it can be completely defeated?

text: Kag mahawiran man lang gihapon ang Crimea, ukon pila pa ka lugar nga na-okupar na sini?
english: And will Crimea still be occupied, or some other places it has already occupied?

text: Indi seguro matabo ina.
english: That probably won't happen.

text: Nanumpa gid ang Ukraine nga bawion ang tanan nga lugar nga gin-annex sang Russia halin sa Ukraine.
english: Ukraine has actually vowed to take back all the areas that Russia has annexed from Ukraine.

text: Gani, madugay pa seguro ang gyera sang Russia kag Ukraine.
english: So, the war between Russia and Ukraine is probably going to last a long time.

text: Samtang ginpagamo man sining gyera ang kalibutanon nga ekonomiya tungod sa pagsalakay sang Russia sa Ukraine./PN
english: Meanwhile, the war has also disrupted the global economy due to Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

text: Pangunahan ni Carlos Edriel “Caloy” Yulo ang team halin sa Pilipinas nga magapasakop sa 53rd Artistic Gymnastics World Championships sa Jakarta, Indonesia.
english: Carlos Edriel “Caloy” Yulo will lead the team from the Philippines that will participate in the 53rd Artistic Gymnastics World Championships in Jakarta, Indonesia.

text: Maga-umpisa ang kumpetisyon sa Domingo, Oktubre 19, kun sa diin tatlo ka adlaw ang qualification rounds kag naka-schedule naman ang finals sa Oktubre 22 tubtub 25.
english: The competition will start on Sunday, October 19, with three days of qualification rounds and the finals scheduled for October 22 to 25.

text: Dayunon sang 25-anyos nga gymnast ang pag-intra apisar sang naangkon sini nga wrist injury, apang base sa reports, limitahan lang sini ang iya pasakupan sa floor exercise kag sa vault.
english: The 25-year-old gymnast will continue to participate despite her wrist injury, but based on reports, she will limit her participation to the floor exercise and the vault.

text: Kaupod ni Yulo ang iban pa nga Southeast Asian Games medalists kaangay kanday Juancho Besana, John Ivan Cruz kag Justine Ace De Leon, Haylee Garcia kag Paris Olympians nga sanday Aleah Finnegan kag Emma Malabuyo.
english: Yulo was joined by other Southeast Asian Games medalists such as Juancho Besana, John Ivan Cruz and Justine Ace De Leon, Haylee Garcia and Paris Olympians Aleah Finnegan and Emma Malabuyo.

text: Talalupangdon nga maga-upod man sa kumpetisyon ang manghod ni Yulo nga si Elaiza.
english: Notably, Yulo’s younger sister, Elaiza, will also be joining the competition.

text: Magasulod si Yulo sa tournament nga isa sa ginakabig bilang most decorated gymnasts nga may duha ka gold medals sa World Championship nga amo ang sa floor exercise kag sa vault; duha ka silver medals nga nakuha sini sa parallel bars kag sa vault; kag duha man ka bronze medals nga naangkon naman sini sa floor exercise kag sa parallel bars sa nagligad nga mga edisyon sang nasambit nga global event.
english: Yulo will enter the tournament as one of the most decorated gymnasts with two gold medals at the World Championships, namely in the floor exercise and the vault; two silver medals it earned on the parallel bars and the vault; and two bronze medals in the floor exercise and parallel bars in previous editions of the global event.

text: Sang 2023 World Championships sa Belgium, nagpang-apat lamang si Yulo sa floor exercise nga amo ang isahanon nga apparatus kun sa diin nag-qualify siya para sa finals.
english: At the 2023 World Championships in Belgium, Yulo placed only fourth in the floor exercise which was the only apparatus where he qualified for the finals.

text: Maga-upod ang opposition figures nga sanday Leila de Lima kag Chel Diokno sa prosecution panel sang Kamara sa impeachment trial ni Vice President Sara Duterte kasunod sang imbitasyon halin mismo kay House Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: Opposition figures Leila de Lima and Chel Diokno will join the prosecution panel of the House of Representatives in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte following an invitation from House Speaker Martin Romualdez himself.

text: Suno sa house speaker, kilala ang duha sa pinakalagting nga mga indibidwal sa legal nga propesyon, kag ang ila nga pagkalakip sa prosekusyon ang makadugang sang kredibilidad kag balanse.
english: The house speaker said the two are known to be among the most prominent individuals in the legal profession, and their inclusion in the prosecution will add credibility and balance.

text: “Former Senator De Lima and Atty. Diokno are two of the most respected legal minds in the country.
english: “Former Senator De Lima and Atty. Diokno are two of the most respected legal minds in the country.

text: Their potential inclusion in the prosecution panel would add credibility, balance, and depth to this constitutionally mandated process,” pahayag ni Romualdez.
english: Their potential inclusion in the prosecution panel would add credibility, balance, and depth to this constitutionally mandated process,” pahayag ni Romualdez.

text: Lunsay naman nagpaguwa sang statement ang kampo nanday Congresswoman-elect De Lima kag Congressman-elect Diokno nga ginabaton nila ang tanyag ni Romualdez.
english: The camps of Congresswoman-elect De Lima and Congressman-elect Diokno both issued statements saying they accept Romualdez's offer.

text: Suno kay De Lima nga kilala sa pagpakigbato para sa tawhanon nga kinamatarong, nagapanindugan siya para sa kamatuoran kag para mapasabat ang may salabton, kag magapabilin ini nga commitment bisan ano man ang political affiliation.
english: De Lima, who is known for fighting for human rights, said he stands for the truth and for those responsible to be held accountable, and this commitment will remain regardless of political affiliation.

text: “My decision comes from a place of duty and principle.
english: “My decision comes from a place of duty and principle.

text: I have always stood for truth, accountability, and the rule of law — across different administrations, regardless of political affiliation.
english: I have always stood for truth, accountability, and the rule of law — across different administrations, regardless of political affiliation.

text: That commitment remains unchanged,” pahayag sini.
english: That commitment remains unchanged,” it said.

text: Nahibaluan nga si De Lima amo ang first nominee sang Mamamayang Liberal (ML) nga ginalantaw nga makakuha sang isa ka pwesto sa Kongreso.
english: De Lima is the first nominee of the Mamamayang Liberal (ML) who is expected to win a seat in Congress.

text: Nagpaguwa naman sang statement ang Akbayan partylist nga bug-os nga ila suporta sa ila first nominee nga si Diokno nga mangin kabahin sang panel.
english: The Akbayan partylist issued a statement that they fully support their first nominee, Diokno, to be part of the panel.

text: Ang Akbayan naman amo ang una nga grupo sa party-list race subong nga eleksyon.
english: Akbayan is the first group in the party-list race this election.

text: “As the principal endorser of the first impeachment complaint and after thorough party deliberations, we extend our full support to this historic process of accountability.
english: “As the principal endorser of the first impeachment complaint and after thorough party deliberations, we extend our full support to this historic process of accountability.

text: Incoming Akbayan Rep.
english: Incoming Akbayan Rep.

text: Atty. Chel Diokno will join the House prosecution panel,” suno sa partylist.
english: Atty. Chel Diokno will join the House prosecution panel,” according to the partylist.

text: Natabo ang pag-imbitar kanday De Lima kag Diokno matapos nga wala nagdaog sa ila reelection bid ang duha sa 11 kag House prosecutors nga una na nga ginpakilala sang Kamara sang Pebrero.
english: The invitation to De Lima and Diokno came after two of the 11 House prosecutors who were first introduced by the House in February failed in their reelection bid.

text: Ini amo sanday Ako Bicol Representative Jil Bongalon kag General Santos City Representative Loreto Acharon.
english: Ini amo sanday Ako Bicol Representative Jil Bongalon kag General Santos City Representative Loreto Acharon.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo Third District Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Iloilo Third District Rep.

text: Lorenz Defensor nga myembro man sang prosecution team, iya ginpahayag nga daku nga kadulaan sa team sanday Bongalon kag Acharon, apang kumpyansa man siya sa abilidad nanday De Lima kag Diokno.
english: Lorenz Defensor, who is also a member of the prosecution team, said that Bongalon and Acharon are a big loss to the team, but he is also confident in the ability of De Lima and Diokno.

text: “Sila ay mahuhusay na litigators, at kung willing silang tumulong sa impeachment, makakatulong sila sa pagpresenta nang maayos ng aming mga ebidensya,” suno kay Defensor.
english: “They are good litigators, and if they are willing to help in the impeachment, they can help present our evidence properly,” Defensor said.

text: Suno pa sa iya, ang pinaka-importante amo nga mabatian sang mga Pilipino ang kaundan sang ebidensya sang prosecution amo man ang depensa sang bise-presidente.
english: He said the most important thing is that Filipinos hear the content of the prosecution's evidence as well as the vice-president's defense.

text: Importante man suno sa iya nga mabaton ang desisyon sang senator-judges.
english: He said it is also important to accept the decision of the senator-judges.

text: Hulyo 30 ginalauman nga maga-umpisa ang impeachment trial batok kay Duterte sa senado kasunod sang opisyal nga mga preparasyon sa pagbalik sang session sa Kongreso sa Hunyo 2.
english: The impeachment trial against Duterte is expected to begin in the Senate on July 30 following official preparations for the resumption of the session in Congress on June 2.

text: May na-report na nga mga kaso sang monkeypox sa United Kingdom, Espanya, Portugal, Italya, kag Estados Unidos subong nga semana — isa ka makabig rare occurrence sang virus nga na-rekord lang anay sa central kag western Africa.
english: Cases of monkeypox have already been reported in the United Kingdom, Spain, Portugal, Italy, and the United States this week — a considerably rare occurrence of the virus previously recorded only in central and western Africa.

text: Gin-report sang US ang una nga monkeypox case subong nga tuig sang nagligad lang nga Myerkules.
english: The US reported its first monkeypox case this year just last Wednesday.

text: Ang una nga kaso amo ang lalaki sa Massachusetts.
english: The first case was a man in Massachusetts.

text: Nagpahayag man ang New York City’s health department nga may posible nga kaso man nga ginasundan subong.
english: New York City's health department also said a possible case is also being investigated.

text: Sa U.K., siyam ka mga kaso ang nareport halin sang Mayo.
english: In the U.K., nine cases have been reported since May.

text: May isa sa Italya, 14 sa Portugal, pito sa Spain kag may 22 ka suspected cases.
english: There is one in Italy, 14 in Portugal, seven in Spain and there are 22 suspected cases.

text: May suspected case man sa France.
english: There is also a suspected case in France.

text: ANO ANG MONKEYPOX?
english: WHAT IS MONKEYPOX?

text: Nalakip ang monkeypox sa family of poxviruses kun sa diin included man ang smallpox.
english: Monkeypox belongs to the family of poxviruses which also includes smallpox.

text: Nadiskubrehan ini sang scientists sa laboratory monkeys sang 1958.
english: Scientists discovered it in laboratory monkeys in 1958.

text: Ang first monkeypox case sa tawo ang na-diagnose sang 1970.
english: The first human monkeypox case was diagnosed in the 1970s.

text: Halin sang amo nga tion, na-rekord kag nag-concentrate ini nga infection sa Democratic Republic of the Congo kag sa Nigeria.
english: Since that time, this infection has been recorded and concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and in Nigeria.

text: Ang sahi sang monkeypox nga natumod sang damlag lang sa U.S. kag sa European countries ang ginalaragway nga “milder disease” ipaanggid sa iban nga common branch sang virus.
english: The strain of monkeypox identified recently in the U.S. and European countries is described as a “milder disease” compared to other common branches of the virus.

text: PAANO MA-INFECT SANG MONKEYPOX?
english: HOW TO GET INFECTED WITH MONKEYPOX?

text: Makuha sang tawo ang monkeypox paagi sa mga sapat — posible paagi sa kagat ukon scratches.
english: Humans get monkeypox through animals — possibly through bites or scratches.

text: Pwede ini nga malaton sang tawo sa isa pa ka tawo paagi sa exchange sang large respiratory droplets kun nagakadugayan ang face-to-face contact.
english: It can be transmitted from person to person through the exchange of large respiratory droplets during prolonged face-to-face contact.

text: Pwede man nga ma-expose ang tawo sa direct contact sa bodily fluids ukon contaminated items kaangay sang panapton ukon bedding.
english: People can also be exposed to direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated items such as clothing or bedding.

text: Ang newly identified cases sa Europe ang na-rekord sa mga lalaki nga nakapakighilawas sa kaangay nga lalaki, apang ginapahayag nga ang monkeypox ang indi makabig nga sexually transmitted infection.
english: The newly identified cases in Europe were recorded in men who had sex with men, but it is said that monkeypox is not considered a sexually transmitted infection.

text: ANO ANG MGA SINTOMAS NGA DAPAT BANTAYAN?
english: WHAT ARE THE SYMPTOMS TO WATCH FOR?

text: Masami nga lima tubtub 21 ka adlaw ang ginalawig antes nga makit-an ang mga sintomas sang monkeypox.
english: It usually takes five to 21 days for symptoms of monkeypox to appear.

text: Lakip sa mga initial symptoms amo ang mataas nga temperatura sang lawas, pagpalanakit sang ulo kag likod, muscle aches, swollen glands, pagpalangurog kag pagbatyag sang kakapoy.
english: Initial symptoms include high body temperature, headache and back pain, muscle aches, swollen glands, chills and feeling tired.

text: Magatuhaw ang rashes isa tubtub lima ka adlaw pagkatapos sang una nga tion nga nakit-an ang sintomas.
english: Rashes will appear one to five days after symptoms first appear.

text: Nagaumpisa ang rashes sa nawong kag nagalapta sa iban nga bahin sang lawas.
english: The rash starts on the face and spreads to other parts of the body.

text: Kun kaisa masal-an ini nga daw sulalob.
english: Sometimes it can be mistaken for a lightning bolt.

text: Ginapahayag nga nagalawig ang sintomas sa sulod sang duha tubtub apat ka semana, apang may pila ka tawo nga nagakinahanglan gid sang hospital treatment.##
english: Symptoms reportedly last for two to four weeks, but some people require hospital treatment.##

text: Wala sang tupong ang kasubo sang pamilya kun mapatay ang ila himata — ilabi na kun ini biktima lang sang sirkumstansya kaangay sang plug nga nasal-an lang kag ginbutong sang ospital.
english: There is no equal to the grief of a family when their loved one dies — especially when it is a victim of circumstances such as a plug that was just mistaken and removed by the hospital.

text: Sa Vancouver, Washington, USA, isa ka ospital ang ginkasuhan sang negligence kag pagtuga sang severe emotional distress bangud sa pagkakas sa plug sa sala nga pasyente nga nagakinahanglan sang life support.
english: In Vancouver, Washington, USA, a hospital was charged with negligence and causing severe emotional distress for unplugging the wrong patient who needed life support.

text: Nag-ugat ini nga kaso sang ginpamangkot sang PeaceHealth Southwest Medical Center ang pamilya sang ‘brain dead’ patient nga si Michael Beehler kun padayunon pa nila ang life support.
english: The case arose when the PeaceHealth Southwest Medical Center asked the family of brain dead patient Michael Beehler if they would continue life support.

text: Bisan mabudlay ang amo nga desisyon, nagsabat ang utod ni Michael nga si Debbie Danielson nga mapasugot sila nga butungon na lamang ang plug.
english: Although the decision was difficult, Michael's sister, Debbie Danielson, replied that they would agree to just pull the plug.

text: Ginhaya ang bangkay ni Michael, ginbutang pa ang iya pangalan sa obituary section sa newspaper, kag madamo ang nagpakig-unong sa pamilya.
english: Michael's body was embalmed, his name was even included in the obituary section of the newspaper, and many expressed their condolences to the family.

text: Napuno sang kasubo ang mga himata kag abyan, apang nabayluhan ini sang tuman nga kakibot bangud pagkasunod nga adlaw, nakabaton sang tawag ang utod nga si Debbie halin mismo kay Michael.
english: Relatives and friends were filled with grief, but it was replaced by shock because the next day, sister Debbie received a call from Michael himself.

text: Indi makapati si Debbie nga buhi ang iya utod bangud ginhaya pa gani nila ini, gani nga nag-report sila gilayon sa otoridad.
english: Debbie couldn't believe that her brother was alive because they even threw him away, so they immediately reported to the authorities.

text: Gin-retrieve sang Clark County Medical Examiner ang bangkay, kag sang gin-usisa paagi sa fingerprint examination, didto nakumpirma nga indi ini si Michael kundi isa ka lalaki nga nagahingalan kay David Wells.
english: The Clark County Medical Examiner retrieved the body, and upon fingerprint examination, it was confirmed that it was not Michael but a man named David Wells.

text: Natukiban nga si Wells, 69, ang bag-o lang gid nag-abot sa ospital sang amo nga tion bangud nadunlan ini sang ginkaon nga steak kag nangin unconscious kag nag-untat man sa pagginhawa.
english: It was discovered that Wells, 69, had just arrived at the hospital at the time because he had swallowed a steak and became unconscious and stopped breathing.

text: Bangud roommate sila ni Michael, nasal-an nga siya ang ‘brain dead’ patient kag siya ang ginkakasan sang life support bisan nga wala man sang pahanugot halin sa iya nga pamilya.
english: Because they were roommates with Michael, he was mistaken for a brain dead patient and was taken off life support without the permission of his family.

text: Suno sa bata ni Wells nga si Shawn, napahibalo man siya sang ospital nga may medical emergency nga ginkamatay sang iya amay, apang wala gid siya sang hinalung-ong nga may natabo gali nga sala sa pag-identify sa pasyente.
english: Wells' son, Shawn, said he was also informed by the hospital that his father died of a medical emergency, but he had no idea that there was a mistake in identifying the patient.

text: Nabalahuba lamang ang kamatuoran sang nabalita ini kag ginpangayuan siya sang komento sang telebisyon duha ka tuig ang nagligad.
english: The truth was only revealed when the news broke and he was asked for comment by television two years later.

text: Nakit-an sang Washington Department of Health nga sampaw-sampaw ang violations sang hospital lakip na ang kapalpakan sa proseso sa pag-identify sa pasyente kag pag-train sa ila nga staff para sa identification.
english: The Washington Department of Health found that the hospital's violations were widespread, including failures in the process of identifying patients and training their staff for identification.

text: “The PeaceHealth Southwest Emergency Department is one of the busiest on the West Coast, treating 80,000 patients a year.
english: “The PeaceHealth Southwest Emergency Department is one of the busiest on the West Coast, treating 80,000 patients a year.

text: Our highly skilled healthcare team is committed to providing quality care in a safe environment every day,” kabahin naman sang nangin statement sang ospital.
english: Our highly skilled healthcare team is committed to providing quality care in a safe environment every day,” the hospital said in a statement.

text: “Given that PeaceHealth is involved in litigation, it is unfortunate we are unable to share more facts about this situation.
english: “Given that PeaceHealth is involved in litigation, it is unfortunate we are unable to share more facts about this situation.

text:
Our unwavering commitment of caring for our community remains stronger than ever.”

Magluwas sa ospital, ginkasuhan man ang American Medical Response Ambulance kag ang All County Cremation and Burial bangud sa negligence kag severe emotional distress nga natuga sa pamilya sang napatay.
english:
Our unwavering commitment of caring for our community remains stronger than ever.”

In addition to the hospital, American Medical Response Ambulance and the All County Cremation and Burial were also sued for negligence and severe emotional distress caused to the family of the deceased.

text: Wala ginpahanugutan sang Senado ang request ni Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa nga magamit sang iya pamilya ang Senate Mansion sa Baguio City.
english: The Senate rejected the request of Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa for his family to use the Senate Mansion in Baguio City.

text: Sa sulat kay Senate President Tito Sotto kahapon, Marso 12, ginpangayo ni dela Rosa nga tugutan ang iya pamilya nga mag-istar anay sa Senate Mansion para sa Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces of the Philippines ukon CSAFP Cup 2026 shooting competition sa Marso 26 tubtob 29.
english: In a letter to Senate President Tito Sotto yesterday, March 12, dela Rosa requested that his family be allowed to stay at the Senate Mansion for the Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces of the Philippines or CSAFP Cup 2026 shooting competition on March 26 to 29.

text: Suno naman kay Mark Llandro Mendoza, Senate Secretary, sandig sa patakaran, kinahanglan nga upod mismo ang senador kun may magamit sang Senate Mansion.
english: According to Mark Llandro Mendoza, Senate Secretary, according to the rules, the senator must be present when someone uses the Senate Mansion.

text: Dugang pa niya, ginapaidalom man subong sa renovation ang amo nga mansion.
english: He added that the mansion is also undergoing renovation.

text: “The Senate mansion is undergoing repairs now and the policy is the family must be accompanied by the senator,” suno kay Mendoza.
english: “The Senate mansion is undergoing repairs now and the policy is the family must be accompanied by the senator,” Mendoza said.

text: Nahibaluan nga hiwaton ang CSAFP Cup 2026 sa Philippine Military Academy (PMA) firing range sa Fort Del Pilar, Baguio City.
english: The CSAFP Cup 2026 will be held at the Philippine Military Academy (PMA) firing range in Fort Del Pilar, Baguio City.

text: Missing in action si Dela Rosa halin sang Nobyembre 2025.
english: Dela Rosa is missing in action from November 2025.

text: Nag-umpisa ini matapos gin-anunsyo ni Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla nga nakit-an na sini ang ginaalegar kopya sang alleged warrant of arrest halin sa International Criminal Court (ICC) batok kay Dela Rosa.
english: It started after Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla announced that he had found the alleged copy of the alleged warrant of arrest from the International Criminal Court (ICC) against Dela Rosa.

text: Ginhingadlan ang amo nga senador (nga former PNP chief) bilang alleged co-conspirator sa crimes against humanity case nga ginapangatubang ni former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The senator (former PNP chief) was named as an alleged co-conspirator in the crimes against humanity case facing former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Apisar nga wala ginkumpirma sang ICC kun ano ka matuod ang claim ni Remulla, wala na nagpakita si Dela Rosa sa tanan nga official activities, hearings, kag sessions sang Senado apisar nga nagabaton gihapon ini sang iya nga sweldo.#
english: Although the ICC did not confirm the truth of Remulla's claim, Dela Rosa did not appear in all official activities, hearings, and sessions of the Senate despite still receiving his salary.

text: Lauman ang senentimos nga pagsaka sang presyo sang diesel kag kerosene antes magtakop ang tuig 2025.
english: Diesel and kerosene prices are expected to rise by a penny before the end of 2025.

text: Para sa diesel kag kerosene, magasaka sang P0.60 kada litro, samtang ang presyo sang gasoline ang wala sang pagbag-o sa sini nga semana.
english: For diesel and kerosene, it will increase by P0.60 per liter, while the price of gasoline will remain unchanged this week.

text: Ipatuman ang nasambit nga pagsaka sang presyo sang produktong-petrolyo buwas sa aga.
english: The said increase in the price of petroleum products will be implemented tomorrow morning.

text: 𝗟𝗔𝗠𝗜𝗧𝗔𝗡 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬, 𝗕𝗔𝗦𝗜𝗟𝗔𝗡 – Patay ang tatlo ka operatiba sang Intelligence Service sang Armed Forces of the Philippines (ISAFP) sa ambush sa Barangay Baimbing, Lamitan City, sang hapon sang Lunes, Disyembre 23, 2024.
english: 𝗟𝗔𝗠𝗜𝗧𝗔𝗡 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬, 𝗕𝗔𝗦𝗜𝗟𝗔𝗡 – Three Intelligence Service operatives of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (ISAFP) were killed in an ambush in the Barangay Baimbing, Lamitan City, on the afternoon of Monday, December 23, 2024.

text: Ang mga biktima, nga ginapahayag nga mga myembro sang ISAFP nga naka-base sa Zamboanga City, ang nagasakay sa isa ka van sang gintiro sang mga armado nga mga grupo gamit ang assault rifles.
english: The victims, allegedly members of the ISAFP based in Zamboanga City, were riding in a van when they were shot by armed groups using assault rifles.

text: Suno sa Lamitan City Police Station kag Basilan Provincial Police Office, yara ang mga ISAFP agents sa isa ka intelligence-gathering mission sa Lamitan City sang natabo ang ambush, nga nagresulta sa ila gilayon nga kamatayon.
english: Suno sa Lamitan City Police Station kag Basilan Provincial Police Office, yara ang mga ISAFP agents sa isa ka intelligence-gathering mission sa Lamitan City sang natabo ang ambush, nga nagresulta sa ila gilayon nga kamatayon.

text: Sa subong, nagapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang mga awtoridad sa insidente.
english: Authorities are still investigating the incident.

text: Gin-delay sang International Olympic Committee (IOC) ang medal ceremony para sa team figure skating competition sa nagapadayon nga Winter Olympics sa Beijing, China bangud sa ginpahayag “legal issues” nga kinahanglan pa solbaron.
english: The International Olympic Committee (IOC) has delayed the medal ceremony for the team figure skating competition at the ongoing Winter Olympics in Beijing, China due to alleged “legal issues” that still need to be resolved.

text: May media reports nga naga-guwa nga isa ka myembro sang Russian Olympic Committee (nga amo ang nakakuha sang una nga pwesto) ang nagpositibo sa drug test.
english: There are media reports that a member of the Russian Olympic Committee (who won first place) tested positive for drugs.

text: Wala gintumod kun sin-o nga Russian skater ang nangin positive sa test, kun san-o ginpatigayon ang test, kag kun ano nga partikular nga substance ang na-trace.
english: It was not specified which Russian skater tested positive, when the test was conducted, and what specific substance was traced.

text: Wala pa sang komento nagikan sa IOC, International Skating Union, Russian Olympic Committee kag international agency nga charge sa drugs testing.
english: There is no comment from the IOC, International Skating Union, Russian Olympic Committee and international agency charged with drug testing.

text: Sa amo nga kumpetisyon, nakuha sang Russia ang bulawan nga medalya, nagapanguha ang Estados Unidos, kag nagapangatlo ang Japan.
english: In that competition, Russia won the gold medal, the United States was third, and Japan was third.

text: Sa idalom sang pagsulundan sang Olympic Games, may nagakaigu nga penalidad nga idagdag batok sa sin-o man nga madakpan nga magagamit sang droga agud nga mapaayo ang performance sa hinampang.
english: Under the rules of the Olympic Games, there are appropriate penalties to be added against anyone caught using drugs to improve performance in the games.

text: Antes sini, ang Russians ang may yara na nga daan sang duha ka tuig nga ban sa Olympiada, kag subong naga-aserbe lang bilang mga tiglawas sang Russian Olympic Committee.
english: Before that, the Russians already had a two-year ban from the Olympics, and now only serve as representatives of the Russian Olympic Committee.

text: Kasunod ini sang daku nga Russian state-sponsored doping program nga nadiskubrehan sang 2016.
english: It follows a massive Russian state-sponsored doping program uncovered in 2016.

text: Maumpisa na subong nga adlaw ang pagbakuna sa mga construction kag factory workers.
english: Vaccination of construction and factory workers will start today.

text: Suno kay Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) Sec.
english: According to Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) Sec.

text: Silvestre Bello III, kapin 500,000 ang ginpain para sa mga construction kag manufacturing workers sa pungsod.
english: Silvestre Bello III, more than 500,000 have been allocated for construction and manufacturing workers in the country.

text: Ginhatagan ang lokal nga panguluhan sang 450,000 doses sang bakuna nga amo ang magapakig-angot sa mga industriya para sa rollout.
english: The local government has been given 450,000 doses of the vaccine which will liaise with the industries for the rollout.

text: Suno kay Bello, dako ini nga butang agud nga maghulag ang ekonomiya sang pungsod.
english: According to Bello, this is a big thing to boost the country's economy.

text: Sa una nga pahayag ang DOLE, ang mga factory workers sang Calabarzon, Central Visayas kag contruction workers sang Metro Manila amo ang una nga hatagan sang bakuna.
english: According to the DOLE, factory workers in Calabarzon, Central Visayas and construction workers in Metro Manila will be the first to be vaccinated.

text: Gin-athag man ang natungdan nga magapadayon ang construction sa idalom sang Build Build Build Program.
english: He also explained that construction will continue under the Build Build Build Program.

text: Nakabaton sang Ani ng Dangal Awards ang 52 ka mga personalidad sa isa ka seremonya sa Malacañang nga ginpangunahan ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Fifty-two personalities received the Ani ng Dangal Awards at a ceremony in Malacañang presided over by President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Ang nasambit nga pasidungog ang ginhatag sang National Commission for Culture and the Arts sa mga personalidad nga nakakuha sang international awards sa nakaligad nga tuig.
english: The award was given by the National Commission for Culture and the Arts to personalities who have won international awards in the past year.

text: 17 ka mga personalidad sa patag sang cinema ang nakabataon sang Ani ng Dangal nga ginlakipan nanday Judy Ann Santos-Agoncillo, Alden Richards kag iban pa.
english: 17 personalities in the field of cinema have given birth to Ani ng Dangal including Judy Ann Santos-Agoncillo, Alden Richards and others.

text: Ginpasidunggan man ang isa ka artist nagikan sa Architecture and the Allied Arts, pito nagikan sa Dance category tatlo sa Literary Arts, walo sa Music kag 16 naman sa Visual Arts.
english: One artist was also honored from Architecture and the Allied Arts, seven from the Dance category, three from Literary Arts, eight from Music and 16 from Visual Arts.

text: Ang ani ng Dangal awards ang isa sa hightlight sang National Arts Month nga ginahiwat kada Pebrero base sa Presidential Proclamation No 683 nga ginpirmahan sang 1991.
english: The Dangal awards are one of the highlights of the National Arts Month held every February based on Presidential Proclamation No 683 signed in 1991.

text: Ginbida sang isa ka Pinoy Chief ang ‘Asin Tultul’ sa Turin, Italy.
english: A Filipino Chief starred in 'Asin Tultul' in Turin, Italy.

text: Ang Tultul ang isa ka organic nga asin nga may gata kag makit-an sa Barangay Hoskyn, Jordan, Guimaras.
english: Tultul is an organic salt with milk and is found in Barangay Hoskyn, Jordan, Guimaras.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alejo Vincent Abawan, president sang Guimaras Slow food, iya ginpahayag nga malipayon ini nga nahatagan sang kahigayunan ang Slow Food Cooks Alliance of Visayas nga magpasakop sa Terra Madre Salone del Gusto 2024 sa Turin, Italy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alejo Vincent Abawan, president of Guimaras Slow food, said he is happy that the Slow Food Cooks Alliance of Visayas was given the opportunity to participate in the Terra Madre Salone del Gusto 2024 in Turin, Italy.

text: Suno kay Abawan, ang Terra Madre ang isa ka international event nga nakatutok sa food politics, sustainable agriculture kag environment.
english: According to Abawan, Terra Madre is an international event focused on food politics, sustainable agriculture and the environment.

text: Diri kag ginbida sini ang mga luto nga Pinoy kaangay na lang sang Inasal, KBL (Kadyos, baboy, langka) kag Kinilaw sa diin naggamit ini sang salted blue marlin kag salted duck eggs.
english: Here, he also featured Filipino dishes such as Inasal, KBL (Kadyos, pork, langka) and Kinilaw where he used salted blue marlin and salted duck eggs.

text: Apang ang ginpabugal sini amo ang paggamit sini sang ‘Asin Tultul’ sa tanan sini nga linuto.
english: But what it prided itself on was its use of ‘Asin Tultul’ in all its dishes.

text: Gindayaw naman sang iban nga mga pungsod nga nagpasakop sa kahiwatan ang ginluto sini nga pagkaon.
english: Other countries that participated in the event praised the food.

text: Nagnubo ang volume sang foreign direct investments (FDI) sa Pilipinas ipaanggid sa iban nga kaiping nga mga pungsod.
english: The volume of foreign direct investments (FDI) in the Philippines has decreased compared to other neighboring countries.

text: Suno kay Senator Richard Gordon, chairman sang Senate Committee on Government Corporations and Public Enterprises, halin sa $8.2 billion sang 2016, nagnubo ang foreign investments sa $6.5 billion sang 2020, kag $1.5 billion sang Enero tubtob Pebrero sini nga 2021.
english: According to Senator Richard Gordon, chairman of the Senate Committee on Government Corporations and Public Enterprises, from $8.2 billion in 2016, foreign investments fell to $6.5 billion in 2020, and $1.5 billion in January to February of this 2021.

text: Pahayag ni Gordon, ini nga figures ang tuman ka disbentaha ilabi na nga may P11-trillion pa nga utang ang pungsod.
english: Gordon said these figures are very disadvantageous especially since the country still has P11-trillion in debt.

text: Agud mabutong pabalik suno sa iya ang foreign investors, kinahanglan nga makahatag ang pungsod sang nagakaigo nga incentives.
english: In order to attract foreign investors, he said, the country needs to provide appropriate incentives.

text: “Tingin ko babalik talaga tayo ng incentives,” pahayag ni Gordon.
english: “I think we will definitely bring back incentives,” Gordon said.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang mayor nga katuyuan sang hearing nga ginpatigayon sang Senado amo ang Senate Bill No.
english: The main purpose of the hearing was to discuss Senate Bill No.

text: (SBN) 1549 nga nagatuyo nga makahimo sang Regional Investment and Infrastructure Coordinating Hub of Central Luzon (RICH).
english: (SBN) 1549 which aims to create the Regional Investment and Infrastructure Coordinating Hub of Central Luzon (RICH).

text: Katuyuan sini nga mapasangkad ang paggamit sang available infrastructures, natural resources, kag human resources agud ma-engganyo ang foreign kag local investments saggwa sang National Capital Region.
english: It aims to expand the use of available infrastructures, natural resources, and human resources to encourage foreign and local investments outside the National Capital Region.

text: “The future is now and all government needs to do is to create the atmosphere of equal opportunity.
english: “The future is now and all government needs to do is to create the atmosphere of equal opportunity.

text: The atmosphere where people can go in and trade mind for mind, work for work, effort for effort and enjoy the blessings of their hard work and vision.”
english: The atmosphere where people can go in and trade mind for mind, work for work, effort for effort and enjoy the blessings of their hard work and vision.”

text: MANILA – Magasentro sa youth education ang mangin adbokasiya ni Miss Iloilo Universe Rabiya Mateo sa iya journey sa labing una nga edition sang Miss Universe Philippines 2020.
english: MANILA – Miss Iloilo Universe Rabiya Mateo will focus on youth education in her journey in the first edition of Miss Universe Philippines 2020.

text: Sa Good Morning Philippines program, ginpahayag ni Rabiya nga nagatiglawas sang syudad sang Iloilo, nga masako siya sa pre-pageant activities humalin sang siya ang nagpasa sang application sa Miss Universe Philippines Organization.
english: In the Good Morning Philippines program, Rabiya, who represents Iloilo City, said she has been busy with pre-pageant activities since she submitted her application to the Miss Universe Philippines Organization.

text: Suno kay Rabiya, bugal para sa iya ang pagkalakip sa 52 ka opisyal nga kandidata kaupod ang Ilongga Flight Attendant nga si Kim Chi Crizaldo nga nagatiglawas naman sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Rabiya said she is proud to be among the 52 official candidates along with Ilongga Flight Attendant Kim Chi Crizaldo who represents Iloilo province.

text: Ginpahayag ni Rabiya nga humalin sang siya ang nag-intra sa Miss Iloilo 2020, iya gid nga ginapanindugan ang adbokasiya bilang Review Center Lecturer nga may katuyu-an nga makahatag kag maka-paambit sang kaalam sa mga pamatan-on.
english: Rabiya said that since she participated in Miss Iloilo 2020, she has been advocating as a Review Center Lecturer with the aim of giving and sharing knowledge to the youth.

text: Bilang isa ka beauty queen, ginpahayag sang natungdan nga madamo sang mga pagpanghangkat nga dapat malampuwasan ilabi na ang online bashing.
english: As a beauty queen, she said there are many challenges to overcome especially online bashing.

text: May kaangtanan diri, ginpahayag ni Rabiya nga iya gid nga ginapanumdom nga normal lang ang ginatawag nga bashing apang nagakadapat nga hibaluon kun ano ang constructive critisism.
english: In this regard, Rabiya said that she remembers that bashing is normal but it is necessary to know what constructive criticism is.

text: Bugal man para sa iya nga ginapaanggid siya kay Miss Universe 2011 3rd runner-up kag Miss Universe Philippines Organization national director Shamcey Supsup-Lee kag kay Miss World 2013 Megan Young apang suno kay Rabiya, luyag niya nga makilala sang tanan paagi sa iya pagkatawo bilang si Rabiya Meteo sang Balasan, Iloilo.
