english: It is also a matter of pride for her to be compared to Miss Universe 2011 3rd runner-up and Miss Universe Philippines Organization national director Shamcey Supsup-Lee and Miss World 2013 Megan Young but Rabiya said she wants everyone to know her by her identity as Rabiya Meteo of Balasan, Iloilo.

text: Sa subong, ginpahayag sang 23 anyos nga Ilongga beauty queen nga desidido siya nga makuha ang Miss Universe crown kag itiglawas ang Pilipinas sa international pageant.
english: Meanwhile, the 23-year-old Ilongga beauty queen said she is determined to win the Miss Universe crown and represent the Philippines in the international pageant.

text: Nagapati si Philippine Ski and Snowboard Federation President Jim Palomar Apelar nga madala pauli ni Pinoy Alpine skier Asa Miller ang bulawan nga medalya sa 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics.
english: Philippine Ski and Snowboard Federation President Jim Palomar Apelar believes that Pinoy Alpine skier Asa Miller will bring home the gold medal at the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Apelar, iya ginpahayag nga si Miller ang lone representative sang pungsod sa Winter Olympics.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Apelar said Miller is the country's lone representative at the Winter Olympics.

text: Puno naman ini sang suporta naghalin sa Philippine Government, Philippine Olympics Committee kag sa mga sponsor sa iya nga racing suit.
english: He is full of support from the Philippine Government, Philippine Olympics Committee and the sponsors of his racing suit.

text: Suno kay Apelar, magasugod ang hampang ni Miller sa Pebrero 13 sa giant slalom kag sa Pebrero 16 naman ang hampang sini slalom nga ginapatigayon sa Yanqing National Alpine Skiing Centre.
english: Apelar said Miller will start on February 13 in the giant slalom and on February 16 in the slalom at the Yanqing National Alpine Skiing Centre.

text: Nagadepende naman sa kadasigun sang mga skier ang pagdeklara sang tagdaug.
english: The winner will be declared depending on the speed of the skiers.

text: Nagalaoy ang pila ka mga manugbaligya sa Super ukon sa Iloilo Terminal Market sa Iloilo City Proper bangud sa stagnant water sa ila pwesto nga nagaapekto sa ila palangabuhian.
english: Some vendors in the Super or Iloilo Terminal Market in Iloilo City Proper are complaining about the stagnant water in their places that is affecting their livelihood.

text: Partikular nga namensyonar ang area sa corner De Leon-Mabini kag corner De Leon-Fuentes kun sa diin nahamtang ang baligyaan sang mga prutas kag utan amo man ang karne.
english: Particular mention was made of the area at the corner of De Leon-Mabini and corner De Leon-Fuentes where the fruit and vegetable shops as well as meat are located.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay alias Nene, isa ka manugbaligya, iya ginpahayag nga daw kaangay nga pinabay-an ang sitwasyon apisar nga nagabayad man sila sang renta sa ila pwesto kada bulan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, alias Nene, a vendor, said the situation seems to be neglected despite the fact that they also pay rent for their stall every month.

text: Pahayag sini, bisan nga gamay lang nga ulan, nagalaputyak ang ila area, kag apisar nga napalab-ot na nila ang reklamo, wala pa gihapon na-address ang ila nga concern.
english: He said that even with a little rain, their area is getting muddy, and although they have already conveyed the complaint, their concern has not been addressed.

text: Ginakahangaw-an sini nga maglala ang ila pwesto subong nga nagsugod na ang tig-ululan.
english: He fears that their situation will worsen now that the rainy season has begun.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay Eddie Britanico, isa ka barbero nga yara man sa Iloilo Terminal Market, iya ginpahayag nga kun mag-ulan kag magtaob, nagasulod ang tubig kag nagatuga sang huol sa ila nga mga customer.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Eddie Britanico, a barber who is also at the Iloilo Terminal Market, said that when it rains and floods, water enters and causes inconvenience to their customers.

text:
NAGPADALA SANG DECLOGGING TEAM

Nakalab-ot naman sa igtalupangod sang Iloilo City Engineer’s Office ini nga problema.
english:
SEND DECLOGGING TEAM

The problem has reached the attention of the Iloilo City Engineer's Office.

text: Suno kay Joel Gerasmia, chief of staff sang amo nga opisina, nagpadala na ang talatapan sang declogging team agud nga ma-address ang concern.
english: According to Joel Gerasmia, chief of staff of the office, the office has already sent a declogging team to address the concern.

text: Kaangot naman sa reklamo nga makapila ka beses nga napalab-ot sa ila ang problema, nagsabat si Gerasmia nga wala pa sila sang nabaton nga report bangud bag-o lang nagsugod ang pag-ulan-ulan.
english: Regarding the complaint that they have been informed several times about the problem, Gerasmia replied that they have not received any report because the rains have just started.

text: Apang sa walkthrough nga ginpatigayon sa Mabini-de Leon suno sa iya, may nakit-an na sila nga narusdak nga drainage bangud sa nagalabay nga dalagku nga mga truck.
english: Apang sa walkthrough nga ginpatigayon sa Mabini-de Leon suno sa iya, may nakit-an na sila nga narusdak nga drainage bangud sa nagalabay nga dalagku nga mga truck.

text: Matapos nabaton ang report subong nga hapon, naghulag ang team agud nga pasuyupan ang stagnant water kag ma-address ang problema sang vendors.
english: After receiving the report this afternoon, the team moved to suck up the stagnant water and address the problem of the vendors.

text: Nahibaluan nga may gintukod ang city government nga Drainage Task Force agud nga makahimo sang comprehensive assessment sa drainage infrastructure kag matumod ang critical flood-prone areas.
english: The city government has established a Drainage Task Force to conduct a comprehensive assessment of drainage infrastructure and identify critical flood-prone areas.

text: Sandig sa Executive Order 46 nga gin-isyu ni Mayor Jerry Treñas, kinahanglan gid nga ma-koordinar ang mga pagpaninguha nga matapna ang pagbaha kag masiguro nga magamit sang maayo ang drainage system sa Iloilo City.#
english: According to Executive Order 46 issued by Mayor Jerry Treñas, it is necessary to coordinate efforts to prevent flooding and ensure the proper use of the drainage system in Iloilo City.

text: Kaangay sang isa ka bata nga nadulaan sang isa ka superhero, daw kaangay nga nadulaan sang ‘Kuya’ ang aktor nga si Gerald Anderson sa pagtaliwan sang iya long-time idol kag National Basketball Association (NBA) legend nga si Kobe Bryant.
english: Like a child who loses a superhero, actor Gerald Anderson seems to have lost a ‘Kuya’ with the passing of his long-time idol and National Basketball Association (NBA) legend Kobe Bryant.

text: Ang balita sang kamatayon ni Kobe sang nagligad nga Enero 26 bangud sang helicopter crash sa Calabasas, California, United States ang indi pa halos mabaton sang aktor tubtob subong.
english: The news of Kobe’s death last January 26 due to a helicopter crash in Calabasas, California, United States is something the actor cannot accept until now.

text: “Mabigat eh.
english: “Heavy eh.

text: Hindi pa rin ako makapaniwala.
english: I still can't believe it.

text: Lalo na ‘pag makita ko sa social media, kasi ‘di ba…ahhh,” pahayag sang aktor samtang emosyonal nga ginabalikan kun paano nangin inspirasyon si Kobe para sa iya.
english: Especially when I see it on social media, because 'di ba...ahhh,” said the actor while emotionally recalling how Kobe became an inspiration for him.

text: “Parang nawalan ako ng Kuya, ng superhero.
english: “I feel like I lost a brother, a superhero.

text: Kasi siya yung lagi kong pinapanood.
english: Because he's the one I always watch.

text: Everyday.
english: Everyday.

text: On how to get through the day, like kung may mga challenges sa buhay, paano niya nalalagpasan yun.
english: On how to get through the day, like if there are challenges in life, how does he overcome them.

text: Para siyang invincible.
english: He felt invincible.

text: Parang hindi siya mamamatay,” dugang pa ni Gerald nga nagpahayag nga tuman kadaku nga ‘shock’ ang gindulot sini sa iya bilang fan.
english: It's like he's not going to die,” Gerald added, saying it was a big shock for him as a fan.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Gerald, iya ginpahayag nga wala siya sang ginpalampas nga interview kag libro sang Black Mamba, kag adlaw-adlaw niya ini nga ginalantaw.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Gerald said he has not missed any interview and book of Black Mamba, and he watches it every day.

text: Makaduha ka bes man nga nakalantaw si Gerald sa NBA game ni Kobe (tuig 2010 kag 2012) kag makaduha ka bes man nga nakit-an niya ini sa Pilipinas, apang wala siya nahatagan sang kahigayunan nga maistorya ini sa personal.
english: Gerald also watched Kobe's NBA game twice (2010 and 2012) and saw him twice in the Philippines, but he was not given the opportunity to talk to him in person.

text: “Pero alam mo yun, hindi kami magkakilala, pero parang kilala ko na siya.
english: “But you know, we don't know each other, but I feel like I know him.

text: Parang magkakilala kami,” dugang sang aktor samtang ginapabugal ang ‘very fortunate experience’ sini sa diin ginsuksok niya ang jersey shirt nga may jersey number sang iya idolo sang siya ang nagpadulong sa  Staples Center sa Los Angeles.
english: It's like we know each other,” the actor added while bragging about his 'very fortunate experience' where he wore a jersey shirt with his idol's jersey number when he went to the Staples Center in Los Angeles.

text: Naintindihan ni Gerald nga madamo sang mga fans ang nagadululungan nga nagabatyag sang kasubo subong.
english: Gerald understands that many fans are huddled together feeling sad right now.

text: “At the end of the day, mawawala din naman yan.
english: “At the end of the day, it will go away.

text:
Gamitin natin sa tamang paraan yung lungkot para sa ikabubuti nating lahat.”

Sa bahin sang aktor, may mga naka-frame siya nga mga jersey shirts nga nagapahanumdom sa iya sa iya idolo, kag ang iya ginpatindog nga gym malapit sa isa ka TV network sa Manila ang may yara sang daku nga picture ni Kobe.
english:
Let's use the sadness in the right way for the good of all of us.”

For the actor's part, he has framed jersey shirts that remind him of his idol, and the gym he built near a TV network in Manila has a large picture of Kobe.

text: “Siguro kasi, more than ‘on the court’, it’s the inspiration na ibinibigay niya sa bawat tao…on how he is working really hard, kung ano man ang passion niya.
english: “Maybe because, more than ‘on the court’, it’s the inspiration that he gives to everyone…on how he is working really hard, whatever his passion is.

text:
Kita niyo naman kung ano ang impact niya sa buong mundo, hindi lang sa mga basketball players kundi sa halos lahat talaga.”

Bilang isa ka artista nga may daku nga impluwensiya sa publiko kag bilang isa ka basketball enthusiast, luyag ni Kobe nga pakigbahinan sang positibo nga panan-aw ang mga kabataan.
english:
You see what an impact he has on the whole world, not just on basketball players but on almost everyone.”

As an actor with a huge influence on the public and as a basketball enthusiast, Kobe wants to share a positive outlook with kids.

text: “No matter how hard ang pinagdadaanan, you make it to the point na malalagpasan mo.
english: “No matter how hard it is, you make it to the point that you can overcome it.

text: Hindi mo alam kung sino ang maiinspire mo.
english: You never know who you'll inspire.

text: Just like Kobe.
english: Just like Kobe.

text: Never stop inspiring, motivating, doing your best in every endeavor sa buhay mo.
english: Never stop inspiring, motivating, doing your best in every endeavor in your life.

text: Always remember you are inspiring someone.”
english: Always remember you are inspiring someone.”

text: Nagpangayo na sang pasaylo ang content creator nga si Euleen Castro ukon mas kilala sa tawag nga “Pambansang Yobab” matapos ang kontrobersyal niya nga video sa isa ka popular nga coffee chain sa Iloilo.
english: Content creator Euleen Castro or better known as “Pambansang Yobab” has apologized after her controversial video at a popular coffee chain in Iloilo.

text: Sa latest video nga gin-post niya sa iya youtube channel, ginpamangkot siya sang kaupod nga content creator kun may sala gid man ini sa natabo, kag ang sabat ni Castro amo nga may yara siya sang kakulangan.
english: In the latest video he posted on his youtube channel, a fellow content creator asked him if there was anything wrong with what happened, and Castro's answer was that he had a shortcoming.

text: Pahayag niya, ang kulang niya amo nga wala siya sang disclaimer kag indi constructive ang iya ginhimo.
english: He said what he lacked was that he did not have a disclaimer and what he did was not constructive.

text: Depensa niya, opinyon lamang niya ang iya ginpabutyag kun sa diin, suno sa iya, wala gid man siya nanamitan sa pagkaon.
english: He defended that he was only expressing his opinion where, according to him, he did not taste the food.

text: Nagpangayo naman ini sang dispensa sa tag-iya kag sa mga empleyado sang coffee chain bangud sa natabo.
english: He apologized to the owner and employees of the coffee chain for the incident.

text: Samtang, gin-ako naman ni Castro nga nakibot siya sa nabaton nga “hate” halin sa mga tawo.
english: Meanwhile, Castro admitted that he was surprised by the “hate” he received from the people.

text: Suno sa iya, apisar nga sa kape kag sa pagkaon lang ang sentro sang iya content, apang kaangay nga bilog nga pagkatawo na niya ang ginkaugtan sang publiko.
english: He said that although his content focuses on coffee and food, it seems that his whole being is hated by the public.

text: UNITED KINGDOM – Isa ka Ilonggo ang napilian nga magtiglawas sang Pilipinas sa Best Diplomats nga ginapatigayon subong sa London, United Kingdom.
english: UNITED KINGDOM – An Ilonggo has been selected to represent the Philippines in the Best Diplomats being held today in London, United Kingdom.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jan Dominic Araneta Barredo, sang North Fundidor, Molo, Iloilo City kag Philippine Delegate to Best Diplomats United Nations sa London, United Kingdom,  iya ginpahayag nga ang Best Diplomats, ang isa ka New York-based organization nga nagatutok sa pagpatigayon sang Diplomatic Simulations sang prestigious international bodies kaangay sang United Nations, European Union, African Union, kag madamo pa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Jan Dominic Araneta Barredo, of North Fundidor, Molo, Iloilo City and Philippine Delegate to Best Diplomats United Nations in London, United Kingdom, said that Best Diplomats, a New York-based organization that focuses on conducting Diplomatic Simulations of prestigious international bodies such as the United Nations, United Nations, African Union, African Union, and many more.

text: Suno kay Barredo, mayor nga ginatutukan sang Best Diplomats amo ang paghanas sang individuals, teams, kag organizations aud mangin world-class diplomats, expert negotiators, kag visionary leaders.
english: According to Barredo, the main focus of Best Diplomats is to train individuals, teams, and organizations to become world-class diplomats, expert negotiators, and visionary leaders.

text: Diri kag gina-utilize ang ini nga simulations bilang isa ka powerful platform para sa mga young leaders kag change-makers agud magpakigbahin sa constructive dialogue kag masolusyunan ang ginakabig nga pinakadako nga issue sa kalibutan.
english: This is where these simulations are utilized as a powerful platform for young leaders and change-makers to engage in constructive dialogue and solve what is considered the world's biggest issue.

text: Nagapatigayon man ini sang collaboration sa mga governments, educational institutions, kag leading companies agud madula ang antad sa tunga sang academic knowledge kag real-world application.
english: It also facilitates collaboration with governments, educational institutions, and leading companies to bridge the gap between academic knowledge and real-world application.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini na ang ikatatlo nga tion nga nagtilawas si Barredo sang pungsod sa Best Diplomats sa diin una ini nga nagtambong sang 2019 sa Malaysia kag 2022 sa Dubai.
english: This is the third time Barredo has represented the country in the Best Diplomats where he first attended in 2019 in Malaysia and 2022 in Dubai.

text: Nagakadapat nga mapatuman sang maayo ang panibag-o nga COVID-19 Plan sang Pilipinas agud makabangon ang sektor sang ekonomiya.
english: The Philippines' new COVID-19 Plan must be implemented properly in order for the economic sector to recover.

text: Suno kay Moody’s Analytics chief Asia-Pacific economist Steven Cochrane, sa tion nga ma-excute maayo sang pungsod ang tatlo ka economic rebound nga gintumod sang economic managers ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte, pat-od nga mabalanse ang pagtapna sa COVID-19 kag pag-rekober sang mga negosyo sa pungsod.
english: According to Moody's Analytics chief Asia-Pacific economist Steven Cochrane, once the country successfully executes the three economic rebounds identified by President Rodrigo Duterte's economic managers, it will surely balance the fight against COVID-19 and the recovery of businesses in the country.

text:
Yari ang tatlo ka stratehiya sang pungsod agud ma-facilitate ang economic rebound:

Dugang pa sang economist, mangin ‘universally available’ na ang vaccinations umpisa sa Oktubre sa diin ginalauman nga mapahagan-hagan na ang pagsaka sang kaso sang virus
english:
Here are the country’s three strategies to facilitate economic rebound:

The economist added that vaccinations will be universally available starting in October, which is expected to ease the rise in cases of the virus.

text: ILOILO CITY- Under detention sa gihapon ang status sang tennis star nga si Novak Djokovic samtang nagahulat sang resulta sang iya appeal batok sa iya visa cancellation sa Australia matapos ini gin- block nga makasulod sa amo nga pungsod.
english: ILOILO CITY – Tennis star Novak Djokovic is still under detention while awaiting the outcome of his appeal against his visa cancellation in Australia after he was blocked from entering the country.

text: Resulta ini sang desisyon sang Australian Border Force nga i- deport ang World Number 1 tennis star matapos nag-abot sa Australia nga may ginauyatan nga medical exemption gikan sa Covid-19 vaccination rules nga mag-compete sa tournament apang wala ginbaton sang border officials ang amo nga medical exemption.
english: This is the result of the decision of the Australian Border Force to deport the World Number 1 tennis star after he arrived in Australia with a medical exemption from the Covid-19 vaccination rules to compete in the tournament but the border officials did not accept the medical exemption.

text: Nahibaluan nga kinahanglan nga fully vaccinated ang players nga magapasakop sa tournament kag requirement man ini sa tanan nga travellers nga magasulod sa amo nga pungsod.
english: It is known that the players who will participate in the tournament must be fully vaccinated and this is also a requirement for all travelers entering the country.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Denmark Suede direkta sa Australia, isa si Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison nga nanindugan nga indi dapat paghatagan sang special treatment ang Serbian tennis star nga magsulod sa pungsod nga nagapatuman sang isa sa pinaka-istrikto nga border restrictions.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Denmark Suede directly in Australia, one Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison insisted that the Serbian tennis star should not be given special treatment to enter the country that implements one of the strictest border restrictions.

text: Magalawig naman tubtob sa Lunes ang iya detention kag ini ang nagabutang sa iya sa alang -alang nga madepensahan ang iya Australian Open title kun indi magpabor ang desisyon sa iya.
english: His detention will last until Monday and this puts him at risk of defending his Australian Open title if the decision is not in his favour.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang hotel kun sa diin gin-detain si Djokovic amo man ang ginagamit sang Australian government sa pag- detain sang refugees kag asylum-seekers.
english: The hotel where Djokovic was detained is also used by the Australian government to detain refugees and asylum-seekers.

text: Patay ang isa turista nga Pinoy matapos nalipong samtang nagasakay sa isa ka ride sa Hong Kong Disneyland sang damlag lang.
english: A Filipino tourist died after fainting while riding a ride at Hong Kong Disneyland recently.

text: Nakasakay sa Frozen Ever After attraction ang 53-anyos nga biktima sang natabo ang insidente.
english: The 53-year-old victim was riding the Frozen Ever After attraction when the incident occurred.

text: Naggwa sa imbestigasyon nga may pre-existing medical condition ang biktima kun sa diin may ginasuprir ini nga high-blood pressure kag sakit sa corazon.
english: Investigation revealed that the victim had a pre-existing medical condition such as high-blood pressure and heart disease.

text: Gindala pa sa ospital ang biktima apang ginbawian gid sang kabuhi.
english: The victim was rushed to the hospital but died on the spot.

text: Makapauli na sa Pilipinas ang anum ka Filipino seafarers matapos na-acquit sa kaso nga drug trafficking sa Türkiye.
english: Six Filipino seafarers can return to the Philippines after being acquitted of drug trafficking in Turkey.

text: 11 ka bulan man nga na-detain ang mga Pinoy antes napamatud-an sa Ereğli Criminal Court sang Septyembre 16, 2024 nga inosente sila kag wala sang kahilabtanan sa iligal nga droga.
english: The Filipinos were also detained for 11 months before being proven innocent and not involved in illegal drugs in the Ereğli Criminal Court on September 16, 2024.

text: Base sa mandu sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), ginaproseso na sang Philippine Embassy sa Ankara ang repatriation kaupod man sa Philippine Consulate General in Istanbul.
english: Based on the order of the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), the Philippine Embassy in Ankara is already processing the repatriation along with the Philippine Consulate General in Istanbul.

text: Ginpasiguro man nga yara sila sa maayo nga kondisyon kag mapasakay na pabalik diri sa Pilipinas.
english: They were also assured that they are in good condition and can be flown back to the Philippines.

text: Matandaan nga sang Oktubre 2023, ang anum ka Pinoy kaupod ang apat ka senior officers sa Panamanian-flagged cargo vessel nga Phoenician M ang gin-aresto bangud sa alegasyon sang drug trafficking samtang yara ang ila barko sa Ereğli Port sa Zonguldak nga nahamtang sa Black Sea region sang Türkiye.
english: Matandaan nga sang Oktubre 2023, ang anum ka Pinoy kaupod ang apat ka senior officers sa Panamanian-flagged cargo vessel nga Phoenician M ang gin-aresto bangud sa alegasyon sang drug trafficking samtang yara ang ila barko sa Ereğli Port sa Zonguldak nga nahamtang sa Black Sea region sang Türkiye.

text: Nagbulig ang Legal Assistance Fund sang DFA agud nga maproteksyunan ang kinamatarong sang mga Pinoy kag masunod ang due process.
english: The DFA's Legal Assistance Fund helped to protect the rights of Filipinos and follow due process.

text: Nagtingob-pwersa man ang mga abogado sang embahada kag legal counsel sang insurance company sang manning agency sa pagtambong sa tanan nga hearings sa korte sang Hunyo, Hulyo, kag Septyembre subong nga tuig tubtub nga dalayon nga nabasura ang kaso.
english: The embassy lawyers and the legal counsel of the manning agency's insurance company also joined forces to attend all court hearings in June, July, and September this year until the case was immediately dismissed.

text: Samtang yara sa detention facility, ginsigurado man nga nahatagan ang mga Pinoy sang panapton, pictures sang ila pamilya, financial kag welfare assistance paagi sa Assistance-to-Nationals (ATN) Fund sang DFA.
english: Samtang yara sa detention facility, ginsigurado man nga nahatagan ang mga Pinoy sang panapton, pictures sang ila pamilya, financial kag welfare assistance paagi sa Assistance-to-Nationals (ATN) Fund sang DFA.

text:
‘

Ginsigurado man sang embahada nga regular nga ma-update ang ila pamilya sa Pilipinas sa dalagan sang ila kaso.
english:
‘

The embassy also ensured that their families in the Philippines are regularly updated on the progress of their case.

text: Nanginwala ang Australian Open organisers nga isa ka sahi sang pagpang-blackmail ang ila nga pag-require sang COVID-19 vaccination nga amo ang ginatudlo rason kun ngaa posible indi makahampang si World Number One kag 20-time grand slam champion Novak Djokovic sa maabot nga Enero.
english: The Australian Open organizers have denied that their requirement of COVID-19 vaccination is a form of blackmail, which is the reason why World Number One and 20-time grand slam champion Novak Djokovic may not be able to play in January.

text: Una diri, nagpahayag si Srdjan, amay ni Djokovic, nga duha-duha pa kun makapartisipar ang iya anak sa kumpetisyon sa Melbourne Park sa Enero 2022 kag ginpahayag man sini nga katumbas sang blackmail ang pagsulundan sang Tennis Australia sa vaccination sa mga players.
english: Earlier, Srdjan, Djokovic's father, said it was still doubtful whether his son would be able to participate in the competition at Melbourne Park in January 2022 and also said that Tennis Australia's vaccination policy for players was tantamount to blackmail.

text: Tubtub subong, wala pa ginasapubliko kun bakunado na ukon indi si Djokovic.
english: So far, it has not been made public whether Djokovic is vaccinated or not.

text: Sabat naman ni Victorian Sports Minister Martin Pakula, ginapasigurado lang nila nga protected ang Victorian community kadungan sang amo kadaku nga kumpetisyon.
english: Victorian Sports Minister Martin Pakula said they are just ensuring that the Victorian community is protected during such a big competition.

text: Katungdanan sang international tennis players nga magsunod diri nga requirement, apang suno kay Pakula, diretso na ni Djokovic kun mapabakuna ini ukon indi.
english: It is the duty of international tennis players to comply with this requirement, but according to Pakula, it is up to Djokovic whether to be vaccinated or not.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakadaug na si Djokovic sang siyam ka Australian Open men’s singles titles kag amo subong ang defending champion.Pareho sila nanday Roger Federer kag Rafael Nadal nga may 20 men’s major singles titles.
english: Djokovic has won nine Australian Open men's singles titles and is currently the defending champion. He is tied with Roger Federer and Rafael Nadal with 20 men's major singles titles.

text: Nagakabudlayan ang Department of Budget and Management (DBM) sa pagpangita sang kuhaan sang P13 billion nga gin-request sang Department of Health (DOH) nga amo ang maga-cover sa meal, accommodation kag transportation allowances sang health workers.
english: The Department of Budget and Management (DBM) is struggling to find the source of the P13 billion requested by the Department of Health (DOH) to cover the meal, accommodation and transportation allowances of health workers.

text: Suno kay DBM Undersecretary Tina Rose Marie Canda, ang allowance para sa pagkaon, akomodasyon kag transportasyon sang mga health worers ang dapat nga i-charge sa pondo sang DOH bangud ini ang nasaad sa approval nga naghalin sa Office of the President.
english: According to DBM Undersecretary Tina Rose Marie Canda, the allowance for food, accommodation and transportation of health worers should be charged to the DOH fund because it is stipulated in the approval from the Office of the President.

text: Apang pahayag niya, tuman ka dako ang kinahanglan nga pondo rason nga mabudlay ini i-akomodar sa budget sang DOH.
english: However, he said, the funds required are so large that it is difficult to accommodate them in the DOH budget.

text: Nahibaluan nga nag-release sang dugang nga P311 million ang DBM para sa COVID-19 special risk allowance (SRA) sang mga health workers.
english: The DBM has released an additional P311 million for the COVID-19 special risk allowance (SRA) of health workers.

text: Ginakabig sang Malakanyang nga isa ka palaligban ang motibo ni Sen.
english: Malakanyang considers the motive of Sen.

text: Imee Marcos sa iya pahayag nga punggan niya pananglitan nga i-appoint bilang Ombudsman si Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla.
english: Imee Marcos in his statement that he will prevent if Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla is appointed as Ombudsman.

text: Una na ginpahayag ni Imee nga nagapati siya nga kahimbon si Remulla sa plano para mapapreso si Vice President Sara Duterte bag-o ang 2028 elections.
english: Earlier, Imee said she believes Remulla is involved in the plan to imprison Vice President Sara Duterte before the 2028 elections.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Atty. Claire Castro, indi maathag kun ang motibo sang senadora amo nga protektahan ang iya abyan ukon mahatag ang hustisya para sa pumuluyo.
english: According to Palace Press Officer Atty. Claire Castro, it is not clear whether the senator's motive is to protect her friend or to provide justice for the people.

text: Suno kay Castro, kaangay nga luyag ni Sen.
english: According to Castro, Sen.

text: Marcos nga ang mangin Ombudsman ang indi magpasaka sang kaso sa mga tawo nga dapat kasuhan.
english: Marcos said the Ombudsman will not file cases against people who should be prosecuted.

text: Ipinahayag ni Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Secretary Vince Dizon na kanilang rerepasuhin ang proposed budget upang matukoy kung may kahina-hinalang flood control projects o iba pang anomalya sa dokumento.
english: Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Secretary Vince Dizon said they will review the proposed budget to determine if there are any suspicious flood control projects or other anomalies in the document.

text: May mga napaulat na proyekto na tapos na pero nananatiling bahagi ng panukala.
english: Some projects have been reported that have been completed but remain part of the proposal.

text: Mayroon ding mga proyektong may parehong halaga at hindi tugma ang mga deskripsyon.
english: There are also projects with the same value and the descriptions do not match.

text: Aminado si Dizon na hindi nila agad masusuri ang lahat ng nilalaman ng 700-pahinang dokumento ngunit uunahin nila ang mga proyektong binanggit ng mga mambabatas.
english: Dizon admitted that they cannot immediately review all the contents of the 700-page document but they will prioritize the projects mentioned by the lawmakers.

text: Target umano nilang suriin ang pinakamarami sa abot ng kanilang makakaya.
english: They say they target to test as many as they can.

text: Samantala, sinabi ni Budget Secretary Amenah Pangandaman na matapos ang pagsusuri ay muling isusumite ng Department of Budget and Management (DBM) ang binagong budget sa Kongreso.
english: Meanwhile, Budget Secretary Amenah Pangandaman said that after the review, the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) will submit the revised budget to Congress.

text: Bagamat hindi tiyak kung bababa ang kabuuang halaga, inaasahang magkakaroon ng pagbabago sa alokasyon.
english: Although it is not certain that the total amount will decrease, it is expected that there will be a change in the allocation.

text: Paliwanag ni Pangandaman, mas mainam ang proseso ng muling pagsusumite ng listahan ng proyekto kumpara sa mungkahi ng ilang mambabatas na ibalik sa DPWH ang buong panukalang budget.
english: Pangandaman explained that the process of resubmitting the list of projects is slower than the proposal of some lawmakers to return the entire budget proposal to the DPWH.

text: Aniya, ito ay hindi pa kailanman nangyari at magiging komplikado kung gagawin.
english: Aniya, this has never happened before and it would be complicated to do.

text: Dagdag pa niya, magpapatupad din ang DBM ng reporma sa pagtanggap at pagsusuri ng budget proposals gamit ang makabagong teknolohiya.
english: He added that the DBM will also implement reforms in the receipt and review of budget proposals using modern technology.

text: Hinikayat din niya ang DPWH na tiyakin na maayos ang internal planning at identification ng kanilang mga proyekto.
english: He also urged the DPWH to ensure proper internal planning and identification of their projects.

text: Ang malawakang pagsusuri ng budget ay ipinatupad matapos utusan ni Pangulong Marcos ang DBM at DPWH na muling balikan ang 2026 budget kasunod ng mga katanungan ng ilang mambabatas ukol sa ilang flood control projects na pinaghihinalaang hindi regular.
english: The extensive budget review was implemented after President Marcos ordered the DBM and DPWH to revisit the 2026 budget following questions from some lawmakers about some flood control projects that are suspected to be irregular.

english: Tanza Timawa 2, Iloilo City Proper.

english: The subjects were identified as Mama Lee, High-Value Individual (HVI), 51, manicurist, and her husband Papa Jun, 50, both residents of the said barangay.

text: ‘Loyal’ si pole vault star EJ Obiena sa Pilipinas kag wala ini sang gana ukon plano nga bayaan ang pungsod apisar sang kontrobersiya nga ginakaulamiran matapos ang mga alegasyon sang Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (Patafa).
english: Pole vault star EJ Obiena is 'loyal' to the Philippines and has no desire or plan to leave the country despite the controversy surrounding the allegations of the Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (Patafa).

text: Suno sa Filipino Olympian, luyag gid niya nga magdaug para sa Pilipinas, kag ipakita sa kalibutan ang masarangan ini sang mga Pilipino.
english: The Filipino Olympian said he really wants to win for the Philippines, and show the world what Filipinos can do.

text: “Even now, in this current crisis, I have no desire to change nations.
english: “Even now, in this current crisis, I have no desire to change nations.

text: I see these statements on social media and active encouragement to switch allegiances.
english: I see these statements on social media and active encouragement to switch allegiances.

text: But this is not who I am and why I do this.
english: But this is not who I am and why I do this.

text: I want to win for Philippines and show the world what we can do.
english: I want to win for Philippines and show the world what we can do.

text: I want to win for us,”suno sa 26-anyos nga Olympian.
english: I want to win for us,” the 26-year-old Olympian said.

text: Apisar sang commitment nga ginpahayag ni Obiena kag apisar sang goal sini nga makadaug sang gold medals para sa pungsod, may mga punto suno sa iya nga basi kun mapwersa siya nga sundon ang option nga indi niya gusto.
english: Despite the commitment Obiena expressed and despite his goal of winning gold medals for the country, there are points, he said, that if he is forced to follow the option he does not want.

text: “I have realized I may at some point have no option.
english: “I have realized I may at some point have no option.

text: I cannot accept to be accused of false allegations and have my reputation smeared.
english: I cannot accept to be accused of false allegations and have my reputation smeared.

text: I know I may at some point be forced into choices I don’t want to make.
english: I know I may at some point be forced into choices I don’t want to make.

text: It seems to be happening a lot lately like defending myself in a rushed presscon.
english: It seems to be happening a lot lately like defending myself in a rushed presscon.

text:
But my goal is focused on winning gold medals for my nation, my country, my flag—The Philippines.”

Si Obiena nga subong amo ang World Number 6 ang gin-akusaran sang PATAFA nga nag-falsify sang iya nga mga dokumento kag wala nagbayad sa iya nga coach.
english:
But my goal is focused on winning gold medals for my nation, my country, my flag—The Philippines.”

Obiena, who is currently World Number 6, was accused by PATAFA of falsifying his documents and not paying his coach.

text:
Nagsampa ng kasong kriminal ang Department of Education laban sa pitong pribadong paaralan na umano’y sangkot sa anomalya sa senior high school voucher program, kung saan halos 70 milyong piso ang nawawala dahil sa tinatawag na mga “ghost beneficiaries.”

Ipinahayag ni Education Secretary Sonny Angara sa budget briefing ng kagawaran sa House Committee on Appropriations na nasa tanggapan na ng piskalya ang mga reklamo laban sa mga paaralang sangkot.
english:
The Department of Education has filed criminal charges against seven private schools allegedly involved in anomalies in the senior high school voucher program, where nearly 70 million pesos are lost due to so-called “ghost beneficiaries.”

Education Secretary Sonny Angara said during the budget briefing of the department in the House Committee on Appropriations that the prosecutor's office is already receiving complaints against the schools involved.

text: Pahayag ni Angara, umabot sa P61.9 milyon ang kabuuang halagang kinasasangkutan ng mga kasong isinampa, at may mga demand letter na rin umanong ipinadala.
english: Angara said the total amount involved in the cases filed reached P61.9 million, and demand letters have also been sent.

text: Ang “ghost” students ay tumutukoy sa mga learner na binigyan ng voucher para makapag-aral sa mga pribadong paaralan, ngunit lumalabas na hindi kwalipikado o hindi naman talaga umiiral.
english: Ghost students refer to learners who were given vouchers to study in private schools, but turned out not to be qualified or did not actually exist.

text: Dagdag pa ni Angara, may mga kasalukuyang imbestigasyon pa ang legal department ng kagawaran ukol sa iba pang paaralan na pinaniniwalaang may kahalintulad na kaso.
english: Angara added that the legal department of the department is still investigating other schools that are believed to have similar cases.

text: Matatandaang sa isang pagdinig sa Senado noong nakaraang taon, sinabi ni Senador Sherwin Gatchalian na may higit 19,000 “ghost students” na nakikinabang sa voucher program, batay sa ulat ng Commission on Audit noong 2016 at 2018.
english: It can be recalled that in a hearing in the Senate last year, Senator Sherwin Gatchalian said that there are more than 19,000 “ghost students” who benefit from the voucher program, based on the report of the Commission on Audit in 2016 and 2018.

text: Nagsaka na sa masobra 20 ang napatay sa apat ka states sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika bangud sa paglaslas sang Hurricane Helene.
english: The death toll from Hurricane Helene has risen to more than 20 in four states in the United States.

text: Lakip sa pinakaapektado amo ang South kag North Carolina, Florida, kag Georgia.
english: Among the hardest hit are South and North Carolina, Florida, and Georgia.

text: Ginakahangaw-an nga madugangan pa ini bangud sa reports nga may mga tawo pa nga na-trap sa mga building kag may yara pa sang nagsaka sa mga atop.
english: It is feared that the number will increase due to reports that people are still trapped in buildings and some have climbed on roofs.

text: Pagkatapos sang landfall bilang Category 4 hurricane sa Big Bend region sa Florida sang nagligad nga gab-i, naghina na ini subong kag isa na lang ka tropical depression.
english: After making landfall as a Category 4 hurricane in the Big Bend region of Florida last night, it has now weakened to a tropical depression.

text: Sa pihak sini, madamo pa nga states ang ginabaha kag may mga nag-isyu pa sang flash flood emergencies sa Southeast lakip sa Atlanta.
english: Meanwhile, many states are still flooded and some have issued flash flood emergencies in the Southeast including Atlanta.

text: Masobra naman sa apat ka million nga mga balay kag mga negosyo ang na-report nga nawad-an sang suplay sang kuryente sa Florida, Georgia, South Carolina, Tennessee kag Virginia kag posible nga sinemana pa ang ilawig antes mabalik sa normal ang suplay.
english: More than four million homes and businesses were reported to have lost power in Florida, Georgia, South Carolina, Tennessee and Virginia and it could take weeks before the supply is restored to normal.

text: (Photo:  Jonathan Drake/Reuters)
english: (Photo:  Jonathan Drake/Reuters)

text: ILOILO CITY – Lunsay 5 ang ginhatag nga score sang Bombo Guest Commentators sa nangin performance sang  ika-duha nga competing tribe nga Tribu Baybayanon kun sa diin nagsentro sa paghirupay kag pagtuo kay Sr.
english: ILOILO CITY – Bombo Guest Commentators gave a score of 5 to the performance of the second competing tribe, Tribu Baybayanon, which focused on the comfort and faith of Sr.

text: Sto.
english: Sto.

text: Niño ang ila performance.
english: Niño their performance.

text: Sa over-all performance sang Tribu Baybayanon sang Melchor Nava National High School, ginpahayag sang director kag choreoprapher nga si Novy Bereber nga maayo ang nangin performance sang mga warrior apang kulang sa pagpanghanda kun costume kag props ang pagahambalan.
english: On the overall performance of Tribu Baybayanon of Melchor Nava National High School, director and choreographer Novy Bereber said that the warriors performed well but lacked preparation when it came to costumes and props.

text: Suno kay Bereber, nakaapekto sa over-all performance sang tribu ang gintipid nga pondo para sa costume, props kag ang music nga gingamit ang kasubong nga wala sang element of surprise.
english: According to Bereber, the overall performance of the tribe was affected by the funds saved for costumes, props and the music used as there was no element of surprise.

text: Ginpahayag naman sang Cultural Works Specialist nga si Joseph William Albania nga nakulangan siya sa underwater concept sang tribu.
english: Cultural Works Specialist Joseph William Albania said he lacked the underwater concept of the tribe.

text: Suno kay Albania, may yara pa sang dapat nga bag-uhon ang Tribu Baybayanon agud nga mas mapanami pa gid ang ila performance.
english: According to Albania, Tribu Baybayanon still needs to change in order to improve their performance.

text: Skateboard ang nangin sagang sang isa ka Person with disability (PWD) sa mga pagpanghangkat nga iya naagyan agud makagradwar sa Iloilo State University of Fisheries Science and Technology (ISUFST)- Dumangas Campus.
english: Skateboard became the barrier of a Person with disability (PWD) in the challenges he went through to graduate from Iloilo State University of Fisheries Science and Technology (ISUFST)- Dumangas Campus.

text: Ini amo si Jefferson Dela Peña, 26-anyos, residente sang Dumangas, Iloilo apang nabun-ag sa Bacolod City.
english: This is Jefferson Dela Peña, 26, resident of Dumangas, Iloilo but born in Bacolod City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dela Peña, iya ginpahayag nga apisar sang iya kasablagan, wala ini nangin upang agud malab-ot sini ang iya handom nga makatapos sa kurso nga Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (BS IT).
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Dela Peña said that despite his disability, it did not prevent him from achieving his dream of graduating with a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (BS IT).

text: Suno kay Dela Peña, ginakonsiderar sini nga pagpanghangkat amo ang ulan nga iya masugata sa iya pagtuon nga nagdala man sang kabudlay ilabi na nga siya ang wala sang duha ka tiil.
english: According to Dela Peña, he considers the challenge is the rain he encountered in his studies which also brought difficulties especially that he does not have two legs.

text: Dugang sini nga indi nangin mahapos nga magsakay sa skate board kon basa kag malutak ang dalan.
english: He added that it was not easy to ride the skate board when the road was wet and muddy.

text: Apisar sini, wala man niya ginakahuya ang iya kahimtangan bisan pa nga mabudlay.
english: Despite this, he is not ashamed of his situation, even though it is difficult.

text: Nangin rason pagid ini kay Dela Peña, agud lab-uton pa ang mas masangkad nga buwas-damlag.
english: This is another reason for Dela Peña, to achieve a brighter future.

text: Nagpasalamat man ang natungdan sa iya pamilya kag himata nga nagsuporta sa iya tubtob sa siya ang naka-gradwar.
english: He also thanked his family and relatives who supported him until he graduated.

text: Sa maragtason nga hitabo, ang Iloilo State University of Fisheries Science and Technology naghatag sang mga degree sa 1,825 ka mga graduates—lakip ang 74 ka magna cum laude kag 324 ka cum laude honorees.
english: In the historic event, Iloilo State University of Fisheries Science and Technology conferred degrees on 1,825 graduates—including 74 magna cum laude and 324 cum laude honorees.

text: Nangabay ang legal counsel sang kontrobersyal nga mag-asawa nga Sarah kag Curlee Discaya nga indi pag-umidon ang ila kabataan.
english: The legal counsel of the controversial couple Sarah and Curlee Discaya asked not to neglect their children.

text: Ini sa tunga sang ginapangatubang nga kontrobersya sang mga ini  tuhoy sa flood control projects.
english: This is amid the controversy they are facing over flood control projects.

text: Suno kay Atty. Cornelio Samaniego III, may mga problema sa ikaayong lawas ang mga anak nga Discaya gani nag-apelar ini nga ang mag-asawa na lang ang hilabtan bangud mabaskog kag makabato ang mga ini.
english: According to Atty. Cornelio Samaniego III, the children of Discaya have health problems so he appealed that only the couple should be involved because they are strong and resilient.

text: ILOILO CITY – Movement wise kag energetic ang warriors sang labing una nga competing tribe nga Tribu Panayanon sang Iloilo City National High school.
english: ILOILO CITY – Movement wise and energetic are the warriors of the first competing tribe Tribu Panayanon of Iloilo City National High School.

text: Suno sa director kag choreographer nga si Novy Bereber, mapagsik ang pagsaot sang mga warrior sang Tribu Panayanon nga isa ka maayo nga panugod sa kompetisyon.
english: According to director and choreographer Novy Bereber, the warriors of the Tribu Panayanon danced energetically which was a good start to the competition.

text: Magluwas diri, gindayaw man ni Bereber ang maayo nga music kag ang nagasanto nga props nga gingamit sa konsepto nga nagsentro sa pagsalig kay Sr.
english: Besides, Bereber also praised the good music and the matching props used in the concept that focused on the trust of Sr.

text: Sto.
english: Sto.

text: Niño apang mas makapaayo kun tani kun ang costume sang mga warrior ang maduagon kag wala na kun tani ginbutangan sang sequence bilang disenyo ang indi makabig nga tradisyonal.
english: Niño but it would have been better if the costumes of the warriors were victorious and there was no sequence as the design is not considered traditional.

text: Sa pihak sini, 8 ang score nga ginhatag ni Bereber sa Tribu Panayanon.
english: Meanwhile, Bereber gave the Panayanon Tribe a score of 8.

text: Samtang, 7 naman ang score nga ginhatag sang cultural works specialist nga si Joseph William Albania para sa Tribu Panayanon.
english: Meanwhile, cultural works specialist Joseph William Albania gave a score of 7 to the Panayanon Tribe.

text: Sa pagpaathag ni Albania, mapagsik ang pagsaot sang mga warrior rason nga napakita ang mensahe nga luyag ipahibalo sa mga tumalan-aw.
english: Albania explained that the warriors' dance was energetic, which showed the message they wanted to convey to the audience.

text: Ginpaboran ni Albania ang komento ni Bereber nga mas maayo kun tani nga naggamit sang colorful costume ang tribu agud nga mas manami lantawon.
english: Albania favored Bereber's comment that it would have been better if the tribe had used colorful costumes to look better.

text: Nakakuha sang duha ka bronze medals ang Team Philippines sa International Bowling Federation (IBF) World Championships nga ginhiwat sa Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
english: Team Philippines won two bronze medals at the International Bowling Federation (IBF) World Championships held in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

text: Ang men’s team nanday Ian Dychangco, Merwin Tan, Patrick Nuqui, kag Kenneth Chua ang nakakuha sang bronze sa team event, samtang sanday Uella Marcial, Mades Arles, Norel Nuevo, kag Rachelle Leon ang nagdaog man sang bronze para sa women’s team.
english: The men’s team of Ian Dychangco, Merwin Tan, Patrick Nuqui, and Kenneth Chua took bronze in the team event, while Uella Marcial, Mades Arles, Norel Nuevo, and Rachelle Leon also won bronze for the women’s team.

text: Suno kay Biboy Rivera, ang national team coach, madugay man nga wala nakakuha sang medalya ang men kag ladies teams sa World Championships gani nga “extra special” ini para sa iya.
english: According to Biboy Rivera, the national team coach, the men and ladies teams have not won medals in the World Championships for a long time so this is “extra special” for him.

text: Ang South Korea amo ang nakakuha sang bulawan nga medalya samtang silver medal naman ang nakuha sang Singapore sa men’s competition.
english: South Korea won the gold medal while Singapore won the silver medal in the men's competition.

text: Sa women’s event, ang Team USA amo ang nanguna sa kompetisyon samtang ang Malaysia ang nagpangaduha.
english: In the women’s event, Team USA topped the competition while Malaysia finished second.

text: Wala nakapugong ang kakulang sa eksperyensya kag preparasyon agud nga maka-secure sang medalya ang men’s and women’s bowling teams sang Pilipinas sa International Bowling Federation (IBF) World Championships sa Dubai.
english: The lack of experience and preparation did not stop the men's and women's bowling teams of the Philippines from securing medals at the International Bowling Federation (IBF) World Championships in Dubai.

text: Pareho nga bronze ang nakuha sang men’s and women’s squads sa amo nga kumpetisyon.
english: Both the men’s and women’s squads won bronze in the competition.

text: Suno kay former world masters champion kag national team coach Biboy Rivera, madugay-dugay naman ang nagligad sang nakakuha sang medalya ang pungsod sa World Championships.
english: According to former world masters champion and national team coach Biboy Rivera, it has been a long time since the country won a medal at the World Championships.

text: “It is extra special to have won it at the same time.
english: “It is extra special to have won it at the same time.

text: Bronze feels like Gold!,” suno kay Rivera.
english: Bronze feels like Gold!,” Rivera said.

text: Sa women’s team semifinal, Malaysia ang nakapierde sa Pilipinas, samtang Singapore naman ang nakapierde sa men’s team sang pungsod sa semis.
english: In the women's team semifinal, Malaysia defeated the Philippines, while Singapore defeated the country's men's team in the semis.

english: — via Inquirer

text: Ginapreparahan sang militar sang Israel ang posible pagpatigayon sang ground assault ukon ground operation sa Lebanon.
english: The Israeli military is preparing for a possible ground assault or ground operation in Lebanon.

text: Kasunod ini sang ila asud-asud nga air strikes nga ginlunsar batok sa Lebanese armed group Hezbollah.
english: This follows their repeated air strikes launched against the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah.

text: Antes sini, ginpahayag man ang Israeli Army nga ginpatawag sini ang duha ka brigades sang reservists sa north agud padayunon ang pagpakig-away batok sa militante nga grupo nga Hezbollah.
english: Earlier, the Israeli Army also said it had called up two brigades of reservists in the north to continue the fight against the militant group Hezbollah.

text: Gin-anunsyo man sang Lebanese health minister nga sang Miyerkules, may panibag-o nga 61 nga napatay sa strikes.
english: The Lebanese health minister also announced that on Wednesday, there were 61 new deaths from the strikes.

text: Nagsaka na sa 615 ang patay sa nagligad nga tatlo ka adlaw nga atake kun sa diin masobra naman sa 2,000 ang nasamaran.
english: The death toll from the three-day attack has risen to 615, with more than 2,000 injured.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginapangunahan naman sang Estados Unidos ang madamo nga pungsod sa pagpanawagan nga ipatigayon anay ang ceasefire sa Lebanon.
english: Meanwhile, the United States is leading many countries in calling for a ceasefire in Lebanon.

text: Suno kay White House press secretary, Karine Jean-Pierre, padayon nila nga ginalab-ot ang Israel para sa kasugtanan, apisar nga una na nagpangindi ang Israel sa ceasefire kag determinado gid nga papason ang Hezbollah.
english: White House press secretary, Karine Jean-Pierre, said they continue to reach out to Israel for a deal, despite Israel having previously refused a ceasefire and being determined to wipe out Hezbollah.

text: Nagapadayon naman subong ang istoryahanay sa United Nations General Assembly sa New York kun sa diin nalakip ini sa istorya.
english: The talks are now underway at the United Nations General Assembly in New York where it is included in the story.

text: Patay matapos ginluthang ang isa ka manunudlo nga bag-o lang nakapasar sa Licensure Examination for Teachers (LET) sa Pikit, Cotabato.
english: A teacher who recently passed the Licensure Examination for Teachers (LET) was shot dead in Pikit, Cotabato.

text: Ang biktima amo si Yasser Abdullah, isa ka part-time teacher sa isa ka private school.
english: The victim was identified as Yasser Abdullah, a part-time teacher at a private school.

text: Suno sa Cotabato Police Provincial Office, ang biktima nagaserbe man nga treasurer sa Barangay Macabual sa idalom sang Special Geographic Area ng Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (SGA-BARMM).
english: According to the Cotabato Police Provincial Office, the victim also serves as a treasurer in Barangay Macabual under the Special Geographic Area of ​​the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (SGA-BARMM).

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, nakasakay na sa motorsiklo ang biktima kag bag-o lang naggwa sa eskwelahan sang ginluthang siya sang mga lalaki nga sakay man sa motorsiklo.
english: According to the investigation, the victim was riding a motorcycle and had just left the school when he was shot by men who were also riding a motorcycle.

text: Nag-angkon sang igo sang bala sa ulo kag nagkalain-lain nga parte sang lawas ang biktima.
english: The victim sustained multiple gunshot wounds in the head and various parts of the body.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang pulis para makilal-an ang mga kriminal kag ang motibo sa pagpangluthang.
english: Police are still investigating to identify the criminals and the motive of the shooting.

text: Ginakabig sang Department of Education (DEPED) Schools Division of Iloilo nga isa ka pagpanghangkat sa ila bahin ang resulta sang 2024 Functional Literacy, Education and Mass Media Survey.
english: The Department of Education (DEPED) Schools Division of Iloilo considers the results of the 2024 Functional Literacy, Education and Mass Media Survey as a challenge for them.

text: Nakasaad diri nga ang Iloilo ang may pinakamanubo nga functional literacy rate sa Western Visayas.
english: It states that Iloilo has the lowest functional literacy rate in Western Visayas.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Leonil Salvilla, spokesperson sang Department of Education Schools Division of Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga ang resulta nagakahulogan nga kinahanglan pa nga i-improve, identify ang gap, kag i-expand ang program agud nga maka-empower sa mga estudyante nga makapanumdom sang malig-on.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Leonil Salvilla, spokesperson of the Department of Education Schools Division of Iloilo, said the results mean that the program needs to be improved, identified, and expanded to empower students to remember well.

text: Gin-athag sini nga ang edukasyon ang isa ka “share responsibility” sa tunga sang eskwelahan kag sang panimalay.
english: He explained that education is a “shared responsibility” between the school and the home.

text: Dugang ni Salvilla nga antes pa man naguwa ang resulta, may programa na nga daan ang talatapan nga ginhingadlan “Tib-ong Bumulutho” nga nagahanda sa mga estudyante nga ginalakipan sang literacy and numeracy classes.
english: Salvilla added that even before the results came out, the office already had a program called “Tib-ong Bumulutho” that prepares students including literacy and numeracy classes.

text: Lakip sa ginalantaw sang talatapan nga factor amo ang nutrisyon sang mga estudyante nga mahimo makaapekto sa ila nga pagtuon.
english: Among the factors the office is looking at is the nutrition of the students that may affect their learning.

text: Nagpasalig man ang natungdan sang intervention para school feeding program nga lakip man sa budget sang DEPED.
english: He also promised intervention for school feeding program which is also included in the budget of DEPED.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Iloilo naka-post sang basic literacy rate nga 88.6% kag functional literacy rate nga 68.4%.
english: Iloilo posted a basic literacy rate of 88.6% and a functional literacy rate of 68.4%.

text: Baliskad ini sa Aklan nga nakarehistro sang pinakamataas nga rate sa rehiyon, nga may 92.1% nga basic literacy kag 73.9% functional literacy.
english: This is in contrast to Aklan which registered the highest rate in the region, with 92.1% basic literacy and 73.9% functional literacy.

text: Masobra 150 ka mga para-athletes sa pungsod ang maga-compete sa Pilipinas Para Games (PPG) Online Chess Competition nga gin-organisa sang Philippine Sports Commission.
english: More than 150 para-athletes in the country will compete in the Pilipinas Para Games (PPG) Online Chess Competition organized by the Philippine Sports Commission.

text: Ang event ang maga-umpisa sa Nobyembre 19.
english: The event will start on November 19.

text: Suno kay PSC oversight commissioner for para-athletes Arnold Agustin, ang paglunsyar sang proyekto ang may katuyuan nga i-address ang kinahanglanon sa sports development program para sa mga para-athletes.
english: According to PSC oversight commissioner for para-athletes Arnold Agustin, the launch of the project aims to address the need for a sports development program for para-athletes.

text: Ang online chess competition ang mangin nationwide event na.
english: The online chess competition is now a nationwide event.

text: Ang mga winners sa kompetisyon ang magabaton sang medalya, certificates of excellence kag cash incentives.
english: The winners of the competition will receive medals, certificates of excellence and cash incentives.

text: Pahanugutan na nga makasulod sa Hong Kong umpisa sa Agusto 30 ang mga overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) nga nagpatublok sang COVID-19 vaccine diri sa Pilipinas.
english: Overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) who have received the COVID-19 vaccine in the Philippines will be allowed to enter Hong Kong starting August 30.

text: Suno kay Labor Secretary Silvestre Bello III, sandig sa kumpirmasyon halin sa Hong Kong Government, pwede nga makasulod ang vaccinated OFWs sa amo nga lugar sa kondisyon nga may i-presentar gid nga vaccine cards nga gin-isyu sang Philippine Bureau of Quarantine.
english: According to Labor Secretary Silvestre Bello III, based on confirmation from the Hong Kong Government, vaccinated OFWs can enter the area on condition that they present vaccine cards issued by the Philippine Bureau of Quarantine.

text: Madumduman nga gindumilian anay sang Hong Kong nga makatapak sa ila nga jurisdiction ang mga Pinoy nga nagbaton sang COVID-19 vaccines diri sa Pilipinas.
english: Hong Kong had previously banned Filipinos who received COVID-19 vaccines in the Philippines from entering its jurisdiction.

text: Ini nga bag-o nga development ang makabulig sa 3,000 workers nga subong nagahulat na lang sang schedule agud ma-deploy na sa Hong Kong.
english: This new development will help the 3,000 workers who are currently waiting for a schedule to be deployed in Hong Kong.

text: Ginabanta 210,000 tanan ang OFWs ang nagatrabaho bilang domestic helpers sa amo nga lugar.
english: An estimated 210,000 OFWs are working as domestic helpers in the area.

text: Ipatawag sang tatlo ka komitiba sa Kamara ang pila ka personalidad kaangot sa imbestigasyon sa mga maanomaliya nga flood control projects, kalakip si Ako-Bicol party-list Rep.
english: The three House committees will summon several personalities in connection with the investigation into the anomalous flood control projects, including Ako-Bicol party-list Rep.

text: Zaldy Co.
english: Zaldy Co.

text: Ini pananglitang nga may makita nga mapag-on nga ebidensya nga magaangot sa iya sa mga ini.
english: This is only if there is hard evidence to link him to them.

text: Suno kay House Committee on Public Accounts kag Bicol Saro party-list Rep.
english: According to House Committee on Public Accounts and Bicol Saro party-list Rep.

text: Terry Ridon, obligado nga ipatawag si Co kun mapamatud-an nga may kaangtanan siya sa mga kuwestiyonable nga kontrata.
english: Terry Ridon, Co is obliged to be summoned if he is proven to be involved in questionable contracts.

text: Naghalin ang pahayag matapos ang alegasyon ni Navotas Rep.
english: The statement came after Navotas Rep.

text: Tobias Tiangco nga si Co ang ginatudlo sini nga nagduso sang bilyones nga pondo para sa mga proyekto sa idalom sang 2025 national budget kag sa iya nga termino bilang appropriations chairperson.
english: Tobias Tiangco said Co is the one who proposed billions of funds for projects under the 2025 national budget and during his term as appropriations chairperson.

text: Apang suno kay Ridon, mas nagakaangay nga istoryahan ang mga isyu ni Tiangco sa House Committee on Appropriations, kag indi sa tatlo ka panel nga nagaimbestigar sa mga flood control projects.
english: But Ridon said it would be more appropriate to discuss Tiangco's issues with the House Committee on Appropriations, and not with the three panels investigating flood control projects.

text: Dugang niya, ang importante para sa publiko amo ang salabton sa mga maanomaliya nga proyekto.
english: He added that what is important for the public is accountability for anomalous projects.

text: Ginpunto man ni Ridon nga kun luyag ni Tiangco nga busision ang budget insertion, dapat siya nga mag-file sang separado nga resolusyon.
english: Ridon also pointed out that if Tiangco wants to amend the budget insertion, he should file a separate resolution.

text: Naghatag sang iya mensahe sa atubang sang mga world leaders sa pinakaulihi nga kahigayunan si United States President Joe Biden sa 79th Session sang United Nations General Assembly.
english: United States President Joe Biden delivered his message in front of world leaders for the last time at the 79th Session of the United Nations General Assembly.

text: Sa atubang sang 193-member UN General Assembly, isa sa ginhatagan niya sang importansya ang posibilidad sang pag-angkon sang kalinong ilabi na sa Middle East.
english: In front of the 193-member UN General Assembly, one of the things he emphasized was the possibility of achieving peace especially in the Middle East.

text: Suno sa iya, posible gid nga masolbar ang mga kinagamo kaangay sang nagapatunga sa Israel kag Hezbollah sang Lebanon kag amo man batok sa Hamas.
english: He said it was entirely possible to resolve conflicts like the one between Israel and Lebanon’s Hezbollah and also against Hamas.

text: Tion naman suno sa iya nga tapuson ang 17 ka bulan nga civil war sa Sudan.
english: He said it is time to end the 17-month civil war in Sudan.

text: Pahayag niya, ang ano man nga full scale nga giyera ang wala gin sa interes sang bisan sin-o kag apisar nagsingki pa gid ang tensyon, indi gihapon imposible nga may madihon nga solusyon.
english: He said any full scale war is not in anyone's interest and although tensions have escalated, it is not impossible to have a peaceful solution.

text: Samtang, ginpanawagan naman sini ang padayon nga Western support para sa Ukraine sa giyera batok sa Russia.
english: Meanwhile, he called for continued Western support for Ukraine in the war against Russia.

text: Ginpalawig sang Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) ang deadline sang payment sang mga taxpayer nga yara sa mga lugar nga napaidalom sa Enhanced Community Quarantine (ECQ) kag Modified Enhanced Community Quarantine (MECQ).
english: The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has extended the payment deadline for taxpayers in areas under Enhanced Community Quarantine (ECQ) and Modified Enhanced Community Quarantine (MECQ).

text: Suno kay BIR Commissioner Caesar Dulay, sa idalom sang Revenue Memorandum Circular (RMC) No.
english: According to BIR Commissioner Caesar Dulay, under Revenue Memorandum Circular (RMC) No.

text: 91-2021, ang deadline sang pagbayad ang iga-extend sa 15 ka-adlaw halin sa tion nga mabatak na ang nasambit nga quarantine classifications sa pila ka mga lugar sa pungsod.
english: 91-2021, the deadline for payment will be extended to 15 days from the time the said quarantine classifications are withdrawn in some areas of the country.

text: Pahayag niya, ini nga tikang sang ahensya ang kasunod sang asud-asud nga lockdown nga ginapatuman sa nanuhay-tuhay nga mga lugar bangud sa peligro nga dala sang mga mas makalalaton nga variant sang COVID-19.

text: Pat-od nga indi mo gid gusto nga maabtan mo ang natabo sa isa ka Lolo sa Peru.
english: Surely you would never want to experience what happened to a Grandfather in Peru.

text: Ini isa ka 81-anyos nga tigulang nga nakabatyag sang kabudlay sa pagtulon kag masakit man pati ang iya pagginhawa sa sulod na sang apat ka adlaw.
english: He is an 81-year-old man who has been experiencing difficulty swallowing and breathing for four days.

text: Bangud indi na ini makaagwanta, nagpalapit ini sa ospital, kag sang nagpaidalom sa X-ray, tuman ang iya kakibot sang nahibal-an nga nagbara gali ang pustiso sa iya nga tutunlan.
english: Unable to cope, he went to the hospital, and when he underwent an X-ray, he was shocked to learn that the prosthesis in his throat was blocked.

text: Nahibaluan nga may epilepsy man si Lolo.
english: It turns out that Lolo also has epilepsy.

text: Gin-istorya sini nga sang gin-atake siya sang kumbulsyon, ginpinsar niya nga nabuga niya ang iya pustiso kag na-missing, apang wala gid siya nagpinsar nga natulon niya gali ini.
english: He said that when he had a seizure, he thought he had spit out his denture and missed it, but he never thought he had actually swallowed it.

text: Madasig naman ang medical team sa Sabogal hospital sa Lima sa pagpatigayon sang operasyon.
english: The medical team at the Sabogal hospital in Lima was quick to conduct the operation.

text: “During a convulsive episode in Huacho on December 13, 2024, he expelled a dental prosthesis – that’s what the patient thought.
english: “During a convulsive episode in Huacho on December 13, 2024, he expelled a dental prosthesis – that’s what the patient thought.

text: But what really happened was that he had ingested this foreign body, it had remained in the hypopharynx,” suno sa report ni Dr. Raul Maurta sang Sabogal Hospital.
english: But what really happened was that he had ingested this foreign body, it had remained in the hypopharynx,” according to the report of Dr. Raul Maurta of Sabogal Hospital.

text: Nakuha gikan sa iya tutunlan ang pustiso, kag tuman ang kalipay sang Lolo bangud mahapos na liwat kag indi na masakit ang iya pagginhawa.
english: The denture was removed from his throat, and the grandfather was very happy because he could breathe easily and without pain again.

text: Naka-guwa naman si Lolo sa ospital matapos ang madinalag-on nga procedure.
english: Lolo was discharged from the hospital after a successful procedure.

text: BY THE WAY, may reklamo ang pila ka mga pumuluyo diri sa siyudad sang Iloilo batok sa GDR Taxi.Sadto madale man lang kuno ang magkuha sang ila unit paagi sa telefono dira sa ila lugar.
english: BY THE WAY, some residents here in Iloilo City have a complaint against GDR Taxi.

text: Matuod, suludlon ining lugar nila kag kon nagaulan ginadanaw ang pila ka bahin sang alagyan dira nga manubo, pero indi man gani problema gid ini.In fact, madamo nga mga pumuluyo dira ang may salakyan nga balewala man lang ini nga problema sa ila, kon problema gid man.
english: It is true that this area is crowded and when it rains some parts of the road are low, but it is not a problem. In fact, many residents there have vehicles that do not care about this problem, if it is a problem.

text: Sige man ang ila pagwa kag pasulod dira nga wala reklamo.
english: They keep coming in and out of it without complaining.

text: Ang iban nga taksi wala man gani gareklamo sa pagdul-ong kag pagsugat sang pasahero dira.Gani, natingala ang pila ka pumuluyo nga hinali na lang mabudlay na ang pagsulod sang unit sang GDR unit agud magkuha sang pasahero sa ila lugar dira.Sang ulihi nakabati na lang sila sing reklamo halin mismo sa isa nila ka drayber.
english: Some taxis did not even complain about dropping off and picking up passengers there. Therefore, some residents were surprised that suddenly it was difficult for the GDR unit to enter their area to pick up passengers. Later they heard a complaint from one of their drivers.

text: Indi kuno sila magsulod diri kay mahigkuan ang ila taksi sang danaw, samtang wala man ini nila ginareklamo sadto.Gali kay sa pagbalik sang pagluag sang restriction angot sa pandemic nagdamo na ang mga pasahero kag wala na sila kinahanglan magsugat kag magdul-ong pasahero pakadto kag paggwa sa mga puluy-an dira.Kon matuod, violation man bala ini ang indi pagbaton sang pasahero sang mga taksi samtang pwede man nila mahimo.
english: They say they will not enter here because their taxi will be polluted by the lake, while they did not complain about it before. But with the return of the restriction related to the pandemic, the number of passengers has increased and they do not have to meet and take passengers to and from the houses there. they can.

text: Indi bala Mr. Land Transportation Office?Kag ano ayhan ang penalidad diri sa GDR Taxi kon magreklamo ining mga pumuluyo?
english: Isn't Mr. Land Transportation Office? And what is the penalty here at GDR Taxi if these residents complain?

text: Nga daan luyag na magreklamo sang pila ka mga pumuluyo sa LTO parti sini nga problema nila sa GDR Taxi.
english: Some residents already want to complain to the LTO about their problem with GDR Taxi.

text: Sa karon, makalilibog pa gihapon ang sitwasyon sang P680-M nga Ungka Flyover II, nga nagaangot sang Iloilo city kag banwa sang Pavia.Duha ka bulan kag tunga pa lang nga nagamit ini sang nakita diri ang mga litik (cracks) sa pila ka bahin sang flyover nga nakahatag alarma sa mga nagaalagi dira nga mga salakyan.Ang pagpanayasat sang rehiyonal nga upisina sang DPWH nagpakita nga ining mga cracks tuga gali sang pag-usmod (vertical displacement) sa bahin kon diin nagatindug ang pila ka haligi (pile post) sini.Gani gindesisyunan na nila nga ipasara anay ang flyover sugod sadtong Setyembre 18 agud malikawan ang padayon nga pag-usmod sini.Samtang nagdulot na ini sang pagginutok sang trapiko sa kilid sini nga pwede anay maagyan.Problema pa ugaling kay sa kadugay nga pagtuon sang regional office sang DPWH indi pa maseguro sini kon ano ang pag-solbar sa problema.
english: At present, the situation of the P680-M Ungka Flyover II, which connects Iloilo City and Pavia town, is still confusing. It has only been in use for two and a half months when cracks were found in some parts of the flyover that alarmed passing vehicles. The cracks were caused by vertical displacement in the area where some of the pile posts stood. So they decided to close the flyover from September 18 to avoid further displacement. The problem is that the regional office of the DPWH has not been able to determine how to solve the problem.

text: In fact, tubtub sining Disyembre, mga tatlo ka bulan na ang nagligad, indi pa makasiling ini kon ano gid ang ila bagay himuon.Tungod sini gani, ang Pavia municipal council nagpasar na sing resolution sadtong Disyembre 12 agud ma-imbestigaran na ining problema sang DPWH Central Office.Wala kita nagapakanubo sang abilidad sang DPWH-6 kag sang contractor sini nga International Builders Corp.
english: In fact, until this December, about three months ago, it could not say what they should do. Therefore, the Pavia municipal council passed a resolution on December 12 to investigate this problem by the DPWH Central Office.

text: (IBC) agud masolbar ining pag-usmod sang flyover.Matuod, sandig sa research naton, malawak gid man ang pwede maproblema nila sa pag-resolbar sa sining problema.
english: (IBC) to solve this flyover collapse. Indeed, based on our research, they may have a lot of problems in solving this problem.

text: Madamo sing rason kon ngaa natabo ining pag-usmod sang flyover.Indi lang kay kinahanglan dugangan ang haligi (pile post), kay basi lain man ang problema.
english: There are many reasons why this flyover collapse occurred. It is not just that the pile post needs to be increased, but there may be another problem.

text: Nga daan ang problema yara sa idalom duta nga indi makita sang “naked eye” sang mga engineer.Posible ang problema tungod kay nag-collapse ang ginatungtungan nga duta didto sa idalom sang pile.
english: The problem is already underground that cannot be seen by the naked eye of the engineers. The problem is possible because the soil under the pile has collapsed.

text: Posible man ang problema sang alignment sang mga structural parts sang flyover.
english: The alignment problem of the structural parts of the flyover is also possible.

text: Posible man nga tungod mahuyang ang nagahugot nga semento (concrete).
english: It is also possible that the concrete is weak.

text: Kag ang madamo pa nga rason angot sa structural procedure, sa kabug-usan.Ang napaligban sang mga pumuluyo ugaling kon ngaa kadugay gid madiskubrihan ang problema agud matagaan na ini sing solusyon.
english: And the many other reasons related to the structural procedure, in general. What the residents are concerned about is why it took so long to discover the problem and give it a solution.

text: Mga expert man bala ang mga engineers sang DPWH?
english: Are the DPWH engineers experts?

text: Ti ngaa indi pa matultulan ang problema sa sulod na sang tatlo ka bulan kag matagaan na sing solusyon?Samtang sige ang pag-antos sang mga pumuluyo sa gaproblema na nga trapiko sa kilid sang flyover.Kinahanglan pa bala naton mag-hire ang isa ka structural consultancy firm nga mas makasarang agud mapadale ang solusyon sa problema nga ini sang flyover?Nagapin-ut na gani ang dughan sang madamo sa ila pag-ugtas sa daw wala katapusan nga pagdiskubre pa lang gani sang problema!
english: Why can't the problem be identified within three months and given a solution? While the residents are suffering from the already problematic traffic along the flyover. Do we need to hire a structural consultancy firm that is more capable of solving this problem? chests of many in their revulsion at the seemingly endless discovery of the problem!
