text: Nag-request ang legal team ni Former President Rodrigo Duterte sa International Criminal Court (ICC) nga tugutan sila nga magdugang sang 78 ka ebidensya para sa nagahilapit nga hearing sa confirmation of charges sang anay Presidente sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte's legal team has requested the International Criminal Court (ICC) to allow them to add 78 pieces of evidence for the upcoming hearing on the confirmation of charges against the former President at the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Sa pagpanguna sang abogado ni Duterte nga si Nicholas Kaufman, nag-request sila sa ICC Pre-Trial Chamber 1, nga naghingyo sang mga dugang nga ebidensya, bilang paghanda sa kaso, ilabi na matapos nga magpahayag ang prosekusyon sang 1,242 ka items sang ebidensya batok kay Duterte.
english: Led by Duterte's lawyer Nicholas Kaufman, they requested the ICC Pre-Trial Chamber 1, which requested additional evidence, in preparation for the case, especially after the prosecution disclosed 1,242 items of evidence against Duterte.

text: Ginpunto nila nga ang request nasumiter 15 ka adlaw antes ang hearing, suno sa ICC rules, kag ang pagdugang sang ebidensya indi makadelay sa proseso kag indi makaapekto sa prosekusyon.
english: They pointed out that the request was submitted 15 days before the hearing, as per ICC rules, and the addition of evidence would not delay the process and would not affect the prosecution.

text: Suno man sa ila, ang legal representatives sang mga biktima bag-o pa lang na-appoint, gani ang pagdugang sang ebidensya indi makapektar sa ila mga katungdanan.
english: They also said the legal representatives of the victims were recently appointed, so the addition of evidence would not affect their duties.

text: Gin-mensyonar sang kampo ni Duterte nga kun indi pagtugutan ang request, mahimo gid ini makapahina sang depensa ni Duterte sa pagpanindugan sang iya kaso.
english: Duterte's camp mentioned that if the request is not granted, it could weaken Duterte's defense in defending his case.

text: Bukas si Iloilo Third District Rep.
english: Tomorrow is Iloilo Third District Rep.

text: Lorenz Defensor sa pagpadalagan sa pagka-gobernador ukon bisan sa pagka-senador sa masunod nga eleksyon.
english: Lorenz Defensor to run for governor or even senator in the next election.

text: Kasunod ini sang iya kadalag-an sa 2025 polls kun sa diin nagpabilin ini sa pwesto matapos nakakuha sang 194,791 votes — daku nga abanse sa iya kasumpong nga si Thelma Langusta nga may yara lamang sang 2,679 ka mga boto.
english: This follows his victory in the 2025 polls where he remained in office after securing 194,791 votes — a huge lead over his opponent Thelma Langusta who had only 2,679 votes.

text: Bangud ini na ang iya ikatatlo kag katapusan nga termino bilang mamalidha, nagpahayag ang kongresista nga mas paayuhon pa sini ang iya serbisyo sa third district.
english: As this is his third and final term as a lawmaker, the congressman said he will further improve his service in the third district.

text: “Sa 2028, manami man kun makapadayon ako sa pagserbisyo sa mga Ilonggo sa iban nga paagi, kag bukas gid ako nga ma-prioritize ang development sang probinsya sang Iloilo,” suno kay Defensor sa interview sang Bombo Radyo.
english: “In 2028, it would be nice if I could continue to serve the Ilonggos in other ways, and I am open to prioritizing the development of Iloilo province,” Defensor said in an interview with Bombo Radyo.

text: Sa partikular nga pamangkot kun handa ini nga buslan ang iya magulang nga si reelected Governor Arthur ‘Toto’ Defensor, Jr., nagsabat ang manghod nga malayo pa ang 2028 apang wala niya ginadula ini nga posibilidad.
english: Asked specifically if he is ready to replace his brother, reelected Governor Arthur 'Toto' Defensor, Jr., the younger brother replied that 2028 is still far away but he does not rule out the possibility.

text: “Bukas kita sa tanan nga options subong.
english: “We are open to all options now.

text: Sa national level, wala kita nakahibalo sang hulag, apang ginabuksan ko ang lawas ko sa tanan nga options para sa ikaayo sang mga Ilonggo,” pahayag sini.
english: At the national level, we don't know the movement, but I open my body to all options for the good of Ilonggos,” he said.

text: Antes pa man ang 2025 elections, may mga naga-mensyonar naman sang pangalan sang kongresista bilang posible nga material sa senatorial race.
english: Even before the 2025 elections, there are those who mention the name of the congressman as possible material in the senatorial race.

text: “Kun indi ka artista, komedyante, ukon action star, or incumbent senator, dapat may magpili anay sa imo nga mangin parte ka sang lineup [sa senatorial race], kay kun indi ka man lang pagpilion, indi na naton pag-usikan sang tyempo ang national nga eleksyon,” pahayag sini.
english: “If you are not an actor, comedian, or action star, or incumbent senator, someone should first choose you to be part of the lineup [in the senatorial race], because if you are not chosen, we will not waste time in the national election,” he said.

text: Gindugang sini nga wala man sang malain nga magsaot kag magkanta, apang nagalaum siya nga kun magpungko na ang mga indibidwal sa Senado, nahangpan man nila ang obligasyon sa legislation.
english: He added that there is nothing wrong with dancing and singing, but he hopes that when individuals sit in the Senate, they also understand the obligation to the legislation.

text: Martes, Mayo 13, sang nagpatigayon ang Provincial Board of Canvassers sang proclamation sang winners sa 2025 elections sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Tuesday, May 13, when the Provincial Board of Canvassers conducted the proclamation of the winners in the 2025 elections in Iloilo province.

text: Nanguna sa proklamasyon sang Commission on Elections – Iloilo Province si Provincial Election Supervisor Atty. Reinier Layson sa session hall sang Iloilo Provincial Capitol.
english: The proclamation of the Commission on Elections – Iloilo Province was led by Provincial Election Supervisor Atty. Reinier Layson in the session hall of the Iloilo Provincial Capitol.

text: Ginklaro sang Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) nga wala nagbag-o ang suporta sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika sa Pilipinas.
english: The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) clarified that the support of the United States of America to the Philippines has not changed.

text: Ini kasunod sang reports nga may redeployment sang US missile systems halin sa South Korea pakadto sa Middle East bangud sang padayon nga gyera batok sa Iran.
english: This follows reports of the redeployment of US missile systems from South Korea to the Middle East due to the ongoing war against Iran.

text: Suno sa AFP, wala sang indikasyon nga plano sang Washington nga kuhaon ukon bawion ang ila military assets nga yara sa Pilipinas.
english: According to AFP, there is no indication that Washington plans to withdraw its military assets in the Philippines.

text: Lakip sa assets sang US nga yari sa Pilipinas amo ang Typhon (MRC) missile system kag ang Navy-Marine Expeditionary Ship Interdiction System (NMESIS).
english: Among the US assets in the Philippines are the Typhon (MRC) missile system and the Navy-Marine Expeditionary Ship Interdiction System (NMESIS).

text: Pareho nga nag-abot sa Pilipinas ini nga assets sang 2025, kag pareho man nga gingamit sa military exercises kaangay sang Balikatan Exercise.
english: Both of these assets arrived in the Philippines in 2025, and both were used in military exercises such as the Balikatan Exercise.

text: Ini ang kabahin sang military cooperation sa tunga sang US kag Pilipinas para sa depensa kag seguridad sang rehiyon.
english: This is part of the military cooperation between the US and the Philippines for the defense and security of the region.

text: “Our alliance with the U.S. continues to strengthen, and there has been no change in the level of support being provided,” suno kay AFP Spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea RAdm.
english: “Our alliance with the U.S. continues to strengthen, and there has been no change in the level of support being provided,” according to AFP Spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea RAdm.

text: Roy Vincent Trinidad.
english: Roy Vincent Trinidad.

text: Gin-athag man sang opisyal nga ang EDCA sites amo ang Philippine bases nga may pasilidad para sa mutual defense kag humanitarian assistance kag wala ginagamit bilang staging areas para sa offensive operations.
english: The official also explained that the EDCA sites are Philippine bases with facilities for mutual defense and humanitarian assistance and are not used as staging areas for offensive operations.

text: Pasakaan sang P130 ang sweldo sang mga existing nga mga Job hires sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: The salary of existing job hires in Iloilo City will be increased by P130.

text: Gin-anunsyo ini ni Mayor-Elect Raisa Treñas-Chu kadungan sang ginpatigayon nga Tree Planting Activity sa Sunset Boulevard.
english: This was announced by Mayor-Elect Raisa Treñas-Chu during the Tree Planting Activity held at Sunset Boulevard.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Treñas, ginpahayag niya nga halin sa P450 mahimo na ini nga P580 agud may inugbayad ini sila sa Philhealth Contribution.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Treñas said that from P450, it will be increased to P580 so that they can pay the Philhealth Contribution.

text: Ini lakip man sa health care nga prayoridad sang manugsulod nga alkalde.
english: This is also among the health care priorities of the incoming mayor.

text: Magahalin naman ang funding sa income surplus sang syudad kag improved nga Real Property Taxes (RPT) collection kun sa diin amo ini ang ika-duha sa pinakadako nga source sang revenue sang syudad.
english: The funding will come from the city's income surplus and improved Real Property Taxes (RPT) collection which is the second largest source of revenue for the city.

text: Dugang diri, ang permanent city employees ang makabenepisyo sa implementation second tranche sang Salary Standardization Law (SSL) 6 sugod sa Agosto 2025.
english: In addition, permanent city employees will benefit from the implementation of the second tranche of the Salary Standardization Law (SSL) 6 starting August 2025.

text: Ang pondo para diri nakuha sa idalom sang Supplemental Budget No.1 para subong nga tuig, nga gin-aprubahan sang Sangguniang Panlungsod sang nagligad nga Abril.
english: Funding for this was obtained under Supplemental Budget No.1 for this year, which was approved by the City Council last April.

text: Ginaproseso man ang coverage sang Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) para sa mga regular nga empleyado, sa koordinasyon sang Resource Employees Association of City Hall (REACH).
english: Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) coverage for regular employees is also being processed, in coordination with the Resource Employees Association of City Hall (REACH).

english: The mayor also assured that the city employees of the proper salary adjustment in line with the rising cost of living.

text: Required ang vaccination para sa mga imports nga magasulod sa Pilipinas agud maghampang sa PBA Governors Cup sa Nobyembre 28 sa Ynares Sports Arena sa Pasig.
english: Vaccination is required for imports entering the Philippines to play in the PBA Governors Cup on November 28 at the Ynares Sports Arena in Pasig.

english: Quarantine protocols will also be in effect.

text: Nagpabutyag si PBA commissioner Willie Marcial sang pagpasalamat kay Pasig Mayor Vico Sotto sa pagpahanugot sa first stage sang Philippine Cup nga pagahiwaton sa syudad.
english: PBA commissioner Willie Marcial expressed his gratitude to Pasig Mayor Vico Sotto for allowing the first stage of the Philippine Cup to be held in the city.

text: Sa idalom sang Alert Level 2 sa NCR Plus, suno kay Marcial, pwede naman ang live audience nga makalantaw sang hampang apang ini ang konsultahon pa sa IATF kun ano ang mangin kapasidad, ang distansya sang pulungkuan, vaccination rules kag sanitation requirements.
english: Under Alert Level 2 in NCR Plus, Marcial said, live audiences can watch the game but it will be consulted with the IATF on the capacity, seating distance, vaccination rules and sanitation requirements.

text: Nagsaka na sa 492 ang patay kag 1,645 ang nasamaran sa airstrikes sang Israel sa Lebanon sa sulod lamang sang isa ka adlaw.
english: The death toll from Israeli airstrikes in Lebanon has risen to 492 and 1,645 injured in just one day.

text: Natabo ini kahapon, Lunes, kun sa diin ginkumpirma sang Israel nga 300 ka “terrorist targets” ang ila gin-igu sa sulod sang kaiping nga pungsod nga ginapatihan naangot sa Hezbollah nga amo ang militant group kag political party nga suportado sang Iran.
english: This happened yesterday, Monday, when Israel confirmed that it had hit 300 "terrorist targets" inside the neighboring country believed to be linked to Hezbollah, a militant group and political party supported by Iran.

text: Ini nga death toll amo ang pinakamataas nga numero sa away sang Hezbollah kag Israel subong nga tuig kag amo man ang pinakamakamamatay nga adlaw halin sang natabo ang masobra isa ka bulan nga giyera sa tunga sang Israel kag Lebanon sang 2006.
english: This death toll was the highest figure in the fighting between Hezbollah and Israel this year and also the deadliest day since the more than month-long war between Israel and Lebanon in 2006.

text: Suno sa Israel Defense Forces, mas pasangkaron pa nila ang ila atake sa “terror targets” sa Bekaa Valley sa eastern border sang pungsod.
english: The Israel Defense Forces say they will intensify their attacks on “terror targets” in the Bekaa Valley on the country’s eastern border.

text: Nagpaandam man ini sa mga sibilyan nga magbakwit na kag magpalayo sa mga lugar nga naka-posisyon ang militante nga grupo.
english: He also warned civilians to evacuate and stay away from areas where the militant group is positioned.

text: Suno naman kay Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, indi mga taga-Lebanon ang ila kontra, apang kinahanglan nila nga papason ang mga armas kag ginahukmungan sang Hezbollah antes pa man ini makalupad sang mga rocket agud nga iguon man ang mga residente sang Israel.
english: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said their opponents are not Lebanese, but they need to destroy Hezbollah's weapons and positions before it can launch rockets to hit Israeli residents.

text: Gin-abisuhan naman sang health ministry ang mga ospital sa nabagatnan kag nasidlangan nga i-suspinde anay ang indi pa tuman ka kinahanglanon nga surgeries kag magtutok anay sa mga napilasan sa airstrikes.
english: The health ministry has advised hospitals in the south and east to suspend non-essential surgeries and focus on those injured in the airstrikes.

text: Ginsirado naman sang Ministry of Education ang tanan nga high schools, vocational kag technical colleges, kag ginsuspinde ang klase sa Lebanese University sa Beirut.
english: The Ministry of Education has closed all high schools, vocational and technical colleges, and suspended classes at the Lebanese University in Beirut.

text: Ginkumpirma naman sang Israel Defense Forces nga ini ang una nga bes nga nagpaandam sila nga magpalayo ang mga sibilyan sa Lebanon sa militant positions.
english: The Israel Defense Forces confirmed that this is the first time they have warned civilians in Lebanon to stay away from militant positions.

text: Ila man ginpahayag nga nagatutok sila subong sa aerial strikes kag wala pa sang ginapatigayon nga ground assault.
english: They also said they are now focusing on aerial strikes and no ground assault is being conducted.

text: Una na nagpaandam ang United Nations sa posible mga risgo pananglitan himuon sang Israel ang Lebanon nga daw kaangay sa Gaza nga subong halos napulbos na bangud sa gyera kontra sa Hamas.
english: The United Nations has earlier warned of possible risks if Israel makes Lebanon like Gaza, which is now almost destroyed by the war against Hamas.

text: Pananglitan madayon ang all-out war sa Lebanon, magasangkad pa ang ginamo sa Middle East kag ginakahangaw-an ang pag-intra sang Iran nga taga-suporta sang Hezbollah kag Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga kaalyado naman sang Israel.
english: If the all-out war in Lebanon continues, the conflict in the Middle East will spread and the involvement of Iran, which supports Hezbollah, and the United States, which is an ally of Israel, is feared.

text:
MGA PILIPINO SA LEBANON

Samtang, liwat nga nag-abiso ang embahada sang Pilipinas nga dapat nga magpabilin nga vigilante ang mga Pilipino ilabi na ang nahamtang sa south Lebanon.
english:
FILIPINOS IN LEBANON

Meanwhile, the Philippine embassy once again warned that Filipinos should remain vigilant especially those located in south Lebanon.

text: Wala pa sang kumpirmasyon kun may mga Pilipino nga nalakip sa nasamaran kag napatay sa airstrikes, apang base sa pahayag sang embassy, dapat nga magpabilin sa sulod sang balay ang Filipino nationals kag pasulabihon gid ang safety and security samtang wala pa nagatahaw ang bombahanay.
english: There is no confirmation whether any Filipinos were among the injured and killed in the airstrikes, but based on the embassy's statement, Filipino nationals should stay indoors and give priority to safety and security while the bombing is still going on.

text: Antes ang airstrikes kahapon, ginpahayag ni Philippine Ambassador to Lebanon Raymond Balatbat nga ginatos ka mga Pilipino ang nagbawi sang ila nga request nga magpa-repatriate apisar sang gamo sa amo nga pungsod.
english: Before the airstrikes yesterday, Philippine Ambassador to Lebanon Raymond Balatbat said hundreds of Filipinos had withdrawn their request for repatriation despite the unrest in the country.

text: Yara sa 1,174 ang applications for repatriation apang halin sang nagluntad ang kinagamo, 505 pa lamang ang napapauli sa Pilipinas bangud nagdesisyon ang iban nga magtinir.
english: There are 1,174 applications for repatriation but since the unrest, only 505 have been returned to the Philippines because some decided to stay.

text: Una na nagsiling ang embahada nga dapat magbiya na ang mga Pilipino samtang may available pa nga commercial flights.
english: Earlier, the embassy said Filipinos should leave while there are still available commercial flights.

text: Ang Philippine government ang magasabat sa travel expenses bangud napaidalom ang Beirut sa alert level 3, buot silingon, available ang repatriation apang wala ginapilit ukon boluntaryo gid lamang.
english: The Philippine government will be responsible for travel expenses as Beirut is under alert level 3, meaning that repatriation is available but not forced or voluntary.

text: Ginpanubuan sang S&P Global Ratings ang ila economic growth forecasts sa pungsod para sa sini nga tuig 2021 kag 2022.
english: S&P Global Ratings has lowered its economic growth forecasts in the country for this year 2021 and 2022.

text: Ini nga tikang ang ginabasol sang Debt watcher sa COVID-19 pandemic-related lockdowns nga ginapatuman sa nanuhay-tuhay nga bahin sang pungsod.
english: The Debt watcher blamed the move on the COVID-19 pandemic-related lockdowns being implemented in various parts of the country.

text: Suno sa S&P Global Ratings, nangin dako nga huol ang intermittent lockdowns sa economic activity sa diin mas ginpahugtan pa subong ang mga pagsulundan bangud sa pagsulod sang Delta COVID-19 variant.
english: According to S&P Global Ratings, the intermittent lockdowns have been a major concern to economic activity where the rules have been tightened due to the entry of the Delta COVID-19 variant.

text: Bangud sini, mahimo nga 4-5 percent lang ang mangin rate sang economic growth para sa sini nga tuig kag kun magpadayon pa ang nagalala nga sitwasyon, posible nga magasarurot sa gihapon ang ekonomiya sang pungsod sa 2022.
english: As a result, the economic growth rate for this year may be only 4-5 percent and if the situation continues to deteriorate, the country's economy may still shrink in 2022.

text: May mga kaso nga dalayon na lang nga nagakatulugan… malubong na lang sa limot apang wala pa gihapon nahatag ang hustisya.
english: There are cases that are just asleep... buried in oblivion but justice has not been done.

text: Apang may mga kaso man nga kaangay sining natabo sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika kun sa diin malapit na lang dalayon masolbar ang isa ka murder case nga natabo sang 1988 ukon 36 anyos na ang nagligad.
english: But there are also cases like this that happened in the United States of America where a murder case that happened in 1988 or 36 years ago is almost immediately solved.

text:
Kaso ini sang 27-anyos nga babaye nga si Karen Taylor, residente sang Roxbury sa Boston, U.S.A.

Sang Mayo 1988, nagtawag ang iya iloy sa ila apartment, apang ang tatlo ka tuig nga bata ni Karen ang nakasabat kag nagpanugid nga nagakatulog ang iya mama kag indi niya ini mapukaw.
english:
This is the case of 27-year-old woman Karen Taylor, a resident of Roxbury in Boston, U.S.A.

In May 1988, her mother called their apartment, but Karen's three-year-old son answered and told her that his mother was asleep and could not wake her.

text: Sang ginkadtuan ang apartment, nakit-an ang lawas ni Karen nga nagahamyangon, nagapaligo sa kaugalingon nga dugo, kag may 15 ka mga pilas tuga sang pagkabuno partikular na sa iya ulo, dughan, kag liog.
english: When the apartment was searched, Karen's body was found lying on the floor, bathed in her own blood, and with 15 stab wounds particularly to her head, chest, and neck.

text: Ang suspek nga naangot sa krimen amo ang lalaki nga si James Holloman.
english: The suspect linked to the crime is a man named James Holloman.

text: Sang tion nga nakit-an ang biktima, nakit-an man didto ang cheke nga nakapangalan kay James.
english: When the victim was found, a check in James' name was also found there.

text: May “scrapings” man sa kuko sang biktima, may duguon nga sweatshirt malapit sa lawas sini, kag may upos sa sigarilyo sa banyo.
english: There were also scrapings on the victim's nails, a bloody sweatshirt near his body, and a cigarette butt in the bathroom.

text: Ginkulang sang forensic evidence gani nga bitin ang pag-link kay James sa pagpapatay kay Karen.
english: There is a lack of forensic evidence to link James to Karen's murder.

text: Apang nakakuha ang pulis sang DNA sa mga ebidensiya, gani na-profile sang mga pulis ang posible nga killer.
english: But the police were able to get DNA from the evidence, so the police were able to profile the possible killer.

text: Abi sang tanan, malipatan na lang ang kaso, kag mangin si James ang wala nagdumdom nga mabuhi pa liwat ang amo nga istorya.
english: Everyone thought the case would be forgotten, and even James didn't think the story would ever come back to life.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, sa isa ka simple nga adlaw, nagdupla siya sa guwa sang ila balay sa Boston, apang likom sa iya ihibalo, may mga operatiba nga nagkuha sang sample sa amo nga dupla kag ginpaidalom sa DNA test.
english: Last year, on a simple day, he spit outside his house in Boston, but secretly without his knowledge, some operatives took a sample from that spit and subjected it to a DNA test.

text: Ini nga sample ang nagsanto gid sa DNA nga didto naman nakuha sa kuko sang biktima, kag nag-match man sa duguon nga sweatshirt kag sa upos sang sigarilyo sa banyo.
english: This sample matched the DNA obtained from the victim's nail, and also matched the bloody sweatshirt and cigarette butt in the bathroom.

text: Sang September 19, gindakop si James, ginpatigayon ang hearing, ginkasuhan ini sang first-degree murder, kag gin-detain nga wala sang piyansa.
english: On September 19, James was arrested, a hearing was held, he was charged with first-degree murder, and held without bail.

text: Naka-schedule ang masunod nga hearing sa korte sa October 29, 2024.
english: The next court hearing is scheduled for October 29, 2024.

text: Kumpyansa ang kampo sang suspek nga subong nagaedad na sang 65-anyos nga indi siya madutlan sa kaso.
english: The camp of the suspect, now 65, is confident that he will not be charged.

text: Ginpabugal naman sang Suffolk County District nga isa ini ka ehemplo sang dalayawon nga investigative work sang detectives kag prosecutors gamit ang modern criminology science.
english: The Suffolk County District said it was an example of the admirable investigative work of detectives and prosecutors using modern criminology science.

text: Labaw sa tanan suno sa district, isa ini ka oportunidad para sa mga himata sang biktima nga makit-an nila nga may manabat sa krimen kag mahatag na gid man ang hustisya apisar malapit apat ka dekada na ang nagligad.#
english: Above all, the district said, this is an opportunity for the victim's relatives to see someone held accountable for the crime and justice will be done despite the fact that nearly four decades have passed.

text: Ginkumpirma ni Atty. Camille Sue Mae Ting, spokesperson sang Supreme Court, nga wala pa sang clearance si Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla halin sa Ombudsman.
english: It was confirmed by Atty. Camille Sue Mae Ting, spokesperson of the Supreme Court, said Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla has not yet received clearance from the Ombudsman.

text: Isa ini ka mandatory requirement agud maka-secure sang Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) nomination para makapungko sa Office of the Ombudsman.
english: It is a mandatory requirement to secure a Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) nomination to sit in the Office of the Ombudsman.

text: Magluwas kay Remulla, wala man sang clearance si PCSO Chairperson Felix Reyes.
english: Besides Remulla, PCSO Chairperson Felix Reyes also did not have clearance.

text: Sa clearance nga ini gina-certify nga wala sang pending cases ang aplikante para sa pagka-Ombudsman.
english: This clearance certifies that the applicant has no pending cases for the position of Ombudsman.

text: Base sa pagsulundan sang JBC, disqualified nga i-nominate para sa Ombudsman ukon Deputy Ombudsman ang mga indibidwal nga may “pending criminal or regular administrative cases”.
english: According to the JBC rules, individuals with “pending criminal or regular administrative cases” are disqualified from being nominated for Ombudsman or Deputy Ombudsman.

text: Madumduman nga may ginpasaka si Senator Imee Marcos nga kaso batok kay Remulla sa Office of the Ombudsman kaangot sa isyu sa pagdakop kay former President Rodrigo Duterte kag pagdala sa iya sa International Criminal Court (ICC) sa The Hague.
english: Senator Imee Marcos has filed a case against Remulla with the Office of the Ombudsman over the issue of former President Rodrigo Duterte's arrest and extradition to the International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague.

text: Apisar kulang sa clearance, gintugutan sila nga magsabak sa public interview sa Korte Suprema kahapon, Septyembre 2.#
english: Despite lacking clearance, they were allowed to appear in a public interview at the Supreme Court yesterday, September 2.#

text: Ginpili sang pambato sang Pilipinas sa Tokyo Olympics nga si Yuka Saso ang Japanese citizenship.
english: Philippine Tokyo Olympics champion Yuka Saso chose Japanese citizenship.

text: Suno sa 20 anyos nga Pinay Olympian, mas ginpili niya ang Japan bangud sa nationality law sini.
english: According to the 20-year-old Filipino Olympian, she preferred Japan because of its nationality law.

text: Sa idalom sang Japanese nationality law, kinahanglan nga magpili ang indibidwal nga may dual citizenship kun ano ang iya mangin nationality sa tion nga mag-edad na ini sang 22.
english: Under Japanese nationality law, individuals with dual citizenship must choose their nationality when they turn 22.

text: Matandaan nga ang iloy ni Saso ang isa ka Filipina kag Japanese national naman ang iya amay.
english: Saso's mother is a Filipina and his father is a Japanese national.

text: Nangin tiglawas pa sang Pilipinas si Saso humalin sang nag-umpisa ini sa pag-intra sa mga kompetisyon sa iban nga pugsod bilang junior golfer, bilang isa ka amateur, kabahin man siya sa Asian Games sa Jakarta sang 2018 kag sa 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
english: Saso has represented the Philippines since he started participating in international competitions as a junior golfer, as an amateur, he also participated in the Asian Games in Jakarta in 2018 and the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.

text: Si Saso man ang nagdaog sa 2021 US Women’s Open kag ika-anom sa bilog nga kalibotan matapos ang iya paghampang sa Founders’ Cup sa New Jersey sa diin nakuha niya ang fourth place.
english: Saso also won the 2021 US Women’s Open and was ranked sixth in the world after playing at the Founders’ Cup in New Jersey where she took fourth place.

english: He also warned civilians to evacuate and stay away from areas where the militant group is positioned.

text: We’re eliminating seniors, eliminating commanders, eliminating rockets – and counting.

english: Those who will try to hurt us, we will hurt him gravely,” according to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

english: The health ministry has advised hospitals in the south and east to suspend non-essential surgeries and focus on those injured in the airstrikes.
