text: Nagapakitluoy ang pinakadako nga business group sa Pilipinas saCOVID-19 Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases (IATF) nga untatan na ang pagpatuman sang lockdown.
english: The largest business group in the Philippines is pleading with the COVID-19 Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases (IATF) to stop implementing the lockdown.

text: Nagalaum si Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PCCI) acting president Edgardo Lacson nga mas mapadasig pa sang IATF ang vaccination program agud nga malab-ot ang herd immunity.
english: Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PCCI) acting president Edgardo Lacson hopes that the IATF will accelerate the vaccination program to achieve herd immunity.

text: Apang kun mapaslawan man ang IATF nga ma-meet ang target dates tungod sa mga indi kontrolado nga hitabo, nagaapelar ang PCCI kay Sec.
english: However, if the IATF fails to meet the target dates due to uncontrollable events, the PCCI appeals to Sec.

text: Carlito Galvez Jr.
english: Carlito Galvez Jr.

text: nga kakason na ang lockdown nga ginalantaw sang gobyerno nga isa sa mga pamaagi nga marespondehan ang pandemya.
english: that the government will lift the lockdown as one of the ways to respond to the pandemic.

text: Dugang pa sang business group, nagatuga sang kapigaduhon, kagutom kag pagsaka pa sang unemployment ang lockdown nga nangin resulta sang pag-agunto sang mga tawo, pagpakitluoy, pagpangutang kag paghulat sang ayuda.
english: The business group added that the lockdown is causing poverty, hunger and an increase in unemployment as a result of people's suffering, pleading, borrowing and waiting for aid.

text: Ginhingyo ni Senator Bam Aquino nga ibalik sa executive ang proposed P881 billion budget sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) para sa masunod nga tuig.
english: Senator Bam Aquino has asked the executive to return the proposed P881 billion budget of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) for next year.

text: Ini matapos nakit-an ang madamo nga “red flags” ukon kwestyonable nga items.
english: This is after many “red flags” or questionable items were found.

text: Lakip sa red flags amo ang ginmuno ni Senator Panfilo Lacson nga halin sa Metro Manila pakadto sa Central Luzon, may 500 items na nga may palareho nga amount nga P75 million, P100 million, P120 million, kag P150 million kada isa sa DPWH proposed budget.
english: Among the red flags is that Senator Panfilo Lacson said that from Metro Manila to Central Luzon, there are 500 items with the same amount of P75 million, P100 million, P120 million, and P150 million each in the DPWH proposed budget.

text: “I’d like to propose [that] we should schedule an executive session.
english: “I’d like to propose [that] we should schedule an executive session.

text: Way forward po ito kasi with your guidance we are willing [to] amend and delete all these similarly costed projects, but we want to know ano ang direksyon ng national government [at] saan namin dadalhin,” suno kay Lacson.
english: It's not forward because with your guidance we are willing [to] amend and delete all these similarly costed projects, but we want to know what the direction of the national government [and] where we will take it,” Lacson said.

text: Sa ginpresentar naman ni Senator Sherwin Gatchalian, may mga proyekto nga wala sang station number; may duplicated projects sa kabug-usan nga budget; may mga proyekto nga “divided into phases” nga may pareho nga amounts; kag may projects nga nagagamit sang termino nga “with packages” nga ara sa pareho nga area.
english: In the presentation of Senator Sherwin Gatchalian, there are projects that do not have station numbers; there are duplicated projects in the overall budget; there are projects “divided into phases” with equal amounts; and there are projects that use the term “with packages” that are in the same area.

text:
May mga proyekto nga may pareho nga round number sang amounts; may projects nga may specific code names samtang may iban naman nga inconsistent ang label; samtang may ara man nga nagtuhaw na sa 2025 General Appropriations Act apang ara pa gid sa 2026 National Expenditure Program

“Let’s refuse to accept this DPWH budget.
english:
Some projects have the same round number of amounts; some projects have specific code names while others have inconsistent labels; while there are those that have already appeared in the 2025 General Appropriations Act but are still in the 2026 National Expenditure Program

“Let’s refuse to accept this DPWH budget.

text: There is an ongoing investigation; inaaral ang mga proyektong ito.
english: There is an ongoing investigation; these projects are being studied.

text: There are so many questions, there [are] so many red flags that you have already pointed out, so wag po nating tanggapin ito.
english: There are so many questions, there [are] so many red flags that you have already pointed out, so let's not accept it.

text: Ibalik natin ito sa executive, you have four months to give it back to us na maayos na, wala nang ghost project, wala nang flood control sa mga lugar na wala namang flooding,” suno kay Aquino.
english: Let's give it back to the executive, you have four months to give it back to us that it's fine, no more ghost projects, no more flood control in areas that are not flooding,” Aquino said.

text: Dugang niya: “Sabi nga po ni Presidente, mahiya naman kayo.
english: He added: “The President said, you are ashamed.

text:
Let’s come up with a DPWH budget–a real flood control budget na maipagmamalaki natin at hindi natin ikahihiya at wala na po dapat red flag.”

Nagsabat naman si Budget Secretary Amenah Pangandaman nga indi ini mahimo mapasugtan sa budget process matapos nga napasa na ang expenditure plan sa Kongreso.
english:
Let’s come up with a DPWH budget–a real flood control budget that we can be proud of and not be ashamed of and there should be no red flag.”

Budget Secretary Amenah Pangandaman replied that it cannot be allowed in the budget process after the expenditure plan has been submitted to Congress.

text: “So that’s why the budget process is that the executive proposes and the legislative can amend,” suno sa tiglikom.
english: “So that’s why the budget process is that the executive proposes and the legislative can amend,” according to the secretary.

text: Apang dugang sini, nagapakig-angot na siya kay DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon para repasuhon ang mga programa sang ahensya kag kakason ang indi naman kinahanglanon.#
english: However, he added that he is already in contact with DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon to review the agency's programs and remove unnecessary ones.

text: Wala na nakalab-ot pa sa adlaw sang iya kasal ang isa ka groom matapos ini nga gintiro matapos ang iya nga bachelor’s party sa Laoag City, Ilocos Norte.
english: A groom did not make it to his wedding day after he was shot after his bachelor's party in Laoag City, Ilocos Norte.

text: Ang biktima amo si Andres Dacquioag, 59-anyos, nga nag-angkon sang igo sang bala sa ulo kag likod.
english: The victim was identified as Andres Dacquioag, 59, who sustained gunshot wounds in the head and back.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, yara sa gwa sang isa ka convenience store ang biktima kaupod ang iya nobya sang ginluthang ini.
english: According to the investigation, the victim was outside a convenience store with his girlfriend when he was shot.

text: Gindala pa siya sa ospital apang ginbawian gid sang kabuhi.
english: He was rushed to the hospital but died on the spot.

text: Natalana kuntani ang ila kasal sang iya live-in partner subong nga adlaw.
english: His live-in partner was scheduled to get married today.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon para matumod ang tawo nga responsable sa krimen kag kun ano ang motibo sa pagpangluthang.
english: Investigation is ongoing to identify the person responsible for the crime and the motive of the shooting.

text: Makatilingalahan nga nakaluwas ang isa ka lalaki matapos duha ka beses nga ginlapak sang tren.
english: Amazingly, a man survived after being run over twice by a train.

text: Natabo ini sa Brgy.
english: This happened in Brgy.

text: EMs Barrio 1, Legazpi City, Albay.
english: EMs Barrio 1, Legazpi City, Albay.

text: Ang biktima amo si Jack, 59-anyos, may asawa, residente sang amo nga lugar.
english: The victim was identified as Jack, 59, married, resident of the same area.

text: Suno sa iya asawa, samtang yara sa kilid sang riles sang tren ang biktima sang malapakana ang too nga tiil sini sang tren nga halin sa Naga City, Camarines Sur kag padulong sa Legazpi City PNR Terminal.
english: According to his wife, the victim was on the side of the train tracks when his right leg was hit by a train from Naga City, Camarines Sur to the Legazpi City PNR Terminal.

text: Duguon nga gindala sa ospital ang biktima apang bangud sa iya malala nga pilas, natalana nga utdon ang iya bilog ng batiis.
english: The victim was rushed to the hospital but due to his serious injuries, his entire leg was scheduled to be amputated.

text: Pahayag pa sang misis, sang Oktubre 2024, nautod man ang isa ka tudlo sini sa kamot matapos nga nalapakan man sang tren.
english: The wife said that in October 2024, she also lost a finger after being trampled by a train.

text: Nagrekord sang kasaysayan ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte matapos nagpangayo sang P5.024 trillion nga budget para sa tuig 2022.
english: President Rodrigo Duterte made history after requesting a P5.024 trillion budget for 2022.

text: Suno kay Presidential Spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque, ang nasambit nga budget ang ‘largest in history’ sa Pilipinas.
english: According to Presidential Spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque, the said budget is the 'largest in history' in the Philippines.

text: Ginpahayag ni Roque nga ang nasambit nga budget ang gamiton para sa pagbuhi liwat sang ekonomiya matapos naapektuhan sang COVID-19 pandemic, pagtapna sang mas makalalaton nga coronavirus variants, paghatag sang trabaho kag pagpatukod sang dugang nga mga infrastructure.
english: Roque said the budget will be used to revive the economy after being affected by the COVID-19 pandemic, prevent more contagious coronavirus variants, create jobs and build additional infrastructure.

text: Ang propose nga 2022 budget ang mas mataas sang 11.5% kun ipaanggid sa 2021 allotment.
english: The proposed 2022 budget is 11.5% higher than the 2021 allotment.

text: Ang social services sector, nga ginalakipan sang COVID-19 vaccine procurement kag universal healthcare, ang makabaton sang pinakadako nga allocation nga may P1.92 trillion kag ginasundan sang P1.47 trillion para sa economic service sector nga ginalakipan sang key infrastructure projects.
english: The social services sector, which includes COVID-19 vaccine procurement and universal healthcare, will receive the largest allocation with P1.92 trillion followed by P1.47 trillion for the economic service sector which includes key infrastructure projects.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini na ang pinakaulihi nga budget ni Duterte sa diin matapos na ang iya six-year term sa Hunyo 2022.
english: It is known that this is the latest budget of Duterte whose six-year term ends in June 2022.

text: Magluwas sa ginasinggitan nga hustisya, nagapangayo man sang bulig ang pamilya sang soltero nga nasapwan nga patay sa Aglalana, Passi City.
english: Besides crying for justice, the family of the young man who was found dead in Aglalana, Passi City is also asking for help.

text: Ang biktima amo si certain Roland, 23-anyos, residente Barangay Danao, Janiuay, Iloilo.
english: The victim was identified as certain Roland, 23, resident of Barangay Danao, Janiuay, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Vanesa Cataluna, magulang sang biktima, iya ginpahayag nga sa tunga sang ila kalisod, nagaproblema pa gid sila sang kwarta nga gastuhon sa pagproseso sang bangkay sang ya manghod.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Vanesa Cataluna, the victim's elder sister, said that in the midst of their suffering, they are still having trouble with the money to spend on the processing of her brother's body.

text: Suno sa iya, tuman ka-budlay sang ila sitwasyon subong ilabi na nga bag-o lang gin-operahan sa liog ang iya iloy bangud sa balatian samtang ang iya amay naman ang isa ka stroke patient.
english: He said their situation is very difficult now especially since his mother recently underwent neck surgery due to illness while his father is a stroke patient.

text: Nagapangayo gid sila sang bulig.
english: They are really asking for help.

text: Mahimo lang magpakig-angot sa ila sa numero nga 09215826351.
english: They can only be contacted at 09215826351.

text: Nagakahangawa si United Nations (UN) Secretary-General António Guterres nga matabo man sa Lebanon ang sitwasyon sang Gaza nga halos ginpulbos sang Israel bangud sa binulan na nga gyera bilang balos sa militante nga Hamas.
english: United Nations (UN) Secretary-General António Guterres is concerned that the situation in Gaza, which Israel has almost pulverized due to months of war in retaliation for militant Hamas, will also happen in Lebanon.

text: Ini ang pahayag sang UN Chief samtang nagasangkad pa ang away sang Hezbollah batok sa Israel Defense Forces (IDF).
english: The UN chief's statement comes as the fight between Hezbollah and the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) continues.

text: “It is for me clear that both sides are not interested in a ceasefire.
english: “It is for me clear that both sides are not interested in a ceasefire.

text: And that is a tragedy, because this is a war that must stop,” suno kay Guterres.
english: And that is a tragedy, because this is a war that must stop,” Guterres said.

text:
“Neither the government of Israel nor the Hamas really want the ceasefire.”

Pahayag sini, ang pagsinigabong sang communication devices sa Lebanon sang nagligad nga semana ang signos na sang “potential” nga mas daku nga away nga panibag-o na naman nga trahedya sa Middle East.
english:
“Neither the government of Israel nor the Hamas really wants the ceasefire.”

He said the explosion of communication devices in Lebanon last week is a sign of a “potential” larger conflict that is another tragedy in the Middle East.

text: Gindugangan pa ini sang pagpatay sang Israel sa Hezbollah commanders sang nagligad nga adlaw kun sa diiin 45 ang napatay sa isa lang ka aistrike.
english: This was compounded by Israel's killing of Hezbollah commanders the previous day, where 45 were killed in a single aistrike.

text: Sini lang nga weekend, ginpasagunsunan pa ini sang Israel sang 300 strikes bilang preemptive action sa ginaalegar plano sang Hezbollah nga mag-atake.
english: This weekend, Israel launched a series of 300 strikes as a preemptive action against Hezbollah's alleged plans to attack.

text: Sa subong wala pa sang mga Pilipino nga na-report nga nasamaran apang sila ang gina-abisuhan nga magpauli na samtang may yara pa sang commercial flights.
english: So far, no Filipinos have been reported injured but they are advised to return home while there are still commercial flights.

text: Yara na sa final stages sang preparasyon ang national team sa Men’s Under-23 para sa AFC U23 Asian Cup 2022 qualifiers nga natalana sa Oktubre 25 tubtob 31 sa Singapore.
english: The national team is in the final stages of preparation in the Men’s Under-23 for the AFC U23 Asian Cup 2022 qualifiers scheduled for October 25 to 31 in Singapore.

text: Ang Pilipinas ang nalakip sa Group H sa diin maatubang sini ang mga defending champions sang Korea Republic, Singapore, kag Timor-Leste sa Jalan Besar Stadium.
english: The Philippines are in Group H where they will face defending champions Korea Republic, Singapore, and Timor-Leste at Jalan Besar Stadium.

text: Ang midfielders nga sanday Oliver Bias at Mark Winhoffer, goalkeeper Quincy Kammeraad, kag defender Justin Baas ang una na nga nangin kabahin sang senior Men’s National Team lineup sang Preliminary Joint Qualifiers Round 2 nga ginhiwat sang Hunyo 2021 sa Sharjah, United Arab Emirates.
english: Midfielders Oliver Bias and Mark Winhoffer, goalkeeper Quincy Kammeraad, and defender Justin Baas were previously part of the senior Men’s National Team lineup of the Preliminary Joint Qualifiers Round 2 held in June 2021 in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates.

text: Sa subong, ang team ang yara sa Doha, Qatar para sa final stages sang training camp.
english: The team is currently in Doha, Qatar for the final stages of the training camp.

text: I-duso ni Albay Representative Joey Salceda ang 10% nga pagpataas sang budget sa agrikultura sa 2022 General Appropriations Act.
english: Albay Representative Joey Salceda will propose a 10% increase in the agriculture budget in the 2022 General Appropriations Act.

text: Nakig-angot na si Salceda kay Department of Agriculture (DA) Secretary William Dar sa posible nga pagpataas sang pondo agud nga mabuligan ang sektor sang agrikultura nga maka-recover.
english: Salceda has already contacted Department of Agriculture (DA) Secretary William Dar on the possible increase in funds to help the agricultural sector recover.

text: Suno kay Salceda, kun mahimo lang kuntani nga mapahalogan ang pila ka mga restrictions nga ginapatuman, dako ang posibilidad nga mapasangkad ang sektor.
english: According to Salceda, if some of the restrictions imposed could be eased, there is a great possibility to expand the sector.

text: Sa idalom sang 2021 national budget, ang agriculture sector ang ginpainan sang P71 billion.
english: Under the 2021 national budget, the agriculture sector was allocated P71 billion.

text: Ginbuyagyag ni anay Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Secretary Manuel Bonoan nga may natukiban sila nga 15 “non-existent” projects ukon wala gid naka-eksister nga proyekto.
english: Former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Secretary Manuel Bonoan revealed that they have discovered 15 “non-existent” projects.

text: Ini ang nagguwa sa masobra ka 1,600 ka public works projects nga ila gin-validate.
english: This came out of more than 1,600 public works projects they validated.

text: Kadam-an sini ang yara sa 1st District sa Bulacan kag may yara man sa Regions 1, 2, kag 3.
english: Most of them are in the 1st District in Bulacan and there are also in Regions 1, 2, and 3.

text: “If you recall, we submitted to the president the report of completed projects from July 2022 to May 2025 of about 9,855 projects and many of these have already been validated in specific areas.
english: “If you recall, we submitted to the president the report of completed projects from July 2022 to May 2025 of about 9,855 projects and many of these have already been validated in specific areas.

text: And I think, the reports have already been completed and we will be turning over this to Secretary Vince,” suno kay Bonoan.
english: And I think, the reports have already been completed and we will be turning over this to Secretary Vince,” according to Bonoan.

text: “As I can recall, I think ang nakita doon, there are actually 15… ’non-existent’ hindi pa naman ‘ghost’, this still going to be validated.
english: “As I can recall, I think what was seen there, there are actually 15... 'non-existent' is not yet 'ghost', this is still going to be validated.

text: Fifteen out of 1,600 projects sites that have been validated,” pahayag sini.
english: Fifteen out of 1,600 projects sites that have been validated,” it said.

text: Indi ini ghost projects bangud ang ghost projects suno sa anay tiglikom amo ang gin-report nga ‘completed’ na apang kun lantawon sa aktwal nga lokasyon wala man sang napatindog nga imprastraktura.
english: These are not ghost projects because the ghost projects according to the former secretary are those that are reported to be 'completed' but if you look at the actual location there is no infrastructure built.

text: May 160 ukon masobra pa nga nga mga lokasyon nga padayon nga gina-validate.
english: There are 160 or more locations that are still being validated.

text: Target naman ni DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon nga matapos ang pagbalasa sini ukon reorganisasyon sa ahensya sa sulod sang duha ka bulan.
english: DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon targets to complete the reorganization of the agency within two months.

text: Sunod ini suno sa iya sang mando sang president nga manglimpyo kag kay-uhon gid ang guba sa DPWH.#
english: He said this is in line with the president's order to clean up and repair the damage in the DPWH.

text: Napilian nga maghampang sa Taiwan si Gilas Pilipinas player Jordan Heading.
english: Gilas Pilipinas player Jordan Heading has been selected to play in Taiwan.

text: Gin-anunsyar mismo sang T1 League sang Taiwan nga napili sang team Taichun Suns ang nasambit nga basketball player.
english: Taiwan's T1 League itself announced that the team Taichun Suns had selected the basketball player.

text: Ginakabig ni Heading nga “homecoming” ini para sa iya bangud naka-eskwela siya sadto sa Taichung Morrison American School antes nag-istar sa Estados Unidos.
english: Heading considers it “homecoming” for her as she previously attended Taichung Morrison American School before settling in the United States.

text: Una nga naghampang ang Filipino-Australian guard sa Gilas Pilipinas sang Hunyo sa Fiba Asia Cup qualifiers.
english: The Filipino-Australian guard first played for Gilas Pilipinas in June in the Fiba Asia Cup qualifiers.

text: Kalakip man siya sa national team sang Olympic Qualifying Tournament sa Serbia.
english: He was also a member of the national team of the Olympic Qualifying Tournament in Serbia.

text: Siya mana ng una nga overall pick sang Terrafirma sa 2020 PBA Draft.
english: He was the first overall pick of Terrafirma in the 2020 PBA Draft.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Heading ang ika-tatlo na nga Filipino nga magahampang sa T1 League kasunod nanday Brickman at Caelan Tiongson.
english: Heading is the third Filipino to play in the T1 League after Brickman and Caelan Tiongson.

text: Ginapreprar na sang mga otoridad ang kaso batok sa construction worker nga nagbuno-patay sa isa ka pulis sa Barangay Pakiad, Oton, Iloilo.
english: Authorities are preparing a case against the construction worker who stabbed to death a policeman in Barangay Pakiad, Oton, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Police Staff Sergeant Erwin Calubayan, sang Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) Iloilo kag residente sang Barangay Balabag, Dumangas, Iloilo.
english: The victim was identified as Police Staff Sergeant Erwin Calubayan, of the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) Iloilo and resident of Barangay Balabag, Dumangas, Iloilo.

text: Ang suspek naman amo si, alyas Dan, 40, construction worker kag residente sang Barangay Siniba-an, Dingle Iloilo.
english: The suspect was identified as Dan, 40, construction worker and resident of Barangay Siniba-an, Dingle Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Patrolman Fritz Desbaro, imbestigador sang Oton Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga kaso nga murder ang ila ipasaka sa suspek.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Patrolman Fritz Desbaro, investigator of the Oton Municipal Police Station, said they will file a murder case against the suspect.

text: Ini bangud patalikod ang pagbuno sini sa biktima kag ginplanuhan pa.
english: This is because he stabbed the victim from behind and was planned.

text: Nag-angkon naman ang biktima sang pilas sa tu-o nga porsyon sang iya tiyan kag gilayon nga gindala sa ospital apang ginbawian sang kabuhi.
english: The victim sustained injuries to his right abdomen and was rushed to the hospital but died on the spot.

text: Samtang, natiruhan naman sang biktima ang suspek sa diin naka-hospital arrest ini subong.
english: Meanwhile, the victim stabbed the suspect who is currently under hospital arrest.

text: Selos naman ang ginalantaw nga nga motibo sa krimen bangud nagwa sa imbestigasyon nga lunsay nagapangaluyag ang biktima kag suspek sa isa lang ka babaye.
english: Jealousy is believed to be the motive of the crime as the investigation revealed that the victim and the suspect were both in love with the same woman.

text: ILOILO CITY – Kinahanglan nga mapadayon ang pagtib-ong sang Original Pilipino Music bilang tanda sang kultura sang mga Filipino.
english: ILOILO CITY – The promotion of Original Filipino Music as a symbol of Filipino culture must continue.

text: Ini ang panugyan sang 12 ka finalist sa The 3rd National Bombo Music Festival sa mga aspiring composer kag singer nga nagaduha-duha nga ipakita ang ila talento sa patag sang musika.
english: This is the advice of the 12 finalists of The 3rd National Bombo Music Festival to aspiring composers and singers who are hesitant to showcase their talent in the field of music.

text: Sa Good Morning Philippines Program, ginpahayag ni Glenn Bawa, composer kag interpreter sang ambahanon nga Sabi Ko Naman Sa’yo, nga sa tagsa ka kompetisyon, may yara gid sang nagadaug kag may yara man sang napaslawan.
english: On the Good Morning Philippines Program, Glenn Bawa, composer and interpreter of the song Sabi Ko Naman Sa’yo, said that in every competition, there are winners and losers.

text: Suno kay Bawa, indi importante ang premyo nga makuha kundi ang dungog bilang isa sa mga music contributor sa pungsod.
english: According to Bawa, the prize is not important but the prestige as one of the music contributors in the country.

text: Ginpahayag ni Bawa nga indi dapat pag-ikahuya ang talento ilabi na kun ini ang para sa kaayuhan.
english: Bawa said talent should not be embarrassed especially if it is for the good.

text: Para naman sa manunudlo nga si Ramie Capuyan, isa sa mga composer sang ambahanon nga Break, iya gid nga gina-engganyo ang mga estudyante nga pasangkaron ang talento sa pagbalay sang ambahanon.
english: For teacher Ramie Capuyan, one of the composers of the song Break, he encourages the students to develop their talent in composing songs.

text: Suno kay Capuyan, kinahanglan nga mas pasangkaron sang mga ulihing tubo ang ila tagsa ka abilidad agud nga indi madula ang Original Pilipino Music.
english: According to Capuyan, the younger generation needs to develop their skills so that the Original Pilipino Music will not be lost.

text: Bilang isa sa mga finalist sa Bombo Music Festival, ginpahayag sang natungdan nga bugal para sa iya nga isa ang ambahanon nga Break sa mga ginpili-an sang hangkilan nga music artists sa pungsod.
english: As one of the finalists in the Bombo Music Festival, he said he is proud that the song Break is one of the choices of the best music artists in the country.

text: Samtang, para naman kay Ernie John Colores sang San Pablo City kag Musical Arranger sang ambahanon nga Sabi ko Naman Sa’yo, paagi sa Bombo Music Festival, iya nabinag-binag nga indi lamang ang mga composer kag performer ang may daku nga papel.
english: Meanwhile, for Ernie John Colores of San Pablo City and Musical Arranger of the song Sabi ko Naman Sa’yo, through the Bombo Music Festival, he considered that not only composers and performers have a big role.

text: Suno kay Colores, indi mangin madinalag-on ang isa ka ambahanon kun wala ang musical arranger nga amo ang nakatuka kun ano ang mangin plastada sang musika.
english: According to Colores, a song cannot be successful without the musical arranger who decides what the music will be.

text: May kaangtanan naman sa ginpatigayon nga Bombo Music Festival, ginpahayag sang natungdan nga daku ang iya pagpasalamat sa kahigayunan nga iya napakita kun ano man ang iya natun-an sa patag sang musika.
english: Regarding the Bombo Music Festival, he said he is very grateful for the opportunity to show what he has learned in the field of music.

text: Indi na magpadalagan liwat si anay United States President Donald Trump sa 2028 presidential election pananglitan malutos siya sa piniliay sa Nobyembre subong nga tuig.
english: Former US President Donald Trump will not run again in the 2028 presidential election if he loses the election in November this year.

text: Ini ang latest nga statement sang 78-anyos nga Republican leader matapos ginpamangkot sa US news program nga “Full Measure”: “No, I don’t. I think that that will be, that will be it.
english: This is the latest statement of the 78-year-old Republican leader after being asked on the US news program “Full Measure”: “No, I don’t. I think that that will be, that will be it.

text:
I don’t see that at all.”

Sa pihak sini, nagpahayag man ang Republican leader nga nagalaum siya nga mangin madinalag-on siya sa balota sa binotohay sa November 5.
english:
I don’t see that at all.”

Meanwhile, the Republican leader also said he hopes to be successful on the November 5 ballot.

text: Halos patas subong si Trump kag ang Democratic candidate nga si Vice President Kamala Harris lakip na sa key battleground states nga amo ang ginabantayan nga makatumod sang winners sa elections.
english: Trump and Democratic candidate Vice President Kamala Harris are now almost tied in key battleground states that are expected to determine winners in the elections.

text: Nagsaka ang suporta sa Democrats matapos nag-withdraw sa eleksyon si 81-anyos nga si President Joe Biden sang Hulyo kasunod sang iya tuman ka pigado nga debate performance batok kay Trump.
english: Support for Democrats soared after 81-year-old President Joe Biden withdrew from the election in July following his very poor debate performance against Trump.

text: Samtang sinemana na lang ang nabilin antes ang Nobyembre 5, nagpasugot pa si Harris sa ikaduha nga presidential debate batok kay Trump sa CNN, apang nangindi na ang Republican bangud atrasado na suno sa iya.
english: With only a week left before November 5, Harris agreed to a second presidential debate against Trump on CNN, but the Republican refused because he said it was too late.

text: Gintumod sini ang pagsugod na sang in-person voting sa Minnesota, Virginia kag South Dakota kag may pila na ka postal ballots nga napadala antes sini.#
english: He pointed to the start of in-person voting in Minnesota, Virginia and South Dakota and several postal ballots have already been sent before that.

text: Nakit-an na sang Bureau of Customs ang 12 tanan ka mga luxury vehicles nga nakalista sa search warrant sa St.
english: The Bureau of Customs has already found 12 luxury vehicles listed in the search warrant in St.

text: Gerard construction company sa syudad ng Pasig.
english: Gerard construction company in Pasig City.

text: Suno kay Customs Commissioner Ariel Nepomuceno, kagab-i gin-surrender sang pamilya Discaya ang mga salakyan kag sa subong yara na ini naka-park sa compound sang St.
english: According to Customs Commissioner Ariel Nepomuceno, the Discaya family surrendered the vehicles last night and they are now parked in the compound of St.

text: Gerard Construction General Contractor and Development Corporation.
english: Gerard Construction General Contractor and Development Corporation.

text: Ang mga salakyan ang ginalakipan sang Rolls Royce Cullinan 2023, Bentley Bentayga, Mercedes Benz G-Class (Brabus G-Wagon), Mercedes AMG G 63 SUV 2022, Toyota Tundra 2022, Toyota Sequoia, kag Cadillac Escalade ESV 2021.
english: The vehicles include the 2023 Rolls Royce Cullinan, Bentley Bentayga, Mercedes Benz G-Class (Brabus G-Wagon), Mercedes AMG G 63 SUV 2022, Toyota Tundra 2022, Toyota Sequoia, and Cadillac Escalade ESV 2021.

text: Samtang ang tatlo ka mga salakyan nga Mercedes Benz G 500 SUV 2019, GMC Yukon Denali SUV 2022 (Gas), kag Lincoln Navigator L 2024 ang yara sa authorized service centers bangud ginpakay-o ang mga ini.
english: Meanwhile, the three vehicles Mercedes Benz G 500 SUV 2019, GMC Yukon Denali SUV 2022 (Gas), and Lincoln Navigator L 2024 are at authorized service centers as they were repaired.

text: Suno kay Nepomuceno, tanan nga mga salakyan ang ginselyuhan kag ginabantayan ba sang mga katapo sang Bureau of Customs samtang gina-tsekyar naman kun may paglapas ang tag-iya kaangay sang indi pagbayad sang bastante nga mga buwis kag pila ka mga dokumento sa mga imported nga mga luxury cars.
english: According to Nepomuceno, all vehicles are sealed and monitored by members of the Bureau of Customs while the owner is being checked for violations such as non-payment of sufficient taxes and certain documents on the imported luxury cars.

text: Nag-advance na sa three apparatus finals si Carlos Yulo lakip na sa floor exercise kun sa diin iya ginadepensahan ang titulo sa 50th FIG Artistic Gymnastics World Championships sa Kitakyushu, Japan.
english: Carlos Yulo has advanced to three apparatus finals including the floor exercise where he is defending his title at the 50th FIG Artistic Gymnastics World Championships in Kitakyushu, Japan.

text: Una nga nag-perform si Yulo sa vault qualifications kag nangin third placer nga may score nga 14.808.
english: Yulo performed first in the vault qualifications and was the third placer with a score of 14.808.

text: Samtang nagpanguna naman si Yulo sa parallel bars nga nga may score nga 9.166 sa execution kag 6.400 sa degree of difficulty.
english: Meanwhile, Yulo topped the parallel bars with a score of 9.166 in execution and 6.400 in degree of difficulty.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Samurai Correspondent Josel Palma, nangin impressive ang floor exercise ni Yulo nga may 15.166 qualifications.
english: According to Bombo International Samurai Correspondent Josel Palma, Yulo's floor exercise was impressive with 15.166 qualifications.

text: May score siya nga 8.566 sa execution halin sa iya nga 6.600 degree of difficulty routine.
english: He had a score of 8.566 in execution from his 6.600 degree of difficulty routine.

text: Ginpahayag ni Yulo ng indi niya luyag nga magsala sa iya nga hampang sa diin ginatumod sini ang nangin kapaslawan niya sa Tokyo Olympics.
english: Yulo said he did not want to make mistakes in his game, referring to his failure in the Tokyo Olympics.

text: Ang final floor exercise ang patigayunon sa Oktubre 23 samtang ang medal round sa vault kag parallel bars ang patigayunon sa Oktubre 24.
english: The final floor exercise will be held on October 23 while the medal round in vault and parallel bars will be held on October 24.

text: Nagpasalig ang Police Regional Office 6 (PRO-6) nga pagasabton nila ang pagpabulong sang isa ka 18-anyos nga estudyante nga nabungguan sang ambulansya sa bahin sang Dungon B, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: The Police Regional Office 6 (PRO-6) assured that they will take care of the treatment of an 18-year-old student who was hit by an ambulance in Dungon B, Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Ang biktima amo salyas Bebe, 18, estudyante, samtang ang ang driver naman sang nasambit nga ambulansya ang isa ka Police Corporal.
english: The victim was identified as Bebe, 18, a student, while the driver of the ambulance was a Police Corporal.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PLT.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PLT.

text: Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson sang Police Regional Office 6, iya ginpahayag nga halin sa banwa sang Pavia ang nasambit nga ambulansya kag pakadto kuntani sa importante nga transaksyon sang natabo ang insidente.
english: Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office 6, said the ambulance was heading from Pavia town to an important transaction when the incident occurred.

text: Suno kay Solis, samtang nagapadulong ang ambulansya, hinali nga may babayi nga nagtabok sa pedestrian lane, rason nga nadulaan sang control ang driver.
english: According to Solis, while the ambulance was heading, a woman suddenly crossed the pedestrian lane, causing the driver to lose control.

text: Gilayon man nga gindala sa malapit nga ospital ang biktima nga bangud ini ang nakaagum sang head injury tuga sang mabaskog nga impact sa diin guba man ang bumper kag windshield sang amo nga ambulansya.
english: The victim was immediately brought to a nearby hospital where he sustained head injuries due to the strong impact.

text: Ginklaro man sang opisyal nga may kompleto nga dokumento ang driver kag ini ang una nga tion nga na-involve ini sa aksidente.
english: The official also clarified that the driver had complete documents and this was the first time he was involved in an accident.

text: Ginalantaw na karon sang mga otoridad ang mga CCTV footage sa lugar kag padayon ang imbestigasyon, kag ang driver ang yara na sa kustodiya sang Iloilo City Police Station 3.
english: Authorities are now looking at CCTV footage from the scene and the investigation is ongoing, and the driver is now in the custody of Iloilo City Police Station 3.

text: Ginpabutyag man sang PRO-6 ang ila suporta sa pamilya sang biktima kag ginasiguro nga makabaton sang nagakaigo nga bulig.
english: PRO-6 also expressed its support to the victim's family and is ensuring that they receive appropriate assistance.

text: Gin-extend pa sang Department of Agriculture (DA) ang validity sang import clearance bilang sabat sa ginakulang nga mga container van kag port congestion tuga sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) has extended the validity of import clearance in response to the shortage of container vans and port congestion caused by the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Ginmanduan ni DA Secretary William Dar nga palawigon pa ang validity sang sanitary kag phytosanitary permits nga gin-isue sa agriculture importers sa 90 ka adlaw gikan sa 60 ka adlaw.
english: DA Secretary William Dar has ordered the extension of the validity of sanitary and phytosanitary permits issued to agriculture importers to 90 days from 60 days.

text: Magluwas sa karne, ang iban nga mga produkto kaangay sang mga animal feeds kag feed ingredients , animal products and by-products nga ginalakipan sang meat products, eggs, milk, dairy, veterinary drugs, kag biological products ang sakop man sa amo nga mandu.
english: Besides meat, other products such as animal feeds and feed ingredients, animal products and by-products including meat products, eggs, milk, dairy, veterinary drugs, and biological products are also covered by the order.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang arrival sang meat imports sa pungsod ang nagakadelay sa sulod sang duha tubtob tatlo ka bulan gikan sa usual delivery nga isa ka bulan.
english: It is known that the arrival of meat imports in the country is delayed for two to three months from the usual delivery of one month.

text: Ginbaton ni Vice President Kamala Harris ang imbitasyon nga makig-debate liwat kay former President Donald Trump sa Oktubre 23 sinemana ang nabilin antes ang November presidential elections sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Vice President Kamala Harris has accepted an invitation to debate former President Donald Trump again on October 23, a week before the November presidential elections in the United States of America.

text: Suno sa kampo sang bise-presidente, handa si Harris nga atubangon liwat si Trump sa entablado.
english: According to the vice president’s camp, Harris is ready to face Trump on stage again.

text: Iya ini sang CNN network nga kun matabo amo na ang ikaduha nga presidential debate sa tunga sang former president kag current vice president.
english: It belongs to the CNN network that if it happens it will be the second presidential debate between the former president and current vice president.

text: “It would be unprecedented in modern history for there to just be one general election debate,” pahayag sang Harris-Walz campaign chair nga si Jen O’Malley Dillon.
english: “It would be unprecedented in modern history for there to just be one general election debate,” Harris-Walz campaign chair Jen O’Malley Dillon said.

text:
“Debates offer a unique chance for voters to see the candidates side by side and take stock of their competing visions for America.”

Ginpahayag naman sang Republican leader sa rally sa Wilmington, North Carolina nga atrasado na nga magpatigayon pa sang debate bangud nakaumpisa na sa pagboto ang Americans sa 2024 election.
english:
“Debates offer a unique chance for voters to see the candidates side by side and take stock of their competing visions for America.”

The Republican leader said at a rally in Wilmington, North Carolina that it is too late to hold a debate because Americans have already started voting in the 2024 election.

text: Pahayag ni Trump, gusto lamang ni Harris nga mag-rematch sila sa debate bangud nakit-an na sini nga nagakalutos na siya.
english: Trump said Harris only wanted a rematch in the debate because he saw that he was losing.

text: Una nga nagkitaay ang duha sa presidential debate sa Philadelphia sang Septyembre 10 kun sa diin matunog nga ginsinggitan sang Democrats nga nakabawi sila kag nagdaog ang Democratic nominee, apang nagpanindugan naman si Trump nga siya ang mas nangibabaw.
english: The two first met in a presidential debate in Philadelphia on September 10 where Democrats loudly shouted that they had won and the Democratic nominee won, but Trump insisted that he had the upper hand.

text: Nahibalaun nga nagsugod na ang una nga in-person voting sa Minnesota, Virginia kag South Dakota kag may pila na ka postal ballots nga napadala antes sini.
english: The first in-person voting has already begun in Minnesota, Virginia and South Dakota and several postal ballots have already been sent out.

text: Ginaagunto na lang sang pila ka mga negosyante ang ila pagkapiyerde bangud sa pagbalik sang enhanced community quarantine (ECQ) kag epekto sang importasyon sa mga agricultural products.
english: Some traders are just enduring their losses due to the return of enhanced community quarantine (ECQ) and the impact of imports on agricultural products.

text: Suno sa Samahang Industriya ng Agrikultura, madamo nga mga hog producer ang nagsaylo sa pag-import nga mas madasig nga pamaagi agud nga maka-kwarta.
english: According to the Samahang Industriya ng Agrikultura, many hog producers have switched to importing which is a faster way to make money.

text: Pahayag naman sang Department of Agriculture, wala pa nakabawi ang mga tanom nga utan halin sa paglaslas sang bagyo Fabian kag habagat.
english: According to the Department of Agriculture, vegetable crops have not yet recovered from the onslaught of Typhoon Fabian and Habagat.

text: Wala sang ayuda ang ahensya para sa mga napyerde nga negosyo subong nga pandemya apang bakus sa gihapon ang mga loan programs.
english: The agency has no assistance for losing businesses during the pandemic but loan programs are still available.

text: Wala na nakasulod sa Top 10 sang Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP) ranking si Swiss tennis star Roger Federer.
english: Swiss tennis star Roger Federer has dropped out of the Top 10 of the Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP) rankings.

text: Ini bangud wala na nakahampang humalin sang Hulyo ang 40 anyos nga si Federer bangud sa injury matapos ginpyerde siya sa Wimbledon quarterfinals ni Hubert Hurkacz sang Poland .
english: This is because the 40-year-old Federer has not played since July due to injury after he was defeated in the Wimbledon quarterfinals by Hubert Hurkacz of Poland.

text: Nagsaka naman ang pwesto sang bag-o nga Indian Wells champion nga si Cameron Norrie sang Britain nga yara na sa rank 15 matapos ginlutos si Nikoloz Basilashvilli sang Georgia.Nanaog man ang rank ni British tennis player Andy Murray nga sadto yara sa rank 51 apang sa subong, yara na lang siya sa rank 172.
english: New Indian Wells champion Cameron Norrie of Britain rose to rank 15 after beating Nikoloz Basilashvilli of Georgia. British tennis player Andy Murray also dropped from rank 51 to rank 172.

text: Ang nagapanguna sa puwesto amo si Serbian Novak Djokovic nga ginasundan ni Daniil Medvedev sang Russia, Stefanos Tsitsipas sang Greece, Alexander Zverev sang Germany kag Rafael Nadal sang Spain sa ika-lima nga pwesto.
english: Leading the standings is Serbian Novak Djokovic followed by Daniil Medvedev of Russia, Stefanos Tsitsipas of Greece, Alexander Zverev of Germany and Rafael Nadal of Spain in fifth place.

text: Natalana nga ihawon ang 200 ka mga elepante sa Zimbabwe agud mapanagtag ang karne sa ginagutom nga mga residente.
english: As many as 200 Zimbabwean elephants are set to be slaughtered to distribute the meat to starving residents.

text: Ini kasunod sang epekto sang El Niño sa 68-million ka mga tawo sa southern Africa nga rason sang pagkulang sang pagkaon sa rehiyon.
english: This follows the impact of El Niño on 68-million people in southern Africa causing food shortages in the region.

text: Ginkumpirma sang Zimbabwe Parks and Wildlife Authority ang plano sang pungsod kag ginpahayag man nga ginatun-an na subong ang mga plano kun paano ini himuon.
english: The Zimbabwe Parks and Wildlife Authority confirmed the country's plan and said plans are now being studied on how to implement it.

text: Pananglitan matigayon na ini sa Hwange, Mbire, Tsholotsho kag Chiredzi districts, ini ang labing-una nga tion sa sulod sang 1988 nga may mga ihawon nga elepante sa amo nga pungsod.
english: For instance it is now available in Hwange, Mbire, Tsholotsho and Chiredzi districts, this is the first time since 1988 that there have been elephant slaughters in that country.

text: Pareho man ini sa desisyon sang Namibia sang nagligad nga bulan sa 83 ka mga elepante kag ginpang-tagtag man ang karne sa mga tawo nga naapektuhan sang gutom.
english: This is similar to Namibia’s decision last month on 83 elephants and also distributed the meat to people affected by famine.

text: Pareho man ang duha ka nasyon sa Africa nga nagdeklarar sang state of emergency bangud sa drought.
english: Both African countries have declared states of emergency due to drought.

text: Nahibaluan nga masobra 200,000 ang elepante nga nagakabuhi sa conservation area sa lima ka southern African countries – Zimbabwe, Zambia, Botswana, Angola kag Namibia – nga amo ang nagahimo sa rehiyon bilang puluy-an sang isa sa pinakadaku nga elephant populations sa kalibutan.
english: It is known that more than 200,000 elephants live in the conservation area in five southern African countries – Zimbabwe, Zambia, Botswana, Angola and Namibia – which makes the region home to one of the largest elephant populations in the world.

text: Magluwas nga mabulong ang kagutom sang komunidad, kabahin man ini sang lihok agud nga ma-decongest ang ila mga parke nga maka-sustain lamang sang 55,000 elephants.
english: Besides curing the hunger of the community, this is also part of the move to decongest their parks that can only sustain 55,000 elephants.

text: Sa subong, ang Zimbabwe ang may yara sang masobra 84,000 ka mga elepante.
english: Currently, Zimbabwe is home to over 84,000 elephants.

text: Magatutok ang Filipino gymnastics star nga si Carlos Yulo sa tatlo ka events subong nga semana sa 2021 World Artistic Gymnastics Championships sa Kitakyushu, Japan.
english: Filipino gymnastics star Carlos Yulo will focus on three events this week at the 2021 World Artistic Gymnastics Championships in Kitakyushu, Japan.

text: Suno kay Gymnastics Association of the Philippines President Cynthia Carrion, magapasakop si Caloy sa floor, vault, kag parallel bars events.
english: According to Gymnastics Association of the Philippines President Cynthia Carrion, Caloy will compete in the floor, vault, and parallel bars events.

text: Ang 20 anyos nga si Caloy ang defending world champion sa floor exercise, isa ka historic feat nga iya naangkon sa katapusan nga world gymnastics tilt sang 2019.
english: The 20-year-old Caloy is the defending world champion in the floor exercise, a historic feat she achieved at the last world gymnastics tilt in 2019.

text: Sang amo man nga tion, nakahimo si Caloy sang maragtas bilang una nga Pinoy nga nakakuha sang world gymnastics crown.
english: At the same time, Caloy made history as the first Filipino to win the world gymnastics crown.

text: Matandaan nga sa vault apparatus nga category man sang diutayan lang siya nga nakakuha sang medalya sa iya Olympic debut sa Tokyo sang nagligad nga Agusto.
english: It can be recalled that in the vault apparatus category, he almost won a medal in his Olympic debut in Tokyo last August.

text: Suno kay Carrion, target ni Caloy nga maka-gold sa floor exercise, silver sa vault, kag makabot sa final round para sa parallel bars.
english: According to Carrion, Caloy's target is to win gold in the floor exercise, silver in the vault, and reach the final round for the parallel bars.

text: Wala na naglab-ot sa ospital ang isa ka dalagita samtang pilason naman ang iya amay kag iloy matapos ginpalibutan kag ginkagat sang mga buyog sa bukid sa Brgy.
english: A girl did not reach the hospital while her father and mother were injured after being surrounded and bitten by bees in the mountains in Brgy.

text: Fatima, New Bataan, Davao de Oro.
english: Fatima, New Bataan, Davao de Oro.

text: Ang napatay nga biktima amo si alyas Monica Cañas, residente sa nasambit nga lugar.
english: The deceased victim was identified as Monica Cañas, resident of the said area.

text: Kaupod sang biktima ang iya nga ginikanan sa bukid sang hinali lang sila gin-atake sang mga buyog.
english: The victim was with his parents in the mountains when they were suddenly attacked by bees.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa ka PWD si Monica kag masami ini nga ginaupod sa bukid sang iya ginikanan.
english: Monica is a PWD and is often accompanied by her parents to the mountains.

text: Kumpiyansa ang Malacañang nga mabalik ang ekonomiya sang pungsod matapos ang duha ka semana nga lockdown sa Metro Manila.
english: Malacañang is confident that the country's economy will recover after the two-week lockdown in Metro Manila.

text: Ini ang kasunod sang 11.8% nga Gross Domestic Product (GDP) sang pungsod sa second quarter sang tuig sa pihak sang pandemya.
english: This follows the country's 11.8% Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth in the second quarter of the year despite the pandemic.

text: Suno kay Presidential Spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque, ginakalipay niya nga nakaangkon sang mataas nga GDP ang pungsod sa diin buot silingon amat-amat na nga nagabangon ang ekonomiya.
english: According to Presidential Spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque, he is pleased that the country has achieved a high GDP which means that the economy is slowly recovering.

text: Gani subong nagalaum si Roque nga makabawi pa ang ekonomiya sa last quarter sang tuig.
english: So now Roque hopes that the economy will recover in the last quarter of the year.

text: ILOILO CITY-Desisyunan pa sang Iloilo City Council ang pagpatuman sang signal shutdown bilang paghatag seguridad sa publiko sa patigayunon nga Dinagyang Festival 2020.
english: ILOILO CITY-The Iloilo City Council will decide on the implementation of a signal shutdown to ensure public safety during the upcoming Dinagyang Festival 2020.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo City Councilor Jojo Javellana, chairman sang committee on Peace and Order sa konseho, iya ginpahayag nga  istoryahan pa nila kun magapatuman sang signal interruption sa Enero 25 kadungan sang Dagyang sa Calle Real kag Enero 26 kadungan sang Dinagyang 360 degrees umpisa alas sais sa aga tubtob alas dos sa hapon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo City Councilor Jojo Javellana, chairman of the committee on Peace and Order in the council, said they will discuss whether to implement signal interruption on January 25 during the Dagyang in Calle Real and January 26 during the Dinagyang from 36:00 am to 2:00 pm.

text: Suno kay Javellana, may ginpasa sa City Council si Pol.
english: According to Javellana, Pol.

text: Col.
english: Col.

text: Martin Defensor Jr., director sang Iloilo CIty Police office nga naga-request sang signal shutdown kadungan sang dalagko nga kahiwatan sa Enero 25 kag  26.
english: Martin Defensor Jr., director of the Iloilo City Police office who requests a signal shutdown during major events on January 25 and 26.

text: Apang suno kay Javellana, mas maayo nga sa Enero 26 na lang ipatuman ang signal shutdown bangud nga kalabanan sa magatambong sa Dinagyang 360 degrees ang mga dalagko nga personalidad kag mga Very Important Persons.
english: However, Javellana said it is better to implement the signal shutdown on January 26 because most of those who will attend the Dinagyang 360 degrees are big personalities and Very Important Persons.

text: Dugang pa ni Javellana, sa Huwebes, Enero 9 pa patigayunon ang deliberasyon sa konseho agud madesisyunan na ang natuhoy sa signal shutdown.
english: Javellana added that the deliberation in the council will be held on Thursday, January 9 to decide on the signal shutdown.

text: ILOILO CITY – Kombinasyon sang kaanyag, kaalam kag abilidad ang ginapangita sa Miss Iloilo 2020.
english: ILOILO CITY – A combination of beauty, intelligence and ability is sought in Miss Iloilo 2020.

text: Sa Good Morning Philippines program, ginpahayag ni Raymond Villanueva, Binibining Pilipinas Executive Committee Member, pageant mentor, director/fashion designer, nga kun kaanyag lang ukon kaalam lang, indi ini bastante nga basehan agud nga makakuha sang major crown sa labing una nga edition sang Miss Iloilo.
english: In the Good Morning Philippines program, Raymond Villanueva, Binibining Pilipinas Executive Committee Member, pageant mentor, director/fashion designer, said that beauty or intelligence alone is not enough basis to win the major crown in the first edition of Miss Iloilo.

text: Suno kay Villanueva, ang kilalahon nga Miss Iloilo ang kinahanglan nga may yara sang kombinasyon sang kaanyag kag kaalam agud nga itiglawas kag itib-ong ang Iloilo sa national kag international pageants.
english: According to Villanueva, the recognized Miss Iloilo must have a combination of beauty and intelligence in order to represent and promote Iloilo in national and international pageants.

text: Ginpahayag ni Villanueva nga kinahanglan man nga tutukan sang winning candidates ang ila tagsa ka adbokasiya sa katuyu-an nga makabulig sa isig ka tawo.
english: Villanueva said the winning candidates should also focus on their respective advocacy in order to help others.

text: Bilang Binibining Pilipinas Executive Committee Member, ginpahayag sang natungdan nga wala siya nagpangindi sang ginhatagan sang kahigayunan nga mangin creative consultant sang Miss Iloilo.
english: As Miss Pilipinas Executive Committee Member, she said she did not refuse when given the opportunity to be the creative consultant of Miss Iloilo.

text: Ini bangud nga magluwas nga isa siya ka Visayan, luyag niya suno kay Villanueva nga madala sa Miss Iloilo ang mataas nga standards sa patag sang pageantry.
english: This is because besides being a Visayan, Villanueva said she wants to bring high standards in the field of pageantry to Miss Iloilo.

text: Tatlo ka korona ang nagahulat sa deserving nga Ilongga Beauty Queen sa coronation night sang Miss Iloilo 2020.
english: Three crowns await the deserving Ilongga Beauty Queen at the coronation night of Miss Iloilo 2020.

text: Sa Good Morning Philippine Program, ginpahayag ni Gerlin dela Cruz, coordinator sang nasambit nga pageant, nga ang coronation night sang labing una nga edition sang Miss Iloilo ang patigayunon sa West Visayas State University Cultural Center sa Enero 23.
english: In the Good Morning Philippine Program, Gerlin dela Cruz, coordinator of the said pageant, said that the coronation night of the first edition of Miss Iloilo will be held at the West Visayas State University Cultural Center on January 23.

text: Suno kay dela Cruz, antes pa man ang coronation night, balantayan ang Casual Wear Competition and Fashion Show nga patigayunon sa SM City Iloilo sa Enero 11, Talent Competition nga patigayunon sa Festive Walk Mall sa Enero 18 samtang sa Enero 19 naman ang Outreach Program nga patigayunon sa Robinson’s Place Iloilo.
english: According to dela Cruz, before the coronation night, the Casual Wear Competition and Fashion Show will be held at SM City Iloilo on January 11, the Talent Competition will be held at the Festive Walk Mall on January 18 and the Outreach Program will be held at Pla Robinson, Iloilo on January 19.

text: Ginpahayag ni dela Cruz nga ang tatlo ka mga korona nga mahimo madag-an sang deserving nga kandidata amo ang Miss Iloilo 2020, Miss Iloilo Dinagyang 2020 kag Miss Iloilo World 2020.
english: Dela Cruz said the three crowns that the deserving candidate can win are Miss Iloilo 2020, Miss Iloilo Dinagyang 2020 and Miss Iloilo World 2020.

text: Magluwas sa tatlo ka korona, may yara man sang First Runner-Up kag Second Runner-Up kag ang mga tagdaug ang makabaton sang cash prize kag tour package.
english: In addition to the three crowns, there will also be a First Runner-Up and Second Runner-Up and the winners will receive a cash prize and a tour package.

text: Ang makakuha sang tatlo ka major crowns amo ang magatiglawas sang Iloilo sa national pageants.
english: The winner of three major crowns will represent Iloilo in the national pageants.

text: Dako ang kumpyansa sang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga malab-ot ang 2021 target sa produksyon sang humay.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) is confident that the 2021 rice production target will be achieved.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Secretary William Dar, masobra sa 20 million metric tons ang target subong nga tuig, sa diin sa una nga semester, yara na sa 8.8 million metric tons ang narecord nga produksyon.
english: According to Agriculture Secretary William Dar, the target is more than 20 million metric tons this year, where in the first semester, the production was recorded at 8.8 million metric tons.

text: Pahayag ni Dar, makabig nga ‘highest in the country’s history ang produksyon sang humay sang Enero tubtob Hunyo sini nga tuig sa diin mas mataas ini sang 9 percent ipaanggid sa tinalikdan nga tuig sa amo man nga period.
english: Dar said the rice production from January to June this year was the highest in the country's history, up 9 percent compared to the same period last year.

text: Samtang, ginpat-od man ni Dar nga doble na ang efforts sang ahensya agud ma-reverse ang negative livestock production growth.
english: Meanwhile, Dar also assured that the agency has redoubled its efforts to reverse the negative livestock production growth.

text: Nag-abiso na ang embahada sang Pilipinas sa mga Pinoy nga naga-istar kag naga-trabaho sa Lebanon nga ikonsiderar na ang pagbiya sa pungsod samtang available pa ang commercial flights.
english: The Philippine embassy has warned Filipinos living and working in Lebanon to consider leaving the country while commercial flights are still available.

text: Suno sa Philippine embassy, prayoridad gid ang safety kag ikaayo sang mga Pilipino.
english: According to the Philippine embassy, ​​the safety and well-being of Filipinos is a top priority.

text: Para naman sa mga nagdesisyon nga magtinir gid, gina-abisuhan man nga maghalong gid kag ipabilin ang kontak sa embahada, ihanda ang passports, kag mag-monitor gid sa mga balita.
english: For those who decide to stay, they are advised to be very careful and keep in touch with the embassy, ​​prepare passports, and monitor the news.

text: Ini nga paandam sang embahada ang kasunod sa pagsigabong sang mga walkie-talkie ukon hand-held radios nga ginagamit sang militante nga grupo nga Hezbollah kun sa diin 20 gid ang napatay kag 450 ang napilasan.
english: The embassy's warning follows the explosion of walkie-talkies or hand-held radios used by the militant group Hezbollah, which killed 20 people and wounded 450 others.

text: Magluwas pa ini sa pagsigabong man sang pagers sa nagligad nga adlaw kun sa diin 12 gid ang napatay kag 3,000 ang nasamaran.
english: This is in addition to the explosion of pagers last day where 12 people were killed and 3,000 injured.

text: Ginatudlo sang Hezbollah nga ang Israel ang may kahimuan sa amo nga mga pagpang-atake.
english: Hezbollah points to Israel being behind such attacks.

text: Ginakahangaw-an man nga mag-resulta ini sa gyera sa magtimbang nga bahin nga posible magresulta man sa pag-intra sang Iran nga taga-suporta sang Hezbollah kag Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga kaalyado naman sang Israel.
english: There are also fears that this could result in war on both sides that could also result in the involvement of Iran, which supports Hezbollah, and the United States, which is an ally of Israel.

text: “The Philippine Embassy strongly urges all Filipino nationals to CONSIDER leaving the country while commercial flights are still available.
english: “The Philippine Embassy strongly urges all Filipino nationals to CONSIDER leaving the country while commercial flights are still available.

text: Your safety and well-being are of utmost priority.
english: Your safety and well-being are of utmost priority.

text: Those who intend to remain for any reason are advised to exercise extreme caution and remain in contact with the Embassy,” suno sa embassy.
english: Those who intend to remain for any reason are advised to exercise extreme caution and remain in contact with the Embassy,” the embassy said.

text: “The Philippine Embassy understands that this may be a challenging time, and we are here to support you throughout this process.
english: “The Philippine Embassy understands that this may be a challenging time, and we are here to support you throughout this process.

text: Your prompt action is crucial to ensure your safety and well-being.For further inquiries or assistance, please contact the Philippine Embassy in Lebanon or the Migrant Workers Office (MWO-Lebanon): Embassy ATN hotline (for permanent residents): 70 858 086/ Migrant Workers Office hotline (for ALL workers): 79 110 729,” dugang sang embahada.#
english: Your prompt action is crucial to ensure your safety and well-being.For further inquiries or assistance, please contact the Philippine Embassy in Lebanon or the Migrant Workers Office (MWO-Lebanon): Embassy ATN hotline (for permanent residents): 110 729,” the embassy added.#

text: Duha ang patay sa natabo nga shootout sa Novaliches, Quezon City.
english: Two people were killed in a shootout in Novaliches, Quezon City.

text: Ang mga biktima amo sanday Jonari Dangalan, 29, delivery rider kag residente sang Brgy.
english: The victims were identified as Jonari Dangalan, 29, delivery rider and resident of Brgy.

text: Gulod, Novaliches, kag Eries John Genovatin, 24, 2nd year criminology student, kag residente sang Caloocan City.
english: Gulod, Novaliches, and Eries John Genovatin, 24, 2nd year criminology student, and resident of Caloocan City.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, sakay si Da­ngalan sa motorsiklo sang ginlagas sang mga suspek nga nagaangkasanay sa motorsiklo.
english: According to the investigation, Dangalan was riding a motorcycle when he was chased by the suspects.

text: Ila ginpalukpan si Dangalan kag natabuan nga may mga pulis kag ginlagas ang mga suspek.
english: They surrounded Dangalan and it happened that there were police and chased the suspects.

text: Nagpalupok sa mga pulis ang mga suspek gani nagbalos man ang otoridad.
english: The suspects opened fire on the police and the authorities retaliated.

text: Matapos ang engkwentro, nakit-an si Genovatin nga duguon samtang madamo man sang igo si Dangalan.
english: After the encounter, Genovatin was found bleeding while Dangalan sustained multiple gunshot wounds.

text: Gindala pa sa ospital ang mga biktima apang ginbawian gid sang kabuhi.
english: The victims were rushed to the hospital but died on the spot.

text: 11 ka igo sang bala ang naangkon ni Dangalan samtang naigo naman sang bala sa hita si Genovatin.
english: Dangalan sustained 11 gunshot wounds while Genovatin was hit in the thigh.

text: Nagapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon sa insidente.
english: The investigation into the incident is ongoing.

text: Proud nga ginpakigbahin ni Marjorie Barretto nga nag-gradwar na ini sa kolehiyo sa edad nga 51-anyos.
english: Marjorie Barretto proudly shared that she graduated from college at the age of 51.

text: Nakuha sang anay aktres ang Bachelor of Arts degree in Communication Arts halin sa Philippine Women’s University.
english: The former actress earned a Bachelor of Arts degree in Communication Arts from the Philippine Women’s University.

text: “At 51 years old, I finally wore this cap and gown.
english: “At 51 years old, I finally wore this cap and gown.

text: For years, finishing college was a dream tucked away — paused for show business, raising children, public service, business, and building a life.
english: For years, finishing college was a dream tucked away — paused for show business, raising children, public service, business, and building a life.

text: But God never forgot.
english: But God never forgets.

text: In His perfect time, He gave me the courage to return, the strength to push through, and the joy of crossing this finish line,” pahayag sini sa Instagram post.
english: In His perfect time, He gave me the courage to return, the strength to push through, and the joy of crossing this finish line,” she said in an Instagram post.

text: Ginpakigbahin sini nga ang pinakamatam-is nga parte sang iya kadalag-an amo nga nasaksihan ini sang iya mga anak.
english: She shared that the sweetest part of her success was that her children were able to witness it.

text: “The sweetest part?
english: “The sweetest part?

text: My children were there to witness it — taking my photos and videos, handing me flowers and gifts.
english: My children were there to witness it — taking my photos and videos, handing me flowers and gifts.

text: A moment so surreal, a full circle moment,” dugang sini sa iya post.
english: A moment so surreal, a full circle moment,” she added in her post.

text:
Nagpasalamat ini sa iya mga pinalangga sa kabuhi nga naghatag sa iya sang inspirasyon: “To my loved ones who inspired me, pushed me, and talked me out of my panic and anxieties — thank you from the bottom of my heart.”

Naghatag man ini sang mensahe sa iban nga indi pagpangampuan ang mga handum.
english:
She thanked her loved ones in life who inspired her: “To my loved ones who inspired me, pushed me, and talked me out of my panic and anxieties — thank you from the bottom of my heart.”

It also gave a message to others not to chase dreams.

text:
“And to those my age who still carry dreams in their hearts: it’s never too late, and you are never too old, to realize the dreams God placed in you.”

Doble-selebrasyon man ini para sa iya anak nga si Leon bangud maga-graduate man siya sa University of Asia and the Pacific subong nga Agusto.
english:
“And to those my age who still carry dreams in their hearts: it’s never too late, and you are never too old, to realize the dreams God placed in you.”

It is also a double celebration for his son Leon as he will also graduate from the University of Asia and the Pacific this August.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa ka former actress kag politician si Marjorie kag iloy sang lima ka kabataan nga sanday Dani, Julia, Claudia, Leon, kag Erich.
english: Marjorie is a former actress and politician and the mother of five children, Dani, Julia, Claudia, Leon, and Erich.

english: Iloilo City Mayor elect Raisa Treñas laid out her goals for the city following her victory in the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga kon nagdaog si Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon, dako kontani ang mabulig sini sa iya kag bisan sa syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Treñas said that if Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon had won, it would have helped him and even the city.

text: Suno kay Treñas, padayon nga suportahan sang city government ang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) sa pagpangampanya batok sa iligal nga druga.
english: Treñas said the city government will continue to support the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) in its campaign against illegal drugs.

text: Hatagan man sang administrasyon sang prayoridad ang Iloilo City College.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga tion naman agud nga ang mga babaye ang magpakita sa ila ikasarang sa patag sang pagdumala sang syudad.
english: He also said that it is time for women to show their skills in the field of city management.

text: Handa man ang alkalde nga mag-reach out sa Team Baronda agud magsapol para sa mangin plano para sa Iloilo City.
english: The mayor is also ready to reach out to Team Baronda to meet for a plan for Iloilo City.

text: Nahibaluan nga magluwas kay Treñas, na-reelect man si Iloilo City Lone District Representative Jam-Jam Baronda samtang ang iya utod nga si Love-love Baronda ang magapungko man bilang bise-alcalde sang Iloilo City.
english: Nahibaluan nga magluwas kay Treñas, na-reelect man si Iloilo City Lone District Representative Jam-Jam Baronda samtang ang iya utod nga si Love-love Baronda ang magapungko man bilang bise-alcalde sang Iloilo City.

english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Punong Barangay Joseph Poral of Brgy.

text: Tacas, Jaro, Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga magapauli kuntani ang biktima sa ila balay sa Zone 4 Brgy.
english: Tacas, Jaro, Iloilo City, he said the victim was on his way home from his house in Zone 4 Brgy.

text: Tacas, Jaro, sang nasag-idan sini ang isa ka motor rason nga natumba ini kag nagtupa sa idalom sang truck.
english: Tacas, Jaro, when it hit a motorcycle causing it to fall and fall under the truck.

text: Suno sa traffic investigator medyo madasig ang pagpadalagan sang biktima rason nga natumba ini sa porsyon sang dalan kun sa diin suno kay PB Poral accident prone area.
english: According to the traffic investigator, the victim was driving fast and fell on the portion of the road where according to PB Poral accident prone area.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang suspek nga nakabunggo-patay sa biktima ang nagapauli man sa iya barangay sa Tacas Jaro.
english: He also said that the suspect who hit and killed the victim was also returning to his barangay in Tacas Jaro.

text: Sa karon, nadesisyunan sang pamilya nga indi na lang magpasaka sang kaso batok sa suspek apang kinahanglan sini nga buligan sa pagpalubong ang biktima amo man ang pagbayad sa nabilin nga balayran sa ospital.
english: At present, the family has decided not to file a case against the suspect but they need to help bury the victim as well as pay the remaining hospital bills.

text: Nagpahanumdum naman si Punong barangay Poral sa mga motorista nga nagalabay sa nasambit nga lugar nga maghinay-hinay gid agud indi na maliwan ang kaangay nga aksidente kun sa diin nag-utas gid ini sang kabuhi.
english: Punong barangay Poral reminded motorists passing through the area to slow down to avoid a similar accident where he lost his life.

text: SA PAGTANTYA (estimate) sang mga experto, ang paggamit sang fossil fuel (oil, natural gas, coal) sang mga pungsod pwede mapanubo tubtub 60% lang anay sa pag-abot sang 2040.
english: Experts estimate that countries' use of fossil fuels (oil, natural gas, coal) could be reduced by up to 60% by 2040.

text: Ikumparar ini sa 85% sang paggamit pa sini sa subong, samtang amat-amat pa lang ginapatuman ang mga renewable energy projects gamit ang hydro, wind kag solar energy, katulad sang yara na sa Filipinas nga mga e-vehicles, e-bikes, digital gadgets, kag iban pa.
english: This is compared to 85% of its current use, while renewable energy projects using hydro, wind and solar energy are being implemented, such as e-vehicles, e-bikes, digital gadgets, and others.

text: Syempre indi pa madale-dale dula ang paggamit sang fossil fuel kag kinahanglan anay ang isa ka “transition strategy” agud maseguro nga indi kita makadalin-as sa ginapadulungan naton nga bag-o nga pagpangabuhi nga wala na ining makahalalit sa kalibutan nga fossil fuel.
english: Of course, the use of fossil fuels is not yet completely eliminated and a transition strategy is needed to ensure that we do not slip into the new life we ​​are moving towards without this harmful fossil fuel.

text: Ano bala ang aton prioridad sa ining “transition strategy” angot sa aton kaugalingon nga problema pa sa fossil fuel sa Filipinas?
english: What are our priorities in this transition strategy regarding our own fossil fuel problem in the Philippines?

text: Ano bala ang mayor naton anay unahon ukon ipaulihi sa pagdula?
english: Ano bala ang mayor naton anay unahon ukon ipaulihi sa pagdula?

text: Ang oil, natural gas, ukon coal?
english: Oil, natural gas, or coal?

text: Ngaa kag paano?
english: Why and how?

text: Sandig bala sa availability pa sini sa karon ukon, samtang ginagamit, pwede bala mapa-improve pa anay, ukon indi, ang “efficiency” sini, meantime nga gakabuhi pa kita upod sa mahaliton nga greenhouse effect sang fossil fuel?
english: Is it based on its current availability or, while in use, can its efficiency be improved, or not, while we are still living with the harmful greenhouse effect of fossil fuels?

text: Etcetera!
english: Etcetera!

text: Ano naman ang mahimo naton sa posible nga kahalitan sang mataas gihapon nga init sang kalibutan (Global Warming) base sa aton na-eperyensyahan na naton, labi na gid sa sining nagligad nga mga bagyo katulad sang bagyo Odette kag Paeng?
english: What can we do about the possible damage of global warming based on what we have already experienced, especially in these past typhoons such as typhoons Odette and Paeng?

text: Of course, samtang wala pa kita mabaton nga bulig sang mga manggaran nga mga pungsod para sa mga mas “vulnerable” nga mga pungsod, katulad sang Filipinas, nga ginpasalig sang COP27, nga patup-on pa ugaling, kon magtupa gid man, sa hiwaton nga COP28 sa United Arab Emirates sa 2023.
english: Of course, while we have not yet received aid from rich countries for more “vulnerable” countries, such as the Philippines, which was assured by COP27, which will be increased, if at all, at COP28 in the United Arab Emirates in 2023.

text: Daku nga kahalitan ang natuga sining mga bagyo sa kabuhi, pangabuhian kag infrastructura diri sa pungsod nga wala pa ma-experyensahan sang madamo sa ila bug-os nga kabuhi.
english: These storms have caused great damage to life, livelihood and infrastructure here in the country that many have never experienced in their entire lives.

text: Dala gani sini ang malaparon kag madalom nga pagbaha, pagdugay sang pagtuyot (drought) pagkatapos sang tag-ulan, landslide kag mudslide halin sa napahuyang sang ulan nga bahin sang duta halin sa ibabaw, kag pati na ang mga linog nga pila sini tuga sang “drilling” para sa fossil fuel.
english: It has led to widespread and deep flooding, prolonged drought after the rainy season, landslides and mudslides from the rain-weakened part of the earth from above, and even earthquakes, some of which are caused by drilling for fossil fuels.

text: Kinaandan na ang pagduaw sa aton pungsod sang indi magkulang sa 20 ka bagyo kada tuig.
english: It is common for our country to be visited by at least 20 hurricanes a year.

text: Gani dapat preparahan ta na ini sa masunod nga tuig kay basi amo gihapon, kon indi sobra pa, ang maagoman naton sa indi pa mapunggan nga pagtaas sang init sang kalibutan.
english: So we should prepare for it next year because we might experience the same, if not more, unstoppable global warming.

text: Mayor diri ang pagtukod sang mga proyekto nga makaluas sing kabuhi, makahatag trabaho sa mga pumuluyo, makapaugwad sang pangabuhian nga mahimo kag mabuligan sang gobyerno kag pribado nga sector, kag iban pa.
english: These include the establishment of projects that can save lives, provide jobs to the people, improve livelihoods that can be done and supported by the government and the private sector, and others.

text: Kinahanglan man naton ang pagtukod sang mas mabakod nga mga settlement houses sang aton mga informal settlers, evacuation centers, kag mga infra batok sa baha, landslide kag mudslide; na-train sing maayo nga mga disaster and rescue personnel, “laging handa” nga ayuda sa pagkaon kag kinahanglan sang mga evacuees, masaligan nga mga aviso; kag iban pa.
english: We also need the construction of stronger settlement houses of our informal settlers, evacuation centers, and infrastructure against floods, landslides and mudslides; well-trained disaster and rescue personnel, “always ready” food aid and needed evacuees, reliable warnings; and so on.

text:
***

Samtang, kinahanglan ta man ma-ideyahan ang mga medyos posibles nga mapatahaw ang epekto sang paggamit sa iban pa nga mga paagi.
english:
***

Meanwhile, we also need to devise ways to possibly mitigate the effects of use in other ways.

text: Katulad sang pagpasanyog ssng forest cover nga nagasuyop sang carbon dioxide nga 75% sini kalakip sa greenhouse gases (GHG) nga nagadugang painit sang kalibutan (Global Warming nga nagapalala sang klima.
english: Such as promoting forest cover that absorbs 75% of carbon dioxide, including greenhouse gases (GHG) that increase global warming.

text: Lakip na ang padayon nga “carbon capture” kag “carbon segregation” agud maibanan ang nagaluntad nga GHG sa atmospera.
english: Including continuous “carbon capture” and “carbon segregation” to reduce existing GHGs in the atmosphere.

text: Subong man ang pag-hybrid, ukon pag-upod sang pila ka energy sources, nga makapanubo sang produksyon sang GHG, pag-improve sang mga dalanon kag isratehiya sang transportasyon nga makapanubo sang paggamit sang fossil fuel, kag iban pa.
english: As well as hybridization, or combining several energy sources, which can reduce GHG production, improving roads and transportation strategies that can reduce the use of fossil fuels, and so on.

text:
***

No doubt, importante gid nga matagaan na sing maabtik nga aksyon ining problema naton sa Climate Change, labi na gid kay pabalik-balik lang ang daku nga kahalitan sini sa aton kada tuig bisan pa sa 1.2o Celsius pa lang ang pagtaas sang init kalibutan sa karon.
english:
***

No doubt, it is very important to take immediate action on our problem of Climate Change, especially since it is causing us more damage every year even though the global temperature is only rising by 1.2o Celsius.

text: Sa nasiling ta na gani, mayor diri ang pagtukod sang mga proyekto nga makaluas sing kabuhi, makahatag trabaho sa mga pumuluyo nga mahimo sang gobyerno kag mga negosyo, kag makapaugwad sang indibidwal nga pangabuhian nga may bulig man sang gobyerno kag sang pribado nga sektor.
english: As we have already said, the main focus is on the construction of projects that can save lives, provide jobs to the people that can be done by the government and businesses, and improve individual livelihoods with the help of the government and the private sector.

text: Indi naton ini mahimo paagi sa tikal lang kag wala katapusan nga pangako, kundi sa maabitk nga pag-aksyon sa mga bagay nga mga hilimuon!
english: We cannot do this by merely temporary and endless commitments, but by taking decisive action in the right way!
