english: MERRY CHRISTMAS & A VERY HAPPY NEW YEAR to all!/PN

text: Magapabilin sa ₱43 kada kilo ang maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) sang 5% broken imported rice samtang ginatapos sang gobyerno ang mga kinahanglanon nga proseso para sa pagtaas sang taripa sa pag-import sang bugas, suno kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: The maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) of 5% broken imported rice will remain at ₱43 per kilo while the government completes the necessary processes for the increase in rice import tariffs, Agriculture Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr. said.

text: Ginpahayag sang ahensya nga ginaplanuhan nga ipatuman sa Enero 16 ang pagtaas sang rice import duties halin sa 15% pakadto sa 20%, sunod sa regulatory kag procedural requirements.
english: The agency said it plans to implement on January 16 the increase in rice import duties from 15% to 20%, in accordance with regulatory and procedural requirements.

text: Paathag pa ni Laurel nga kun mapatuman na ang mas mataas nga taripa, amo ang pagbuhat sang tikang kun may pagbag-o sa MSRP sang imported rice.
english: Laurel explained that once the higher tariff is implemented, the step will be taken if there is a change in the MSRP of imported rice.

english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. also ordered the

english: the four-month moratorium on rice imports that began in September, to support farmgate prices of farmers amid the wet-season harvest that began in October.

text: Nagkampyon sa Shanghai Masters si Valentin Vacherot.
english: Valentin Vacherot won the Shanghai Masters.

text: Ini matapos nga ginlutos niya sa finals ang pakaisa pakaisa sini nga si Arthur Rinderknech sa score ng 4-6, 6-3, 6-3 .
english: This after he defeated his cousin Arthur Rinderknech in the finals with a score of 4-6, 6-3, 6-3.

english: As a result, the 26-year-old, ranked 204, became the lowest player to win the ATP Masters 1000 title.

text: Antes nagkampyon, ginlutos sini ang mga may matag-as nga ranking kaangay nanday Holger 11 nga si Holger Rune sa quaterfinals kag sa semifinals naman nga si Novak Djokovic.
english: Before winning the championship, he defeated high-ranking players such as Holger 11 Holger Rune in the quarterfinals and Novak Djokovic in the semifinals.

text: Nagnubo sa 1.5 percent ang Philippine agriculture production sa ika-duha nga quarter sang 2021.
english: Philippine agriculture production fell by 1.5 percent in the second quarter of 2021.

text: Santo sa Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), ini ang kasunod man sang decline sa produksyon sang livestock kag fisheries.
english: According to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), this is also due to the decline in livestock and fisheries production.

text: 19.3 percent ang gin-nubo sang livestock production — nga naghatag sang 14.2 percent nga kontribusyon sa kabug-usan nga agricultural production.
english: 19.3 percent was reduced by livestock production — making a 14.2 percent contribution to total agricultural production.

text: Samtang ang hog production naman ang nagnubo man sa 26.2 percent kag ang dairy output sa 6.6 percent.
english: Meanwhile, hog production also declined to 26.2 percent and dairy output to 6.6 percent.

text: Nagserbe sang search warrant ang Bureau of Customs (BOC) sa balay ni former Pasig City mayoralty candidate Sarah Discaya.
english: The Bureau of Customs (BOC) served a search warrant on the house of former Pasig City mayoralty candidate Sarah Discaya.

text: Ginkumpirma ini ni BOC Chief of Staff Atty. Jek Casipit.
english: This was confirmed by BOC Chief of Staff Atty. Jack Casipet.

text: Suno kay Casipit, duha ka beses nga gintinguhaan nga iserbe ini kagab-i apang wala sila gintugutan nga magsulod.
english: According to Casipit, they tried to serve it twice last night but they were not allowed to enter.

text: Sa hearing sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee kahapon, September 1, gin-ako ni Discaya nga may yara siya sang 28 luxury cars.
english: In a hearing of the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee yesterday, September 1, Discaya admitted to owning 28 luxury cars.

text: Nabuyagyag man sa hearing nga may yara siya sang siyam nga construction firms nga naga-bid sa mga proyekto sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).
english: It was also revealed in the hearing that he has nine construction firms bidding for projects of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).

text: 𝗣𝗔𝗦𝗦𝗜 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – Nagapanindugan ang girlfriend sang Corps Commander sa Reserve Officers’ Training Corps (ROTC) sa Passi City College sa Passi City nga ang ginhimo nga hazing sa iya boyfriend amo ang rason sa paghikog sini.
english: 𝗣𝗔𝗦𝗦𝗜 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – The girlfriend of the Corps Commander in the Reserve Officers’ Training Corps (ROTC) at Passi City College in Passi City insists that the hazing done to her boyfriend was the reason for her suicide.

text: Ang biktima amo si JP Mombay, 3rd year Bachelor of Science in Criminology.
english: The victim was identified as JP Mombay, 3rd year Bachelor of Science in Criminology.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jessa Mae Tomo, iya ginpahayag nga tuman nga ginbatyag sang iya boyfriend ang ginhimo nga hazing sa iya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jessa Mae Tomo said her boyfriend felt the hazing.

text: Suno kay Tomo, gin-ako mismo sang iya boyfriend  nga samtang naka-topless ini, ginbulos-bulusan siya sumbag siya sa dughan kag ginsulok-sulok sang iya mga seniors sa ROTC.
english: According to Tomo, her boyfriend himself admitted that while she was topless, she took turns kicking him in the chest and being stared at by her seniors in ROTC.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga wala nakahibalo si Mombay kun san-o matupa kag kun sin-o ang nagsumbag sa biktima bangud naka-blindfold ini.
english: He said Mombay did not know when he fell and who hit the victim because he was blindfolded.

text: May mga pictures man ini nga ginpadala sa iya girlfriend sa diin makit-an nga puno ini sang lagob.
english: He also sent pictures to his girlfriend where she was seen full of bruises.

text: Magluwas diri, nagasuka man ini sang dugo.
english: Besides, it also vomits blood.

text: Sa ulihi, nagdulot ini sang stress kag depression sa biktima.
english: Eventually, this caused stress and depression to the victim.

text: Bangud sa natabo, naghikog na ang biktima sa sulod sang iya boarding house sa Tubod, Passi City.
english: The victim committed suicide inside his boarding house in Tubod, Passi City.

text: Una diri, nagpahayag na ang pamilya ni Mombay nga desidido sila nga pasakaan sang kaso ang mga nagpatigayon sang hazing sa iya anak.
english: Earlier, Mombay's family said they were determined to prosecute those who carried out the hazing of his daughter.

text: Bukas naman ang Bombo Radyo sa paathag sang Passi City College.
english: Bombo Radyo is open to the explanation of Passi City College.

text: Wala pa sang desisyon si Tokyo Summer Games gold medalist Hidilyn Diaz kun bala magapartisipar siya sa 5th Olympics sa Paris sa 2024.
english: Tokyo Summer Games gold medalist Hidilyn Diaz has yet to decide whether she will participate in the 5th Olympics in Paris in 2024.

text: Sa subong, nakatutok anay si Diaz sa pagpakigbahin sa SEA kag Asian Games apang indi pa niya mapat-od kun maga-upod siya sa national team sa World Championships sa Tashkent, Uzbekistan sa Disyembre 7 tubtob 17.
english: Diaz is currently focused on participating in the SEA and Asian Games but is not sure whether he will join the national team at the World Championships in Tashkent, Uzbekistan from December 7 to 17.

text: Suno sa Olympic gold medalist, padayon kag adlaw-adlaw sa gihapon ang iya nga training sa coach nga si Julius Naranjo kag nagalaum nga makabalik sa Malaysia agud nga makahanda para sa World Championships apang indi mangin madasig ang pagproseso bangud sa travel protocols.
english: According to the Olympic gold medalist, he is still training daily with coach Julius Naranjo and hopes to return to Malaysia to prepare for the World Championships but the processing will not be fast due to travel protocols.

text: Gina-ko ni Diaz nga yara sa iya paminsaron ang Paris apang nakadepende sa iya qualifying process kun masarangan sini ang masunod nga Olympics.
english: Diaz admits that Paris is on his mind but it depends on his qualifying process if he can make it to the next Olympics.

text: Patay ang nagakarga-tapas sang tubo matapos nga ginaalegar ginluthang ang iya nga kaugalingon gamit ang armas sa Brgy.
english: A pipe loader was killed after he allegedly shot himself with a gun in Brgy.

text: Aglalana, Passi City.
english: Aglalana, Passi City.

text: Ang biktima amo si certain Roland, 23-anyos, residente Barangay Danao, Janiuay, kag manogkarga-tapas sang tobo sa Brgy.
english: The victim was identified as certain Roland, 23, resident of Barangay Danao, Janiuay, and a tobo loader in Brgy.

text: Aglalana.Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Werne Padernal, tag-iya sang balay kon sa diin ginaalegar nag-suicide ang biktima, iya ginpahayag nga posible ang ginaalegar nga pagmolestya sang biktima sa iya nga menor-de-edad nga nobya ang rason kon ngaa nahimo sini nga utdon ang iya nga kabuhi.
english: Aglalana.In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Werne Padernal, owner of the house where the victim allegedly committed suicide, said it is possible that the victim's alleged molestation of his minor girlfriend was the reason why he managed to cut off his life.

text: Suno kay Padernal, takna mga alas-3 sang hapon sang nagpahuway-huway si certain Roland sa iya puluy-an kag nagpungko sang hinali lang nga may nabatian ini nga gulpi lang nga may naglupok.
english: According to Padernal, around 3 pm, certain Roland was resting in his house and sitting down when he suddenly heard a sudden explosion.

text: Didto kag nasapwan sini nga dugo-on na ang biktima.
english: He found the victim bleeding.

text: Gilayon man nga naguwa ang natungdan agud ipahibalo nga ginluthang sang biktima ang iya kaugalingon, kon sa diin, gindala pa sa ospital.
english: The victim immediately went outside to report that he had shot himself, where he was taken to the hospital.

text: Kasunod sini, ginlibot ang balay kag didto nakita ang sling bag nga itom kag nakit-an man ang sulodlan sang pusil apang wala nakit-an ang armas.
english: Subsequently, the house was searched and a black sling bag was found and a gun was found but the weapon was not found.

text: Suno kay Kagawad Garly Padernal, indi pa man matumod sang kapulisan kon nag-suicide gidman ukon ginpatay ang biktima.
english: According to Kagawad Garly Padernal, the police are yet to determine whether the victim committed suicide or was murdered.

text: Dugang sang natungdan nga posible nga ang rason sang pag-utod sang kabuhi sang biktima amo ang ginapahayag naabtan sila sang iloy sang iya nga nobya nga nagahulid.
english: He added that it is possible that the reason for the victim's death was that the mother of his girlfriend allegedly caught them having sex.

text: Ginaalegar nga nagtulod man ini sa iloy nga magpasaka sang kaso batok sa biktima bangud menor-de-edad ang iya anak, rason, nga wala ini nadula sang panghuna-huna ni certain Roland.
english: It is alleged that this also prompted the mother to file a case against the victim because her son is a minor, which is why certain Roland did not lose his mind.

text: Nagboto ang member states sa United Nations agud pormal nga i-demand nga tapuson na ang pagpang-atake kag pagtinir sang Israel sa mga teritoryo sang Palestine.
english: Member states voted at the United Nations to formally demand an end to Israel's attacks and occupation of Palestinian territories.

text: Pananglitan indi ini magtuman sa sulod sang 12 ka bulan, may ginpaandam nga idagdag nga sanctions.
english: If it does not comply within 12 months, there is a warning that sanctions will be added.

text: 124 ang nagpabor, 14 ang nagpamatok, kag 43 naman ang nag-abstain sang ginpatigayon ang pagbinotohay.
english: 124 voted in favor, 14 against, and 43 abstained when the vote was taken.

text: Ini nga non-binding resolution sang United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) ang naka-base sa advisory opinion halin sa International Court of Justice (ICJ) nga nagasiling nga iligal ang pagsakop sang Israel sa amo nga mga teritoryo halin sang 1967.
english: This non-binding resolution of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) is based on an advisory opinion from the International Court of Justice (ICJ) which states that Israel’s occupation of such territories since 1967 is illegal.

text: Kun matandaan, ginpaguwa sang korte ang desisyon sang Hulyo kun sa diin ginsiling nga gina-abusuhan sang Israel ang ila status bilang occupying power kag makabig na nga iligal ang ila settlements sa West Bank kag East Jerusalem.
english: The court issued a ruling in July that Israel was abusing its status as an occupying power and that its settlements in the West Bank and East Jerusalem were illegal.

text: Ang pag-adoptar sini nga resolusyon ang natabo sinemana antes ang una nga anibersaryo sang pag-atake sang Hamas sa southern Israel sang Oktubre 2023 nga rason sang pagbalos sang Israel sa Gaza nga nagapadayon tubtub subong apisar sang linibo nga nagkalamatay.
english: The adoption of this resolution comes weeks before the first anniversary of the Hamas attack on southern Israel in October 2023 that sparked the Israeli retaliation in Gaza that continues to this day despite thousands of deaths.

text: Gintawag naman sang Palestine nga maragtason ang resolusyon samtang naakig naman ang Israel kag gintawag ini nga “cynical international politics.”
english: Palestine called the resolution historic while Israel was angry and called it “cynical international politics.”

text: Patay ang 14 ka mga tawo kag nasamaran ang 450 ka iban pa bangud sa pagsigabong sang mga walkie-talkie sa Lebanon.
english: Fourteen people were killed and 450 others injured when walkie-talkies caught fire in Lebanon.

text: Ini nga hand-held radios ang ginagamit sang Lebanese armed group nga Hezbollah.
english: These hand-held radios are used by the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah.

text: Isa sa pagsigabong ang natabo malapit mismo sa haya sang mga napatay sa separado man nga pagsigabong sang pagers sang nagligad nga adlaw nga ginapasibangod man sang militante sa Israel.
english: One of the attacks occurred near the grave of those killed in a separate attack on pagers the previous day that was also blamed on militants in Israel.

text: Base sa pictures sang naglupok nga walkie-talkies, may nakabutang nga inside panel nga may label nga “ICOM” kag “made in Japan.” Base sa ila website, ang ICOM isa ka Japan-based radio communications kag telephone company.
english: Based on the pictures of the exploded walkie-talkies, there is an inside panel labeled “ICOM” and “made in Japan.” Based on its website, ICOM is a Japan-based radio communications and telephone company.

text: Nahibaluan man nga ini nga mga radyo ang ginbakal sang Hezbollah lima ka bulan na ang nagligad kadungan man sang ila pagbakal sang pagers.
english: It is also known that these radios were bought by Hezbollah five months ago at the same time as they bought pagers.

text: Antes ang pagsigabong sang walkie-talkies, 12 na ang napatay kag malapit 3,000 ang nasamaran sa separado nga pagsigabong sang pagers nga ginagamit man sang Hezbollah.
english: Before the blast of the walkie-talkies, 12 people had been killed and nearly 3,000 injured in separate blasts of pagers also used by Hezbollah.

text: Nagpaandam ang grupo nga magatimalos sila sa Israel apang wala pa sang komento nga ginpaguwa ang Israeli Army apisar sang reports nga ginbutangan gid man sang ila mga operatiba sang substance sang explosives ang imported nga pagers.
english: The group warned that they would retaliate against Israel but the Israeli Army has not yet issued a comment despite reports that its operatives did indeed put the substance of explosives in the imported pagers.

text: Kaangot diri, magasapol na ang United Nations Security Council buwas kasunod sang request sang Algeria (on behalf sang Arab nations).
english: In this regard, the United Nations Security Council will meet tomorrow following the request of Algeria (on behalf of Arab nations).

text: Nahibaluan nga may engkwentro na ang Hezbollah kag Israel halin pa man sang nagsugod ang gyera sa Gaza sang Oktubre 2023.
english: It is known that there have been clashes between Hezbollah and Israel since the beginning of the war in Gaza in October 2023.

text: Ini nga mga away ang ginakahangaw-an nga magalapta pa gid sa Middle East nga posible magdalahig na pati sa Iran nga naga-suporta sa Hezbollah kag Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga kaalyado naman sang Israel.
english: The fighting is feared to spread to the Middle East, possibly involving Iran, which supports Hezbollah, and the United States, which is an ally of Israel.

text: Pananglitan may matabo nga full-blown war, ginakahangaw-an man ang mangin sitwasyon sang Lebanon bangud wala pa ini nakabangon sa mga krisis nga natabo sa sulod sang pila ka tuig lakip na ang 2019 financial collapse kag ang pagsigabong sa pantalan sa Beirut sang 2020.
english: In the event of a full-blown war, Lebanon's situation is also worrying because it has not yet recovered from the crises that have occurred over the past few years, including the 2019 financial collapse and the 2020 Beirut port fire.

text: Nadepensahan ni RING kag WBC world heavyweight world champion Tyson Fury sang Britain ang iya world title kasunod sang eleventh-round knockout stoppage batok kay Deontay Wilder sang Amerika.
english: Britain's RING and WBC world heavyweight world champion Tyson Fury defended his world title following an eleventh-round knockout stoppage against America's Deontay Wilder.

text: Ang away sang duha ka boksidor sa T-Mobile Arena sa Las Vegas, USA amo ang isa sa ginakabig all-time great heavyweight bouts.
english: The fight between the two boxers at the T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, USA is considered one of the all-time great heavyweight bouts.

text: Duha ka beses nga natumba si Fury sa fourth round sang hampang.
english: Fury was knocked down twice in the fourth round of the match.

text: Apang sa brutal nga roller coaster fight, gintumba sang 33 anyos nga Briton ang Amerikano nga si Wilder sa ika-10 nga round.
english: But in a brutal roller coaster fight, the 33-year-old Brit knocked out American Wilder in the 10th round.

text: Sa 1:10 mark sang round 11, gin-knockout ni Fury si Wilder paagi sa iya nga right hook.
english: At the 1:10 mark of round 11, Fury knocked out Wilder with a right hook.

text: Sa subong, bitbit ni Fury ang iya 31-0-1 nga record, samtang si Wilder naman ang may yara sang 42-2-1 record.
english: Fury currently carries his 31-0-1 record, while Wilder has a 42-2-1 record.

text: Matandaan nga may yara na sang history sanday Fury kag Wilder sa controversial draw sa Los Angeles sang 2018, antes nga na-secure ni Fury ang seventh-round knockout sa ila ikaduha ng away 20 ka bulan na ang nagligad.
english: Fury and Wilder have a history of a controversial draw in Los Angeles in 2018, before Fury secured a seventh-round knockout in their second fight 20 months ago.

text: Isang 49-anyos na lalaki ang nasawi habang hindi bababa sa 80 pamilya ang inilikas matapos ang malalakas na pag-ulan na nagdulot ng matinding pagbaha sa mga bayan ng Balingasag at Lagonglong sa Misamis Oriental nitong weekend.
english: A 49-year-old man was killed while at least 80 families were evacuated after heavy rains caused severe flooding in the towns of Balingasag and Lagonglong in Misamis Oriental this weekend.

text: Ayon sa ulat ng Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office, ang biktima ay inanod ng rumaragasang tubig habang tinatawid ang spillway sa Barangay Camuayan, Balingasag bandang alas-tres ng madaling-araw.
english: According to the Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office, the victim was swept away by the rushing water while crossing the spillway in Barangay Camuayan, Balingasag around 3:00 am.

text: Natagpuan ang kanyang bangkay sa baybayin kinabukasan.
english: His body was found on the beach the next day.

text: Sa Claveria Rosario, nasa sampung pamilya ang inilikas, habang sa bayan ng Lagonglong, umabot sa taas-tuhod ang baha sa Barangay Poblacion kaya’t 71 pamilya ang pansamantalang dinala sa evacuation center.
english: In Claveria Rosario, ten families were evacuated, while in Lagonglong town, the flood reached knee-high in Barangay Poblacion so 71 families were temporarily taken to the evacuation center.

text: Nagbalikan naman sa kani-kanilang bahay ang mga apektadong pamilya matapos humupa ang baha.
english: The affected families returned to their homes after the flood subsided.

text: Walang naiulat na nawasak na bahay o nasirang kagamitan ayon sa mga awtoridad.
english: No damaged homes or damaged equipment were reported, according to authorities.

text: Liwat nga gintanyag sang Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) ang TUPAD ukon Tulong Panghanap Buhay para sa Displaced Workers Program para sa mga nawad-an sang trabaho sugod sang ginpatuman ang enhanced community quarantine ukon ECQ.
english: The Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) has once again offered the TUPAD or Tulong Panghanap Buhay para Displaced Workers Program for those who lost their jobs since the implementation of the enhanced community quarantine or ECQ.

text: Suno kay Labor Secretary Silvestre Bello III, ang unemployed kag self-employed workers, lakip na ang nagatrabaho sa non-formal sector kaangay sang mga vendors, drivers, kag helpers ang mahimo nga maka-apply para sa emergency employment.
english: According to Labor Secretary Silvestre Bello III, unemployed and self-employed workers, including those working in the non-formal sector such as vendors, drivers, and helpers can apply for emergency employment.

text: 10 ka adlaw ang ihatag nga trabaho suno kay Bello kag ihatag man dayon ang sweldo paagi sa remittance center.
english: 10 days of work will be given, Bello said, and the salary will be given immediately through the remittance center.

text: Suno sa DOLE, may minimum period of 10 days ang emergency employment kag maximum sang 30 ka adlaw — depende sa nature sang trabaho nga ihatag.
english: According to the DOLE, emergency employment has a minimum period of 10 days and a maximum of 30 days — depending on the nature of the job to be provided.

text: Nagpangabay man ang DOLE sa Department of Budget and Management nga maghatag sang P2 billion bangud ginapahayag ‘fully utilized’ na ang pondo sang DOLE.
english: The DOLE also asked the Department of Budget and Management to provide P2 billion because the DOLE fund is said to be fully utilized.

text: Kulang suno kay Bello ang pondo para sa formal workers bangud informal workers na lang ang natigan-an sang kwarta.
english: Bello said there is a lack of funds for formal workers because only informal workers are given money.

text: Mas maga-antos pa ang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas matapos madugangan ang mga lugar nga ginpaidalom sa mas istrikto nga quarantine classification.
english: The Philippine economy will suffer even more after the number of areas placed under stricter quarantine classification increases.

text: Suno kay Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Kendrick Chua, ang pagpaidalom sa community quarantine classication ang magaresulta sa pakadula sang production output sang P150 billion kada semana.
english: According to Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Kendrick Chua, the community quarantine classification will result in a loss of production output of P150 billion per week.

text: Ini ang magaapekto sa masobra 600,000 nga mga mamumugon kag magasaka ang numero sang mga pigado sa 250,000.
english: This will affect more than 600,000 workers and raise the number of poor to 250,000.

text: Ginabanta P105 million sang ekonomiya ang madula kada semana sa National Capital Region (NCR) nga yara sa idalom sang enhanced community quarantine — ang pinaka-istrikto nga quarantine level.
english: An estimated P105 million of the economy is lost every week in the National Capital Region (NCR) which is under enhanced community quarantine — the strictest quarantine level.

text: Isa ka Filipino ang naka-set sang panibag-o nga world record sa jumping rope.
english: A Filipino has set a new world record in jumping rope.

text: Siya amo Ryan ‘Skipman’ Alonzo, 34, tumandok sang Manila kag nakarekord sang 40,980 double-under skips sa sulod lang sang 12 ka oras.
english: He is Ryan ‘Skipman’ Alonzo, 34, a native of Manila and recorded 40,980 double-under skips in just 12 hours.

text: Sa double-under, kinahanglan maka-duha ka beses ang paglabay sang rope sa kada lukso.
english: In double-under, the rope must be passed twice for each jump.

text: Ang rekord ni Alonzo ang naglumapaw sa 20,000-mark sang Guinness World Records.
english: Alonzo’s record crossed the 20,000-mark of Guinness World Records.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alonzo, iya ginpahayag nga high school siya sang nadiskubrehan niya ang pagkahilig sa jumping rope.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alonzo said he was in high school when he discovered his passion for jumping rope.

text: ”Actually ‘nung bata ako, medyo overweight nga ako eh.
english: "Actually, when I was a child, I was a little overweight.

text: Mga highschool ako ‘nung nagsimula ako mag jump rope.
english: I was in high school when I started jump roping.

text:
I just aim to keep myself healthy and nandito na tayon ngayon.”

Sang nakit-an niya ang manami nga resulta sa iya ikaayong lawas, ginpadayon niya ang jump rope tubtob nga nangin addiction na ang pila ka oras nga paglukso.
english:
I just aim to keep myself healthy and here we are now.”

When he saw the positive results in his health, he continued to jump rope until the hours of jumping became an addiction.

text: ”Super addicting ‘yung jump rope na kailangan ko sabihin sa sarili ko na today, i should only spend 2 hours and stop na.
english: "The jump rope is super addicting and I have to tell myself that today, I should only spend 2 hours and stop.

text:
Halos everyday ako nagja-jump rope since last year.”

Bag-o nahimo ang iya nga rekord, pila man ka training ang gin-agyan ni Alonzo kag halos apat ka bulan ang iya nga nangin preparasyon.
english:
I’ve been jumping rope almost everyday since last year.”

Before making his record, Alonzo went through several training sessions and spent almost four months preparing.

text: Sa iya world record attempt, ginpahayag niya nga pito lang ka minutos kada oras ang iya pahuway kag tinapay ukon saging lang ang iya ginakaon agud nga indi madula ang iya enerhiya.
english: During his world record attempt, he said he took only seven minutes of rest per hour and only ate bread or bananas to keep his energy up.

text: Bangud halos tunga sa adlaw ang iya paglukso, nagsuprer si Alonzo sang muscle cramps apang bangud man sa iya mga pinalangga sa kabuhi nga naga-cheer sa iya, mas nadugangan ang iya determinasyon kag kabakod nga magpadayon.
english: Because he jumped for almost half a day, Alonzo suffered from muscle cramps but also because of his loved ones cheering him on, he was more determined and strong to continue.

text: ”6 hours pa lang nagpulikat na ‘yung legs ko, very discouraging siya.
english: "My legs have been cracking for 6 hours, he's very discouraging.

text: Mga three or four hours left na lang, wala nakong lakas ‘non.
english: About three or four hours left, I don't have the strength.

text: Pero lahat sila nagsasayaw, parang nagpa-party nilagay ko lang ‘yung atensyon ko on them.
english: But they were all dancing, like they were having a party I just put my attention on them.

text:
Kung hindi sa kanila, baka hindi mataas yung numbers natin.”

Kaupod ang iya nga team, ginaproseso nanday Alonzo ang pagpasa sang mga ebidensya sa Guinness World Records agud mangin opisyal ang panibag-o nga feat.
english:
If it wasn't for them, our numbers might not be as high.”

Together with his team, Alonzo is in the process of submitting evidence to Guinness World Records to make the new feat official.

text:
Sa iya kadalag-an, ginpahayag sang Pinoy jump rope legend nga wala sang imposible kun ginahimo sang isa ka indibidwal ang iya nga ”best.”

”I want to set an example na we have to just try our best palagi and see how far we can reach.
english:
In his victory, the Filipino jump rope legend said that nothing is impossible when an individual does his “best.”

”I want to set an example that we have to just try our best palagi and see how far we can reach.

text: Hindi lang sabi na you have to beat this number.
english: It doesn't just say you have to beat this number.

text: For me, you aim to be the best you can be in everything.”
english: For me, you aim to be the best you can be in everything.”

text: Nagpamalibad nga magsabat sang “yes” ukon “no” ang tag-iya sang Wawao Builders nga si Mark Arevalo sang ginpamangkot ini sa Senate Blue Ribbon Committee hearing kun may yara sila sang ghost projects.
english: Wawao Builders owner Mark Arevalo declined to answer “yes” or “no” when asked at the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee hearing if they have any ghost projects.

text: “That Wawao?
english: “That Wawao?

text: Can you answer yes or no [to] ghost projects?” pamangkot ni Senate Majority Leader Joel Villanueva.
english: Can you answer yes or no [to] ghost projects?” asked Senate Majority Leader Joel Villanueva.

text: Naghipos lang si Arevalo.
english: Arevalo remained silent.

text: Ginmuno ni Villanueva kun ngaa malantaw pa ini sa iya nga abogado apisar nga simple nga huo ukon indi lang ang sabat nga ginapangayo.
english: Villanueva explained why he still looks at his lawyer even though the answer is a simple yes or no.

text:
Diri na kag nagsabat si Arevalo nga gina-invoke sini ang iya “right against self-incrimination.”

Nagsal-ot ang nagapanginit nga si Senate President Pro Tempore Jinggoy Estrada kun sa diin ginpasulit sini kay Arevalo ang iya ginhambal.
english:
Arevalo replied that he was invoking his “right against self-incrimination.”

Senate President Pro Tempore Jinggoy Estrada intervened and repeated his words to Arevalo.

text: Sang ginsulit ni Arevalo, nagsabat si Estrada: “My God, the question of the majority floor leader is very simple.
english: When Arevalo repeated, Estrada replied: “My God, the question of the majority floor leader is very simple.

text: Do you have any ghost projects in any of the areas here in the Philippines?
english: Do you have any ghost projects in any of the areas here in the Philippines?

text:
Answer!”

Diri kag nagpaathag si Arevalo nga gamiton batok sa iya ang iya pangbuy-an nga statement sa hearing sang upper chamber.
english:
Answer!”

Arevalo explained that his release statement will be used against him in the hearing of the upper chamber.

text: May ginabasa man ini sang nagsabat sa pamangkot ni Villanueva bangud suno sa iya, ginakulbaan siya sa hearing.
english: He also read something when he answered Villanueva's question because he said he was nervous about the hearing.

text:
Pahayag ni Villanueva: “Pambihira ka, parang tinatanong ka kung tao ka pero hindi mo alam kung tao ka!”

Nahibaluan nga isa ang Wawao Builders sa 15 contractors nga ginhingadlan ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos nga nakakuha sang kadam-an sang flood control deals sa gobyerno.
english:
Villanueva said: “You are extraordinary, it's like you're being asked if you're human but you don't know if you're human!”

Wawao Builders is one of the 15 contractors named by President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos who won most of the flood control deals with the government.

text: Sa Bulacan pa lamang, may 85 na ka mga proyekto ang amo nga kumpaniya nga nagabalor sang P5-billion.#
english: In Bulacan alone, the company has 85 projects worth P5-billion.

text: Dako ang nabulig sang Filipino basketball player nga si Kiefer Ravea sa kadalag-an sang Shiga Lakestars batuk sa Ibaraki Robots sa score nga 93-88 sa Japan B. League.
english: Filipino basketball player Kiefer Ravea played a big role in the Shiga Lakestars' 93-88 victory over Ibaraki Robots in the Japan B. League.

text: Ginpangunahan ni Ravena ang Lakestars nga nagtapos nga may 13 points lakip na ang clutch jumper.
english: Ravena led the Lakestars finishing with 13 points including a clutch jumper.

text: Magluwas sina, may yara pa sang 4 assists, 2 rebounds kag 2 steals si Ravena.
english: In addition, Ravena had 4 assists, 2 rebounds and 2 steals.

text: Wala naman nakahampang si Javi Gomez de Liaño sang Ibaraki bangud ginpaidalom ini sa qurantine.
english: Ibaraki's Javi Gomez de Liaño did not play because he was placed under quarantine.

text: Samtang si Bobby Ray Parks kag ang Nagoya Diamond Dolphins ang napiyerde batuk sa Hiroshima Dragonflies sa score 98-90.
english: Meanwhile, Bobby Ray Parks and the Nagoya Diamond Dolphins lost to the Hiroshima Dragonflies 98-90.

text: Sa sulod sang 13 minutos nga hampang sa B.League debut, duha ka puntos lang ang nahatag sang anay TNT Tropang GIGA player.
english: In 13 minutes of play in the B.League debut, the former TNT Tropang GIGA player managed just two points.

text: Wala man nakahampang si Parks sa first 2 games bangud sa iya calf inury.
english: Parks also missed the first 2 games due to calf inury.

text: Nadakpan sa Antipolo City ang isa ka lalaki nga naghimulos sa isa ka 19-anyos nga babaye nga person with disability (PWD) sa Camarines Norte.
english: A man was arrested in Antipolo City for raping a 19-year-old female person with disability (PWD) in Camarines Norte.

text: Natabo ang paghimulos sang suspek sa biktima sa isa ka payag sa Basud sang Nobyembre 2023.
english: The rape of the victim took place by the suspect in a hut in Basud in November 2023.

text: Suno sa Basud Police, ang biktima ang hinablos sang bayaw sang suspek.
english: According to Basud Police, the victim is the nephew of the suspect's brother-in-law.

text: Malapit apat ka bulan nga ginpangita ang suspek antes nadakpan.
english: The suspect was searched for nearly four months before being arrested.

text: Gin-ako sang suspek nga kilala niya ang biktima, apang hugot nga ginpanginwala ang akusasyon batok sa iya.
english: The suspect admitted that he knew the victim, but strongly denied the charges against him.

text: Natalana ini nga pasakaan sang kaso nga qualified rape.
english: He is scheduled to face charges of qualified rape.

text: Nangin madasig ang pagtaas sang manufacturing output sang Pilipinas sa bulan sang Hunyo.
english: The Philippines' manufacturing output grew rapidly in June.

text: Ini ang santo sa preliminary data sang Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) sa diin nagsaka sa 453.1 percent ang Volume of Production Index (VoPI) sang nasambit nga bulan, mas mataas ipaanggid sa 263.2-percent nga growth sang Mayo.
english: This is based on preliminary data from the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) where the Volume of Production Index (VoPI) rose to 453.1 percent in the said month, higher compared to the 263.2-percent growth in May.

text: Suno sa PSA, ang growth sang produksyon para sa manufacturing sector sang June 2021 ang bangud sa nakita nga improvements sa 19 ka industry divisions.
english: According to the PSA, the growth in production for the manufacturing sector in June 2021 was due to improvements seen in 19 industry divisions.

text: Ginpangsulod sa gate sa isa ka puluy-an ang mga motorsiklo nga naka-park sa bahin sang atubang sang Barangay Hall sang Brgy.
english: Motorcycles parked in front of the Barangay Hall of Brgy.

text: Calaparan, Arevalo, Iloilo City.
english: Calaparan, Arevalo, Iloilo City.

text: Ginapahayag nga ginpangsukot sang isa ka libo ang mga tag-iya sang motor agud nga magawad ini.
english: The owners of the motorcycle were allegedly charged one thousand pesos to get rid of it.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Antonio Iturraga, Kagawad sang Calaparan, Arevalo, iya ginpahayag nga kagab-i, may ginpatigayon sila nga summer league para sa mga kabataan nga ginhiwat sa barangay hall.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Antonio Iturraga, Kagawad of Calaparan, Arevalo, said that last night, they conducted a summer league for children held at the barangay hall.

text: Suno kay Iturraga, may mga nagtambong sa kahiwatan kag may mga nagdala man sang ila motorsiklo kag didto gin-park sa nasambit nga lugar.
english: According to Iturraga, some people attended the event and some brought their motorcycles and parked them in the area.

text: Paathag sini, may nakabutang na nga daan nga senyales nga ‘No Parking’ kag kon magalapas, may multa nga P1,000.
english: He explained that there is already a sign that says 'No Parking' and if you violate it, there will be a fine of P1,000.

text: Depensa sang mga tag-iya sang motorsiklo, makadali lamang sila nga nag-park kag tumalagsahon lamang ang amo nga aktibidad sa ila barangay.
english: The motorcycle owners defended that they only parked for a short time and that the activity was unusual in their barangay.

text: Sang nagpadulong naman ang kagawad sa balay sang ginpahamtangan sang mga motor, tatlo na lang ang ila naabtan kag ang iban ang natigayon nga mapaguwa kasunod sang istoryahanay.
english: When the kagawad went to the house where the motorcycles were parked, they found only three of them and the others were able to get out after a conversation.

text: Pahayag sang tag-iya sang balay, bangud sa magamay ang space sa dalan, may tion nga nagasgasan ang iya salakyan bangud sa mga naga-park sa atubang sang iya balay rason nga ginbutangan sini sang no parking sign.
english: According to the owner of the house, because of the small space on the road, sometimes his vehicle gets scratched because of those who park in front of his house so he put a no parking sign.

text: Matapos nga nakuha na ang tanan nga motor, may isa naman nga nabilin kon sa diin, may komprontasyon pa nga natabo.
english: After all the motorcycles were recovered, there was another one left where, there was a confrontation.

text: Natigayon naman ini nga nakuha sang tag-iya sang motor matapos nga gin-istorya sang isa pa ka barangay kagawad.
english: The owner of the motorcycle was able to recover it after being talked to by another barangay kagawad.

text: Dapat bantayan ang mga pagbag-o nga ipatuman sa Dinagyang Festival 2020-360 degrees.
english: The changes to be implemented in the Dinagyang Festival 2020-360 degrees should be monitored.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Elvert Bañares, chairman sang Committee on Judges kag Committee on Souvenir, kag member sang Artistic Committee sang Dinagyang 2020, iya ginpahayag nga ila igabalik ang daan nga Dinagyang nga selebrasyon sang komunidad kag sang pumuluyo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Elvert Bañares, chairman of the Committee on Judges and Committee on Souvenir, and member of the Artistic Committee of Dinagyang 2020, said they will bring back the old Dinagyang celebration of the community and the people.

text: Suno kay Bañares, ang arena presentation nga ipatuman subong nga Dinagyang sa performance sang mga tribu ang magahatag sang 360 degrees ukon kabilugan nga view sang mga tribu.
english: According to Bañares, the arena presentation to be implemented this Dinagyang on the performance of the tribes will provide a 360 degrees or overall view of the tribes.

text: Ginpahayag ni Bañares nga mangin kaangay ini sang street festival sa diin makit-an sang tumalan-aw ang performance sa tanan nga anggulo.
english: Bañares said it will be like a street festival where the audience can see the performance from all angles.

text: Dumilian man ang dalagko nga mga panel apang mahimo naman maggamit sang risers apang kinahanglan nga indi ini magtabon sa audience.
english: Large panels are also prohibited but risers may be used but must not cover the audience.

text: Iga-introduce man ang award para sa best Production Designer nga labing -una nga ihatag sa maragtas sang Dinagyang agud kilalahon ang abilidad sang mga tawo sa likod sang matahum nga mga production designs sang tribu.
english: The award for best Production Designer will also be introduced for the first time in the history of Dinagyang to recognize the skills of the people behind the beautiful production designs of the tribe.

text: Sa bahin naman sang Dagyang sa Calle Real nga amo ang nagbulos sa Kasadyahan Festival nga ginsaylo na sa Iloilo Charter day Celebration kada Agusto, may award nga Darling of the Crowd sa tribu nga makabaton sang  pinakamatunog nga palakpak gikan sa tumalan-aw.
english: As for the Dagyang in Calle Real, which replaced the Kasadyahan Festival which was moved to the Iloilo Charter Day Celebration every August, there is an award for Darling of the Crowd for the tribe that receives the loudest applause from the audience.

text: Napasakaan na sang kaso ang suspek sa ginaalegar ikaduha nga assassination attempt batok kay anay United States President Donald Trump.
english: The suspect has been charged in the alleged second assassination attempt against former United States President Donald Trump.

text: Ginkilala ang suspek kay Ryan Routh, 58, tumandok sang North Carolina apang naka-istar sang damlag lang sa Hawaii.
english: The suspect was identified as Ryan Routh, 58, a native of North Carolina but who had recently lived in Hawaii.

text: Dies minutos ang ginlawig sang court appearance kun sa diin nakit-an pa ini nga nagayuhom-yuhom kag nagakadlaw.
english: The court appearance lasted 10 minutes and he was seen smiling and laughing.

text:
Duha ka kaso ang ginpasaka nga amo ang “possession of a firearm by a convicted felon” kag “possession of a firearm with an obstructed serial number.”

Posible pa madugangan ini nga mga kaso.
english:
Two charges were filed, namely “possession of a firearm by a convicted felon” and “possession of a firearm with an obstructed serial number.”

These cases are likely to increase.

text: Sa masunod nga Lunes gin-set ang isa pa ka hearing.
english: Another hearing was set for the following Monday.

text: Matandaan nga nagahampang si Trump sang golf sa iya club sa West Palm Beach sa Florida sang alas dos sang hapon sang Domingo (oras sa state) sang may nakit-an ang Secret Service agent nga may rifle barrel sa kahilamunan kag nakatutok sa former president.
english: Trump was playing golf at his club in West Palm Beach, Florida, at 2 pm on Sunday (state time) when a Secret Service agent spotted a rifle barrel in the grass and pointed at the former president.

text: Nagpalupok ang agent sa direksyon sang lalaki kag ginaalegar nga gilayon ini nga nagpalagyo apang nadakpan man sang mga agent sa major highway halos isa ka oras ang nakaligad.
english: The agent fired in the direction of the man and he allegedly immediately fled but was also apprehended by agents on the major highway nearly an hour later.

text: Nakit-an sang FBI sa lugar nga gintiniran sang suspek ang isa ka rifle, scope, duha ka backpacks, kag isa ka GoPro camera.
english: The FBI found a rifle, scope, two backpacks, and a GoPro camera at the suspect's residence.

text: Base sa court documents, 12 ka oras pa ini nga nagpanago sa amo nga lugar antes na-detect sang Secret Agent.
english: According to court documents, he hid in the area for 12 hours before being detected by the Secret Agent.

text: Sa record sa korte, nakit-an man nga may masobra na 100 ka criminal counts nga na-file anay batok sa suspek sa North Carolina.
english: Court records also show that there are more than 100 criminal counts previously filed against the suspect in North Carolina.

text: Bangud sang natabo, mas nagatunog subong ang panawagan nga hatagan sang dugang nga proteksyon ang presidential candidates sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Because of the incident, the call for more protection for presidential candidates in the United States of America is now louder.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni US President Joe Biden nga posible nga nagakinahanglan sang dugang nga bulig ukon extra nga personnel ang Secret Service.
english: US President Joe Biden said the Secret Service may need additional assistance or extra personnel.

text: Wala ginpatapos ni former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Secretary Manuel “Manny” Bonoan ang hearing sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee kaangot sa ma-anomaliya nga flood control projects.
english: Former DPWH Secretary Manuel “Manny” Bonoan did not finish the hearing of the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee on anomalous flood control projects.

text: Personal siya nga nagtambong sa ikaduha nga hearing sang panel, apang naghimo siya sang manipestasyon kun mahimo siya i-excuse bangud indi na siya ang tiglikom sang ahensya kasunod sang iya resignation nga epektibo subong nga Septyembre 1.
english: He personally attended the second hearing of the panel, but he made a demonstration if he could be excused because he is no longer the secretary of the agency following his resignation effective September 1.

text: “In view of this circumstance, Your Honor, that effective today, September 1, since I am no longer the secretary of Public Works and Highways and I don’t have the official capacity to represent the department, that I may be excused on the proceedings at this point in time,” pahayag sini kay panel chairperson Rodante Marcoleta.
english: “In view of this circumstance, Your Honor, that effective today, September 1, since I am no longer the secretary of Public Works and Highways and I don’t have the official capacity to represent the department, that I may be excused on the proceedings at this point in time,” it told panel chairperson Rodante Marcoleta.

text: Gin-grant ni Marcoleta ang hingyo ni Bonoan apang ginsiguro man nga may magahambal para sa department kun may palamangkutanon ang mga senador.
english: Marcoleta granted Bonoan's request but also assured that someone would speak for the department if the senators had any questions.

text: “Your Honor, the people that had been invited from the Department are all here,” dugang sini.
english: “Your Honour, the people that had been invited from the Department are all here,” it added.

text: Kahapon, Agusto 31, gin-anunsyo sang Malacañang ang pag-resign ni Bonoan sa tunga sang mga eskandalo sang kurapsyon sa ahensya partikular na sa flood control projects.
english: Yesterday, August 31, Malacañang announced Bonoan's resignation amid corruption scandals in the agency particularly in flood control projects.

text: Si Vince Dizon nga amo anay ang tiglikom sang Department of Transportation (DOTr) amo ang nagbulos sa iya sa posisyon.#
english: Vince Dizon, former secretary of the Department of Transportation (DOTr), succeeded him.

text: Bukas si four-division world champion Nonito Donaire Jr.
english: Tomorrow four-division world champion Nonito Donaire Jr.

text: sa ideya nga ipusta ang iya WBC world bantamweight title batuk kay IBF world super flyweight champion Jerwin Ancajas.
english: on the idea of ​​betting his WBC world bantamweight title against IBF world super flyweight champion Jerwin Ancajas.

text: Ang long-time 115-pounder nga si Ancajas ang nagpabutyag naman sadto nga luyag sini nga makapataas pa sa bantamweight division.
english: Long-time 115-pounder Ancajas has previously expressed his desire to move up the bantamweight division.

text: Suno kay Ancajas, luyag niya nga makasambuwa sa sulod sang boxing ring sanday John Riel Casimero kag Donaire para sa ila tagsa ka mga world titles kun hatagan siya sang kahigayunan.
english: Ancajas said he would like to fight inside the boxing ring with John Riel Casimero and Donaire for their respective world titles if he is given the opportunity.

text: Wala naman sang problema diri si Donaire sa diin win-win situation ini para sa iya apang sa subong, ang goal niya amo nga i-unify ang world titles sa 118 pounds.
english: Donaire has no problem here as it is a win-win situation for him but for now, his goal is to unify the world titles at 118 pounds.

text: Hayag-hayagan nga ginpakita ni anay US Donald Trump ang iya kaugot sa American pop superstar nga si Taylor Swift.
english: Former US Donald Trump has openly expressed his anger at American pop superstar Taylor Swift.

text: Gin-post sang former president ang mga tinaga nga “I HATE TAYLOR SWIFT!”, all caps, sa iya Truth Social platform kag wala na sang gindugang nga komentaryo ukon anuman nga paathag.
english: The former president posted the words “I HATE TAYLOR SWIFT!”, all caps, on her Truth Social platform and added no commentary or any explanation.

text: Klaro ang context para sa kadam-an sa Amerika ilabi na bangud sinemana na lang ang gina-isip antes ang presidential elections.
english: The context is clear for many in America especially since the presidential elections are only weeks away.

text:
Matandaan nga pagkatapos sang debate nanday Trump kag Democrat nga si Vice President Kamala Harris sang nagligad nga semana, nag-post ang superstar singer/songwriter sa Instagram nga magaboto siya kay Harris bangud isa ini ka “steady-handed, gifted leader.”

Pagkatapos sang amo nga post, nakasabat si Trump sa interview sang Fox News nga indi man siya fan sang amo nga singer/

Inadlaw matapos sini, nagsugod na ang Trump campaign sa pagbaligya sang shirts nga “Trump Era Shirt” nga daw kaangay nga gin-ilog ang poster sa billion-dollar grossing “Eras” tour ni Taylor.
english:
It can be recalled that after the debate between Trump and Democrat Vice President Kamala Harris last week, the superstar singer/songwriter posted on Instagram that she would vote for Harris because she is a “steady-handed, gifted leader.”

After the post, Trump responded in a Fox News interview that he was not a fan of the singer.

Days later, the Trump campaign began selling “Trump Era Shirt” shirts that looked like a poster for Taylor’s billion-dollar grossing “Eras” tour.

text: Indi ini ang una nga bes nga may ginsabat si Trump nga celebrity apang ang direkta sini nga atake kay Taylor ang makabig nga dramatic subplot sa election season.
english: This is not the first time Trump has responded to a celebrity but his direct attack on Taylor can be considered a dramatic subplot in the election season.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang endorsement ni Swift kay Harris iya most high-profile political statement nga nahimo bilang isa ka popular nga singer.
english: It turns out that Swift’s endorsement of Harris is her most high-profile political statement ever made as a popular singer.

text: Isa ang pilason matapos maigo sang barangay tanod nga nagpinalupok sang armas sa isa ka namatyan sa Sitio Carig-on, Brgy.
english: One person was injured after being hit by a barangay tanod who fired a gun at a deceased in Sitio Carig-on, Brgy.

text: Agsanayan, Buenavista, Guimaras.
english: Agsanayan, Buenavista, Guimaras.

text: Ang biktima amo si Alyas Micheal, 47, samtang ang suspek naman amo si alyas Merel, 45.
english: The victim was identified as Micheal, 47, while the suspect was identified as Merel,

text: Sa inisyal nga report, nakaangkon sang samad sa tiyan ang biktima.
english: According to initial reports, the victim sustained injuries to his stomach.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Rene Mercado, officer-in-charge sang Buenavista Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagresponde sila sa Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Rene Mercado, officer-in-charge of the Buenavista Municipal Police Station, said they responded to Brgy.

text: Piña Buenavista, Guimaras matapos may nagpangayo sang police assistance, apang sang nakalab-ot ini sila sa Brgy.
english: Piña Buenavista, Guimaras after someone asked for police assistance, but when they reached Brgy.

text: Agsanayan, ginparahan sila sang mga pumuluyo bangud may nagpinalupok sang armas.
english: Agsanayan, they were stopped by residents because someone fired a gun.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon sang kapulisan, yara sa impluwensiya sang makahulubog nga ilimnon ang suspek kun sa diin nagbaisay sila sang iya tiyo kag nagkuha ini sang 38 caliber revolver kag nagpinalupok.
english: According to police investigation, the suspect was under the influence of alcohol when he had an argument with his uncle and he took out a 38 caliber revolver and opened fire.

text:
Nakahunong na sa custodial facility sang Buenavista police ang suspek matapos nadakpan sa hot pursuit operation.#

(Article: Bombo Phauline Pillora)
english:
The suspect is now detained in the custodial facility of Buenavista police after being arrested in a hot pursuit operation.

(Article: Bombo Phauline Pillora)

text: ILOILO – Magasentro sa ila tagsa ka mga adbokasiya ang mga ginkoronahan sa Miss Iloilo Tourism 2019.
english: ILOILO – The crowned Miss Iloilo Tourism 2019 will focus on their respective advocacies.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga Setyembre 21, ginkoronahan sanday: Tsina Jade Chu sang Anilao bilang Miss Iloilo Tourism 2019, Miss Iloilo Heritage 2019 si Jade Jaleco sang Cabatuan, Miss Eco Tourism 2019 si Kristine Graciela Artuz sang Passi City, 1st runner up si Jascha Angela Arengo sang Balasan kag second runner up si Jean Nicole Solinap sang New Lucena.
english: It can be recalled that last September 21, China Jade Chu of Anilao was crowned as Miss Iloilo Tourism 2019, Miss Iloilo Heritage 2019 Jade Jaleco of Cabatuan, Miss Eco Tourism 2019 Kristine Graciela Artuz of Passi City, 1st ru up Jade Balanner and second runner-up Are Balanner of Rungo. Jean Nicole Solinap of New Lucena.

text: Gikan sa 18 ka mga maanyag kag maalam nga mga Ilongga beauty queens, ang lima ang nagpangibabaw agud nga mangin tourism ambassadress sang Iloilo.
english: Out of 18 beautiful and intelligent Ilongga beauty queens, five prevailed to become tourism ambassadors of Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Miss Iloilo Tourism 2019 Tsina Jade Chu, iya ginpahayag nga ang iya adbokasiya amo ang “Protect, Preserve and Pass on”.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Miss Iloilo Tourism 2019 China Jade Chu said her advocacy is “Protect, Preserve and Pass on”.

text: Suno kay Chu, bilang Miss Iloilo Tourism, indi niya luyag nga mangin isa lang ka beauty queen kundi luyag niya nga tutukan ang pagtib-ong kag pagtatap sang turismo kag kultura sang Iloilo agud nga nga mapanubli sang mga ulihing tubo.
english: According to Chu, as Miss Iloilo Tourism, she does not want to be just a beauty queen but she wants to focus on promoting and caring for the tourism and culture of Iloilo so that it can be inherited by the next generation.

text: Ginpahayag sang 20 anyos nga Business Administration graduate nga tuyo niya nga magpakig-angot sa nanari-sari nga grupo ukon organisasyon nga may adbokasiya kasubong sa iya.
english: The 20-year-old Business Administration graduate said he intends to engage with various groups or organizations that have advocacy like his.

text: Sa iya pagserbe bilang tourism ambassadress, ginpahayag ni Chu nga nalakip sa iya mission kag vission amo nga ipakilala sa mga dumuluong ang turismo kag kultura sang Iloilo.
english: In her service as tourism ambassador, Chu said her mission and vision is to introduce Iloilo's tourism and culture to foreigners.

text: Gintapos na ni Spanish basketball great Pau Gasol ang iya 23 ka tuig nga karera sa basketball.
english: Spanish basketball great Pau Gasol has ended his 23-year basketball career.

text: Ang six-time All-Star kag 41 anyos nga si Gasol ang nakadaug sang back-to-back NBA titles upod ang Los Angeles Lakers sang 2009 kag 2010.
english: The six-time All-Star and 41-year-old Gasol won back-to-back NBA titles with the Los Angeles Lakers in 2009 and 2010.

text: Nakahampang man siya kaupod ang Chicago Bulls, San Antonio Spurs, Milwaukee Bucks kag apat ka bulan sa Portland Trail Blazers apang wala nagdugay bangud sa iya naangkon nga injury.
english: He also played with the Chicago Bulls, San Antonio Spurs, Milwaukee Bucks and four months with the Portland Trail Blazers but did not stay long due to injury.

text: Sa international stage, nakadaug siya sang silver medals sa 2008 Beijing Olympics kag 2012 London Olympics kag may bronze medala sa Rio sang 2016.
english: On the international stage, she won silver medals at the 2008 Beijing Olympics and 2012 London Olympics and had a bronze medal in Rio in 2016.

text: Ini ang magluwas pa sa FIBA World Cup gold sang 2006 kag tatlo ka EuroBasket titles.
english: This is in addition to FIBA ​​World Cup gold in 2006 and three EuroBasket titles.

text: Ginahikutar na sang Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) ang pagproseso sang P25.6 billion nga unpaid hospital claims sa pila ka mga ospital sa pungsod.
english: The Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) is already processing P25.6 billion in unpaid hospital claims in several hospitals in the country.

text: Suno kay Dante Gierran, Presidente kag CEO sang health insurer, nagpakig-angot na siya sa mga hospital representatives sa regional level.
english: Dante Gierran, President and CEO of the health insurer, said he has been in touch with hospital representatives at the regional level.

text: Gin-athag sang korporasyon nga ang P6.3 billion nga ginbayad sa 206 ka mga ospital ang nagatumod sa partial payments sang PhilHealth sa idalom sang Debit-Credit Payment Method (DCPM) para sa mga ospital nga may COVID-19 cases sa mga lugar nga gin-identify sang IATF nga kritikal.
english: The corporation explained that the P6.3 billion paid to 206 hospitals refers to PhilHealth's partial payments under the Debit-Credit Payment Method (DCPM) for hospitals with COVID-19 cases in areas identified by the IATF as critical.

text: Nagpasalig man ang PhilHealth nga may yara na sila sang stratehiya nga ginahimo agud nga ma fast track ang nabilin nga claims.
english: PhilHealth also assured that they have a strategy in place to fast track the remaining claims.

text: Gin-isa-isa ni Sarah Discaya sa Senate Blue Ribbon Committee hearing ang iya ginapanag-iyahan nga 28 ka luxury cars kag kun pila ang ila nga mga balor.
english: Sarah Discaya told the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee hearing that she owns 28 luxury cars and how much they are worth.

text: Lakip diri ang isa ka Rolls Royce; isa ka Maybach; 20 ka Bentley; isa ka Benz G63; duha ka Cadillac Escalade SUV; duha ka GMC SUV; kag isa ka Suburban.
english: These include a Rolls Royce; a Maybach; 20 Bentleys; a Benz G63; two Cadillac Escalade SUVs; two GMC SUVs; and a Suburban.

text: Suno sa iya, sang nagligad nga tuig lang niya ginbakal ang Rolls Royce bangud nanamian siya sa dala sini nga payong.
english: He said he only bought the Rolls Royce last year because he liked the umbrella it came with.

text: Sa iya pag-atubang sa upper chamber, ginpahayag ni Discaya nga ang iya tanan nga luxury cars ang naangkon paagi sa duha ka importer-dealers nga amo ang AutoArt Models kag Frebel Enterprises.
english: In his appearance before the upper chamber, Discaya said all his luxury cars were acquired through two importer-dealers, AutoArt Models and Frebel Enterprises.

text: Wala ini nagasanto sa iya nauna nga statement sa isa ka vlog nga masobra sa 40 luxury cars ang yara sa ila kag pila sa ila ang imported.
english: This does not match his earlier statement in a vlog that they have more than 40 luxury cars and several of them are imported.

text: Paathag sini kay Senate President Pro Tempore Jinggoy Estrada, 28 lang ang luxury cars kag may “service cars” nga nakapangalan sa kumpaniya.
english: He explained to Senate President Pro Tempore Jinggoy Estrada that there are only 28 luxury cars and there are “service cars” that are named after the company.

text: Indi man cash basis ang pagbakal sang malahalon nga salakyan suno sa iya kundi installment gid lamang.
english: He said the purchase of expensive vehicles is not cash basis but installment.

text: Si Discaya ang tag-iya sang Alpha and Omega Gen.
english: Discaya is the owner of Alpha and Omega Gen.

text: Contractors and Development Corporation nga nag-ako nga may siyam siya ka construction companies nga naka-secure sang deal sa gobyerno, apang suno sa iya, wala siya sang kahilabtanan sa ghost projects.
english: Contractors and Development Corporation who admitted that he has nine construction companies that have secured deals with the government, but said he has nothing to do with ghost projects.

text: Nahibaluan nga nalakip ang Discaya-linked firms sa 15 contractors nga ginbuyagyag ni President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.
english: Discaya-linked firms are among the 15 contractors revealed by President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.

text: nga nag-corner sang P100 billion ukon 20 percent sang kabilugan nga P545-billion flood control projects sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: which cornered P100 billion or 20 percent of the total P545-billion flood control projects nationwide.

text: Ginsabat ni Defense Secretary Gilberto ‘Gibo’ Teodoro ang mga impormasyon nga ginpalapta sa Chinese social media nga ginlikawan ni Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) chief General Romeo Brawner, Jr.
english: Defense Secretary Gilberto ‘Gibo’ Teodoro responded to information spread on Chinese social media that was avoided by Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) chief General Romeo Brawner, Jr.

text: ang mga pamangkot nga naangot sa China sa dialogue sa Singapore.
english: the questions related to China in the dialogue with Singapore.

text: Suno sa defense official, wala sang high-ranking delegates nga ginpadala ang China, apang nag-send sila sang magapakuno-kuno bilang journalists agud pamangkuton ang mga opisyal sang Pilipinas.
english: According to the defense official, China did not send any high-ranking delegates, but they sent someone posing as journalists to question Philippine officials.

text: “Wala dito ang Tsina.
english: “China is not here.

text: Ayaw nilang magpunta, ngunit may nagpapanggap na journalist na hinahabol kami ni CS [AFP Chief of Staff General Romeo Brawner Jr.].
english: They don't want to go, but there's a journalist pretending to be chasing us with CS [AFP Chief of Staff General Romeo Brawner Jr.].

text: Si CS hindi sumagot sa tanong nila, ako ang nakipagsagutan dahil ang tanong nila pabalagbag tapos ang narrative nila sa WeChat baliktad na,” suno sa tiglikom.
english: CS did not answer their question, I agreed because their question was objectionable and their narrative on WeChat is upside down,” said the secretary.

text: “Yan ang mga gawain ng China dito,” pagklaro ni Teodoro.
english: “That's what China is doing here,” Teodoro clarified.

text: Dugang sini, sang ginpamangkot na siya, nagsabat gid siya ilabi na sang ginpasibangdan ang Pilipinas nga “proxy” lang sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: He added that when he was asked, he answered especially when the Philippines was accused of being a proxy of the United States of America.

text: Pahayag naman sini, kawatan man sang teritoryo ang China.
english: He said China is also a thief of territory.

text: “Nakipagsagutan ako nang matagal….
english: “I’ve been arguing for a long time….

text: Sila [China], magnanakaw ng teritoryo!
english: They [China], steal territory!

text:
Edi, nagsagutan na kami nang nagsagutan.”

Nagpaathag naman si General Brawner kun ngaa wala siya nagsabat sang una siya nga ginpamangkot.
english:
Well, we've already answered.”

General Brawner explained why he did not answer when he was first asked.

text: Pahayag sini, ginbanggaan lang siya kag wala na siya nag-sabat pa bangud nga nagadali sila sa ila nga kaladtuan.
english: He said he was hit and did not respond because they were in a hurry to their destination.

text: Sang nagguwa na ang istorya sa Chinese social media suno sa iya, ginplastar na nga nagapalagyo ang Philippine officials sa mga pamangkot.
english: When the story came out on Chinese social media, he said, it was postulated that Philippine officials were dodging questions.

text: Sal-ot naman ni Teodoro: “Ina-agrabyado nila ang Pilipinas, eh natural, sasagutin ko!” Sa separado nga video, ang intro sa sabat sang tiglikom sa Chinese officer amo ang: “Thank you for the propaganda spiels disguised as questions.” Matunog ini nga ginpalakpakan sang audience.
english: Teodoro added: “They are aggravating the Philippines, naturally, I will answer!” In a separate video, the intro to the secretary’s response to the Chinese officer is: “Thank you for the propaganda spiels disguised as questions.” This was loudly applauded by the audience.

text: Sa amo man nga public forum, nanindugan pa si Teodoro: “I would like to reiterate that the Philippine position on the West Philippine Sea is not a function of Sino-American strategic rivalry.
english: In the same public forum, Teodoro insisted: “I would like to reiterate that the Philippine position on the West Philippine Sea is not a function of Sino-American strategic rivalry.

text:
Instead, it is caused, no doubt, by the overreach of the Chinese Communist Party of which the most glaring evidence is the nine, 10 or 11-line that has absolutely no basis in international law.”

Pahayag naman ni Brawner sa video sang AFP: “Lalaban tayo.
english:
Instead, it is caused, no doubt, by the overreach of the Chinese Communist Party of which the most glaring evidence is the nine, 10 or 11-line that has absolutely no basis in international law.”

Brawner said in an AFP video: “We will fight.

text: Hindi tayo papayag na api-apihin!”#
english: We will not allow ourselves to be oppressed!”#

text: Nakabaton sang “unqualified opinion” ukon pinakataas nga audit rating ang Department of Tourism (DOT) halin sa Commission on Audit (COA).
english: The Department of Tourism (DOT) received an “unqualified opinion” or the highest audit rating from the Commission on Audit (COA).

text: Ini ang pinakauna nga kahigayunan nga nakabaton ang DOT sang pinakataas nga COA rating halin sang 2009.
english: This is the first time the DOT has received the top COA rating since 2009.

text: Suno kay Tourism Secretary Bernadette Romulo Puyat, nagapati siya nga ini ang kasunod man sang effort sang ila ahensya sa pag-manage sang maid-id sa limitado nga financial resources.
english: According to Tourism Secretary Bernadette Romulo Puyat, she believes that this is also the effort of their agency to manage the limited financial resources.

text: Sang Disyembre 2019, nakabaton man ang DOT sang mataas nga rating halin sa commission bangud sa ila transparent nga financial statements.
english: In December 2019, the DOT also received a high rating from the commission for its transparent financial statements.

text: Pahayag ni Puyat, ginatinguhaan nila ang fair ukon patas nga pagsunod sa layi kag ginapasalig nila nga ipabilin ang matinlo nga rekord sang DOT.
english: Puyat said they strive for fair compliance with the law and promise to maintain a clean record of the DOT.

text: Nadiskubrehan kag naaresto sang Polish security services ang isa ka grupo sang ginabanta 10 ka mga indibidwal nga sa likod sang plano nga pagsabotahe sa gobyerno sang Poland.
english: Polish security services have discovered and arrested a group of approximately 10 individuals behind a plot to sabotage the Polish government.

text: Suno kay Bombo Neva Intrepido Kessler, international correspondent sa Poland, ang magkaalyado nga Russia kag Belarus ang ginatudlo sa likod sang naaresto nga grupo nga tuyo nga i-destabilise ang Poland.
english: According to Bombo Neva Intrepido Kessler, international correspondent in Poland, allies Russia and Belarus are allegedly behind the arrested group that aims to destabilize Poland.

text: Pila ka beses na nga ginaakusahan sang Warsaw ang Moscow sa tuyo nga pagsabotahe sa Poland bangud sa papel sini sa pag-supply sang military aid sa Ukraine, apang ini nga alegasyon ang ginapanginwala naman sang Russia.
english: Warsaw has repeatedly accused Moscow of deliberately sabotaging Poland for its role in supplying military aid to Ukraine, but this allegation has been denied by Russia.

text: Ginpahayag ni Kessler nga ini nga mga manugsabotahe nga naga-operate sa Belarus nga may kooperasyon sa Russia, ang nag-penetrate sang local kag central government institutions, kalakip na ang state-owned companies nga nagapatuman sang military contracts.
english: Kessler said these saboteurs, operating in Belarus with cooperation from Russia, have penetrated local and central government institutions, including state-owned companies executing military contracts.

text: Dugang niya, mayor nga katuyuan sang grupo amo ang mag- extort sang impormasyon agud mag-blackmail sa mga indibidwal kag institusyon kag maglunsar sang de facto cyberwar.
english: He added that the main objective of the group is to extort information to blackmail individuals and institutions and launch a de facto cyberwar.

text: Una na gintuad sang Polish government nga nag-doble ang cyberattacks humalin sang 2023 nga naga-target sang Polish organisations kag institutions, kalakip na ang logistics companies nga nagadumala sang miilitary deliveries sa Ukraine.
english: The Polish government has previously admitted that cyberattacks have doubled since 2023 targeting Polish organizations and institutions, including logistics companies handling military deliveries to Ukraine.

text: ILOILO CITY – 18 ka mga maanyag kag maalam nga Ilongga beauty queen ang maga-agaway sa tatlo ka korona sa grand coronation night sang Miss Iloilo Tourism 2019.
english: ILOILO CITY – 18 beautiful and talented Ilongga beauty queens will compete for three crowns at the grand coronation night of Miss Iloilo Tourism 2019.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Jose Patubo, Tourism Officer sang San Enrique, Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga ang coronation night sang Miss Iloilo Tourism 2019 ang patigayunon sa Setyembre 23 sa isa ka mall sa Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Jose Patubo, Tourism Officer of San Enrique, Iloilo, said the coronation night of Miss Iloilo Tourism 2019 will be held on September 23 at a mall in Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text: Suno kay Dr. Patubo, may yara sang ticket sa coronation night apang mangin libre naman ang talent kag advocacy campaign competition nga patigayunon sa Setyembre 18.
english: According to Dr. Patubo said there will be tickets for the coronation night but the talent and advocacy campaign competition will be free on September 18.

text: Sa patigayunon nga coronation night, lima ang makakuha sang award nga ginalakipan sang Miss Iloilo Tourism, Miss Iloilo Eco Tourism, Miss Iloilo Heritage kag duha ka runners-up.
english: At the coronation night, five contestants will win the award including Miss Iloilo Tourism, Miss Iloilo Eco Tourism, Miss Iloilo Heritage and two runners-up.

text: Ang mga makakuha sang korona ang magaserbe nga Tourism Ambassadress sang Iloilo.
english: The winners will serve as Tourism Ambassadors of Iloilo.

text: Ang tagsa ka mga beauty queen nga nagpasakop sa nasambit nga pageant ang naghalin sa nagkalain-lain nga banwa sa probinsya sang Iloilo nga may yara sang tagsa ka tourism advocacy.
english: Each of the beauty queens who participated in the pageant came from different towns in Iloilo province with their own tourism advocacy.

text: Gintukod ang isa ka tracker team agud nga pangitaon kag anum ka dismissed policemen nga ginatudlo nga may kahilabtanan sa pagpangawat sa balay sang isa ka retired teacher sa Imus, Cavite.
english: A tracker team has been formed to track down six dismissed policemen suspected of involvement in the robbery of the house of a retired teacher in Imus, Cavite.

text: Suno kay Col.
english: According to Col.

text: Geovanny Sibalo, chief sang Criminal Investigation and Detection Group-CALABARZON, ang nagabug-os sa team nga maga-ayam sa mga suspek amo ang mga katapo sang CIDG sa pagpanguna ni Lt.
english: Geovanny Sibalo, chief of the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group-CALABARZON, said the team that will hunt down the suspects includes members of the CIDG led by Lt.

text: Col.
english: Col.

text: Mark Jason Gatdula.
english: Mark Jason Gatdula.

text: Gintukod ini nga tracker team matapos wala ginsapak sang anum ang panawagan sang National Police Commission (Napolcom) nga magsungka na lang sa anuman nga law enforcement unit.
english: The tracker team was formed after the six ignored the call of the National Police Commission (Napolcom) to surrender to any law enforcement unit.

text: Gindugang naman sang CIDG nga dapat tahuron sang anum ka mga pulis ang order sang korte agud nga magamit nila ang ila nga constitutional right to due process.
english: The CIDG added that the six policemen must respect the court order so that they can exercise their constitutional right to due process.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginpangalanan man sang PNP ang mga gina-alegar kawatan nga amo sanday dismissed staff sergeants Jesus Alday, Julius Barbon kag Emil Buna; corporals Jenerald Cadiang kag Lew Amando Antonio, kag patrolmen Reymel Czar Reyes kag Rene Mendoza sang Imus police.
english: The PNP also named the alleged thieves as dismissed staff sergeants Jesus Alday, Julius Barbon and Emil Buna; corporals General Cadiang and Lew Amando Antonio, and patrolmen Reymel Czar Reyes and Rene Mendoza of Imus police.

text: Wala na sang iban nga choice ang mga Filipino-Chinese businessmen sa National Capital Region (NCR) kundi suportahan ang ipatuman nga lockdown apisar piangon sini liwat ang mga negosyo sa rehiyon.
english: Filipino-Chinese businessmen in the National Capital Region (NCR) have no choice but to support the lockdown even though it will cripple businesses in the region again.

text: Suno sa Federation Of Filipino Chinese Chambers Of Commerce and Industry Incorporated, suportahan sang ila grupo ang lockdown measure bangud paagi ini agud matapna ang paglapta sang mas makalalaton nga COVID-19 Delta variant.
english: According to the Federation of Filipino Chinese Chambers of Commerce and Industry Incorporated, their group supports the lockdown measure because it is a way to prevent the spread of the more contagious COVID-19 Delta variant.

text: Suno sa presidente sang grupo nga si Henry Lim Bon Liong, ginapakamalaot man sila sang iban nga mga negosyante bangud sa ila panindugan apang wala naman sila sang iban nga option.
english: According to the president of the group, Henry Lim Bon Liong, they are also criticized by other businessmen for their stand but they have no other option.

text: Nagalaum ang natungdan nga duha lang ka semana ang ilawig sang lockdown agud nga makabalik man sila sa trabaho.
english: He hopes that the lockdown will last only two weeks so that they can return to work.

text: Santo sa gin-aprubahan ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte, Agusto 6 tubtub 20 ang lockdown sa NCR.
english: As approved by President Rodrigo Duterte, the lockdown in the NCR will last from August 6 to 20.

text: Gindala na nanday anay US President Donald Trump kag Vice President Kamala Harris ang ila presidential campaigns sa battleground states sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Former US President Donald Trump and Vice President Kamala Harris have taken their presidential campaigns to battleground states in the United States of America.

text: Ang 78-anyos nga Republican leader ang naghiwat sang rally sa Nevada kun sa diin nagtutok ini sa problema sa ekonomiya lakip na ang inflation.
english: The 78-year-old Republican leader held a rally in Nevada where he focused on economic problems including inflation.

text: Ang 59-anyos naman nga Democrat candidate nga si Harris ang nagkadto sa Pennsylvania nga amo ang ginakabig nga pinaka-crucial nga swing state nga amo ang ginalantaw nga maga-determina sang winner sa presidential elections.
english: The 59-year-old Democrat candidate, Harris, went to Pennsylvania, which is considered the most crucial swing state that is expected to determine the winner of the presidential election.

text: May ginhanda man nga taped interview sa Democratic vice president sa Philadelphia nga amo ang pinakadaku nga syudad sa amo nga state.
english: A taped interview with the Democratic vice president was also prepared in Philadelphia, the state's largest city.

text: Pito ka semana na lang ang nabilin antes ang eleksyon.
english: There are only seven weeks left before the election.

text: Matandaan nga pareho nga nagdeklarar sang kadalag-an ang kampo nanday Trump kag Harris matapos ang ila una nga 90-minute debate sa ABC News sa Philadelphia.
english: Both the Trump and Harris camps declared victory after their first 90-minute debate on ABC News in Philadelphia.

text: Pagkatapos sang amo nga debate, nagpangindi na si Trump sa isa pa ka hugnat kag nagpahayag nga dapat magtutok na lang si Harris sa iya trabaho bilang vice president, samtang nagsabat naman si Harris nga may salabton sila sa publiko nga isa pa gid ka presidential debate.
english: After that debate, Trump refused another round and said Harris should focus on her job as vice president, while Harris responded that they have a public responsibility for another presidential debate.

text: Gin-cite in contempt sang Senate blue ribbon committee ang mga kontraktor nga una na nga gin-subpoena apang wala nagtambong sa hearing subong nga adlaw, Septyembre 1.
english: The Senate blue ribbon committee cited in contempt the contractors who were previously subpoenaed but failed to attend today’s hearing, Sept. 1.

text: Nag-mosyon si Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa kag ginsegundahan naman ni Senate President Pro Tempore Jinggoy Estrada.
english: Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa made the motion and it was seconded by Senate President Pro Tempore Jinggoy Estrada.

text: Gin-aprubahan naman ni panel chairperson Senator Rodante Marcoleta ang motion bilang preparasyon sa posible ipaguwa nga nga warrant of arrest.
english: Panel chairperson Senator Rodante Marcoleta approved the motion in preparation for the possible issuance of a warrant of arrest.

text: Agusto 22 pa ginpadala ang subpoena sa mga head sang construction companies nga wala nagkadto sa initial public hearing.
english: The subpoena was sent on August 22 to the heads of construction companies who did not attend the initial public hearing.

text: Pila ka mga presidente kag tag-iya sang construction companies ang na-late sa hearing kag nag-abot lang sang naaprubahan na ang mosyon nga i-contempt sila.
english: Several presidents and owners of construction companies were late for the hearing and only arrived when the motion to contempt them was approved.

text: Nagtakop nga hearing nga ang wala pisikal nga nakatambong amo si Hi-Tone Construction & Development Corp.

text: Yara man nagtambong si former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) secretary Manuel Bonoan, apang sang ulihi na-request ini nga indi na pagpatapuson bangud nag-resign naman siya sa posisyon.
english: Former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) secretary Manuel Bonoan was also present, but was later requested not to be terminated because he resigned from the position.

text: Nagapangita na sang dugang nga pondo ang Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) para sa assistance nga ihatag sa mga mamumugon nga maapektuhan sang duha ka semana nga pagpaidalom sa enhanced community quarantine (ECQ) sa Metro Manila, umpisa Agosto 6.
english: The Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) is seeking additional funds for assistance to be given to workers who will be affected by the two-week enhanced community quarantine (ECQ) in Metro Manila, starting August 6.
