text: Suno kay Labor Undersecretary Benjo Santos Benavidez, wala pa natumod sang ahensya kun magahingyo sila sang dugang nga pondo sa Department of Budget and Management ukon gamiton na lamang ang ila nabilin nga fund.
english: Labor Undersecretary Benjo Santos Benavidez said the agency has not yet determined whether they will request additional funds from the Department of Budget and Management or use their remaining funds.

text: Nahibaluan nga i-paidalom sa pinaka-istrikto nga quarantine status ang Manila kasunod sang presensya sang pila ka COVID-19 Delta variant nga yara na sa pungsod.
english: Manila will be placed under the strictest quarantine status following the presence of several COVID-19 Delta variants already in the country.

text: Una na ginpahayag ni Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Kendrick Chua nga kada semana nga yara sa ECQ ang National Capital Region— ang sentro sang ekonomiya sang pungsod, ginabanta nagadangat sa kapin P105 billion ang economic loss katumbas sang 444,000 job loss.
english: Earlier, Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Kendrick Chua said that every week that the National Capital Region - the country's economic center - is under ECQ, the economic loss is estimated at more than P105 billion equivalent to 444,000 job losses.

text: Nagpagwa sang pila ka mga rekomendasyon ang Iloilo City Health Office (ICHO) agud malikawan ang paglapta sang monkeypox ukon mpox sa syudad, kasunod sang pagtaas sang kaso sini.
english: The Iloilo City Health Office (ICHO) has issued several recommendations to prevent the spread of monkeypox or mpox in the city, following the increase in cases.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Mary Ann Diaz, head sang Iloilo City Health Office, iya ginpahayag nga kinahanglan magpabilin nga alerto ang publiko kag mag-obserbar sang mga health protocols pareho sang pagdistansya sa iban, regular nga pag-disinfect, kag pagsuksok sang face mask, ilabi na sa matawo nga lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Mary Ann Diaz, head of the Iloilo City Health Office, said the public should remain alert and observe health protocols such as social distancing, regular disinfection, and wearing face masks, especially in public places.

text: Madumduman nga nadugangan sang tatlo ang kaso sang mpox sa syudad, kun sa diin duha ang makabig nga new cases kag isa ang anay positibo sa resulta sang test nagligad nga semana.
english: It can be recalled that there were three new cases of mpox in the city, with two new cases and one previously positive last week.

text: Bangud sini, ginaengganyo sang City Health Office ang publiko nga kun may nabatyagan nga mga sintomas sang monkeypox pareho sang hilanat, rashes, kag kasakit sang lawas, dapat gilayon magpa-test sa mga health centers agud matapna kag malikawan ang dugang nga paglapta.
english: The City Health Office urges the public to get tested immediately at health centers if they experience symptoms of monkeypox such as fever, rashes, and body aches to prevent further spread.

text: Sa subong, padayon ang pagpanghanda sang lokal nga gobyerno sang Iloilo City kag ang CHO sa mga tikang batok sa mpox, lakip na ang impormasyon kag pag-educate sa publiko tuhoy sa balatian.
english: Currently, the local government of Iloilo City and the CHO are continuing to prepare for measures against mpox, including information and education of the public about the disease.

text: Ginapahanumdom man sang ICHO nga importante ang kooperasyon sang tanan sa pagsunod sa mga patakaran kag pag-report sang mga sintomas agud maprotektahan ang komunidad.
english: The ICHO also reminds that the cooperation of everyone is important in following the rules and reporting symptoms in order to protect the community.

text: Nagsuprer sang duha ka asud-asud nga pagkalutos ang Gilas Pilipinas Women matapos ginpierde sang world No.
english: Gilas Pilipinas Women suffered two consecutive defeats after being defeated by world No.

text: 3 nga Australia sa 2021 FIBA Women’s Asia Cup sa Amman, Jordan.
english: 3 Australia at the 2021 FIBA ​​Women’s Asia Cup in Amman, Jordan.

text: Nagtapos ang hampang sa score nga 120-56 pabor sa Australia.
english: The match ended with a score of 120-56 in favor of Australia.

text: Sang Lunes, ginlutos man sang world No.
english: On Monday, he also defeated world No.

text: 7 nga China ang Gilas Women sa score nga 143-52.
english: 7 China the Gilas Women with a score of 143-52.

text: Buwas sa gab-i, makasumpong sang Gilas Women ang Chinese Taipei.
english: Tomorrow night, Chinese Taipei will face the Gilas Women.

text: Kinahanglan nila nga maka-secure sang isa ka daug sa ila nga grupo agud malikawan ang relegation match batok sa lowest-ranked team sa pihak nga grupo sang tournament.
english: They need to secure a win in their group to avoid a relegation match against the lowest-ranked team in the other group of the tournament.

text: CAGAYAN DE ORO – Mixed emotions ang nabatyagan sang isa ka registerned nurse kag composer matapos nalakip sa Top 12 finalist sang Bombo Music Festival 2020.
english: CAGAYAN DE ORO – A registered nurse and composer felt mixed emotions after being included in the Top 12 finalists of the Bombo Music Festival 2020.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Winset Rose Jacot sang Lumbia, Cagayan De Oro, iya ginpahayag nga nagasamo ang kasadya kag kalangkag nga iya nabatyagan sang nahibalu-an nga liwat siya nga nalakip sa Top 12 finalist sang Bombo Music Festival.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Winset Rose Jacot of Lumbia, Cagayan De Oro, said she felt a mixture of joy and excitement when she learned that she was again included in the Top 12 finalist of the Bombo Music Festival.

text: Suno kay Jacot nga composer sang “Kung Mahal Mo Siya”, ang tema sang ambahanon amo ang tuhoy sa paghigugma sa isa ka tawo nga may yara man sang ginapalangga nga iban.
english: According to Jacot, the composer of “Kung Mahal Mo Siya”, the theme of the song is about loving someone who also loves someone else.

text: Ginpahayag ni Jacot nga ang nasambit nga istorya ang makabig nga “common” bangud nga ini ang nagakatabo sa matuod nga kabuhi.
english: Jacot said the story is considered “common” because it happens in real life.

text: Nadugangan pa gid ang kalangkag ni Jacot sa nagahilapit nga finals night bangud nga finalist man ang iya utod.
english: Jacot's excitement for the upcoming finals night increased because his brother was also a finalist.

text: Ginkahidlawan man sang natungdan ang pagbisita sa Iloilo, ang pagka maabi-abihon sang mga Ilonggo kag luyag man niya matilawan ang mga bantog nga Ilonggo cuisine.
english: He also missed visiting Iloilo, the hospitality of the Ilonggos and wanted to taste the famous Ilonggo cuisine.

text: Si Jacot ang composer kag interpreter sang “Pagod Na Akong Makihati” nga isa man sa finalist sa Bombo Music Festival 2020.
english: Jacot is the composer and interpreter of “Pagod Na Akong Makihati” which is also one of the finalists in the Bombo Music Festival 2020.

text: Masobra 200 ka mga preso ang napapauli na sa Russia kag Ukraine matapos nagsugtanay ang duha ka pungsod nga magpatigayon sang swap ukon bayluhanay sang prisoners of war.
english: More than 200 prisoners have been repatriated to Russia and Ukraine after the two countries agreed to conduct a swap of prisoners of war.

text: May tag-103 ka mga preso halin sa magtimbang nga bahin ang nadala sa amo nga deal.
english: A total of 103 inmates from both sides were involved in the deal.

text: Sa Kyiv, suno kay President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, ang 103 Ukrainians nga napapauli ang lunsay halin sa military kun sa diin 82 ang soldado kag privates samtang 21 naman ang officers.
english: In Kyiv, according to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, the 103 Ukrainians being repatriated are all from the military, of which 82 are soldiers and privates while 21 are officers.

text: Sa Moscow naman, gin-report sang Russian Defence Ministry nga lunsay Russian soldiers ang 103 nga amo anay ang gin-preso sa border nga Kursk region kun sa diin nagpatigayon ang Ukrainian forces sang surprise incursion sang nagligad nga Agusto.
english: In Moscow, the Russian Defense Ministry reported that all 103 soldiers were Russian soldiers who were previously detained in the border Kursk region where Ukrainian forces conducted a surprise incursion last August.

text: Ini nga bayluhanay sang mga preso ang ginpatung-an sang United Arab Emirates.
english: This prisoner swap was brokered by the United Arab Emirates.

text: Ini na ang ika-walo nga mediation nga nahimo sang amo nga Arab nation subong nga tuig.
english: This is the eighth mediation conducted by the Arab nation this year.

text: Nahibaluan nga madamo nga beses na nga nagsugtanay ang Russia kag Ukraine sa prisoner swap halin sang nag-invade ang Moscow sang Pebrero 2022.
english: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to prisoner swaps multiple times since Moscow’s February 2022 invasion.

text: Ang natabo sang weekend amo na ang ikatatlo halin sang ginpatigayon sang Kyiv ang cross-border incursion sa Kursk region sang Agusto.
english: What happened over the weekend was the third since Kyiv conducted a cross-border incursion into the Kursk region in August.

text: Handa na ang national basketball team sang Pilipinas nga atubangon ang mga matag-as nga mga basketball players sang iban nga pungsod sa 2021 FIBA Women’s Asia Cup bwas sa Amman, Jordan.
english: The Philippine national basketball team is ready to face the top basketball players of other countries in the 2021 FIBA ​​Women’s Asia Cup tomorrow in Amman, Jordan.

text: Ang Gilas Pilipinas women nga may yara sang average height nga 5-foot-8 ang natalana nga mag-atubang sa China, Australia kag Chinese -Taipei.
english: The Gilas Pilipinas women, who have an average height of 5-foot-8, are scheduled to face China, Australia and Chinese-Taipei.

text: Ang Chinese ang may yara sang average height nga 6-foot-1 samtang ang Australians naman ang nagataas sang 5-foot-11.
english: The Chinese have an average height of 6-foot-1 while the Australians are 5-foot-11.

text: Apang indi upang ang height difference suno kay Clare Castro sang Gilas nga nagataas sang 6-foot-4.
english: But the height difference is not an obstacle, according to Clare Castro of the Gilas, who is 6-foot-4.

text: Indi man manigar pahayag niya nga may yara sang pressure sa iya nga bahin ilabi na nga siya lang ang pinakamataas sa ila nga team.
english: He also said that there is pressure on his side especially since he is the only one who is the tallest in their team.

text: Sa pihak sini, excited sa gihapon si Castro para sa tournament.
english: Despite this, Castro is still excited for the tournament.

text: Pila sa mga kaupod ni Castro sa Gilas amo sanday Ann Pingol, Mar Prado kag Ria Nabalan nga lunsay nagataas sang 5-foot-7.
english: Some of Castro’s Gilas teammates include Ann Pingol, Mar Prado and Ria Nabalan, all of whom stand at 5-foot-7.

text: Gani, importante pahayag niya nga likawan ang “unnecessary fouls” samtang ginabantayan ang mga higante nga players halin sa iban nga pungsod.
english: Therefore, he said it is important to avoid “unnecessary fouls” while watching the giant players from other countries.

text: Nagsaka sa 4.3 ang inflation rate ukon ang pagmahal sang mga balaklon sini nga bulan sang Hulyo.
english: The inflation rate rose to 4.3 in July.

text: Suno kay Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor Benjamin Diokno, mas mataas ini ipaanggid sa 4.1 percent nga inflation rate sang tinalikdan nga Hunyo.
english: According to Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor Benjamin Diokno, this is higher compared to the 4.1 percent inflation rate last June.

text: Pahayag ni Diokno, kadam-an sa mga produkto nga may pagtaas sa presyo para sa bulan sang Hulyo amo ang gatong, key food items, kag kuryente.
english: Diokno said most of the products that saw price increases for the month of July were fuel, key food items, and electricity.

text: Suno sa Department of Energy, sini lamang Hulyo, ikatlo ka beses nga ginpataas sang pila ka mga local oil companies ang presyo sang gatong.
english: According to the Department of Energy, this July alone, some local oil companies raised fuel prices for the third time.

text: Gin-updan sang militar ang paglubong sa isa ka Olympian marathon runner nga napatay sang una nga semana nga Septyembre matapos ginsunog sang iya ex-boyfriend.
english: The military accompanied the funeral of an Olympian marathon runner who died in the first week of September after being set on fire by her ex-boyfriend.

text: Ginpatigayon ang military funeral kay Rebecca Cheptegei, 33, sa district of Bukwo nga malapit na sa border sang pungsod sa Kenya.
english: A military funeral was held for Rebecca Cheptegei, 33, in the district of Bukwo, which is close to the country's border with Kenya.

text: Daku ang papel sang militar sa lubong bangud isa anay ka sergeant ang biktima sa Uganda Peoples’ Defence Forces rason nga ginhatagan ini sang “gun salute” kadungan sang pagdul-ong sa iya sa katapusan niya nga palahuwayan.
english: The military played an important role in the funeral as the victim was a former sergeant in the Uganda Peoples' Defense Forces and was given a gun salute while taking him to his final resting place.

text: Magluwas diri, linibo ang nagtambong sa lubong nga ginalakipan sang mga atleta, himata, kag iya mga abyan.
english: Besides, thousands attended the funeral which included athletes, relatives, and his friends.

text: Kilala si Cheptegei nga nagpang-44 anay sa women’s marathon nga iya ginpasakupan sa Paris Summer Games sang nagligad gid lamang nga bulan.
english: Cheptegei is known for finishing 44th in the women's marathon at the Paris Summer Games last month.

text: Natabo ang krimen sa balay sini sa western Trans Nzoia County sa Kenya.
english: The crime took place at his home in western Trans Nzoia County in Kenya.

text: Ginpahayag nga nagkadto sa ila balay ang iya anay boyfriend nga si Dickson Ndiema nga may dala nga gasolina.
english: Her ex-boyfriend, Dickson Ndiema, reportedly came to her house with petrol.

text: Base sa report sang pulis, may nabatian pa nga singgitan ang mga kasilingan bangud sa away sa duta antes ginbubuan sang suspek sang gasolina ang lawas sang babaye kag ginsunog.
english: According to police reports, neighbors heard screams over a land dispute before the suspect poured gasoline on the woman's body and set it on fire.

text: Bangud sa pagkarab-karab sang iya lawas, halos 80% gid ang nasunog kag sini lang nga Myerkules, ginkumpirma sang ospital nga nagsuprer ang biktima sang multi-organ failure nga rason nga ginbawian gid ini sang kabuhi.
english: Due to the burns, almost 80% of his body was burned and on Wednesday, the hospital confirmed that the victim suffered from multi-organ failure which led to his death.

text: Ang suspek naman nga nakaangkon man sang sunog sa 30% nga parte sang iya lawas kag gindala man sa ospital sa syudad sang Eldoret.
english: The suspect, who also sustained burns to 30% of his body, was rushed to the hospital in Eldoret City.

text: Ikatatlo na si Cheptegei nga elite female athlete nga ginpatay sa Kenya sa sulod lamang sang tatlo ka tuig.
english: Cheptegei is the third elite female athlete to be killed in Kenya in just three years.

text: Sang 2021, ginpatay man ang isa ka 25-anyos nga Olympic runner sa iya balay kun sa diin ginhatok-hatok ini sang buno sa iya liog.
english: In 2021, a 25-year-old Olympic runner was also killed in his home where he was stabbed in the neck.

text: Ang iya bana ang ginpasakaan sang kaso nga murder.
english: Her husband was charged with murder.

text: Pila ka bulan lang ang nagligad, isa pa ka 28-anyos nga Kenyan athlete ang nasapwan-patay man sa iya balay, ginapatihan nga ginkuga, kag ang iya boyfriend man ang main suspect.
english: Just a few months later, another 28-year-old Kenyan athlete was found-also dead in her home, believed to have been strangled, and her boyfriend was also the main suspect.

text: Base sa latest figures sa Kenya National Bureau of Statistics nga nabalhag sang January 2023, nakabutang nga 34 percent sang mga babaye sa amo nga pungsod ang naga-eksperyensya sang physical violence halin sa edad nga 15-anyos.#
english: Based on the latest figures in the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics published in January 2023, it states that 34 percent of women in the country experience physical violence from the age of 15-years-old.#

text: Ginrekomenda na ni Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) Chairman Andres Reyes nga ipauntat ang operasyon sang amo nga komisyon subong nga Marso.
english: Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) Chairman Andres Reyes has recommended that the operation of the commission be suspended this March.

text: Suno kay Reyes, nahatag na sang komisyon sa Office of the Ombudsman ang tanan nga mga dokumento nahanungod sa flood control scandal kun sa diin magahatag man sila sang kaangay nga mga papeles sa Department of Justice kag Department of Public Works and Highways.
english: Reyes said the commission has already submitted all documents regarding the flood control scandal to the Office of the Ombudsman and they will also submit similar documents to the Department of Justice and Department of Public Works and Highways.

text: Nagapangabay man si Reyes nga subong nga magatakop na ang ila operasyon sa ICI, mas mangin transparent ang mangin plano kag budget sa mga proyekto sang gobyerno agud nga malikawan ang mga posible nga iregularidad kag korapsyon sa mga ini.
english: Reyes also requested that now that their operation in ICI is coming to an end, the planning and budgeting of government projects will be more transparent in order to avoid possible irregularities and corruption in them.

text: Madumduman nga gintukod ni President Bongbong Marcos ang ICI sang nagligad nga Setyembre 2025 agud nga imbestigaran ang mga gina-alegar nga korapsyon kag iregularidad sa mga flood control kag infrastructure projects sa Pilipinas.
english: It can be recalled that President Bongbong Marcos established the ICI last September 2025 to investigate alleged corruption and irregularities in flood control and infrastructure projects in the Philippines.

text: Lauman ang mixed movements sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo sa masunod nga semana.
english: Expect mixed movements in the price of petroleum products next week.

text:
Suno sa Department of Energy – Oil Industry Management Bureau, kasunod sang tatlo ka adlaw nga monitoring sa Mean of Platts Singapore (MOPS), yari ang posible nga adjustments antes ang Bag-ong Tuig:

Gasolina – posible nga may rollback nga P0.50Diesel – no adjustmentKerosene – posible magsaka sang P0.10

Wala pa nalakip sa sini nga estimates ang operating cost sang oil companies kag iban pa nga premiums.
english:
According to the Department of Energy – Oil Industry Management Bureau, following three days of monitoring on the Mean of Platts Singapore (MOPS), here are the possible adjustments ahead of the New Year:

Gasoline – possible rollback of P0.50Diesel – no adjustmentKerosene – possible increase of P0.10

These estimates do not include the operating cost of oil companies and other premiums.

text: Ang downward pressure ang ginaangot sang ahensya sa global oversupply halin sa non-OPEC economies kaangay sang Estados Unidos.
english: The agency attributes the downward pressure to global oversupply from non-OPEC economies such as the United States.

text: Ginalantaw man ang maluya nga demand bangud sang mahina nga holiday travels kag seasonal industrial demand kag wala kasiguruhan sa geopolitical tensions sa Venezuela, Ukraine kag Russia.
english: Weak demand is also expected due to weak holiday travels and seasonal industrial demand and uncertainty over geopolitical tensions in Venezuela, Ukraine and Russia.

text: Gina-anunsyo sang oil companies ang opisyal nga price adjustment sa kada Lunes kag ginapatuman ini sa kada Martes sang aga.
english: Oil companies announce the official price adjustment every Monday and implement it every Tuesday morning.

text: Nakumpirma nga kabahin sang isa ka advertisement sang isa ka drink company kag indi parte sa iya retirement ang “Second Decision” nga iya una gin-anunsyo.
english: It was confirmed that the “Second Decision” he initially announced was part of an advertisement for a drink company and not about his retirement.

text: Ginbantayan sang basketball fans ang amo nga anunsyo ni James bangud gintawag niya ini sa social media nga “the decision of all decisions”.
english: Basketball fans watched James' announcement as he called it "the decision of all decisions" on social media.

text: Matandaan nga ginhimo man sang basketball icon ini nga marketing strategy sang nagpahayag nga maga-upod siya sa Miami Heat sang Hulyo 2010 nga television special, apang nagguwa nga isa man ka ad reveal.
english: It can be recalled that the basketball icon also used this marketing strategy when he announced that he would join the Miami Heat in a July 2010 television special, but it turned out to be an ad reveal as well.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini na ang pang-23 nga NBA season sang 40-anyos nga four-time NBA Most Valuable Player.
english: This is the 23rd NBA season of the 40-year-old four-time NBA Most Valuable Player.

text: Ini nga 21-time All-Star kag four-time NBA champion ang naga-uyat sang average nga 24.4 points, 7.8 rebounds kag 8.2 assists sang nagligad nga season kag nagpang-anum sa MVP voting.
english: This 21-time All-Star and four-time NBA champion averaged 24.4 points, 7.8 rebounds and 8.2 assists last season and finished sixth in MVP voting.

text: May career average siya nga 27.0 points, 7.5 rebounds kag 7.4 assists.
english: He has career averages of 27.0 points, 7.5 rebounds and 7.4 assists.

text: Siya man ang ginakilala nga all-time NBA leader sa points (42,184) kag minutes nga nakahampang (59,041).
english: He is also recognized as the all-time NBA leader in points (42,184) and minutes played (59,041).

text: Nakahampang siya sa 1,562 games nga amo ang ikaduha sa pinakamataas sa kabug-usan suno kay Robert “the Chief” Parish (1,611).
english: He played in 1,562 games which was second most overall according to Robert “the Chief” Parish (1,611).

text: Lauman ang pag-ulan sa adlaw sang eleksyon suno sa Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) subong nga Domingo sang hapon.
english: Rain is expected on election day, according to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) this Sunday afternoon.

text: Suno sa weather forecast, magapadayon ang epekto sang frontal system kag easterlies nga magadala sang pag-ulan sa nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang pungsod.
english: According to the weather forecast, the impact of the frontal system and easterlies will continue to bring rainfall to various parts of the country.

text: Ang Batanes kag Babuyan Islands ang maka-eksperyensya sang magal-umon nga kalangitan kag lapta- lapta nga pag-ulan nga may dala nga thunderstorms; nga posible tunaan sang flash floods ukon landslides.
english: Batanes and Babuyan Islands will experience cloudy skies and patchy rain with thunderstorms; which could cause flash floods or landslides.

text: Samtang ang Metro Manila kag nabilin nga bahin sang pungsod ang maka-eksperyensya sang medyo magal-umon tubtob magal-umon nga kalangitan nga may panalagsahon nga pag-ulan.
english: Meanwhile, Metro Manila and the rest of the country will experience partly cloudy to mostly cloudy skies with isolated rainshowers.

text: Sa extreme northern Luzon, mabatyagan ang kasarangan nga mabaskog nga hangin kag kasarangan tubtob mabalod nga kadagatan ang mabatyagan sa extreme northern Luzon.
english: In extreme northern Luzon, moderate to strong winds will be felt and moderate to rough seas will be felt in extreme northern Luzon.

text: Sa nabilin nga bahin sang Luzon, Visayas, kag Mindanao, may mahina tubtob kasarangan nga hangin kag medyo nga pagbalud sa kadagatan.
english: In the rest of Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao, light to moderate winds and slight waves will prevail.

text: Nagahingyo ang pila ka mga taxi drivers nga nagabyahe diri sa syudad sang Iloilo kay Mayor Raisa Treñas nga hatagan man sila sang fuel subsidy nga taga-probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Some taxi drivers who travel here in Iloilo City are asking Mayor Raisa Treñas to give them fuel subsidy from Iloilo province.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Roger Aquino, isa ka taxi driver, iya ginpahayag nga bangud sa mabudlay nga sitwasyon sa pagtaas sang gatong, wala na sila naga-roving.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Roger Aquino, a taxi driver, said that due to the difficult situation with the increase in fuel prices, they are no longer roving.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga kun kaisa nagahulat na lang sila sang masobra tatlo ka oras antes sila makakita sang pasahero.
english: He said that sometimes they wait for more than three hours before they find a passenger.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga sang una makakita pa sila sang masobra 1,200 pesos apang subong nga mataas ang presyo sang gatong ang makuha na lang sini sa iya pagbyahe 500 pesos.
english: He said that in the past they could earn more than 1,200 pesos but now that the price of fuel is high, he can only earn 500 pesos for his trip.

text: Nagpangabay man ini sa gobyerno nga kuntani mabuhinan lang ang presyo sang gatong kun indi man madugangan ang pagsaka sang plete para sa ila nga mga taxi drivers.
english: He also urged the government to reduce the price of fuel if not increase the fare for their taxi drivers.

text: Dugang pa sini nga sa kadugayon na sini nga nagabyahe sa syudad sang Iloilo, kuntani hatagan man sila igtalupangod ni Mayor Treñas nga makabaton sang fuel subsidy bangud nagakinahanglan man sila sang bulig halin sa syudad.
english: He added that since they have been traveling in Iloilo City for a long time, Mayor Treñas should also give them attention to receive fuel subsidy because they also need help from the city.

text: PAANO bala ang manugbaligya makabulig sa manugbakal agud makakinot samtang makabaligya man siya sing maayo, labi na gid sa panahon sang pagtinaas sang balaklon katulad subong?
english: HOW can a seller help a buyer save money while selling well, especially in times of inflation like today?

text: Sa masami, kon nagataas ang bili sang iya ginabaligya sa merkado, maabtik itudlo sini ang pagtaas man sang bili sang iya ginakuha nga inugbaligya kag dayon man niya pataas sang presyo sini sa merkado.
english: Often, when the price of what he sells in the market increases, he quickly points out the increase in the price of his goods and then raises the price in the market.

text: Wala siya kuno “choice” kundi bawion ang kakulangan sang iya kita.
english: He said he had no choice but to make up for the shortfall in his income.

text: Malungo-lungo na lang sina ang manugbakal kag mangita sing medyos kon paano mapaigu ang iya dapat baklon.
english: The buyer will then be confused and look for a way to get what he needs to buy.

text: Daw pareho bala nga gin-surrender na niya ang Bataan sa manugbaligya nga wala sang bisan ano nga reklamo.
english: It was as if he had already surrendered Bataan to the seller without any complaints.

text: Ang iban, ugaling, mangakig gid kay wala sila nagapati sa rason sang manugbaligya.
english: Others, however, will become very angry because they do not believe the seller's reason.

text: Nga daan kinaandan nga pagpati sang madamo nga “kon butigon ang (kwan), mas butigon ang (kwan)”, nga sa iban indi man matuod.
english: It is a common belief among many that “if (kwan) is false, (kwan) is more false”, which to others is not true.

text: Nabal-an naman ninyo seguro kon sin-o nga “kwan” ang ginatumod naton.
english: You probably know who “kwan” we are talking about.

text: Of course, mabakal gihapon sila sang ila kinahanglanon although todo kumod na.
english: Of course, they can still buy what they need although it's all fun.

text: Ano bala ang matugda dira sang aton abyan nga si Pedro nga kilala naton nga wais gid sa iya pagpamalaklon sa merkado.
english: What does our friend Pedro, whom we know is very good at shopping at the market, suggest?

text: Sunu kay Pedro dapat wais nga negosyante (sa maayo nga paagi, siyempre) ang manugbaligya agud makabulig man sa manugbakal samtang makaganar gihapon nga wala sing may nagalangod nga manugbakal.
english: According to Pedro, the seller must be a wise businessman (in a good way, of course) in order to help the buyer while still making a profit without the buyer being bothered.

text: Duha dira at least ang paagi.
english: There are at least two ways.

text: Ang isa amo ang pagbaligya lang sing binilog nga makaganyat sa manugbakal nga pigado, ukon isa ukon pila lang ka bilog ang kinahanglan.
english: One is to sell only in bulk that appeals to a poor buyer, or only one or a few bundles are needed.

text: Gani indi bagay nga pinunsok lang ang imo itanyag ibaligya.
english: So it is not appropriate to offer only a handful.

text: Ang matabo amo nga indi ini sila magbakal sa imo, kag wala ka man sing kita sa ila!
english: What will happen is that they will not buy from you, and you will not earn from them either!

text: Ang isa pa ka paagi agud makabulig man sa manugbakal, samtang nagakita gihapon ang manugbaligya, amo ang pagbaligya sing binilog dungan sa pinunsok, nga mabaligya mo sing “wholesale”.
english: Another way to help the buyer, while still making money for the seller, is to sell in bulk at the same time as the bundle, which you can sell wholesale.

text: Tungod sini, samtang may manugbakal ka man nga isa ukon duha lang ang kinahanglan, may pwede man ma-enganyo nga manugbakal nga mabakal dugang sa “wholesale price” nga ma-reserba niya sa sunod nga adlaw.
english: Because of this, while you may have a buyer who only needs one or two items, you can also entice a buyer to buy in addition to the “wholesale price” that he can reserve the next day.

text: Makalibre pa siya sing pamasahe kay indi anay ini makakadto sa merkado.
english: He can get a free fare because he can't go to the market.

text: Por ejemplo lang nga ang isa ka bugkos nga ulutanon nagabili sing P5.
english: For example, a bundle of vegetables costs P5.

text: Pwede ma-engangyo ini nga ibaligya ang tatlo ka bugkos sing tag-P4.90 lang ang isa, nga sa kabug-usan magabili lang tanan sing P14.70, sa lugar nga P15 kon binakal sini sang isa-isa.
english: He can be persuaded to sell the three bundles for only P4.90 each, which will cost only P14.70 in total, instead of P15 if he bought them one by one.

text: Por ejemplo man…By the way si Pedro klasmit ko anay sa high school sa subject nga Basic Spanish kon ngaa siya kahibalo sing “por ejemplo”, ukon “for example” sa English.
english: For example...By the way Pedro was my classmate in high school in the subject of Basic Spanish why he knows “por ejemplo”, or “for example” in English.

text: Ugaling diutay man lang ang nasulod niya sa iya ulo tungod idol niya si Dr. Jose Rizal nga kontra gid ang mga mapintas nga mga Katsila nga nagagahum sadto sa aton pungsod.
english: But he had little in mind because he idolized Dr. Jose Rizal that he was against the cruel Spaniards who ruled our country.

text: Sadto ang official language sang pungsod amo pa ang Filipino, Spanish kag English.
english: The official languages ​​of the country were Filipino, Spanish and English.

text: Sa karon Filipino na lang kag English.
english: Now it's just Filipino and English.

text: Balik kita sa “por ejemplo man”…pwede man magbaligya lang sing kinihad.
english: Let's go back to “for example”...you can just sell a little.

text: Kon magbakal sing mansanas ukon bisan ubas pa, por ejemplo man, pwede isuhestyon ang pagbakal sini sa tunga ukon tunga sang tunga (1/4) ka kilo lang para makabakal ang bisan pigado.
english: If you buy apples or even grapes, for example, you can suggest buying them for half or half a half (1/4) kilo only so that even the poor can buy.

text: Kon kasubong sina ang pagbaligya mo sang imo inugbaligya makabulig ka matuod sa manugbakal.
english: If you sell your product like that, you can really help the buyer.

text: Ginahingyo ta man sa gobyerno nga palaparon ang malab-ut sang pagbaligya sang barato nga Kadiwa goods, kag lab-uton gid ang mga lugar sang mga informal settlers.
english: We also urge the government to expand the reach of the sale of cheap Kadiwa goods, and reach out to the areas of informal settlers.

text:
***

Good to know nga may plano gali ang MERALCO kag Global Business Power Corp.
english:
***

Good to know that MERALCO and Global Business Power Corp. have a plan.

text: sa Lapaz, Iloilo City nga mag-expand sang ila serbisyo sa Visayas, una sa Cebu kag Iloilo.
english: in Lapaz, Iloilo City to expand their services in the Visayas, first in Cebu and Iloilo.

text: This time, agud magpasanyog sang renewable energy projects diri.
english: This time, to promote renewable energy projects here.

text: Nagapangita na gani sila sang matukuran nga “solar farms” para diri.
english: They are even looking to build solar farms for this.

text: Nagasabat ining ila hingyo sa aton problema sa Climate Change kag nagapaseguro pa sang pag-angkon naton sing “sustainable”, ukon wala pagkaubos, nga “energy” halin hydropower, wind kag solar power kag kasubong nga sources.
english: This answers their request to our problem of Climate Change and ensures our access to sustainable energy from hydropower, wind and solar power and similar sources.

text: Mangin ka-kumpetensya pa ini sa pagpanubo sang bili sang kuryente batok sa mga power plants nga ginapadalagan pa sa subong sang fossil fuel sa medyo madugay pa nga panahon kay indi man madale-dale nga dulaon pa ang mga ini.
english: It will be competitive in reducing the cost of electricity against power plants that are still running on fossil fuels in the longer term because they will not be phased out.

text: Tani madayon na sa indi madugay ining plano nila agud lubos na matigayon ang “sustainable energy needs” sang Panay Island para sa talunsay na nga lakat sang ekonomiya sini./PN
english: Hopefully, this plan will be implemented soon to fully meet the sustainable energy needs of Panay Island for the smooth functioning of its economy./PN

text: JORDAN, GUIMARAS – Madamu sang natun-an ang mga mga estudyante sang Jordan National High School sa pagpakigbahin sa Hobon Kawayan.
english: JORDAN, GUIMARAS – The students of Jordan National High School learned a lot from participating in Hobon Kawayan.

text: Ang Hobon Kawayan ang isa ka school organization nga gintukod sang 2014 nga ginabug-usan sang mga estudyante nga nagatukar sang musical instruments nga himu sa kawayan kasubong sang xylophone, angklung kag clarinet.
english: Hobon Kawayan is a school organization established in 2014 that consists of students who play musical instruments made of bamboo such as xylophone, angklung and clarinet.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay John Chino Cudo, nagatukar sang xylophone kag angklung sa Hobon Kawayan, iya ginpahayag nga ginatudlu-an sila sa pagtukar sang nanari-sari nga musical insturments kag amo man sa tanan nga patag sang arts.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, John Chino Cudo, who plays xylophone and angklung at Hobon Kawayan, said they are taught to play various musical instruments as well as all fields of arts.

text: Magluwas diri, ginatudluan man sila sang maayo nga disiplina kag paminatasan.
english: In addition, they are taught good discipline and manners.

text: Samtang, para naman kay Shanira Gallentes, nagatukar sang clarinet kag angklung, paagi sa pagpakigbahin sa nasambit nga organisasyon, natun-an niya ang pagtukar sang nanari-sari nga musical instruments.
english: Meanwhile, for Shanira Gallentes, who plays clarinet and angklung, by participating in the said organization, she learned to play various musical instruments.

text: Ang iya naman nga natun-an suno kay Gallentes ang iya man nga ginapaambit sa mga kasubong niya nga estudyante nga interesado magpakigbahin sa ila organisasyon.
english: Gallentes said he is sharing what he has learned with his fellow students who are interested in joining their organization.

text: Nagpanugyan si Pope Francis sa mga Katoliko sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga magpili na lang sang “lesser evil” sa November presidential elections.
english: Pope Francis has advised Catholics in the United States to choose a “lesser evil” in the November presidential elections.

text: Wala partikular nga ginmensyonar sang Santo Papa ang pangalan nanday anay anay U.S. President Donald Trump sang Republicans kag Vice President Kamala Harris sang Democrats apang ginpahayag sini ang ila polisa kag gender gani nga halangpon man gihapon kun sin-o ang iya ginatumod nga mga kandidato.
english: The Pope did not specifically mention the names of former U.S. President Donald Trump of the Republicans and Vice President Kamala Harris of the Democrats but he revealed their policies and gender so it is still unclear who he is referring to.

text: Wala nanamian si Pope Francis sa duha gid ka kandidato bangud pareho sini nga ginmuno ang plano ni Trump nga pag-deport sang minilyon ka immigrants kag ang suporta naman ni Harris sa kinamatarong sa abortion.
english: Pope Francis did not like both candidates because they both criticized Trump's plan to deport millions of immigrants and Harris' support for abortion rights.

text: Suno sa Santo Papa, ang indi pag-abi-abi sa immigrants ang makabig nga daku nga sala, samtang ang abortion naman ang mapaanggid na suno sa iya sa asasinasyon.
english: According to the Pope, not welcoming immigrants is considered a serious sin, while abortion is comparable to assassination.

text: Daw kaangay nga patas sanday Harris kag Trump sa mata sang Santo Papa bangud pareho suno sa iya nga “against life” ang ila himuon nga pagsulundan.
english: It seems that Harris and Trump are equal in the eyes of the Pope because he said they will make the same “against life” policy.

text: “Whether it is the one who is chasing away migrants, or the one who that kills children,” pahayag sini.
english: “Whether it is the one who is chasing away migrants, or the one who that kills children,” it said.

text:
“Both are against life.”

Apisar sini, nagpahayag ang 87-anyos nga Pope nga indi maayo kun wala nagaboto gani dapat magpili gihapon ang US Catholics kun sin-o ang ila padag-on nga presidente.
english:
“Both are against life.”

However, the 87-year-old Pope said it is not good not to vote and US Catholics should still choose who they will elect as president.

text: “You must choose the lesser evil,” pahayag sini.
english: “You must choose the lesser evil,” it said.

text: “Who is the lesser evil?
english: “Who is the lesser evil?

text: That lady, or that gentleman?
english: That lady, or that gentleman?

text: I don’t know.
english: I don’t know.

text:
Everyone, in conscience, (has to) think and do this.”

Ini nga pahayag ang ginhimo sang Pope samtang nga nagahana na ini nga magbiya sa Singapore pabalik sa Roma kasunod sang iya 12-ka-adlaw nga byahe sa Southeast Asia kag Oceania.
english:
Everyone, in conscience, (has to) think and do this.”

The Pope made the statement as he prepares to leave Singapore for Rome following his 12-day trip to Southeast Asia and Oceania.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginabanta nga 52-million ang American Catholics kag ginalantaw nga crucial swing voters.
english: It is known that there are an estimated 52-million American Catholics and are seen as crucial swing voters.

text: Sa battleground states lakip na sa Pennsylvania kag Wisconsin, Katoliko ang masobra 20% sang adults.
english: In battleground states including Pennsylvania and Wisconsin, more than 20% of adults are Catholic.

text: 1.4-billion ang mga Katoliko sa bilog nga kalibutan kag ang leader nga si Pope Francis ang masami gid nga nagahalong sa pagbalanse kaangot sa national political elections.
english: There are 1.4-billion Catholics worldwide and leader Pope Francis is often careful to balance national political elections.

text: Apang masami sini nga ginapakamalaot ang abortion nga isa sa ginadumilian sa Catholic teaching.
english: But it often condemns abortion as one of the taboos in Catholic teaching.

text: Masami man sini ginapakamalaot ang anti-immigrant rhetoric ni Trump; halimbawa, sang 2016, gintawag sini nga indi Kristyano ang Republican leader sa iya mga ideolohiya.
english: It also frequently condemns Trump’s anti-immigrant rhetoric; for example, in 2016, it called the Republican leader unchristian in his ideologies.

text: Posible nga madayon na liwat ang napurnada nga away sa tunga nanday Nonito ‘Filipino Flash’ Donaire Jr.
english: It is possible that the fight between Nonito 'Filipino Flash' Donaire Jr.

text: kag John Riel “Quadro Alas” Casimero.
english: and John Riel “Quadro Alas” Casimero.

text: Ini matapos gintuldukan na sang duha ang serye sang ila trash talk online paagi sa pagpangayo ni Casimero sang pasaylo kay Donaire.
english: This was after the two ended their series of trash talk online with Casimero apologizing to Donaire.

text: Nag-sorry si Casimero pati sa asawa kag manager ni Donaire nga nadala man sa away online nga amo ang nangin rason kun ngaa nasuspinde ang ila nga sambuwa sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: Casimero apologized to Donaire's wife and manager who were also involved in an online fight that led to the suspension of their fight last month.

text: “Sinabi ko sa asawa mo na pasensya na kung ang mga kasama ko na may nagawang mali.
english: “I told your wife I’m sorry if my colleagues did something wrong.

text: Tuldukan na natin yun, pasensya na sa asawa mo para matuloy na ang laban natin,” pahayag ni Casimero.
english: Let's stop it, apologize to your wife so that our fight can continue,” Casimero said.

text: Ginbaton naman ni Donaire ang pahayag ni Casimero.
english: Donaire accepted Casimero's statement.

text: “Ok na ako roon.
english: “I’m ok now.

text: Kung may trash talk naman, sabihin mo sa (akin) huwag mong isali naman ang asawa o pamilya ko.
english: If there's trash talk, tell me not to involve my wife or family.

text: Hindi sila pupunta sa ring, ako, ikaw ang mag-away sa ring,” sabat ni Donaire.
english: They won't go to the ring, I, you fight in the ring,” Donaire replied.

text: Matandaan nga i-unify kuntani sang duha ang ila nga titulo sang bulan sang Agusto apang nag-withdraw si Donaire bangud ginapahayag wala ginarespeto ni Casimero ang iya nga pamilya kag asawa.
english: The two were supposed to unify their titles in August but Donaire withdrew because Casimero allegedly did not respect his family and wife.

text: Si Donaire ang nagauyat subong sang WBC bantamweight title, samtang si Casimero naman ang reigning WBO champion.
english: Donaire currently holds the WBC bantamweight title, while Casimero is the reigning WBO champion.

text: May isa pa ka isyu nga kinahanglan athagon antes madayon ang away bangud nagmandu ang WBC kay Donaire nga depensahan ang iya nga titulo batok sa mandatory challenger nga si Reymart Gaballo.
english: There is another issue that needs to be clarified before the fight can go ahead because the WBC has ordered Donaire to defend his title against mandatory challenger Reymart Gaballo.

text: Nagapamalibad si Public Works Secretary Manuel Bonoan nga bayaan ang iya pwesto samtang nagapadayon ang imbestigasyon sa ginaalegar nga kurapsyon sa flood control projects.
english: Public Works Secretary Manuel Bonoan refuses to leave his post while the investigation into alleged corruption in flood control projects continues.

text: Suno kay Bonoan, ang pag-resign indi amo ang nagakaigo nga tikang agud nga i-address ang problema.
english: According to Bonoan, resignation is not the appropriate step to address the problem.

text: Gin-ako sini nga nabatian niya ang mga panawagan nga mag-leave siya ukon manaog siya sa pwesto, apang suno sa iya, indi siya magtalikod sa iya nga katungdanan bilang tiglikom.
english: He acknowledged that he has heard calls for him to resign or step down, but said he will not step down from his duties as secretary.

text: “Meron nga nananawagan sa akin na ako po raw ay mag-leave o kaya po ay mag-resign dahil po sa isyung ito.
english: “There are those who are calling me to leave or resign because of this issue.

text: ‘Yan po sana ang madaling gawin, mag-resign o talikuran ko ang problema.
english: 'That's the easy thing to do, I'll resign or I'll turn my back on the problem.

text: Pero hindi po ang pag-alis o pag-iwas ng responsibilidad ang tamang paraan ng paghahanap ng solusyon,” kabahin sang iya nga video message.
english: But removing or avoiding responsibility is not the right way to find a solution,” he said in a video message.

text: “Sa akin po, tatanggapin ko ang accountability pero tandaan po ninyo, hindi ko po kukonsintihin at papayagan ang anumang uri ng korupsyon na nangyayari,” dugang sini.
english: “For me, I will accept accountability but remember, I will not condone and allow any kind of corruption that is happening,” he added.

text: Ginpanindugan man sang tiglikom nga mas madamo ang disente nga mga tawo sa ila nga ahensya ipaanggid sa mga involved sa anomaliya.
english: The secretary also insisted that there are more decent people in their agency than those involved in anomalies.

text: Ini apisar sa mga nadiskubrehan nga mga “ghost projects” sa Bulacan 1st District Engineering Office.
english: This is despite the discovery of ghost projects in the Bulacan 1st District Engineering Office.

text: Sa Batangas naman, gindakop ang head sang 1st District Engineering Office bangud sa tuyo sini nga suhulan ang isa ka congressman agud nga untaton ang imbestigasyon sa infrastructure projects sang ahensya.
english: In Batangas, the head of the 1st District Engineering Office was arrested for allegedly trying to bribe a congressman to stop the investigation into the agency's infrastructure projects.

text: Nagdugang man ang tiglikom nga pasabton ang dapat nga manabat kag ipapreso ang dapat nga mapreso kun mapamatud-an nga involved sa mga anomaliya.
english: The secretary also added that those who should be held accountable will be held accountable and those who should be imprisoned will be imprisoned if proven involved in anomalies.

text: Matandaan nga nagtukod na ang ahensya sang Anti-Corruption Task Force agud ma-engganyo ang publiko nga i-report sa awtoridad ang kwestyonable nga mga proyekto.
english: The agency has already established an Anti-Corruption Task Force to encourage the public to report questionable projects to the authorities.

text: ILOILO CITY – Handum sang isa ka Grade 12 student nga mangin isa ka bantog nga singer kag mangin isa ka registered nurse sa ulihi.
english: ILOILO CITY – A Grade 12 student dreams of becoming a famous singer and a registered nurse later.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Angel Villaruel, 18, sang Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Angel Villaruel, 18, of Brgy.

text: Bakhaw, Mandurriao, Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga nag-umpisa siya sa pagpakigbahin sa mga singing contest sang siya ang Grade 2 pa lang.
english: Bakhaw, Mandurriao, Iloilo City, he said he started participating in singing contests when he was in Grade 2.

text: Suno kay Villaruel, ang iya nga pamilya ang nag-impluwensya sa iya sa patag sang musika.
english: According to Villaruel, his family influenced him in the field of music.

text: Ginpahayag ni Villaruel nga bilang isa ka aspiring singer, iya gin-intrahan ang mga singing contest sa diin lakip na diri ang Bombo Music Festival.
english: Villaruel said that as an aspiring singer, he participated in singing contests including the Bombo Music Festival.

text: Sa pagkamatuod suno sa natungdan, ang iya original composition ang iya nga ginpasakop sa Bombo Music Festival apang wala nagmadinalag-on.
english: In fact, he said, his original composition was submitted to the Bombo Music Festival but was unsuccessful.

text: Ginpahayag ni Villaruel nga iya nga ginahimu nga inspirasyon ang mga kritisismo nga iya nabaton agud nga mas mapaayo pa gid ang iya abilidad sa pagkanta kag malab-ot ang iya handum.
english: Villaruel said he uses the criticisms he received as inspiration to improve his singing skills and achieve his dreams.

text: Samtang, naghatag man sang sample si Villaruel sang iya original composition nga iya ginpasakop sadto sa Bombo Music Festival.
english: Meanwhile, Villaruel also gave a sample of his original composition that he submitted to the Bombo Music Festival.

text: Nagsaka na sa 254 ang naisip nga nagkalamatay sa Vietnam bangud sa Bagyo Yagi ukon kilala anay nga si Bagyo Enteng nga naglaslas man sa Pilipinas sang nagligad nga semana.
english: The death toll from Typhoon Yagi, formerly known as Typhoon Enteng, which also hit the Philippines last week, has risen to 254 in Vietnam.

text: Suno sa Vietnamese disaster management agency, 820 ka mga tawo ang nasamaran kag 82 pa ang missing.
english: According to the Vietnamese disaster management agency, 820 people were injured and 82 are still missing.

text: Matandaan nga Sabado, Septyembre 7, sang nag-landfall ang bagyo sa northeastern coast sang Vietnam matapos nag-agi sa China nga nagbilin man sang duha ka patay.
english: The typhoon made landfall on the northeastern coast of Vietnam on Saturday, September 7, after passing through China, leaving two dead.

text: Sa isa ka lugar sa Lao Cai, hilway nga nakabalik sa ila puluy-an ang 115 ka mga tawo nga nalista anay nga missing.
english: In one area of ​​Lao Cai, 115 people who were previously listed as missing were able to safely return home.

text: Nadiskubrehan nga nagpanago sila sa bukid, naghimo sang tents nga human sa kawayan kag tarpaulins, bangud sa kahadlok nga matiphagan sang duta ang ila puluy-an bangud sa mabaskog nga bagyo.
english: It was discovered that they were hiding in the mountains, making tents made of bamboo and tarpaulins, for fear that their home would be washed away by the strong typhoon.

text: Suno sa UN children’s agency nga UNICEF, kinahanglanon ang $15 million para magamit sa critical needs sang apektado nga mga kabataan kag ila nga pamilya.
english: According to the UN children's agency UNICEF, $15 million is needed to meet the critical needs of the affected children and their families.

text: Sa kapital nga Hanoi, amat-amat na nga nag-subside ang tubig halin sa nag-awas nga Red River kag ginpahanugutan na liwat nga maglabay sa taytay ang trapiko.
english: In the capital Hanoi, the water from the overflowing Red River has slowly subsided and traffic has been allowed to cross the bridge again.

text: Matandaan nga diri sa Pilipinas, ini nga bagyo ang nagbilin sang masobra 20 ka mga patay.#
english: It can be recalled that here in the Philippines, this typhoon left more than 20 dead.#

text: Ginbuksan na sang Department of Transportation (DOTr) ang 313-kilometer Metro Manila Bike Lane Network — ang pinakalaba nga bike lane sang pungsod.
english: The Department of Transportation (DOTr) has opened the 313-kilometer Metro Manila Bike Lane Network — the country’s longest bike lane.

text: Suno kay Transportation Secretary Arthur Tugade, ang amo nga bike line ang nagasakop sa 12 ka syudad sang Pasig, Marikina, Quezon City, Caloocan, Manila, San Juan, Mandaluyong, Makati, Pasay, Las Piñas, Parañaque, kag Taguig.
english: According to Transportation Secretary Arthur Tugade, the bike line covers 12 cities of Pasig, Marikina, Quezon City, Caloocan, Manila, San Juan, Mandaluyong, Makati, Pasay, Las Piñas, Parañaque, and Taguig.

text: Pahayag niya, maka-akomodar ang bike lane network sang 1,250 cyclists per hour sa kada metro sang road space.
english: He said the bike lane network can accommodate 1,250 cyclists per hour per meter of road space.

text: Ginpabutyag naman sang Metro Manila Development Authority (MMDA) kag sang Metro Manila Council (MMC), ang ila suporta kag commitment sa amo nga proyekto kag ginakabig nga “game changer” ang presensya sang bike lanes sa National Capital Region.
english: The Metro Manila Development Authority (MMDA) and the Metro Manila Council (MMC) expressed their support and commitment to the project and considered the presence of bike lanes in the National Capital Region as a “game changer”.

text: Daog ang Filipino golfer nga si Miguel Tabuena sa 2021 Idaho Open sa Idaho, United States.
english: Filipino golfer Miguel Tabuena won the 2021 Idaho Open in Idaho, United States.

text: Naka-score si Tabuena sang 196 strokes kag 14-under nga nangin rason sang iya pagpangibabaw sa kompetisyon.
english: Tabuena scored 196 strokes and 14-under, which gave him the upper hand in the competition.

text: Nagapangaduha sa kompetisyon si American golfer Brad Marek kag nagapangatlo naman si British golfer Jamie Hall.
english: American golfer Brad Marek is second in the competition and British golfer Jamie Hall is third.

text: Si Tabuena ang silver medalist sang 2010 Asian Games kag two-time Asian Tour winner.
english: Tabuena was the silver medalist at the 2010 Asian Games and a two-time Asian Tour winner.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Preso na ang suspek nga nagpatay kay Barangay Kagawad Jobanie Triste sang San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – The suspect who killed Barangay Kagawad Jobanie Triste of San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo is now in custody.

text: Ini amo si John Castro Jr., residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: This is John Castro Jr., resident of the said place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Alfred Mansoy, hepe sang Tigbauan Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagsungka si Castro subong nga adlaw.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Alfred Mansoy, chief of the Tigbauan Municipal Police Station, said Castro surrendered today.

text: Suno kay Mansoy, nakagwa na ang warrant of arrest ni Castro sa kaso nga murder rason nga nagpabutyag ini nga magsungka.
english: According to Mansoy, Castro has already issued a warrant of arrest for murder and has expressed his willingness to surrender.

text: Diri kag ginpadulungan nila si Castro sa Brgy.
english: They drove Castro to Brgy.

text: Bagumbayan, Tigbauan, Iloilo kag gindala sa police station.
english: Bagumbayan, Tigbauan, Iloilo and was taken to the police station.

text: Gin-ako naman ni Castro ang krimen, apang nagdepensa ini nga gin-unahan lang niya si Triste bangud may plano man ini nga patyon siya.
english: Castro confessed to the crime, but defended that he only went ahead with Triste because he had a plan to kill him.

text: Matandaan nga ang armas nga gingamit ni Castro sa pagpatay kay Triste ang ginapanag-iyahan ni AAMBIS-OWWA Party-list Representative Atty. Lex Colada.
english: It can be recalled that the weapon used by Castro to kill Triste was owned by AAMBIS-OWWA Party-list Representative Atty. Lex Colada.

text: Aksidente nga natiruhan sang anak ang iya iloy sa Sitio Lunok, Cubay, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: A son accidentally stabbed his mother in Sitio Lunok, Cubay, Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Ang biktima amo si alyas Meryl, 59, kag ang bata nga nakatiro amo si alyas Darwin, 36, lunsay residente sang amo nga lugar.
english: The victim was identified as Meryl, 59, and the shooter was identified as Darwin, 36, both residents of the same area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Eduardo Siacon Jr., hepe sang Police Station 9, iya ginpahayag nga antes ang insidente, nasugata ni Darwin ang mag-utod nga sanday alyas Elorde kag alyas Denard kun sa diin nagbaisay ang mga ini kag ginpahayag nga may daan nga hiligut-anon ang mga ini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Eduardo Siacon Jr., chief of Police Station 9, said that before the incident, Darwin met brothers alias Elorde and alias Denard where they had an argument and reportedly had an old quarrel.

text: Suno kay Siacon, nagpauli si Darwin kag nagkuha sang armas kag sang nagbalik ini sa lugar kun sa diin yara ang mag-utod, nagsunod ang iloy sini.
english: According to Siacon, Darwin went home and got a gun and when he returned to the place where the brothers were, his mother followed.

text: Sang nagaatubangay na ang tatlo, gintuyo sang iloy nga magtambag kag punggan ang iya anak kag didto na naglupok ang pusil kag naigo ang biktima sa iya butkon kag paa.
english: When the three were facing each other, the mother tried to advise and stop her son and the gun exploded and hit the victim in his arm and leg.

text: Sa subong, padayon pa nga ginapangita sang mga kapulisan ang suspetsado kag wala marecover ang armas-luthang nga gingamit sini.
english: Police are still searching for the suspect and have not recovered the firearm he used.

text: Nagapabilin naman sa ospital ang iya iloy para sa nagakaigo nga pagbulong.
english: His mother remains in the hospital for proper treatment.

text: Indi pabor ang grupo sang mga negosyante sa posible pagbalik sang lockdowns sa Pilipinas kun magtimbuok ang kaso sang delta variant sang COVID-19.
english: The business group is not in favor of the possible resumption of lockdowns in the Philippines if the number of cases of the delta variant of COVID-19 increases.

text: Suno kay Presidential Adviser for Entrepreneurship Joey Concepcion, lockdown matuod ang paagi agud nga matapna ang kaso apang piangon naman sini ang ekonomiya sang pungsod.
english: According to Presidential Adviser for Entrepreneurship Joey Concepcion, lockdown is indeed the way to prevent the case but it will cripple the country's economy.

text: Ini ang rason nga suno kay Concepcion nga indi dapat pag-ilockdown ang bilog nga ekonomiya kundi ang mga tawo lang nga wala nabakunahan batok sa COVID-19.
english: This is the reason why, according to Concepcion, the entire economy should not be locked down but only the people who are not vaccinated against COVID-19.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Concepcion nga naduso na niya ini nga ideya kay Health Secretary Francisco Duque III kag posible nga mapatuman ini nga polisa sa tatlo ka katapusan nga bulan subong nga 2021 kun may bastante na nga bakuna sa Pilipinas.
english: Concepcion also said that he has already proposed this idea to Health Secretary Francisco Duque III and it is possible to implement this policy in the last three months of 2021 if there is enough vaccine in the Philippines.

text: Ginapahayag nga tilawan ang pagpatuman sini nga polisa sa Lapu-Lapu City sa Cebu.
english: The policy will reportedly be tested in Lapu-Lapu City in Cebu.

text: Naamat-amatan na tampok ang dalan nga ginareklamo sang pumuluyo sa Sitio Canhing, Brgy.
english: The road that residents in Sitio Canhing, Brgy.

text: Jibolo, Janiuay, Iloilo.
english: Jibolo, Janiuay, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Cesar Emmanuel Buyco, Head sang Provincial Government Environment and Natural Resources Office, iya ginpahayag nga obligasyon sang naga-quarry sa lugar ang pagmentinar sang dalan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Cesar Emmanuel Buyco, Head of the Provincial Government Environment and Natural Resources Office, said it is the obligation of the quarrymen in the area to maintain the road.

text: Matandaan nga nagakaguba ang dalan bangud sa dalagko nga mga quarry trucks nga nagalabay sa nasambit nga dalan.
english: It can be recalled that the road is deteriorating due to large quarry trucks passing through the said road.

text: Natigayon ini nga matagaan sang atensyon pinaagi sa Municipal Environment and Natural Resources Office head Joven Barranco.
english: This was brought to the attention of the Municipal Environment and Natural Resources Office head Joven Barranco.

text: Mainit nga gin-abi-abi si Pope Francis sa Singapore nga amo na ang katapusan sa apat ka pungsod nga yara sa lista sang iya apostolic trip subong nga Septyembre 2024.
english: Pope Francis has been warmly welcomed in Singapore, which is now the last of four countries on the list of his apostolic trip this September 2024.

text: Apisar sang kahangawa sa ikaayong lawas sang 87-anyos nga Santo Papa, naga-guwa nga wala ini subong sang ginabatyag nga malain nga kondisyon kag malipayon pa nga nag-atubang sa mga Katoliko nga nagsug-alaw sa iya halin sa Indonesia, Papua New Guinea, kag Timor Leste.
english: Despite concerns about the health of the 87-year-old Pope, it appears that he is not feeling ill and happily faced Catholics who greeted him from Indonesia, Papua New Guinea, and Timor Leste.

text: Matapos ang pormal nga leaving ceremony sa airport sa kapital sang East Timor nga Dili, nag-abot ang Santo Papa sa Singapore kahapon sang hapon kun sa diin ginalauman nga makig-istorya ini subong nga adlaw sa leaders sang city state, mag-deliver sang state address, kag magpanguna sa misa sa national stadium.
english: After a formal leaving ceremony at the airport in the East Timorese capital Dili, the Pope arrived in Singapore yesterday afternoon where he is expected today to meet with city state leaders, deliver a state address, and lead a mass at the national stadium.

text: Magatinir siya sa Singapore tubtub buwas antes magbalik sa Vatican nga amo ang magatakop sa iya pinakamalawig kag pinakamalayo nga byahe sa sulod sang 11 ka tuig nga pagpungko bilang Santo Papa.
english: He will stay in Singapore until tomorrow before returning to the Vatican to end his longest and most distant trip of 11 years as Pope.

text: Ang Singapore nga independent na halin sang 1965 amo ang isa sa pinakamanggaranon sa Asya apang ginamuno gihapon sang rights groups bangud sa kalala sang justice system lakip na ang pagpatuman sang death penalty.
english: Singapore, which has been independent since 1965, is one of the richest in Asia but is still dominated by rights groups because of the poor justice system, including the implementation of the death penalty.

text: Puluy-an ini sang Chinese majority kag Malay kag Indian minorities.
english: It is home to a Chinese majority and Malay and Indian minorities.

text: Ginabanta nga 30 percent sang Singaporeans ang Buddhist, 20 percent ang wala sang relihiyon kag ang nabilin amo ang Catholic, Protestant, Taoist kag Hindu.
english: An estimated 30 per cent of Singaporeans are Buddhist, 20 per cent have no religion and the rest are Catholic, Protestant, Taoist and Hindu.

text: Nagaplano ang Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP) Tour nga magapatuman sang mas istrikto nga rules sa men’s tennis kasunod sang mga malawig nga toilet breaks kag medical timeouts nga ginahimo.
english: The Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP) Tour is planning to impose stricter rules on men’s tennis following extended toilet breaks and medical timeouts being taken.

text: Ang ini nga practice ang madugay na kag liwat-liwat na lang nga ginahimo sang mga tennis players kaangay na lang sa natabo sa US Open sa diin gin-akusaran si Greek tennis player Stefanos Tsitsipas sang gamesmaship ni British tennis player Andy Murray bangud sa madugay sini nga paggamit sang banyo sa una nga round sang ila nga hampang.
english: This practice has been done for a long time and is repeated by tennis players such as what happened at the US Open where Greek tennis player Stefanos Tsitsipas was accused of gamesmaship by British tennis player Andy Murray because of his prolonged use of the bathroom in the first round of their match.

text: Ginpanginwala naman ni Greek world No.
english: Greek world no.

text: 3 ang akusasyon kag ginpahayag nga wala siya sang may nagguba nga rules bangud wala man sang time limit ang bathroom breaks.
english: 3 charge and said he did not break any rules because there is no time limit for bathroom breaks.

text: Suno sa ATP, may yara sang pagabag-uhon sa rules para sa bathroom breaks kag on-court medical timeouts.
english: According to the ATP, there will be changes to the rules for bathroom breaks and on-court medical timeouts.

text: Nagalaom ang asosasyon nga antes mag-umpisa ang masunod nga season sa Enero, may yara na sang naplastar nga mas hugot nga mga pasulundan.
english: The association hopes that before the next season begins in January, stricter rules will be in place.

text: Nagsungka ang isa ka police lieutenant colonel kag nag-ako sa brutal nga pagpatay sa isa ka police executive master sergeant sa sulod mismo sang Camp Bagong Diwa nga amo ang headquarters sang National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO).
english: A police lieutenant colonel has surrendered and confessed to the brutal murder of a police executive master sergeant inside Camp Bagong Diwa, the headquarters of the National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO).

text: Ginhingadlan sa reports ang suspek nga si Lieutenant Colonel Roderick Pascua samtang ang biktima naman amo si Police Executive Master Sergeant Emmanuel De Asis nga assigned bilang non-commissioned officer sa Puerto Princesa Police Provincial Office (PPO) sa Palawan.
english: The suspect was identified as Lieutenant Colonel Roderick Pascua while the victim was identified as Police Executive Master Sergeant Emmanuel De Asis who was assigned as a non-commissioned officer at the Puerto Princesa Police Provincial Office (PPO) in Palawan.

text:
Base sa spot report, nagpanugid ang lieutenant nga ginluthang sini ang sergeant matapos naaktuhan ang “intimate” nga relasyon sa asawa sang lieutenant samtang yara sa ila nga apartment sa Married Non-Officers’ Quarter sa Camp Bagong Diwa sang nagligad nga Nobyembre 28 sang gab-i.

Ginklaro man sa report nga pulis man ang asawa sang suspek nga may ranggo nga police executive master sergeant.
english:
According to the spot report, the lieutenant said he shot the sergeant after he was caught having an intimate relationship with the lieutenant's wife while in their apartment at the Married Non-Officers' Quarter in Camp Bagong Diwa last November 28 night.

The report also clarified that the suspect's wife is also a police officer with the rank of police executive master sergeant.

text: Suno pa sa lieutenant, yara pa mismo ang iya asawa sang gintiro sini ang biktima sa living room sang quarter.
english: According to the lieutenant, his wife was still there when he shot the victim in the living room of the quarter.

text: Base pa sa panugiron sang suspek, ginsugo sini ang iya asawa nga magkuha sang hacksaw ukon lagari nga ginagamit sa salsalon.
english: According to the suspect, he ordered his wife to get a hacksaw or saw used for iron.

text: Amo ini ang iya gingamit sa pag-utod-utod sa lawas sang biktima, ginsulod sa sako, kag ginlubong sa duta sa ila nga ancestral house sa Baguio City.
english: He used it to cut the victim's body into pieces, put it in a sack, and buried it in the ground at their ancestral house in Baguio City.

text: Nag-request ang mga imbestigador sa suspek kag sa iya abogado nga updan sila sa compound sa ancestral house agud nga kutkuton ang mga parte sang lawas sang sergeant sang Miyerkules, Disyembre 4.
english: Investigators requested the suspect and his lawyer to accompany them to the compound at the ancestral house to exhume the sergeant's body parts on Wednesday, Dec. 4.

text: Didto kag na-recover sang otoridad ang duha ka mga kaso nga nagaunod matuod sang mga parte sang lawas sang tawo, duha ka puti nga shirts, kag isa ka tapalan ukon wooden chopping board.
english: There, authorities recovered two cases containing human body parts, two white shirts, and a wooden chopping board.

text: Sunod nga gin-turn over ang utod-utod nga parte sang lawas sa funeral service sa Baguio.
english: The dismembered body parts were later turned over to the funeral service in Baguio.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, may statement ang pamilya sang biktima kun sa diin ginsaad nga planado ang krimen halin pa sang Marso 2024.
english: Meanwhile, the victim's family issued a statement promising that the crime was planned since March 2024.

text: Gin-alegar pa sa statement nga ginplano gid nga i-execute ang krimen kun magkadto ang sergeant sa Manila.
english: The statement also alleged that the crime was planned to be executed when the sergeant went to Manila.

text: Ginlaragway pa nga duha ka mga “demonyo” kag ila mga kahimbon ang naghimo sang amo nga krimen.
english: It was further described that two “demons” and their accomplices committed the crime.

text: Pahayag sang anak sang sergeant, isa ini ka ‘setup’ nga nag-resulta sa abduction kag wala-kaluoy nga torture nga nag-resulta pa gid sa kamatayon sang biktima.
english: According to the sergeant's son, it was a setup that resulted in the abduction and merciless torture that resulted in the death of the victim.

text: “It was planned and prepared [from] March 2024 up to present to kill my father once he [visited] Manila, perpetrated by these two demonic individuals and their cohorts,” kabahin sang statement sang bata.
english: “It was planned and prepared [from] March 2024 up to present to kill my father once he [visited] Manila, perpetrated by these two demonic individuals and their cohorts,” the child’s statement read.

text: Gintugyan na ang imbestigasyon sang kaso sa sa Southern Police District (SPD) kag sa Taguig City Police Station.
english: The investigation of the case has been handed over to the Southern Police District (SPD) and the Taguig City Police Station.

text: May bastante pa nga oras ang Senado agud nga makapasar sang pila ka economic measures antes matapos ang termino ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The Senate still has enough time to pass some economic measures before the end of President Rodrigo Duterte's term.

text: Suno kay Sen.
english: According to Sen.

text: Edgardo ‘Sonny’ Angara, yara na sa advanced stages of legislation ang Retail Trade Liberalization Act, ang Public Service Act kag ang Foreign Investment Act.
english: Edgardo ‘Sonny’ Angara, the Retail Trade Liberalization Act, the Public Service Act and the Foreign Investment Act are already in the advanced stages of legislation.

text: Rasonable man suno kay Angara nga lauman ining tatlo ka hagna.
english: Angara said it is reasonable to expect these three bills.

text: Pending man ang pila ka measure sa idalom sang Comprehensive Tax Reform Programs.
english: Several measures under the Comprehensive Tax Reform Programs are also pending.

text: Ang income-generating packages kaangay sang Tax Reform for Acceleration and Inclusion Law (TRAIN Law) ang naaprubahan na.
english: Income-generating packages such as the Tax Reform for Acceleration and Inclusion Law (TRAIN Law) have already been approved.

text: Nangin mainit ang pinakauna nga presidential debate sa tunga nanday Democratic Party candidate Vice President Kamala Harris kag Republican Party candidate former President Donald Trump.
english: The first presidential debate between Democratic Party candidate Vice President Kamala Harris and Republican Party candidate former President Donald Trump was heated.

text: Naglawig sang masobra isa ka oras kag tunga ang debata sang duha sa diin gin-umpisahan ini sa pagkamusta ni Harris kay Trump.
english: The debate lasted more than an hour and a half and began with Harris greeting Trump.

text: Sa debate, ginlaslasan ni Harris si Trump sa diin ginatawag niya ini nga convicted felon kag gintawag man sini nga kabutigan lang kag assassination attempt sa iya agud makuha ang simpatiya sang publiko.
english: During the debate, Harris lashed out at Trump, calling him a convicted felon and calling him a lie and an assassination attempt to win public sympathy.

text: Ginpakamalaot man ni Trump si Harris bangud sa iya Afghanistan kag immigration issues, sa diin ginpaanggid pa niya ini kay President Joe Biden.
english: Trump also criticized Harris for her Afghanistan and immigration issues, even comparing her to President Joe Biden.

text: Ginbulgar man sini nga sa idalom sang subong nga administrasyon, naglalas ang sitwasyon ang mga immigrants bangud nagakaon na lang ang mga ini sang ido kag kuring.
english: He also revealed that under the current administration, the situation of immigrants has worsened because they are eating dogs and cats.

text: Sa pihak sini, ginakabig man ni Trump ang pag-atubangay nila ni Harris nga isa ka mayo nga kahigayunan, apang indi pa masigurado kun masugpunana pa ini.
english: Meanwhile, Trump also sees the confrontation with Harris as a good opportunity, but it is not yet clear whether it will be completed.

text:
“I think it was the best debate that I’ve ever personally that I’ve had.”

Ginakabig naman ni Harris nga underdog sa gihapon ini kay Trump.
english:
“I think it was the best debate that I’ve ever personally that I’ve had.”

Harris, however, still considers himself an underdog to Trump.

text: “Guys, we’re still the underdogs in this race.
english: “Guys, we’re still the underdogs in this race.

text: It’s tight.
english: It’s tight.

text: We believe in who we are.
english: We believe in who we are.

text: We believe in the American people.
english: We believe in the American people.

text:
This is a campaign about bringing folks together, knowing the vast majority of us have so much more in common than what separates us.”

Nahibaluan nga walo ka semana na lang kag patigayunon na ang presidential elections.
english:
This is a campaign about bringing folks together, knowing the vast majority of us have so much more in common than what separates us.”

The presidential elections are only eight weeks away.

text: Sentro subong sang atensyon sa patag sang sports ilabi na sa women’s tennis ang pagahiwaton nga US Open finals sa bwas, Septyembre 12 bangud sa makasaysayan nga hampang sa tunga sang duha ka mga teenagers.
english: The US Open finals to be held tomorrow, September 12, are the center of attention in the field of sports especially in women's tennis due to the historic match between the two teenagers.

text: Base sa record humalin sang tuig 1968, subong lang liwat matabo ang finals nga lunsay mga unseeded players ang magaatubangay.
english: Based on the record since 1968, the finals will be held again with all unseeded players facing each other.

text: Ang Filipina Canadian nga si Leyla Fernandez ang ranked number 73 sa bilog nga kalibutan, samtang ang 18 anyos nga si Emma Raducanu halin sa Britanya ang yara naman sa ika-150 sa rankings.
english: Filipina Canadian Leyla Fernandez is ranked number 73 in the world, while 18-year-old Emma Raducanu of Britain is 150th in the rankings.

text: Ang 19 anyos nga si Fernandez ang pinakabata nga player humalin pa sang tuig 1999 kun sa diin 17 anyos pa lamang sadto si Serena Williams, ginpiyerde na sini ang tatlo ka top 5 players sa isa ka major tournament.
english: The 19-year-old Fernandez is the youngest player since 1999 when Serena Williams was only 17 years old, defeating three top 5 players in a major tournament.

text: Sa bahin naman sang iya nga makasumpong nga si Raducanu, lakip sa madamo niya nga record, amo nga siya ang una nga British woman nga magapartisipar sa major singles final sa sulod sang 44 ka tuig.
english: As for her opponent, Raducanu, among her many records, is that she is the first British woman to participate in a major singles final in 44 years.

text: Samtang, tuman naman ang pagpasalamat sang iloy ni Fernandez nga isa ka ka Filipina sa mga Pinoy Fans nga nagabantay sa hampang sang iya nga anak.
english: Meanwhile, Fernandez's mother, a Filipina, is very grateful to the Pinoy fans who watch her son's game.

text: Nagdangat sa P12.38 million ang halit nga gintuga sang bagyo Fabian kag sang hangin habagat sa sektor sang agrikultura.
english: The damage caused by Typhoon Fabian and the south wind in the agricultural sector amounted to P12.38 million.

text: Suno sa Department of Agriculture, 885 ka mga mangunguma ang apektado kag 228 metric tons nga volume sang produksyon sang humay ang nadula nga sakop sang 906 hectares sang agricultural areas sa Central Luzon, CALABARZON kag Western Visayas.
english: According to the Department of Agriculture, 885 farmers were affected and 228 metric tons of rice production volume was lost covering 906 hectares of agricultural areas in Central Luzon, CALABARZON and Western Visayas.

text: Dugang pa sang ahensya, ang mga apektado nga commodities ang ginalakipan sang bugas, mais, high-value crops, kag livestock.
english: The agency added that the affected commodities include rice, corn, high-value crops, and livestock.

text: Nakahanda naman ang 104,471 bags sang rice seeds; 11,390 bags sang corn seeds kag 1,949 kilograms sang utan para sa mga mangunguma kag manugpangisda nga apektado sang weather disturbances.
english: Meanwhile, 104,471 bags of rice seeds are ready; 11,390 bags of corn seeds and 1,949 kilograms of vegetables for farmers and fishermen affected by weather disturbances.

text: Ginabantayan na subong sang tanan ang pinakauna nga presidential debate sa tunga nanday Democratic Party candidate Vice President Kamala Harris kag Republican Party candidate former President Donald Trump.
english: Everyone is now watching the first presidential debate between Democratic Party candidate Vice President Kamala Harris and Republican Party candidate former President Donald Trump.

text: Suno kay Bombo Raul Sabido, international correspondent sa Las Vegas, Nevada, nagalaom sila sang isa ka maayo nga debate.
english: According to Bombo Raul Sabido, international correspondent in Las Vegas, Nevada, they are hoping for a good debate.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ginakulbaan na ang kampo ni Harris sa mga isyu nga ihaboy sa Democratic Party.
english: He also said the Harris camp is already nervous about the issues that will be thrown at the Democratic Party.

text: Nahibaluan nga si US President Joe Biden ang kaalyado ni Harris.
english: It is known that US President Joe Biden is an ally of Harris.

text: Apang kampante naman Republican Party nga masabat ni Trump ang tanan nga mga isyu sa debate.
english: But the Republican Party is confident that Trump will answer all the issues in the debate.

text: Ginmandu sang Marcos administration ang pag-shutdown sa Siquijor Power Corporation (SIPCOR) nga ginapanag-iyahan sang pamilya Villar.
english: The Marcos administration ordered the shutdown of the Villar family-owned Siquijor Power Corporation (SIPCOR).

text: Ini amo ang nagaserbe nga power provider sa isla sang Siquijor.
english: It serves as the power provider to the island of Siquijor.

text: Suno kay Energy Secretary Sharon Garin, ginpaguwa sang Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) ang closure order batok sa SIPCOR bangud sang “multiple violations” sa operational kag regulatory compliance requirements.
english: According to Energy Secretary Sharon Garin, the Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) issued the closure order against SIPCOR for “multiple violations” of operational and regulatory compliance requirements.

text: Gindugang sini nga pigado gid kag mas nagalala ang power situation sa Siquijor bangud sa amo nga power provider.
english: He added that the power situation in Siquijor is very poor and getting worse because of the power provider.

text: Nagalawig sang tag-11 ka oras ang brownout sa kada adlaw (average) nga may tuman ka dako nga epekto sa palangabuhian sang mga taga-Siquijor.
english: The brownout lasts 11 hours each day (average) which has a huge impact on the livelihood of the people of Siquijor.

text: Matandaan nga nagbisita si Marcos sa pasilidad sang SIPCOR sang Hunyo 11 kag ginmanduan ang Department of Energy (DOE) kag National Electrificiation Administration (NEA) nga solusyunan ang sulit-sulit nga power interruption sa amo nga isla.
