english: Marcos visited the SIPCOR facility on June 11 and instructed the Department of Energy (DOE) and the National Electrification Administration (NEA) to resolve the repeated power interruptions on the island.

text: “Malinaw po ang utos ng Pangulo, hinidi katanggap tanggap ang dulot na kawalan sa ekonomiya at pinsala sa kabuhayan ng kapabayaang ito,” suno kay Garin.
english: “The President's order is clear, the economic loss and livelihood damage caused by this negligence is unacceptable,” Garin said.

text: Pahayag sang tiglikom, naghulat pa ang gobyerno sang halos duha ka bulan agud nga makaayo sang SIPCOR ang power situation, apang bisan sang tyansa nga ginhatag sa ila, wala sang improvement nga nakit-an.
english: The secretary said the government waited for almost two months for SIPCOR to improve the power situation, but even with the chance given to them, no improvement was seen.

text: “Following a NEA [National Electrification Administration] audit of CIPCOR’s generating units ordered by the DOE, it was revealed that the consumers experienced a total of 568 power interruptions, averaging more than 31 outages per month… Every day po, ibig sabihin, may outage po sa Siquijor,” she said.
english: “Following a NEA [National Electrification Administration] audit of CIPCOR’s generating units ordered by the DOE, it was revealed that the consumers experienced a total of 568 power interruptions, averaging more than 31 outages per month… Every day, that is, there is an outage in Siquijor,” she said.

text: Since January this year, power outages last between 5 to 15 hours, which has pushed the province to declare a state of emergency,” suno sa DOE secretary.
english: Since January this year, power outages have lasted between 5 to 15 hours, which has pushed the province to declare a state of emergency,” according to the DOE secretary.

text: “These failures have interrupted the delivery of essential public services, impacting hospitals and schools.
english: “These failures have interrupted the delivery of essential public services, impacting hospitals and schools.

text: They have also caused disruptions to businesses, especially the tourism sector, which provides a major source of livelihood to the people of Siquijor,” dugang niya.
english: They have also caused disruptions to businesses, especially the tourism sector, which provides a major source of livelihood to the people of Siquijor,” he added.

text:
“Sa madaling salita, malinaw po na hindi kaya ng SIPCOR ibigay ang serbisyo na ipinangako nila.”

Ginatun-an man ang legal sanctions nga ipasaka.
english:
“In short, it is clear that SIPCOR cannot provide the service they promised.”

Legal sanctions are also being studied.

text: Ginpanginwala man sang tiglikom nga isa ini ka akto sang pamulitika.
english: The secretary also denied that it was a political act.

text: Matandaan nga nag-upod ang mga Villar sa mga Duterte sa tinalikdan nga midterm elections lakip na si Senator Camille Villar nga sang amo nga tion yara na kuntani sa Alyansa ni Marcos.
english: It can be recalled that the Villars joined the Dutertes in the last midterm elections including Senator Camille Villar who at that time was supposed to be in the Marcos Alliance.

text: Ginpahayag naman sang SIPCOR nga ginatun-an nila subong ang mando sang gobyerno.
english: SIPCOR said it is currently studying the government's order.

text: “We are currently studying the Order and shall exhaust all remedies available to us under the law,” kabahin sang statement.
english: “We are currently studying the Order and shall exhaust all remedies available to us under the law,” the statement read.

text: “We assure our stakeholders and the public of our commitment to address the matter responsibly and resolve this concern as soon as possible.”#
english: “We assure our stakeholders and the public of our commitment to address the matter responsibly and resolve this concern as soon as possible.”#

text: ILOILO – Gingamit sang isa ka estudyante ang iya talento sa pagsaot agud nga makabulig sa iya pamilya.
english: ILOILO – A student used his dancing talent to help his family.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ferlyn Mae Arda, 17, sang Oton, Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga ang iya iloy ang nag-engganyo sa iya sa pagsaot.
english: Ferlyn Mae Arda, 17, of Oton, Iloilo, said her mother encouraged her to dance.

text: Suno kay Arda, humalin sang siya ang elementarya pa lang, masami na siya nga nagapakigbahin sa mga dance contest.
english: According to Arda, since she was in elementary school, she has often participated in dance contests.

text: Ginpahayag ni Arda nga paagi sa pagsaot, naka-angkon siya sang self confidence kag naka-angkon sang madamu nga abyan.
english: Arda said that through dancing, she gained self confidence and made many friends.

text: Magluwas sa personality development, ginpahayag sang natungdan nga ang pagsaot ang naghatag sa iya sang extra income.
english: Besides personality development, she said dancing has given her extra income.

text: Daku suno kay Arda ang nabulig sa pinansyal nga aspeto ilabi na sang tion nga nagpamigado ang iya amay nga isa ka Overseas Filipino Worker sa Saudi.
english: Arda said it helped him a lot in the financial aspect especially when his father, an Overseas Filipino Worker in Saudi Arabia, became poor.

text: Sa pihak sang kabudlay, ginpahayag ni Arda nga ang iya pagpalangga sa pagsaot ang nagatulod sa iya agud nga magpadayon.
english: Despite the difficulties, Arda said her love for dancing is what drives her to continue.

text: Nagsaka ang rice inventory sang pungsod sa 5.6 percent sa bulan sang Hunyo.
english: The country's rice inventory rose 5.6 percent in June.

text: Santo sa Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), as of June 1, nagsaka sa 2.53 million metric tons ang total rice stocks inventory, mas mataas ipaanggid sa 2.4 million metric tons sang nagligad nga tuig sa amo man nga bulan.
english: According to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), as of June 1, the total rice stocks inventory rose to 2.53 million metric tons, higher compared to 2.4 million metric tons last year in the same month.

text: Base sa 32,000 metric tons nga average daily conosumption sang mga Filipino, bastante ang current inventory para sa 79 ka-adlaw.
english: Based on the 32,000 metric tons average daily consumption of Filipinos, the current inventory is sufficient for 79 days.

text: Para sa sini nga tuig, ginapanan-aw sang Department of Agriculture (DA) ang mas stable nga rice production.
english: For this year, the Department of Agriculture (DA) expects more stable rice production.

text: Nagapaayo na matapos ginpaidalom sa heart surgery si WWE executive Triple H ukon Paul Levesque sa matuod niya nga pangalan.
english: WWE executive Triple H or Paul Levesque is recovering from heart surgery.

text: Ang procedure ang ginhiwat sa Yale New Haven Hospital sa Connecticut.
english: The procedure was performed at Yale New Haven Hospital in Connecticut.

text: Suno sa WWE, ang pagpaidalom ni Triple H sa surgery ang kasunod sang pagbatyag niya sang cardiac arrest san nagligad nga semana.
english: According to WWE, Triple H underwent surgery after he suffered a cardiac arrest last week.

text: Siya ang isa sa mga professional wrestlers kag Enero pa ang ulihe sini nga hampang batuk kay Randy Orton.
english: He is one of the professional wrestlers and his last match was against Randy Orton in January.

text: Indi na aktibo sa ring ang 52 anyos nga 14-time world Champion bangud ang atensyon niya ang yara na sa iya nga trabaho kag pamilya.
english: The 52-year-old 14-time world champion is no longer active in the ring because his attention is now on his work and family.

text: Gin-postpone sang Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) ang Asian Youth Games kag gin-isol sa Disyembre 2022 bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: The Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) postponed the Asian Youth Games and moved them to December 2022 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Ang hampang ang hiwaton kuntani sa Shantou city sa southern Guangdong province sa China sa maabot nga Nobyembre.
english: The match was scheduled to be held in Shantou city in China's southern Guangdong province in November.

text: Sa announcement sang OCA, ila ginpahayag nga ang nasambit nga tikang ang pamaagi agud masiguro nga safe kag healthy ang mga atleta kag tanan nga mga participants.
english: In an announcement, the OCA said the move is a way to ensure the safety and health of the athletes and all participants.

text: Apang pahayag naman ni Chinese Vice Premier Han Zheng, siguruhon sang mga opisyal nga madayon “on time” ang Winter Olympics sa China sa Pebrero sa madason nga tuig.
english: However, Chinese Vice Premier Han Zheng said officials will ensure that the Winter Olympics in China will be held “on time” in February next year.

text: Mangin ang Grand Prix Figure Skating nga naka-schedule kuntani sa Nobyembre 4 tubtob Nobyembre 7 sa southwestern city sang Chongqing ang kanselado man tuga sang restrictions bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: Even the Grand Prix Figure Skating scheduled for November 4 to November 7 in the southwestern city of Chongqing was also canceled due to restrictions due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Gintupok sang kalayo ang pila ka parte sang Alimodian National Comprehensive High School sa Brgy.
english: Fire burned parts of Alimodian National Comprehensive High School in Brgy.

text: Poblacion, Alimodian, Iloilo.
english: Poblacion, Alimodian, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Romar C. Cubin, Principal III sang nasambitan nga eskwelahan, iya ginpahayag nga pasado ‘las 3 sang kaagahon sang nagsugod ang sunog sa hulot malapit sa quadrangle, lakip sa sunog ang ginabulubanta 4 tubtob lima ka classrooms, 2 ka opisina, School Clinic, School Canteen, Stock Rooms nga may mga instruments kag costumes sang mga estudyante.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Romar C. Cubin, Principal III of the school, said the fire broke out around 3 am in a room near the quadrangle.

text: Nagresponde naman sa amo nga sunog ang firetrucks sang Alimodian Bureau of Fire Protection kun sa diin, sa duha isa diri ang serviceable, lakip man sa nagbulig ang firetruck sang Pavia, Oton, Sta.
english: Firetrucks of the Alimodian Bureau of Fire Protection responded to the fire, one of which was serviceable, while firetrucks from Pavia, Oton, Sta.

text: Barbara, kag San Miguel.
english: Barbara, and San Miguel.

text: Samtang, ginakabig naman ni Alimodian Mayor Ian Kenneth Alfeche nga isa ka masubo nga hitabo ang nagluntad nga sunog sa eskwelahan.
english: Meanwhile, Alimodian Mayor Ian Kenneth Alfeche considered the fire at the school as a sad incident.

text: Suno kay Alfeche, apektado sa insidente ang mga estudyante nga nawad-an sang hulot-klasehan ilabi na nga magabukas na ang klase sa Hunyo 16, 2025.
english: According to Alfeche, the incident affected the students who lost their classrooms especially as classes will resume on June 16, 2025.

text: Handa naman ang lokal nga panguluhan sang banwa nga magtanyag sang bulig para sa temporaryo nga hulot nga mahimo klasehan sang mga estudyante.
english: The local government of the town is ready to offer assistance for a temporary room where the students can study.

text: Gituad man sang alkalde nga ang pila ka mga classroom nga wala ginagamit sa klase ang nagaserbi nga stock room para sa equipment ukon musical instruments sang banda ukon Rondalia.
english: The mayor also acknowledged that some classrooms that are not used for classes serve as stock rooms for equipment or musical instruments of the band or Rondalia.

text: Lakip man sa nasunog ang mga costumes sang mga estudyante nga ginabanta masobra P500,000 ang balor.
english: Also burned were the costumes of the students worth more than P500,000.

text: Sa pangkabug-usan, ginabanta indi magnubo sa P14 million ang balor sang kahalitan sang sunog suno sa Alimodian PNP.
english: In total, the damage was estimated at P14 million, according to Alimodian PNP.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes pa man nasunog ang mga hulot, may nakatalana na nga ipatukod nga bag-o nga mga school buildings sa lugar.
english: Even before the rooms were burned, new school buildings were scheduled to be built in the area.

text:
May naman yara sang 1,638 ka mga estudyante ang naga-eskwela sa amo nga buluthuan sa School Year 2024-2025

Padayon naman nga ginasekyar sang katapo sang Bureau of Fire Protection ang eskwelahan agud matul-id ang rason sang sunog.
english:
There are 1,638 students enrolled in the school in the School Year 2024-2025

Members of the Bureau of Fire Protection are still checking the school to determine the cause of the fire.

text: Nahatag na sang Social Security System (SSS) ang P115.3 million para sa educational loans sa sulod sang una nga anom ka bulan sang 2021.
english: The Social Security System (SSS) has already disbursed P115.3 million for educational loans during the first six months of 2021.

text: Suno kay SSS President kag CEO Aurora Ignacio, sa pihak sang virtual kag challenging nga setup subong nga may pandemya, padayon sa gihapon ang State-run pension fund sa pagtanyag sang Educational Loan Assistance Program.
english: According to SSS President and CEO Aurora Ignacio, despite the virtual and challenging setup during the pandemic, the State-run pension fund continues to offer the Educational Loan Assistance Program.

text: Katuyuan sang nasambit nga programa nga maghatag sang oportunidad sa mga myembro sang SSS kag sa mga benepisyareyo nga luyag makatapos sa ila pagtuon.
english: The program aims to provide opportunities to SSS members and beneficiaries who wish to complete their studies.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Educational Assistance Loan Program ang gin-implementar sang 2012.
english: The Educational Assistance Loan Program was implemented in 2012.

text: Nagpangabay si Gen.
english: Gen. requested.

text: Nicolas Torre III sa publiko nga indi siya ang kaluoyan kundi ang minilyon nga Pilipino nga biktima sang mga pagbaha.
english: Nicolas Torre III to the public that he is not the one to be pitied but the millions of Filipinos who are victims of floods.

text: Lakip ini sa kaundan sang video statement nga gin-release sang police official matapos nga gin-relieve siya sa posisyon apisar sang mga high-profile arrests nga iya nahimo antes ang pagpungko bilang pinakamataas nga opisyal sang Philippine National Police (PNP).
english: This is among the contents of the video statement released by the police official after he was relieved of his position despite the high-profile arrests he made before taking office as the highest officer of the Philippine National Police (PNP).

text: Pahayag ni Torre, “okay” siya subong kag gina-abi-abi gid niya ang tanan nga suporta nga nabaton.
english: Torre said he is “okay” now and welcomes all the support he has received.

text: “Salamat sa mga naawa sa akin, ngunit hinihiling ko sa inyo, ‘wag n’yo akong kaawaan… Kung meron man tayong dapat kaawaan, yun ay ang milyun-milyon nating kababayan na paulit-ulit na nagiging biktima ng palagiang pagbaha,” suno kay Torre.
english: “Thank you to those who felt sorry for me, but I ask you, 'don't feel sorry for me... If there is anything we should feel sorry for, it is the millions of our fellow citizens who are repeatedly victims of constant flooding,” Torre said.

text: “Sila ang tunay na nangangailangan ng tulong at kalinga sa panahon ngayon sapagkat hindi naman sila ang dapat laging nagdudusa at naghihirap tuwing tag-ulan,” dugang niya.
english: “They are the ones who really need help and care in this time so they should not be the ones who always suffer and struggle every rainy season,” he added.

text: Ginklaro man liwat ni General Torre nga wala siya sang kalain sang buot kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: General Torre also clarified that he has no grudge against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Pahayag pa sini, bisan indi na siya Chief PNP, pulis man siya gihapon subong, kag magapadayon siya sa pagserbe sunod sa mandu sang presidente kag sang pungsod.
english: He said that although he is no longer Chief PNP, he is still a policeman, and he will continue to serve according to the orders of the president and the country.

text: “Nauunawaan ko na kailangan niyang gumawa ng mga mabibigat na desisyon at ang pagkaalis ko bilang Chief of the Philippine National Police ay isa lamang sa mga ito,” suno sa iya.
english: “I understand that he has to make difficult decisions and my resignation as Chief of the Philippine National Police is just one of them,” he said.

text: “Pulis pa rin naman ako.
english: “I'm still a police officer.

text:
I serve and I still continue to serve at the pleasure of the President and our country.”

Napaidalom subong si Torre sa Personnel Holding and Accounting Unit nga isa ka functional office sa idalom sang Directorate for Personnel and Records Management.#
english:
I served and I still continue to serve at the pleasure of the President and our country.”

Torre is now under the Personnel Holding and Accounting Unit, a functional office under the Directorate for Personnel and Records Management.

text: Nakatalana ang 13 ka mga eskwelahan sa Iloilo nga magasugod sa pilot run sang revised Senior High School (SHS) curriculum sang basic education program subong nga School Year 2025-2026.
english: Thirteen schools in Iloilo are scheduled to start the pilot run of the revised Senior High School (SHS) curriculum of the basic education program this School Year 2025-2026.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Leonil Salvilla, Spokersperson sang Department of Education (DepEd) Schools Division of Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga i-implementar ang bag-o nga mga programa sang Senior High School sa Guimbal National High School, Iloilo National High School, Oton National High School, San Rafael National High School, Cabanbanan National High School, Leganes National High School, Anilao National High School, Sta Rita National High School, Deogracias G. Arlos National High School, Sara National High School, Polopiña National High School, Dela Paz National High School, kag Bulalacao National High School.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Leonil Salvilla, spokesperson of the Department of Education (DepEd) Schools Division of Iloilo, said the new Senior High School programs will be implemented in Guimbal National High School, Iloilo National High School, Oton National High School, San Rafael National High School, Caban National High School, Legan National High School, Legan National High School, Anila National High School, Anila National High School Sta Rita National High School, Deogracias G. Arlos National High School, Sara National High School, Polopiña National High School, Dela Paz National High School, and Bulalacao National High School.

text: Suno kay Salvilla, sige-sige ang pagsinapol agud nga mapatuman ang implementasyon sa masunod nga school year sa masobra 170 nga secondary schools sa Iloilo.
english: According to Salvilla, meetings are ongoing to implement the implementation next school year in more than 170 secondary schools in Iloilo.

text: Antes nagdesisyon nga ipatuman sa 13 ka secondary schools ang amo nga tikang, nagpatuman sang application kag assessment ang talatapan sa tagsa ka mga eskwelahan agud matumod kon handa gidman sila nga magpatuman sang strengthen Senior High School Program.
english: Before deciding to implement the measure in 13 secondary schools, the office conducted an application and assessment in each school to determine if they are ready to implement the strengthen Senior High School Program.

text: Dugang sini nga isa sa mga key features sang bag-o nga kurikulum amo ang pagbuhin sang mga panguna nga mga subject gikan sa 15 nga ginatanyag kada semester, pakadto sa lima lamang nga igatanyag sa bug-os nga tuig sa Grade 11.
english: He added that one of the key features of the new curriculum is the reduction of core subjects from 15 offered per semester, to just five that will be offered throughout the year in Grade 11.

text: Ining lima ka bag-o nga mga subject amo ang: Effective Communication (Mabisang Komunikasyon), Life Skills, General Mathematics, General Science, and Pag-aaral ng Kasaysayan kag Lipunang Pilipino.
english: These five new subjects are: Effective Communication, Life Skills, General Mathematics, General Science, and Philippine History and Society.

text: Nahibaluan nga masobra 800 ka mga eskwelahan sa bug-os nga pungsod ang natalana nga mag-intra sa pilot run sang ginbag-o nga kurikulum sang SHS.
english: More than 800 schools across the country are set to participate in the pilot run of the revised SHS curriculum.

text: Samtang, sa ginpatigayon nga House Committee on Basic Education and Culture briefing, una nga ginlista sang central office sang DepEd ang 727 ka mga buluthuan ang ginklasipikar nga “highly ready” nga malakip sa trial sang “strengthened” program para sa Grades 11 kag 12.
english: Meanwhile, in the House Committee on Basic Education and Culture briefing, the DepEd central office first listed 727 schools classified as “highly ready” to be included in the trial of the “strengthened” program for Grades 11 and 12.

text: Samtang, ang 841 ka mga pilot schools nagarepresentar sang 6.60% sang 12,739 ka kabug-usan nga mga eskwelahan sang SHS sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: Meanwhile, the 841 pilot schools represent 6.60% of the 12,739 total SHS schools nationwide.

text: Sa sini nga 841 ka mga eskwelahan, 580 ang pampubliko kag 261 ang pribado.
english: Of these 841 schools, 580 are public and 261 are private.

text: 806 sang learning institutions ang naghalin sa urban areas, samtang 35 ang gikan sa mga kaumhan ukon rural areas.
english: 806 of the learning institutions are from urban areas, while 35 are from rural areas.

text: Nagsaka na sa 14 ang napatay kag 176 ang nasamaran sa Vietnam matapos nag-landfall ang Super Typhoon Yagi ukon kilala anay nga si Bagyo Enteng sang yari pa sa Pilipinas.
english: The death toll from Super Typhoon Yagi, formerly known as Typhoon Enteng, has risen to 14 in Vietnam.

text: Masobra 3 million ka mga residente ang nawad-an sang suplay sang kuryente sa northern Vietnam samtang masobra naman sa 116,100 hectares sang mga prutasan kag humayan ang nahalitan.
english: More than 3 million residents lost power supply in northern Vietnam while more than 116,100 hectares of orchards and rice fields were damaged.

text: Magluwas pa ini sa ginatos ka flights nga ginkanselar bangud sa temporaryo nga pagsirado sang apat ka airports.
english: This is in addition to hundreds of flights canceled due to the temporary closure of four airports.

text: Nahibaluan nga nag-landfall ang bagyo sa northern coastal provinces sang Quang Ninh kag Haiphong dala ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 149 kilometers per hour (92 miles per hour) sang Sabado sang hapon antes naghinay sa tropical depression sang Domingo sang aga.
english: The typhoon made landfall in the northern coastal provinces of Quang Ninh and Haiphong with winds of 149 kilometers per hour (92 miles per hour) on Saturday afternoon before weakening into a tropical depression on Sunday morning.

text: Antes sa Vietnam, nag-agi man ang bagyo sa isla sang Hainan nga isa ka popular tourist destination sa China kun sa diin 400,000 ka mga tawo ang nagbakwit kag tatlo ang na-rekord nga patay.
english: Before Vietnam, the typhoon also passed through the island of Hainan, a popular tourist destination in China where 400,000 people were evacuated and three were recorded dead.

text: Naglaslas man ini sa Pilipinas kun sa diin sa latest record sang National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC), 20 na ang ginbilin nga patay kag 26 pa ang missing.
english: It also hit the Philippines where according to the latest record of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC), 20 people have been left dead and 26 are still missing.

text: Nagapati ang gobyerno kag pribado nga sektor nga dako ang tyansa sang Pilipinas nga mangin e-commerce leader sa Southeast Asia.
english: The government and private sector believe that the Philippines has a great chance of becoming an e-commerce leader in Southeast Asia.

text: Suno kay Department of Trade and Industry (DT) Secretary Ramon Lopez, masarangan nga mangin e-commerce leader ang pungsod kun buligan ini sang sosyudad.
english: According to Department of Trade and Industry (DT) Secretary Ramon Lopez, the country can become an e-commerce leader if society helps it.

text: Base sa data sang DTI, ang mga online businesses nga naga-involve sang retail trade ang nagtaas halin sa 1,848 sang Enero tubtob Marso sang nagligad nga tuig tubtob sa 88,575 sa katapusan sang 2020.
english: Based on DTI data, online businesses involving retail trade increased from 1,848 in January to March last year to 88,575 at the end of 2020.

text: Ginalantaw sang ahensya nga mas magataas pa ang numero sang e-commerce enterprises gikan sa 500,000 sang 2020 tubtob 1 million sa 2022.
english: The agency expects the number of e-commerce enterprises to increase further from 500,000 in 2020 to 1 million in 2022.

text: Maga-abante na sa third round sang US Open junior girls tournament ang Filipina tennis ace nga si Alex Eala.
english: Filipina tennis ace Alex Eala will advance to the third round of the US Open junior girls tournament.

text: Ini matapos ginlutos ni Eala ang American player nga si Charlotte Owensby sa score nga 6-3 sa round 32 sang hampang.
english: Eala defeated American player Charlotte Owensby 6-3 in round 32 of the match.

text: Paga-atubangon sang seed number 2 nga si Eala ang tiglawas sang Greece nga si Michaela Laki sa masunod nga round.
english: Seed number 2 Eala will face Greece representative Michaela Laki in the next round.

text: Magahampang man si Eala sa junior double tournament kaupod ang tiglawas sang Belgium nga si Hanne Vandewinkel.
english: Eala will also play in the junior doubles tournament alongside Belgian representative Hanne Vandewinkel.

text: SINGAPORE – Hugot nga seguridad ng ginpatuman sa Singapore pila ka adlaw antes ang pagbisita sang Santo Papa sa Setyembre 11 tubtob 13.
english: SINGAPORE – Tight security has been imposed in Singapore a few days ahead of the Pope's visit on September 11 to 13.

text: Suno kay Bombo Phenny Sasa Suing, international correspondent sa Singapore, lakip sa mga apektado nga event venues nga naka-heightened security amo ang Changi International Airport, hotels kag mga dalanon nga labayan sang mga delegates.
english: According to Bombo Phenny Sasa Suing, international correspondent in Singapore, among the affected event venues with heightened security are Changi International Airport, hotels and roads that delegates will pass through.

text:
Ang official events sang Santo Papa amo ang mga masunod:

Setyembre 11: Maabot ini sa Singapore.
english:
The Pope’s official events are as follows:

September 11: It arrives in Singapore.

text: Setyembre 12: Matambong ini sa welcome ceremony sa Parliament House kaupod si President Tharman Shanmugaratnam kag Prime Minister Lawrence Wong.
english: September 12: He will attend the welcome ceremony at Parliament House alongside President Tharman Shanmugaratnam and Prime Minister Lawrence Wong.

text: Matapos sini, makigkita si Pope Francis sa mga myembro sang civil society, diplomatic corps, kag iban pa sa the University Cultural Centre sa National University of Singapore sa aga.
english: Afterwards, Pope Francis will meet with members of civil society, diplomatic corps, and others at the University Cultural Center at the National University of Singapore in the morning.

text: Sa hapon naman, pangunahan sini ang misa sa National Stadium.
english: In the afternoon, he will lead a mass at the National Stadium.

text: Setyembre 13: Mabisita ini sa mga tigulang kag mga masakiton sa St.
english: September 13: It will visit the elderly and sick at St.

text: Theresa Home kag magatambong man sa interreligious meeting kaupod ang mga youths sa Catholic Junior College.
english: Theresa Home and will also attend an interreligious meeting with the youth of the Catholic Junior College.

text: Sa amo man nga adlaw, mabiya na ini sa Singapore.
english: On the same day, it will leave Singapore.

text: Ipatuman naman ang traffic restrictions, lakip na ang diversions kag road closures, partikular sa mga event venues, particular sa hiwatan sang holy mass sa National Stadium.
english: Traffic restrictions, including diversions and road closures, will be implemented, particularly at event venues, particularly during the holy mass at the National Stadium.

text: Wala naman sang may ginpagwa ang mga otoridad nga pahamog sa kahiwatan, apang ang posibilidad sang terorismo ang wala nila ginadula bangud man sa presensya sang radical nga Islamist elements.
english: Authorities did not issue any threats at the event, but they do not rule out the possibility of terrorism due to the presence of radical Islamist elements.

text: Nagpakig-angot kay Department of Justice (DOJ) Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla ang isa ka abogado nga naga-represent sang isa sa Top 15 contractors sang government-funded nga flood control projects.
english: A lawyer representing one of the Top 15 contractors of government-funded flood control projects contacted Department of Justice (DOJ) Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla.

text: Suno kay Remulla, isa ini ka “potential whistleblower”.
english: Remulla said he was a “potential whistleblower”.

text: Pahayag sang tiglikom, naghatag ang abogado sang ideya kun ano ang nagakatabo sa isa sa “ghost projects” sa Central Luzon.
english: The secretary said the lawyer gave an idea of ​​what is happening in one of the ghost projects in Central Luzon.

text: “I have been approached by a lawyer representing a potential whistleblower and they have told me— he’s given me an idea of what happened in one of the projects in Central Luzon, in projects worth P5 billion.
english: “I have been approached by a lawyer representing a potential whistleblower and they have told me— he’s given me an idea of ​​what happened in one of the projects in Central Luzon, in projects worth P5 billion.

text: Ghost projects,” suno kay Remulla.
english: Ghost projects,” Remulla said.

text: Ginkumpirma sini nga naghalin ang abogado sa isa sa 15 ka mga kontraktor nga ginlawag ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: He confirmed that the lawyer came from one of the 15 contractors sought by President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: nga amo ang involved sa maanomaliya nga flood control projects.
english: who are involved in anomalous flood control projects.

text: Suno pa sa Justice secretary, ginpahibalo man siya sang abogado nga mahimo sini ibuyagyag sa gobyerno ang nagakatabo sa modus operandi, ang distribusyon sang kuwarta, ang kontrata, kag ang mga iregularidad.
english: The Justice secretary said the lawyer also informed him that he could reveal to the government what was happening in the modus operandi, the distribution of money, the contract, and the irregularities.

text: “Hindi pa tumutuloy.
english: “It’s not going on yet.

text: Nagbigay lang sa akin ng idea na ‘yung contractor ang kinuha 40%, ang DPWH ganto, na ma-encash ‘yung pera… kahit na DPWH lang ang payable sa contractor.
english: It just gave me the idea that the contractor took 40%, the DPWH that, that the money can be encashed... even if only the DPWH is payable to the contractor.

text: Basta’t marami nang modus na sinabi sa akin nu’ng Sabado,” pahayag ni Remulla.
english: I was told many modus operandi on Saturday,” Remulla said.

text: Dugang sini, nagahulat pa siya sang ebidensya halin sa abogado.
english: He added that he is still waiting for evidence from the lawyer.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini sa iban nga posible nga whistleblowers nga magpalapit sa DOJ, kag kun kinahanglan, mahimo man sila mabutang sa Witness Protection Program sang ahensya.#
english: He also called on other potential whistleblowers to approach the DOJ, and if necessary, they can also be placed in the agency's Witness Protection Program.

text: ILOILO CITY – Bugal kag kadalag-an para sa isa ka manunudlo ang makita nga makatapos sa pagtuon kag maka-angkon sang maayo nga pagpangabuhi ang iya mga estudyante.
english: ILOILO CITY – It is a pride and success for a teacher to see his students graduate and have a good life.

text: Ini ang sabat ni Judy Fabular, basketball coach, school clinic teacher sang Iloilo Central Elementary School kag Alternative Learning System teacher sa female dormitory sang Bureau of Jail Management and Penology, sa pamangkot kun anu ang nagatulod sa iya nga magpadayon sa pagtudlo sa pihak sang kabudlay kag kasakuon sa trabaho.
english: This is the answer of Judy Fabular, basketball coach, school clinic teacher of Iloilo Central Elementary School and Alternative Learning System teacher in the female dormitory of the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology, to the question of what motivates her to continue teaching despite the difficulties and busyness of work.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Fabular, iya ginpahayag nga naghalin siya sa pigado nga pamilya kag kinahanglan niya nga magpangabudlay para nga makatapos sa pagtuon kag maka-angkon sang trabaho.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Fabular said he came from a poor family and had to work hard to finish his studies and get a job.

text: Suno kay kay Fabular, ang iya naagyan nga kabudlay sa pagpangabuhi ang nagatulod sa iya nga magpadayon sa teaching career agud nga makabulig man sa mga tawo nga nagakinahanglan sang paggiya.
english: According to Fabular, his hardships in life motivate him to continue his teaching career so that he can help people who need guidance.

text: Ginpahayag ni Fabular nga kapin na sa duha ka dekada siya nga nangin isa ka manunudlo sa elementary kag manug-apat ka tuig nga manunudlo sa Alternative Learning System sa tagsa ka Sabado.
english: Fabular said he has been an elementary teacher for more than two decades and a four-year teacher in the Alternative Learning System every Saturday.

text: Bilang isa ka manunudlo, ginpahayag ni Fabular nga indi lamang ang pagtudlo sang maayo ang iya katungdanan kundi lakip man ang pagganyat sa mga estudyante nga magpadayon sa pagtuon.
english: As a teacher, Fabular said it is not only his duty to teach well but also to encourage students to continue learning.

text: Indi kasubong sa regular students, ginpahayag sang natungdan nga mas madamu ang pagpanghangkat sa iya pagtudlo sa mga Persons Deprived of Liberty ukon mga preso.
english: Unlike regular students, he said there are more challenges in teaching Persons Deprived of Liberty or prisoners.

text: Ini bangud nga sa kakulang sa pondo, siya na mismo ang nagamato-mato sa pagbakal sang mga kinahanglanon agud nga makatudlo sang maayo sa mga estudyante nga preso.
english: This is because due to lack of funds, he himself is struggling to buy the necessities to teach the students who are incarcerated.

text: Ang iban sa mga preso suno kay Fabular ang indi madali nga tudlu-an rason nga kinahanglan niya nga id-idan ang pagtudlo.
english: Some of the inmates, Fabular said, are not easy to teach so he needs to improve the teaching.

text: Ang Sabado nga adlaw suno kay Fabular ang para kun tani sa iya pahuway apang mas ginpili niya nga magtudlo agud nga makabulig sa mga preso nga maka-angkon sang maayo nga kabuhi sa tion nga makaguwa na sa presuhan.
english: Fabular said Saturday was supposed to be for his rest but he chose to teach in order to help the inmates have a better life when they are released from jail.

text: Indi mabayaran sang kwarta suno sa natungdan ang kalipay nga iya nabatyagan sa tion nga makita nga madamu sa iya mga estudyante ang nakatapos sa elementary kag high school tubtub nga makatapos sa kolehiyo kag makapangita sang maayo nga trabaho.
english: Money cannot pay for the joy he felt when he saw many of his students graduate from elementary and high school until they graduated from college and found a good job.

text: Ginpatpat sang law expert ang mga katalagman sang cyber libel nga nangin isa ka concern para sa mga indibidwal kag mga organisasyon.
english: The law expert explained the dangers of cyber libel which has become a concern for both individuals and organizations.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Alfredo Arungayan, Bombo Abogado, iya ginpahayag nga ang isa ka ‘careless’ nga tweet, komento, ukon blog post indi lamang makahalit sa reputasyon—kundi makadala man sa mga tawo sa daku nga legal nga problema.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Alfredo Arungayan, Bombo Abogado, he stated that a ‘careless’ tweet, comment, or blog post can not only damage reputation—but also get people into serious legal trouble.

text: Suno kay Arungayan, ang mahimo harmless nga online rant mahimo nga magdaku sa isa ka full-blown nga kaso, nga may mga penalidad nga nagahalin sa mabug-at nga multa tubtob sa pagkapreso, depende sa layi.
english: Arungayan said what may be a harmless online rant can escalate into a full-blown case, with penalties ranging from hefty fines to jail time, depending on the law.

text: Dugang sini nga ang freedom of speech wala nagahatag sang immunity gikan sa legal nga salabton, ilabi na kon ang reputasyon ginhalitan sang false statements.
english: It added that freedom of speech does not provide immunity from legal liability, especially when reputation has been damaged by false statements.

text: Mahimo naman nga matumod ang cyber libel paagi sa pagpanglibak ukon pagpamuyayaw nga may kabutigan batok sa isa ka tawo ukon organisasyon pinaagi sa internet—pareho sang Facebook, Twitter, ukon blog posts.
english: Cyber ​​libel can be defined as slander or slander that is false against a person or organization through the internet—such as Facebook, Twitter, or blog posts.

text: Panugyan sini sa publiko nga sa subong, ang pinaka-epektibo nga depensa amo ang: responsable, matinlo, kag may respeto nga paggamit sang social media.
english: He advised the public that for now, the most effective defense is: responsible, clean, and respectful use of social media.

text: Ginlaslasan sang United Broilers and Raisers Association (UBRA) ang Department of Agriculture.
english: The United Broilers and Raisers Association (UBRA) lashed out at the Department of Agriculture.

text: Ini ang kasunod sang padayon nga pagpahanugot sang ahensya sa importation sang poultry products nga nagaapekto sa palangabuhian sang local farmers.
english: This follows the agency's continued allowance of the importation of poultry products which affects the livelihood of local farmers.

text: Suno kay UBRA President Atty. Jose Elias Inciong, napaslawan ang DA sa paghatag sang suporta kag bulig sa ila nga mga local chicken producers.
english: According to UBRA President Atty. Jose Elias Inciong, the DA has failed to provide support and assistance to their local chicken producers.

text: Dugang pa niya, produkto man sang manok ukon baboy basta ginapahanugutan ang pagpasulod sa pungsod, pat-od nga apektado sila tanan nga local farmers.
english: He added that whether chicken or pork products are allowed to enter the country, all local farmers will be affected.

text: Nag-landfall na si Super Typhoon Yagi sa probinsya sang Hainan nga isa ka popular nga kaladtuan sang mga turista sa southern China.
english: Super Typhoon Yagi has made landfall in Hainan province, a popular tourist destination in southern China.

text: Suno sa meteorological service, naglaslas si Yagi sa Wenchang City sa amo nga probinsya pasado alas kuatro sa hapon samtang dala ang kabaskugon nga 245km/h malapit sa sentro.
english: According to the meteorological service, Yagi struck Wenchang City in the province around 4 pm with winds of 245km/h near the center.

text: Antes ang landfall, nahingagaw na nga napabakwit sang gobyerno ang 419,000 ka mga tawo sa amo nga island province.
english: Before the landfall, the government had already evacuated 419,000 people in the island province.

text: Ginkanselar man ang flights sa Hainan, Guangdong, Hong Kong kag Macau, amo man ang mga bangko kag eskwelahan.
english: Flights to Hainan, Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macau were also cancelled, as were banks and schools.

text: Indi kinaandan ang pag-landfall sini sa Hainan bangud halin sang 1949 tubtub sang 2023, 106 ka mga bagyo ang nag-agi sa isla apang siyam lamang ang nagtupa sa kategorya nga super typhoon.
english: Its landfall in Hainan is unusual because from 1949 to 2023, 106 typhoons have passed through the island but only nine have fallen into the super typhoon category.

text: Ang Yagi nga kilala anay nga Bagyo Enteng sang yari pa sa Pilipinas amo ang ikaduha nga pinakabaskog nga tropical cyclone sa 2024 kasunod sa Category 5 Atlantic Hurricane Beryl nga amo naman ang naglaslas sa Pacific basin.
english: Yagi, formerly known as Typhoon Enteng when it was in the Philippines, is the second strongest tropical cyclone in 2024 after Category 5 Atlantic Hurricane Beryl which also tore through the Pacific basin.

text: 16 ka mga tawo ang napatay sa Pilipinas antes ini nagguwa sa Philippine Area of Responsibility sang nagligad nga Miyerkules.
english: 16 people died in the Philippines before it left the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility last Wednesday.

text: Ginalantaw nga magalaslas ini pati sa Guangdong province sa China antes maghulag pakadto sa direksyon sang Beibu Gulf.
english: It is expected to hit Guangdong province in China before moving towards the Beibu Gulf.

text:
Kun basehan ang track forecast, pagkatapos sa southern China, maga-diretso ang bagyo sa Vietnam, particular sa northern kag north-central regions sa palibot mismo sang UNESCO heritage site nga Halong Bay sa weekend.#

(Photo: Guo Cheng, AP)
english:
Based on the track forecast, after southern China, the typhoon will head straight to Vietnam, particularly in the northern and north-central regions around the UNESCO heritage site Halong Bay over the weekend.

(Photo: Guo Cheng, AP)

text: Sa bisperas sang national and local elections, nagpahanumdom si Msgr.
english: On the eve of the national and local elections, Msgr.

text: Meliton Oso, director sang Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center, sa mga botante nga magpamati sa konsensya kag panumduman gid sang maayo kun sin-o ang pilion nga kandidato.
english: Meliton Oso, director of the Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center, urged voters to listen to their conscience and remember carefully who to choose as a candidate.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Oso kasunod sang Holy Mass sa Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral, ginpahayag sini nga dapat nga ilugon ang ginhimo sang cardinal electors sang ginpili si Pope Leo XIV sang nagligad nga adlaw bilang bag-o nga lider sang Simbahang Katolika.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal after the Holy Mass at the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral, Oso said that the cardinal electors should imitate the actions of the cardinal electors when they elected Pope Leo XIV yesterday as the new leader of the Catholic Church.

text: Suno kay Oso, nagtipon ang mga cardinal, nag-discern, nag-assess, nagpangita sang common good, kag nagpamati gid sa Espiritu Santo.
english: According to Oso, the cardinals met, discerned, assessed, sought the common good, and really listened to the Holy Spirit.

text: Dugang pa ni Oso nga amo man ang Iloilo Chairman sang Parish Pastoral Council for Responsible Voting, dapat nga indi gid magbaligya ang mga pumuluyo sang ila nga mga boto.
english: Oso, who is also the Iloilo Chairman of the Parish Pastoral Council for Responsible Voting, added that the people should never sell their votes.

text: Apang pananglitan nga nakabaton na suno kay Oso, dapat nga magbawi kag magpamati sa konsensya antes magkadto sa polling center agud nga magboto.
english: But if you have already received, Oso said, you should withdraw and listen to your conscience before going to the polling center to vote.

text: “Nag-timing gid nga ginasaulog naton ang Good Shepherd Sunday.
english: “It is very timely that we celebrate Good Shepherd Sunday.

text: Ang Shepherd, [sandig] sa Bibliya, ginagamit sa tanan nga lider — sa simbahan man o sa public service.
english: Shepherd, [based on] the Bible, is used of all leaders — whether in the church or in public service.

text: Gani buwas, kun magkadto kita sa mga presinto, magapili kita sang aton nga Shepherd.
english: So tomorrow, when we go to the polling stations, we will choose our Shepherd.

text: Kabay nga ilugon naton ang mga Cardinal nga nag-discern, nag-assess, nagpangita sang common good.
english: May we emulate the Cardinals who discerned, assessed, sought the common good.

text: Please do that,” pahayag ni Oso.
english: Please do that,” Oso stated.

text: Nagtaliwan ang isa ka American climber nga si Balin Miller sa edad nga 23 anyos matapos ini mahulog samtang nagasaka sa El Capitan summit sa Yosemite National Park sa California, USA.
english: American climber Balin Miller died at the age of 23 after he fell while climbing El Capitan summit in Yosemite National Park in California, USA.

text: Ginkumpirmar mismo sang iloy ni Miller nga si Jeanine Moorman ang masubo nga balita sang iya kamatayon.
english: Miller’s mother Jeanine Moorman herself confirmed the sad news of his death.

text: Suno sa mga otoridad, tuyo kuntani ni Miller nga sakaon ang El Capitan, isa sa mga pinakapopular kag delikado nga rock formations sa Estados Unidos, nga may kaatason nga 3,000 ka tapak sa valley floor sang Sea of Dreams.
english: According to authorities, Miller had intended to climb El Capitan, one of the most popular and dangerous rock formations in the United States, which is 3,000 feet high on the valley floor of the Sea of ​​Dreams.

text: Kilala si Miller sa climbing community, kag ginadokumento pa niya ang iya mga pagsaka paagi sa live videos sa iya social media accounts, nga ginatutukan sang madamo niya nga followers.
english: Miller is well-known in the climbing community, and he even documents his ascents with live videos on his social media accounts, which many of his followers focus on.

text: Kun indi mo halos ma-imagine ang moment nga makit-an mo sa personal ang dekalibre nga Hollywood megastar nga si Brad Pitt, ano pa gid ayhan kun maka-relasyon mo ang aktor?
english: If you can't almost imagine the moment when you see the decaliber Hollywood megastar Brad Pitt in person, what else can you do if you can have a relationship with the actor?

text: Siguro feeling mo, daw si Angelina Jolie man ikaw ka-guwapa!
english: Maybe you feel like you're as beautiful as Angelina Jolie!

text: Apang may yara sang isa ka babaye nga naka-relasyon ini nga actor — ukon at least, sa iya nga pagpati, nagpalanggaanay sila nga duha sa sulod sang malawig nga tion.
english: But there was a woman this actor was in a relationship with — or at least, he believed, the two loved each other for a long time.

text: Eksperyensya ini ni ‘Anne’, isa ka 53-anyos nga French interior decorator.
english: This is the experience of ‘Anne’, a 53-year-old French interior decorator.

text: Isa ka bes, samtang yara sa Instagram, nag-post ang babaye sang iya nga mga laragway matapos nag-ski.
english: Once, while on Instagram, the woman posted pictures of herself after skiing.

text: Gilayon nga may nag-chat sa iya nga isa man ka babaye nga nagpakilala nga siya si Jane Pitt nga amo ang iloy ni Brad Pitt.
english: He immediately received a chat from another woman who introduced herself as Jane Pitt, the mother of Brad Pitt.

text: Samtang nagalawig ang ila istoryahanay, gina-sige insister ni Jane Pitt nga bagay gid si Anne sa iya nga anak.
english: As their conversation progressed, Jane Pitt insisted that Anne was perfect for her daughter.

text: Wala magdugay, may lalaki na nga nag-chat kay Anne sa Instagram kag amo na ang nagpakilala nga siya si Brad Pitt, adlaw-adlaw sila nga nagbayluhanay sang mensahe, tubtub nga… to make the long story short, na-in love si Anne kay Brad Pitt bangud ka-thoughtful kuno sa iya kag interesado gid ini sa iya kabuhi.
english: Soon, a man chatted with Anne on Instagram and introduced himself as Brad Pitt, they exchanged messages every day, until... to make the long story short, Anne fell in love with Brad Pitt because he was thoughtful and interested in her life.

text: Suno kay Anne, wala gid nagakalipat si Brad Pitt nga pamangkuton siya sa iya passion, iya trabaho, kag iya pamilya.
english: According to Anne, Brad Pitt never forgets to ask her about her passion, her job, and her family.

text: Ginapadal-an man siya sang poems, mga kanta, kag mga selfies nga indi man makita ni Anne sa iban nga social media pages.
english: She is also sent poems, songs, and selfies that Anne cannot find on other social media pages.

text: Masobra isa ka tuig man nga ginpinsar ni Anne nga ka-long distance relationship sini ang actor.
english: For more than a year, Anne also thought that the actor was in a long distance relationship with her.

text: Sa amo sina kalawig nga relasyon, nakapanugid man si Anne kaangot sa iya divorce sa iya anay manggaranon nga bana.
english: During such a long relationship, Anne also opened up about her divorce from her former wealthy husband.

text: May ginbilin ini sa iya nga daku nga kantidad sang kuwarta kag amo ini ang iya ginagamit magluwas pa sa iya trabaho bilang interior decorator.
english: This left him with a large sum of money and this is what he used in addition to his job as an interior decorator.

text: Sang ulihi, nagpanugid man si Brad Pitt nga may gina-suprer siya nga seryoso nga balatian sa kidney kag naka-admit siya sa ospital, apang indi sini masarangan bayad ang bill bangud sa iya nga pagproseso sang divorce kay Angelina Jolie.
english: Later, Brad Pitt also revealed that he was suffering from serious kidney disease and was admitted to the hospital, but he could not afford to pay the bill because of his divorce process with Angelina Jolie.

text: Bangud in love man sila sa isa kag isa, wala gid nagduha-duha si Anne kag nagpadala ini sang kuwarta.
english: Because they were in love with each other, Anne did not hesitate and sent the money.

text: Naglab-ot ini sa $850,000 ukon masobra P49.70-million lakip na dira ang iya nabaton halin sa divorce settlement.
english: This amounted to $850,000 or more than P49.70-million including what he received from the divorce settlement.

text: Nareyalisar lamang ni Anne nga biktima gali siya sang scam sang nakit-an sini sa balita nga karelasyon gali ni Brad Pitt ang Swiss jewelry professional nga si Ines de Ramon.
english: Anne only realized that she was a victim of a scam when she saw on the news that Brad Pitt was dating Swiss jewelry professional Ines de Ramon.

text: Daw kagton sini ang iya siko sa paghinulsol, apang tuman na gid ka ulihi ang tanan, nadulaan na siya sang lovelife, namigado pa siya bangud sa amo nga scam.
english: He wanted to bite his elbow in regret, but it was too late, he lost his lovelife, he became poor because of the scam.

text: Ulihi man sini nareyalisar nga produkto sang AI ukon Artificial Intelligence ang tanan nga pictures nga ginsend sa iya rason nga indi sini makit-an sa iban nga social media page.
english: He later realized that all the pictures sent to him were products of AI or Artificial Intelligence, which is why he could not find them on other social media pages.

text: Naka-file na si Anne sang reklamo sa pulis kaangot sa scam apang indi klaro kun ano na ang progress ukon may paglaum pa nga masolbar ang iya nga kaso.
english: Anne has already filed a complaint with the police regarding the scam but it is not clear what progress has been made or whether there is any hope that her case will be resolved.

text: Matapos ang binulan nga pagpanago bangud sang ginaalegar warrant of arrest batok sa iya, ginabati-bati nga magatuhaw na gid man si Senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa: indi sa Senado, kundi sa Baguio City.
english: After months of hiding due to an alleged warrant of arrest against him, it is rumored that Senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa will finally appear: not in the Senate, but in Baguio City.

text: Lakip ini sa kaundan sang sulat nga ginpadala ni Dela Rosa kay Senate President Vicente “Tito” Sotto III nga napetsahan Marso 12, 2026.
english: This is among the contents of the letter sent by Dela Rosa to Senate President Vicente “Tito” Sotto III dated March 12, 2026.

text: Sa amo nga sulat, nagahingyo ang senador nga pagamiton ang iya pamilya sang Senate Mansion sa Baguio halin sa Marso 26 tubtub 29.
english: In the letter, the senator requested that his family use the Senate Mansion in Baguio from March 26 to 29.

text: Ginpahayag ni Dela Rosa nga para ini sa Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces of the Philippines ukon CSAFP Cup 2026, isa ka shooting competition kun sa diin involved ang uniformed services sang pungsod.
english: Dela Rosa said it is for the Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces of the Philippines or CSAFP Cup 2026, a shooting competition involving the country's uniformed services.

text: Hiwaton ini nga kumpetisyon sa Philippine Military Academy (PMA) firing range sa Fort Del Pilar, Baguio City.
english: The competition will be held at the Philippine Military Academy (PMA) firing range in Fort Del Pilar, Baguio City.

text: “The mansion will be used solely to accommodate the undersigned’s family during the CSAFP Cup 2026 in Baguio City,” suno sa sulat nga pirmado mismo ni Dela Rosa.
english: “The mansion will be used solely to accommodate the undersigned’s family during the CSAFP Cup 2026 in Baguio City,” according to the letter signed by Dela Rosa himself.

text: Apang base sa inisyal nga impormasyon, gina-renovate subong ang Senate Mansion gani posible nga indi man ini pag-ipagamit.
english: However, based on initial information, the Senate Mansion is currently being renovated so it is possible that it will not be used.

text: Ginahulat pa ang pormal nga sabat sang Senado.
english: A formal response from the Senate is still awaited.

text: Sa idalom sang pagsulundan sang upper chamber, mahimo lamang magamit ang Senate Mansion sa Baguio kun yara mismo ang pisikal nga presensya sang senador nga naga-request.
english: Under the rules of the upper chamber, the Senate Mansion in Baguio can only be used in the physical presence of the requesting senator.
